hero.sub: Onye njikwa nchọpụta & nkwenye maka netwọkụ Vortex ndị ọgbọ na ndị ọgbọ. Mepee. ezoro ezo. Enweghị nkwụsị.

network.label: NETWORK
network.body: Ndị ọgbọ ọ bụla nwere njirimara mbinye aka. Ndị ahịa na-enyocha tupu ijikọ, ọnụ na-egosi nwe ya na ndebanye aha. Ọ nweghị ikike etiti nwere ike ịgha ụgha ihe nzuzo ekwenyelarị.
network.dual_body: Debanyere aha ya na onye njikwa AND mechiri emechi na yinye site na Solana. Ndị akaebe abụọ nọọrọ onwe ha na-akwado koodu hash na pubkey. Ọ dị mma maka nnọkọ nwere mmetụta.
network.ctrl_body: mbinye aka na-egosi na ọnụ nwere igodo nzuzo ya, mana koodu iguzosi ike n'ezi ihe adabaghị n'agbụ. Ọ dị mma maka ọtụtụ oge; ize ndụ = tụkwasara onye ọrụ njikwa obi.
network.unverif_body: Amara site na nhazi ma ọ bụ asịrị. Enweghị ihe akaebe cryptographic. Jiri naanị iji buo listi ndị ọgbọ - ọ dịghị mgbe ọ dị ka ebumnuche aka maka nnọkọ ndụ.

security.label: SECURITY
security.body: Keypair Ed25519 anọ kwụụrụ onwe ya, nke ọ bụla nwere otu ọrụ dị warara. Nkwenye nke igodo ọ bụla anaghị agbaji ndị ọzọ.
security.controller_verified: Ndị ahịa - sitere na SNS ma ọ bụ rụpụta pin
security.step1_d: Gụọ vortexx.sol on-chain. Ndekọ ndị Solana bịanyere aka na ya - agaghị ekwe omume ịpụnara DNS.
security.step2_d: Oku ndị ahịa /v1/integrity. Na-ajụ nzaghachi ọ bụla ewezuga status: verified site na igodo ntọhapụ etinyere.
security.step3_d: Oku ọ bụla API na-alaghachi {payload, sig, signed_by}. Onye ahịa na-enyocha mbinye aka Ed25519 tupu ịtụkwasị obi.
security.step4_d: Ọnụ akara akara: onye ahịa na-agụ code_hash site na ndekọ Solana. Ọdịiche site na njikwa = edebanye aha na-adịgide adịgide.
security.check_auth: Nzizi azịza - agaghị ekwe omume ịme /v1/nodes na-enweghị igodo nzuzo nke onye njikwa.
security.check_integrity: Code iguzosi ike n'ezi ihe - faịlụ ndị njikwa ehichapụ ma na-enyocha ya na mmalite ọ bụla. Ntugharị na-eweghachite 503 tupu ebugara okporo ụzọ ọ bụla.
security.check_identity: Node njirimara - ọnụ ga-eji igodo nke ha debanye aha. Onye na-awakpo enweghị ike ịdebanye aha n'aha igodo ọnụ ụzọ ọzọ.
security.check_dns: DNS Nchekwa nhicha — .sol records live on Solana. Onye mmegide kwesịrị imebi obere akpa ahụ, ọ bụghị naanị onye na-edeba aha DNS.
security.check_handoff: Handoff Security - mbufe nnọkọ na-ebu akara Ed25519 nwere mgbochi imegharị, dị naanị nkeji 5. Ebumnuche na-ajụ isi mmalite ndị amabeghị.
security.check_transport: Nzuzo ụgbọ njem - njikọ URL ga-ahụ ISP / Cloudflare gị. Jiri enyo Tor ma ọ bụrụ na metadata dị mkpa.
security.check_content: Ọdịnaya ozi — NOT onye njikwa metụrụ ya aka. ezoro ezo na ngwụcha ruo ngwụcha n'etiti ndị ọrụ. Onye njikwa enweghị ike ịgụ ihe ọ bụla ọbụlagodi na emebiela ya nke ọma.
security.check_host: Ọbịa OS / kernel - ọ bụrụ na VPS gbanyere mkpọrọgwụ, enwere ike izu ohi igodo. Jiri mbinye aka na-akwado ngwaike maka ibunye ihe na-adịghị mma.

access.label: ACCESS
access.heading_line1: Enwere ike iru ya mgbe niile.
access.body: Ebe ntinye ọtụtụ pụtara na ọ nweghị otu ụlọ ọrụ nwere ike igbochi ohere gị. Saịtị mirror na-enye otu ọdịnaya bịanyere aka na ya sitere na akụrụngwa nọọrọ onwe ya.
access.tunnel_body: Adreesị * .trycloudflare.com efu. Enweghị akaụntụ achọrọ. URL na-agbanwe mgbe ọwara malitegharịa - na-emeso dị ka ephemeral.
access.tor_body: Adreesị yabasị, enwere ike ịnweta naanị site na Tor. Nyocha nyocha na metadata-onwe, mana ọ dị nwayọ. Achọrọ onye ahịa Tor.
access.ipfs_body: Mpempe ihu ihu static na-agwa ọdịnaya. Ọnụ ụzọ IPFS ọ bụla nwere ike ijere ya ozi - ọ nweghị otu ihe nkesa ga-egbochi.
access.direct_body: Ngalaba oge niile + TLS. Nhọrọ kacha ọsọ. Enwere ike igbochi na ọkwa DNS/IP - daa azụ na ndị ọzọ ma ọ bụrụ na enyocha ya.
access.mirrors_body: Ndị ọbịa ọzọ na-enye otu ọdịnaya abịanyere aka na ya dị ka onye njikwa a. A na-enyocha enyo ọ bụla kwa oge - ntụpọ akwụkwọ ndụ akwụkwọ ndụ pụtara enwere ike iru n'ime nkeji ise gara aga. Tor .onion enyo enweghị ike ịlele ahụike na-enweghị onye nnọchi anya Tor.

start.label: GET STARTED
start.step1: Wụnye Vortex na ngwaọrụ gị - mkpanaka ma ọ bụ desktọpụ.
start.step3: Tapawa njikwa URL ( edoziziri onwe ya site na SNS) ma ọ bụ ntinye ọ bụla URL site na ibe ndenye.
start.step4: Nyochaa pubkey dị na ngwa gị dabara akara mkpịsị aka njikwa dị n'okpuru. A mismatch pụtara imebi.
start.step5: Ejikọtara gị. A na-edozi ndepụta ọnụ ọnụ, mbinye aka, na ụzọ ụzọ akpaka.
start.fingerprint_note: Tinye igodo a n'ime onye ahịa gị tupu ị tụkwasa nzaghachi ọ bụla.

treasury.label: TREASURY & REWARDS
treasury.transparency_body: Niile ụgwọ protocol - ụgwọ ndebanye aha ọnụ na mbelata 20% nke ndenye aha adịchaghị - na-aga na obere akpa ego na Solana. Onye ọ bụla ga-enyocha azụmahịa ọ bụla n'ihu ọha.
treasury.rewards_body: 70% nke sub nke ọ bụla na-aga na ọdọ mmiri ụgwọ ọrụ, kesaa pro-rata nye ndị na-arụ ọrụ ọnụ. 20% na-akwado isi mmepe. 10% na-ere ọkụ ma ọ bụ na-anọdụ dị ka mkpuchi.

gravitixDocs.title: Ntụaka Asụsụ Gravitix
gravitixDocs.subtitle: Asụsụ edemede dị elu maka iwu bots. 96 atụmatụ. Nchara nchara.
gravitixDocs.introDesc: Gravitix bụ asụsụ akọwapụtara ngalaba (DSL) emebere site na ala maka ide bots Vortex. Ebe asụsụ ndị ọzọ chọrọ ọba akwụkwọ, oku azụ, na efere esi mmiri ọkụ, Gravitix na-enye gị ndị na-ahụ maka mmemme klaasị mbụ, mkparịta ụka na steeti arụnyere - ha niile na syntax dị ọcha, enwere ike ịgụ nke sitere na Rust.
gravitixDocs.goalReadable: Enwere ike ịgụ - koodu na-agụ dị ka ebumnuche, ọ bụghị igwe
gravitixDocs.goalSafe: Safe — ụdị static na-ejide mperi tupu oge ojiri gaa
gravitixDocs.goalExpressive: Ngosipụta - a na-arụ n'ime mmiri, ndị nche na ndakọrịta ụkpụrụ
gravitixDocs.goalMinimal: Opekempe - enweghị klas, enweghị ihe nketa, enweghị usoro mmụta
gravitixDocs.whoDesc: Gravitix bụ maka onye ọ bụla chọrọ iwulite bot Vortex ngwa ngwa - ma ị debeghị koodu mbụ, ma ọ bụ na ị bụ onye nrụpụta nwere ahụmahụ nke ike gwụrụ Python boilerplate. Ntụaka a na-akụzi Gravitix site na ụkpụrụ nke mbụ: enweghị ahụmịhe tupu achọrọ.
gravitixDocs.howToRead: Otu esi agụ akwụkwọ ntụaka a
gravitixDocs.howToReadDesc: Akụkụ nke ọ bụla na-ewuli elu na nke gara aga. Ọ bụrụ na ị dị ọhụrụ na mmemme, gụọ site n'elu ruo na ala. Ọ bụrụ na ị maralarị asụsụ ọzọ, jiri tebụl ọdịnaya wee malie ozugbo gaa n'ihe na-amasị gị.
gravitixDocs.quickStartDesc: Ụzọ kachasị ọsọ site na efu gaa na bot na-agba ọsọ.
gravitixDocs.whatHappenedDesc: na /bido {... } - na-akọwa onye njikwa na-agba ọsọ mgbe onye ọrụ zipụrụ / malite. emit "..." - na-ezigara onye ọrụ ozi. {ctx.first_name} - na-etinye aha mbụ onye ọrụ n'ime eriri.
gravitixDocs.runningDesc: Na Gravitix IDE, pịa bọtịnụ Run na n'elu mmanya. Tinye Vortex Bot Token mgbe kpaliri gị. Bot ahụ na-amalite ozugbo - enweghị usoro nrụpụta achọrọ.
gravitixDocs.syntaxDesc: Ewubere mmemme Gravitix ọ bụla site na ngọngọ ụlọ atọ bụ isi: ndị na-ahụ maka njikwa, nkwupụta mgbasa ozi, na mgbagha.
gravitixDocs.typesDesc: Uru ọ bụla dị na Gravitix nwere ụdị. Ụdị usoro ahụ kwụ ọtọ: a na-enyocha ụdị n'oge nchịkọta, tupu bot gị agba ọsọ.
gravitixDocs.operatorsDesc: Ndị na-arụ ọrụ na-ejikọta ụkpụrụ iji mepụta ụkpụrụ ọhụrụ.
gravitixDocs.arithmeticOps: Ndị na-arụ ọrụ mgbakọ na mwepụ
gravitixDocs.stringsDesc: Ụdọ dị na Gravitix bụ ederede ederede UTF-8. Ha na-akwado ntinye aka bara ụba na otu ụlọ arụrụ arụ ọrụ.
gravitixDocs.stringOperations: Arụ ọrụ eriri site na arụnyere n'ime ya
gravitixDocs.matchDesc: Ụkpụrụ-dakọtara ọnụ ahịa megide ọtụtụ ụkpụrụ. Chee ya dị ka nkwupụta mgbanwe dị ike.
gravitixDocs.functionsDesc: Ọrụ bụ ngọngọ koodu nwere ike ijikwa ọzọ. Ha na-enyere gị aka izere ikwugharị ma mee ka koodu dị mfe nghọta.
gravitixDocs.eventHandlersDesc: Ndị njikwa bụ obi nke bot Gravitix. Onye njikwa ọ bụla na-ege ntị maka otu ụdị mmemme ma na-agba ọsọ mgbe mmemme ahụ mere.
gravitixDocs.guardDesc: Ndị nche na-ahapụ gị ịgbakwunye ọnọdụ na onye njikwa. Onye na-ahụ maka ya na-agba ọsọ naanị ma ọ bụrụ na onye nche na-atụle n'eziokwu.
gravitixDocs.contextDesc: Ihe ctx dị na-akpaghị aka n'ime onye njikwa ọ bụla. O nwere ozi gbasara ozi dị ugbu a yana onye ọrụ zitere ya.
gravitixDocs.stateDesc: State na-ahapụ gị bot icheta ihe n'etiti ozi. Enweghị steeti, ozi ọ bụla nwere onwe ya na bot enweghị ebe nchekwa.
gravitixDocs.flowsDesc: Fgbọ na-enye gị ohere ide mkparịta ụka ọtụtụ nzọụkwụ n'ụdị ahịrị, nke enwere ike ịgụ. Mgbọ mmiri nwere ike kwụsịtụ wee chere ozi onye ọrụ na-esote.
gravitixDocs.emitDesc: Izipu ozi bụ isi mmalite nke bot.
gravitixDocs.schedulingDesc: Gbaa koodu na-akpaghị aka na nhazi oge - enweghị ọrụ cron, ọ nweghị ọrụ mpụga achọrọ.
gravitixDocs.everyRepeat: ọ bụla - ikwugharị na etiti oge
gravitixDocs.atSpecificTime: na - na-agba ọsọ n'otu oge nke ụbọchị
gravitixDocs.pipeDesc: Onye na-ahụ maka ọkpọkọ |> na-enyefe uru dị ka arụmụka mbụ gaa na ọrụ ọzọ. Ọ na-eme ka arụ ọrụ ịhịa aka gụọ, aka ekpe gaa n'aka nri.
gravitixDocs.errorDesc: Gravitix na-enye njikwa njehie ahaziri ahazi na ịnwale / ijide / n'ikpeazụ ngọngọ.
gravitixDocs.structsDesc: Structs na-enye gị ohere ikpokọta data metụtara n'okpuru ụdị aha. Enum na-akọwapụta ụdịdị dị iche iche mechiri emechi.
gravitixDocs.mathDesc: Gravitix na-ebufe ọbá akwụkwọ mgbakọ na mwepụ zuru oke yana ọrụ ~180.
gravitixDocs.complexDesc: Gravitix nwere ụdị mgbagwoju anya nke ala - otu ụzọ 64-bit na-ese n'elu na-anọchite anya akụkụ dị adị na nke echiche.
gravitixDocs.calculusDesc: Gravitix gụnyere mgbako ọnụọgụgụ: mwepụta na integrals gbakọrọ na ọrụ aka ike.
gravitixDocs.linearAlgebraDesc: Linear algebra bụ mgbakọ na mwepụ nke vectors na matrices.
gravitixDocs.numberTheoryDesc: Ozizi ọnụọgụ na-enyocha njirimara nke ọnụọgụgụ. Ntọala nke cryptography nke oge a.
gravitixDocs.statisticsDesc: Statistics na-enye ngwaọrụ iji kọwapụta, nyocha na wepụta nkwubi okwu sitere na data.
gravitixDocs.specialDesc: Ọrụ pụrụ iche bụ ihe ngwọta maka nha anya dị iche iche dị mkpa.
gravitixDocs.fftDesc: Mgbanwe Fourier na-emebi akara n'ime ugboro ole ndị mejupụtara ya.
gravitixDocs.bp1: Na-ejikwa ihe a na-amaghị mgbe niile
gravitixDocs.bp3: Jiri ndị nche kama iji ọ bụrụ-agbụ maka ikike
gravitixDocs.bp5: Jiri nlọghachi n'oge iji belata akwụ
gravitixDocs.keepLearningDesc: Ụzọ kacha mma iji mụta Gravitix bụ ịrụ ụlọ. Malite na bot echo dị mfe, wee tinye steeti, wee tinye usoro. Echiche ọhụrụ ọ bụla ị mụtara na-emepekwu ohere.

intro.h3: Otu esi agụ akwụkwọ ntụaka a
intro.li1: Enwere ike ịgụ - koodu na-agụ dị ka ebumnuche, ọ bụghị igwe
intro.li2: Safe - ụdị static catch njehie tupu oge agba ọsọ
intro.li3: Expressive — flows, guards, na ụkpụrụ matching ka arụnyere n'ime ya.
intro.li4: Minimal - enweghị klas, enweghị ihe nketa, enweghị usoro mmụta
intro.p1: Gravitix bụ asụsụ akọwapụtara ngalaba (DSL) emebere site na ala maka ide bots Vortex. Ebe asụsụ ndị ọzọ chọrọ ọba akwụkwọ, ịkpọghachi azụ, na efere esi mmiri ọkụ, Gravitix na-enye gị ndị na-ahụ maka mmemme klaasị mbụ, mkparịta ụka flows, na arụnyere n'ime state - ha niile na syntax dị ọcha, enwere ike ịgụ nke sitere na Rust.
intro.p2: Gravitix bụ maka onye ọ bụla chọrọ ịrụ Vortex bot ngwa ngwa - ma ọ bụrụ na ị debeghị koodu mbụ, ma ọ bụ na ị bụ onye nrụpụta nwere ahụmahụ nke ike gwụrụ Python igwe mmiri ọkụ. Ntụaka a na-akụzi Gravitix site na ụkpụrụ nke mbụ: enweghị ahụmịhe tupu achọrọ.
intro.p3: Akụkụ nke ọ bụla na-ewuli elu na nke gara aga. Ọ bụrụ na ị dị ọhụrụ na mmemme, gụọ site n'elu ruo na ala. Ọ bụrụ na ị maralarị asụsụ ọzọ, jiri tebụl ọdịnaya wee malie ozugbo gaa n'ihe na-amasị gị.
intro.p4: N'ime akwụkwọ ntụaka a, → pụtara "ntụle na" ma ọ bụ "na-emepụta", na // ... na-egosi okwu ndị nchịkọta na-eleghara anya.

math_special.p5: Ai(x) na Bi(x) bụ ihe ngwọta nye y '' = xy. Ha na-apụta na tunneling quantum (WKB approximation) na optics (diffraction).

architexDocs.title: Ntụtụ aka Asụsụ Architex
architexDocs.subtitle: Asụsụ nkwupụta UI maka Vortex Mini Apps. Steeti na-emeghachi omume, okirikiri nhọrọ ukwuu, usoro nrụpụta efu efu.
architexDocs.introDesc: Architex bụ obere nkwupụta DSL emebere ka ebufe UI n'ime onye ozi Vortex. Ị na-akọwa ihe ihuenyo kwesịrị ịdị ka; Oge ojiri gaa na-emekọrịta pikselụ na steeti na-akpaghị aka. Enweghị mebere DOM, enweghị ngwugwu, enweghị JSX — faịlụ `.arx` bụ ngwa ahụ.
architexDocs.goalDeclarative: Nkwupụta - ị na-ede UI ị chọrọ, ọ bụghị usoro iji wuo ya
architexDocs.goalReactive: Reactive — `~ count += 1` na akara ọ bụla na-agụ ya na-emelite ebe
architexDocs.goalPortable: Enwere ike ibugharị - otu '.arx' na-agba na webụ, iOS, na gam akporo ọsọ ọsọ na-enweghị ndezigharị
architexDocs.goalTiny: Obere ụgbọ mmiri na-ebugharị ihe na-erughị 30 KB, yabụ Mini Apps mepere ozugbo.
architexDocs.goalReadable: Enwere ike ịgụ - ntinye bụ nhazi; a na-ekechi ihe ngbanwe na '::'; enweghị ụtụ akara edemede
architexDocs.whoDesc: Onye ọ bụla chọrọ ibupu ihuenyo mmekọrịta na Vortex — fọm ndị ahịa, bọọdụ dashboard, ibe ntuli aka, ụdị ụdị TelegramMini App. Ọ bụrụ na ị deela HTML+CSS+JS, Architex ga-amata nke ọma mana ọ na-ede ngwa ngwa. Ọ bụrụ na i mebeghị, Architex bụkwa okwu mmeghe dị nro maka mmemme mmemme n'ihi na asụsụ na-eme ka akara ukwu dị ntakịrị.
architexDocs.howToRead: Otu esi agụ akwụkwọ ntụaka a
architexDocs.howToReadDesc: Akụkụ nke ọ bụla na-ewuli elu na nke mbụ. Malite na ngwa ngwa mmalite, wee gụọ Syntax, State, Layout, Modifiers, Actions, na ngalaba dị elu ikpeazụ. Malite na tebụl ọdịnaya ma ọ bụrụ na ị maraworị React ma ọ bụ Svelte — maapụ echiche ahụ nke ọma.
architexDocs.quickStartDesc: Ụzọ kacha nso site na faịlụ oghere gaa na-agba ọsọ Mini App.
architexDocs.firstScreenExample:
@screen ndewo

  ~ aha = "ụwa"

  col :: pad (24) oghere (12) center

    nkụnye eji isi mee "Ndewo, {~ aha}!" :: nkwuwa okwu (28)

    ntinye ~ aha :: pad (8) radius (6) ókè (#ccc)

    ederede "Pịnye aha n'elu - a na-emelite ederede ka ị na-ede."
      :: nha(12) agba(#888)
architexDocs.whatHappenedDesc: `@screen Ndewo' na-ekwupụta mgbọrọgwụ. `~ aha = "ụwa"' na-emepụta mgbanwe mgbanwe. 'col', 'header', 'ntinye', 'ederede' bụ ihe arụnyere n'ime ya. `::` na-ejikọta ihe ngbanwe (padding, agba, nha). Mgbe onye ọrụ pịnyere n'ime ndenye, mmelite mmekọrịta '{~name}' ọ bụla - enweghị wiring, enweghị ndebanye aha, enweghị onye na-enye ya site na aka.
architexDocs.runningItDesc: Mepee taabụ Architex na Vortex bot studio, mado koodu, pịa Gbaa ọsọ. Oge ojiri gaa na-atụgharị n'ime pane nhụchalụ wee bugharịa ọkụ na nchekwa. Mgbe ị na-ebipụta, ndị ọrụ gị na-emeghe ngwa site na nkata ọ bụla - enweghị nkwụnye.
architexDocs.syntaxDesc: Emebere mmemme Architex ọ bụla n'ime ihe anọ: nkwupụta na-amalite na '@`, mgbanwe mmeghachi omume etinyere na '~', ihe ndị edere dị ka ihe nchọpụta efu, na ndị na-agbanwe agbanwe mgbe '::' gasịrị.
architexDocs.anatomyDeclDesc: `@ aha ihuenyo`, `@ isiokwu`, `@import "./lib.arx"`, na `@maka ihe dị na ~list` na-amalite na kọlụm 0. Ihe ọ bụla etinyere n'okpuru ha bụ nke ngọngọ ahụ.
architexDocs.anatomyCompDesc: Ngwa na-anọdụ ala n'ahịrị nke ha: 'ederede', 'bọtịnụ', 'oyiyi', 'nkụnye isi', 'labelụ', 'baajị', 'kekọrịta', 'kọl', 'ahiri'. Arụmụka ọnọdụ ha na-abịa ozugbo aha: 'ederede ~ ozi', 'bọtịnụ "Chekwa", "Image"/logo.png"'.
architexDocs.anatomyModifierDesc: Ka emechara `::` ị nwere ike yinye ọtụtụ mgbanwe dịka masịrị gị. Nke ọ bụla na-ewe ihe efu ma ọ bụ karịa arụmụka na mbo: `:: pad(24) gap(16) center bold size(20) color(#4f8ef7)`. Ndị na-eme mgbanwe bụ ọnọdụ, ọ bụghị isiokwu - usoro adịghị mkpa ma e wezụga ndị ikpeazụ-edere-emeri dị ka 'agba'.
architexDocs.anatomyActionDesc: `=>' na bọtịnụ (ma ọ bụ akụrụngwa mmekọrịta ọ bụla) na-eme oku ọrụ ma ọ bụ ọrụ na-esote. Otutu `=>` yinye n'akụkụ-na-akụkụ: `bọtịnụ "Nyefee" => ~ ọrụ n'aka = ezi => zipu(omume: "chekwa", data: ~ ụdị)`.
architexDocs.reactiveVarsDesc: Aha ọ bụla edobere ya na '~' bụ cell na-arụ ọrụ. Dee `~count = 0` ka ikwuwapụta, `~ count = 5` ka o nyegharịa, `~ count += 1` ka imelite. Ọnụ ọnụ UI ọ bụla na-agụ cell - ozugbo ma ọ bụ site na interpolation - na-emegharịghachi mgbe cell gbanwere.
architexDocs.computedVarsDesc: Jiri `:=` kama `=` ikwuwapụta okwu agbakọtara: `~ mkpokọta: = ~ gụọ * ~ nzọụkwụ`. Akụkụ aka nri na-enyochagharị mgbe ọ bụla ndabere ọ bụla gbanwere. Enweghị ndebanye aha akwụkwọ ntuziaka na enweghị ahụhụ bara uru - ọ bụrụ na ị gụọ ''~a' ebe na okwu a, ị ga-adabere na ya ozugbo.
architexDocs.typeAnnotationsDesc: Nkọwa bụ nhọrọ mana enyemaka na ozi mmezu na njehie: `~ count: number = 0`, `~name: string = """, `~ok: boolean = false`, `~ ihe: array = []`, `~ onye ọrụ: ihe = {}`. Ọ bụrụ na ịwụpụ ha ụdị a na-enweta site na mmalite.
architexDocs.supportedTypesList: 'nọmba', 'string', 'boolean', 'array', 'ihe', 'null'. A na-agafe ụbọchị na blobs dị ka eriri na ihe n'otu n'otu. Oge ịgba ọsọ na-eji iwu mmanye JavaScript n'okpuru mkpuchi, yabụ ''gụọ + 1' na-arụ ọrụ ọbụlagodi ma ọ bụrụ na ọnụ ọgụgụ' malitere ndụ dịka eriri.
architexDocs.stringInterpolationDesc: Eriri ọ bụla nwere ike itinye okwu na `{...}`: `"Ndewo, {~user.name}!"', `"Mkpokọta: {~agụta * ~ ọnụahịa}"'. Interpolation na-emeghachi omume mgbe niile.
architexDocs.layoutDesc: Architex nwere arịa abụọ nwere ike ịmekọrịta yana ihe mejupụtara akwụkwọ iri na abuo. Akwu ha na indentation - enweghị mmechi mkpado.
architexDocs.containersDesc: 'col' na-akwakọba ụmụaka kwụ ọtọ, 'ahịrị' kwụ ọtọ. Ha abụọ na-anabata `oghere(n)`, `pad(n)`, `center`, `gro`, na ihe ngbanwe obosara/ịdị elu. Tinye ụmụaka otu ọkwa miri emi na akwụkwụ.
architexDocs.containerExample:
ahiri :: oghere (8) pad (16) center
  onyonyo "/avatar.png" :: w(40) h(40) radius(20)
  col :: too oghere(2)
    ederede ~ aha :: obi ike
    ederede ~ bio :: nha (12) agba (#888)
architexDocs.leafComponentsList: 'ederede' - oyiri ahụ ọ bụla. ' nkụnye eji isi mee '' - n'usoro isiokwu bụ isi. 'labelụ' - obere isiokwu ederede. 'bọtịnụ' - njikwa nwere ike imetụ aka. 'ntinye' - mpaghara ederede jikọtara na var reactive. 'Onyinye' - foto sitere na URL. 'badge' - mkpado yiri pill. `divider` — mkpa separator ahịrị. 'toast' - nri nri ephemeral. 'taabụ' / 'tab' - taabụ switcher.
architexDocs.componentTextDesc: Ederede "Ndewo"' na-atụgharị eriri kwụ ọtọ. 'ederede ~ozi' na-emeghachi omume. Jikọọ na interpolation: `ederede "Ngụkọta: {~agụta}"'.
architexDocs.componentHeaderDesc: Ederede isiokwu. Ihe ndabara buru ibu, siri ike karịa 'ederede'. Otu arụmụka ọnọdụ: ` nkụnye eji isi mee "Ntọala"'. Nha nha na ihuenyo - jiri `size(n)' kpachie.
architexDocs.componentButtonDesc: Ihe nwere ike imetụ aka. Ụdọ ọnọdụ bụ akara; ihe omume `=> na-aga na mgbata. 'bọtịnụ "Chekwa" => ~draft = null`. Ọkụ '=>' dị n'usoro.
architexDocs.componentInputDesc: Ogige ederede ga-eji ụzọ abụọ. Ngbanwe na-emeghachi omume ka aha ahụ jigidere uru dị ugbu a: 'ntinye ~ email'. Ndị na-eme mgbanwe: `onye na-edebe ebe ("…")`, `debounce(300)` maka mmelite emelitere.
architexDocs.componentImageDesc: Ibu sitere na ụzọ HTTPS URL ma ọ bụ `/bulite/...` ụzọ. Ndị na-eme mgbanwe `w(px)`, `h(px)`, `radius(px)` na-akpụcha igbe ahụ. Ọ ga-adaghachi na silhouette nkedo ma ọ bụrụ na URL 404s.
architexDocs.componentDividerDesc: Nkewa ntutu isi, 1px, na-asọpụrụ agba isiokwu dị ugbu a. Enweghị arụmụka.
architexDocs.componentBadgeDesc: Ọgwụ na-amakụ ọdịnaya ya: 'baajị ~ ọnụ', 'baajị "ọhụrụ"'. Jiri maka ọnụ ọgụgụ na-agụghị akwụkwọ na mkpado ibe.
architexDocs.componentLabelDesc: Ederede edemede/enyere aka emerie ya. Good maka aha ubi ụdị.
architexDocs.componentToastDesc: Ozi anaghị egbochi. 'toast ~ a na-ahụ anya "Azọpụtara!" :: duration(2000)' na-egosi maka 2 s mgbe ọ bụla `~ a na-ahụ anya' bụ eziokwu, wee chụọ onwe ya. Enweghị nchịkọta modal, enweghị agha z-index.
architexDocs.componentTabsDesc: Akpa Tab jikọtara na eriri na-emeghachi omume: 'taabụ ~ arụ ọrụTab'. N'ime ya, 'tab' "Label" "igodo"' na-ekwupụta otu taabụ; aru etinyere n'okpuru ka egosiri mgbe igodo dakọtara.
architexDocs.modifiersDesc: Modifiers bụ naanị ụzọ ịke ihe akụrụngwa. Kechie ha mgbe `::` gachara. Ha na-abịa n'ezinaụlọ ise: oghere, nha nha, agba, akwụkwọ edemede, na omume.
architexDocs.modSpacingDesc: `pad(n)` - padding n'akụkụ niile. 'pad (x, y)' - kehoraizin + kwụ ọtọ. 'pad(n'elu, aka nri, ala, aka ekpe)' - CSS- ịtụ. `oghere(n)` - oghere n'etiti ụmụaka 'col' / 'ahiri'. ` oke (n)` - oghere dị n'èzí sitere na ụmụnne.
architexDocs.modSizingDesc: `w(px)` - obosara etinyere. `h(px)` - ogologo a kapịrị ọnụ. 'tolite' - dejupụta oghere fọdụrụ n'ahịrị/kọl. 'etiti' - etiti n'akụkụ axis cross; na 'col' ọ gbadoro ụkwụ n'ahịrị, n'ahịrị' ọ gbadoro ọtọ.
architexDocs.modColourDesc: 'agba (#rrggbb)' - ihu ihu. `bg(#rrggbb)` — ndabere. Ha abụọ na-anabata akara ngosi isiokwu: 'agba (~ isi)' na-agụ site na ngọngọ '@ isiokwu' dị ugbu a. Opacity na-aga na hex nwere ọnụọgụ asatọ: `#00000080` bụ 50 % ojii.
architexDocs.modTypographyDesc: `nha(px)` — nha font. `obi ike` / `italic` — ibu na ụdị. `align(aka ekpe|etiti|aka nri)' - nhazi ederede.
architexDocs.modVisibilityDesc: `zoro ezo(~ ọkọlọtọ)` - na-ebupụ ọnụ mgbe ọkọlọtọ bụ eziokwu. `nke a na-ahụ anya (~ ọkọlọtọ)' - n'ụzọ dị iche. Nodes na-ekpughị wụfuo DOM, yabụ ọnọdụ UI dị ọnụ ala.
architexDocs.modBehaviourDesc: 'debounce(ms)' na 'ntinye' na-emelite mmelite. `Onye na-edebe ebe ("…")` na-egosi eriri ntụnye. 'ụdị (ụdị, arg)' na 'ederede' n'ụdị nọmba: 'usoro ("ego", "USD")', 'usoro ("percent")', 'usoro ("kọmpat")'.
architexDocs.modRadiusDesc: 'radius(px)' nkuku okirikiri. 'oke (#rrggbb)' na-adọta strok 1 px. 'oke(px, #rrggbb)' na-esetịpụkwa ọkpụrụkpụ.
architexDocs.actionsDesc: Omume na-agbanwe ọnọdụ ma ọ bụ na-agwa ndị ọzọ okwu. Ha na-agba ọsọ n'otu n'otu na onye na-ahụ maka mgbata/pịa igodo.
architexDocs.actionAssignDesc: `=> ~ọnụ = 0`, `=> ~ na-arụ ọrụ = eziokwu`, `=> ~ ndepụta = []`. Mgbanwe ọ bụla na-emeghachi omume bụ nke a na-ede ede.
architexDocs.actionIncDecDesc: `+= n`, `-= n`, `*= n`, `/= n`. `=> ~ ogugu += 1` bu akpaala okwu maka ngụta.
architexDocs.actionMultipleDesc: Otutu `=>` n'otu ahịrị ahụ ọkụ n'elu-ruo-ala n'otu akara, ka UI na-emelite otu ugboro na njedebe: `button "Zụrụ" => ~ ọrụ = ezi => zipu(omume: "ịzụta") => ~ ọrụ = ụgha`. Maka ọrụ async, họrọ '@reaction' gbakọọ.
architexDocs.actionSendDesc: `send (omume: "aha", ...args)' bụ àkwà mmiri laghachi na bot. Onye ọbịa (Vortex Oge ojiri gaa) na-enweta ya dị ka ozi JSON RPC ma nwee ike ịkpọ koodu bot gị. Jiri ya maka nbanye, API fetches, ịkwụ ụgwọ - ihe ọ bụla DSL n'onwe ya enweghị ike igosipụta.
architexDocs.actionNavigateDesc: `goto("Aha ihuenyo", arg: uru, ...)' na-akwanye '@ ihuenyo' ọzọ n'ime nchịkọta; 'azụ()' gbapụta. Oge ojiri gaa na-emegharị na ndabara.
architexDocs.actionHostBuiltinsDesc: `copy(~text)`, `share(~ederede)`, `haptic("ọkụ" | "ọkara" | "arọ")`, `vibrate(ms)`, `alert("…")`, `kwenye("…") => ~ok = it` — 'it' aka mkpirisi bụ uru nloghachi nke okwu bu ụzọ.
architexDocs.themeDesc: Kwupụta palette otu ugboro, jirikwa ebe niile. Token na-aghọ mgbanwe na-emeghachi omume mgbe niile ka ngwa gị nwee ike ibugharị ngbanwe ọnọdụ gbara ọchịchịrị n'ahịrị atọ.
architexDocs.importsDesc: `@import "./shared/ui.arx"' na-ewepụta '@component' na '@screen' ọ bụla na faịlụ ahụ n'ime ebe dị ugbu a. Ụzọ ndị metụtara faịlụ mbubata; A na-achọpụta mbubata okirikiri ma kwupụta ya n'oge nzacha.
architexDocs.componentsDesc: Kọwaa otu ugboro, jiri ọtụtụ oge: `@component Avatar url size\n image url :: w(size) h(size) radius(size / 2)`. N'ime ahụ akụrụngwa akpọrọ aha dị ka ihe nchọpụta doro anya (na-enweghị `~`).
architexDocs.forLoopsDesc: `@maka ihe dị na ~list` na-atụgharị otu ahịrị maka mmewere. `@ maka ihe, idx na ~ ndepụta` na-ejikọkwa ndeksi dabere efu. Oge ịgba ọsọ na-achọpụta njirimara site na mmewere n'onwe ya, yabụ ịgbakwunye ihe dị n'elu ndepụta 10 000 na-akwụ ụgwọ ọrụ O(1) DOM.
architexDocs.forExample:
@maka ihe, idx n'ime ~ ihe
  ahiri :: oghere (8) pad (4)
    akara ~ idx
    ederede ~ ihe :: tolite
architexDocs.ternaryDesc: 'cond? a : b` na-arụ ọrụ ebe ọ bụla a nabatara okwu. Akwu maka ọnụ ọgụgụ: `~ ọnọdụ >= 10 ? "Elu": ~ ọnọdụ >= 5 ? "mid": "dị ala"'.
architexDocs.slotsDesc: N'ime nkwupụta akụrụngwa, 'slot' na-akara ebe ahụ onye na-akpọ oku na-abanye. Chee ya dị ka oghere React ụmụaka / Vue ndabara.
architexDocs.reactivity: Kedu ka mmeghachi omume si arụ ọrụ
architexDocs.reactivityDesc: '~var' nke ọ bụla bụ akara ngosi. Mgbe ị na-agụ ya n'ime arụmụka agbakọ, mgbako mgbanwe, ma ọ bụ ntinye aka, oge ojiri gaa na-edetu ihe a gụrụ na eserese dabere ugbu a. Mgbe ị na-ede, a na-enyochagharị ọnụ ụzọ ọ bụla gụrụ ya - otu ugboro, na njedebe nke microtask dị ugbu a.
architexDocs.reactivityBatchingDesc: A na-ahazi ọtụtụ ederede n'otu njikwa. `=> ~a = 1 => ~b = 2` na-akpalite otu ngafe.
architexDocs.reactivityEqualityDesc: Site na ndabara, oge ojiri gaa na-eji oke nha anya (`===`). Ide otu uru ahụ anaghị eme ihe ọ bụla. Nyefee ihe/usoro ọhụrụ iji manye mmelite; A na-akwado enweghị mgbanwe mana ọ chọghị.
architexDocs.examplesDesc: Ngwa canonical anọ, nke ọ bụla nwere onwe ya yana n'okpuru ahịrị 40. Detuo nke ọ bụla n'ime ha na taabụ Architex wee pịa Gbaa ọsọ.
architexDocs.exampleCounter: Counter - steeti mmeghachi omume, agbakọ, ndị na-eji bọtịnụ, njide ederede.
architexDocs.exampleTodo: Todo - ndetu ndetu, tinye / wepu, ndezi inline.
architexDocs.exampleProfile: Profaịlụ - onyonyo, baajị, visibiliti ọnọdụ, igodo.
architexDocs.exampleKiller: Njirimara egbu egbu - gburugburu, mbubata, taabụ, toasts, ọnụọgụ ahazi, ternaries, vars nke etinyere.
architexDocs.errors: Njehie ndị a na-ahụkarị na ihe ị ga-eme
architexDocs.errUnknownName: 'Aha amaghị ~ foo' - ị na-eji mgbanwe mmeghachi omume tupu ikwuwapụta ya. Tinye `~ foo = …' n'elu ihe mkpuchi '@screen'.
architexDocs.errIndent: 'Atụmatụ a na-atụghị anya ya' - ụmụaka ga-abụrịrị otu ọkwa miri emi karịa nne na nna ha. Architex na-eji kpọmkwem oghere abụọ n'otu ọkwa; Ajụjụ taabụ iji zere ahụhụ na-adịghị ahụ anya-ọcha.
architexDocs.errModifier: `mgbanwe amaghi ama` — i dere `:: onyinyo` mana oge agba ọsọ anaghị akwado ya. Lelee ndepụta mgbanwe n'elu; Architex siri ike gbasara aha amaghi ama iji kpuchido ndakọrịta n'ihu.
architexDocs.errType: 'ụdị adabaghị' - dịka ọmụmaatụ. ị gafere eriri ebe a na-atụ anya nọmba. Kọwaa mgbanwe mmeghachi omume (`~ count: number`) na parser ga-agwa gị ebe uru ọjọọ ahụ siri.
architexDocs.errDebug: Iji degharịa n'oge ọ na-agba ọsọ, kechie okwu a na-enyo enyo na 'debug(...)' - oge ọ na-agba ọsọ na-edekọ nyocha ọ bụla na njikwa na-enweghị emetụta uru ya.
architexDocs.compatWeb: Weebụ — sụgharịrị n'ime vanilla DOM nwere mgbanwe CSS maka akara isiokwu. Enweghị React / Vue / Svelte ndabere.
architexDocs.compatIOS: iOS — otu '.arx' ka a tụgharịrị wee tụgharịa ya na nlele SwiftUI site na onye nnabata iOS Vortex. Maapụ mgbanwe ọ bụla na ụdị SwiftUI.
architexDocs.compatAndroid: Android - onye ọbịa ahụ na-atụgharị n'ime Jetpack Compose. Ndị na-emegharị mmegharị ahụ (`:: onTap`, `:: onLongPress`) tụgharịa asụsụ ka ọ bụrụ Mepụta ihe.
architexDocs.compatVersions: Amụma ụdị - Architex na-ekwe nkwa ndakọrịta azụ maka faịlụ '.arx' n'ofe obere ụdị. Faịlụ `.arx` nke edere megide 0.1 ka na-arụ ọrụ na 0.9.
architexDocs.nextStepsDesc: Gụọ akwụkwọ esi nri maka ụkpụrụ (ndepụta na-enweghị ngwụcha, ụdị, ịkwụ ụgwọ), ntuziaka ngwaọrụ maka ngwa mgbakwunye koodu CLI na VS, yana ntuziaka ntinye aka ma ọ bụrụ na ịchọrọ ịgbakwunye akụrụngwa arụnyere n'ime ya. Ebe zuru oke dị na github.com/vortex/Architex.

architecture.title: Nchịkọta ihe owuwu ihe owuwu
architecture.subtitle: Usoro atọ - onye ahịa, ọnụ, onye njikwa - yana otu protocol na-ejikọta ha.
architecture.intro: Vortex bụ onye ozi ewepụrụ. Kama otu azụ azụ nke otu ụlọ ọrụ nwere, ọ na-emepe oghere nke oghere ** ọnụ** mepere emepe, nke kọmpat ** onye njikwa ** achọpụtara ma kwụọ ụgwọ maka ya nke na-ebipụta akara mbinye aka nke koodu ọ gbagoro. ** Ndị ahịa** jide igodo nzuzo niile wee nye UI. Ndị ọzọ nke isiakwụkwọ a na-ejegharị usoro atọ ahụ, ókèala ha, na data nke na-agafe n'etiti ha.
architecture.h1p1: Ndị ozi etiti bụ otu ebe mmanye. Iwu ụlọ ikpe, nkwụsị nke onye na-eweta igwe ojii, ma ọ bụ nweta ihe ọjọọ niile sụgharịrị ka ọ bụrụ "ndị ọrụ na-efunahụ ohere". Vortex n'akụkụ nke ahụ site n'ikwe ka onye ọ bụla mee ọnụ ọnụ na ikwe ka ndị ahịa na-agagharị n'etiti ọnụ na-edeghị aha ọzọ.
architecture.h1p2: Ịkwado ọchịchị kwesịrị ichekwa nzuzo na iguzosi ike n'ezi ihe. Njikọ nke sava enweghị ntụkwasị obi na-arụ ọrụ naanị ma ọ bụrụ na sava enweghị ike ịgụ ederede doro anya na enweghị ike ịkọ ozi. Vortex na-akwado ma site na ngwụcha ngwụcha ruo ngwụcha yana akaebe Ed25519 na ozi ọnụ ụzọ ọ bụla.
architecture.h1p3: Onye njikwa ahụ bụ otu akụkụ nke etiti, mana ọ pere mpe. Ọ na-ebipụta naanị `INTEGRITY.sig.json` yana ndepụta ntinye ntụkwasị obi. Onye ọ bụla nwere ike wepụta enyo n'onwe ya, yabụ ọbụlagodi onye njikwa abụghị otu ebe ọdịda - naanị otu isi iyi nke eziokwu maka "nke akara ngosi pubkey weputara".
architecture.h1l1: Enweghị mkpọchi onye na-ere ahịa: ndị ahịa nwere ike ịkwaga njirimara ha n'etiti ọnụ ọnụ oge ọ bụla site na iji JWT ọhụrụ bịanye aka na X25519 pubkey.
architecture.h1l2: Enweghị njikọ ọpụpụ: mgbe otu ọnụ na-agbada, ndị ọrụ na ọnụ ndị ọzọ anaghị ahụ.
architecture.h1l3: Enweghị ikike ọ bụla: ndị na-arụ ọrụ na-ahọrọ ụlọ iwu kwadoro, ndị ọrụ na-ahọrọ onye ọrụ ha.
architecture.h1l4: Enweghị otu UI: iOS, Android, webụ bụ ndị ọgbọ nke mbụ - ọ nweghị ikpo okwu bụ ihe mkpuchi dị mkpa karịa nke ọzọ.
architecture.h2p1: Onye ahịa na-agba ọsọ na ngwaọrụ onye ọrụ. Nke ahụ bụ naanị ebe ozi ederede doro anya, igodo nzuzo, na faịlụ-na-edo anya dị ndụ. Ọnụ ụzọ ahụ adịghị ahụ ha.
architecture.h2p2: Ikpokoro ọ bụla akwadoro na-arụ otu ụkpụrụ waya (HTTPS + WebSocket + WebRTC). Modul njirimara SOLID-ekewa (api/` protocol, `impl/` code, `ui/` views) na-eme ka nkwekọrịta ahụ sie ike na koodu akọwapụtara n'elu ikpo okwu.
architecture.h2p3: Nchekwa na ngwaọrụ: Keychain / EncryptedSharedPreferences / Http Naanị kuki maka tokens; SQLite (GRDB na iOS, Ụlọ dị na gam akporo, IndexedDB wrapper na webụ) maka ederede ciphertext + akara ngosi FTS.
architecture.h2l1: iOS - ngwugwu Swift nwere modul atụmatụ 30+. Minnye mbugharị lekwasịrị anya iOS 17.
architecture.h2l2: Android - Kotlin + Mepụta + Hilt. minSdk 26, targetSdk 34.
architecture.h2l3: Weebụ — vanilla JS PWA, onye na-arụ ọrụ, enweghị ihe nrụpụta gafere ES modul nchikota.
architecture.h2l4: Desktop - Tauri wrapper gburugburu onye ahịa weebụ; otu ùkwù, onye nrụpụta Chrome.
architecture.h3p1: Otu ọnụ bụ usoro Python ('python -m app.main', ma ọ bụ 'run.py' nke achịkọtara) na-ege ntị na 9000 na ndabara. Ọ na-aga n'ihu ederede ciphertext, ndị na-akwado ihe omume WebSocket, na-ejide nzere TURN, yana ndị na-ere ahịa na ọnụ ụzọ ndị ọzọ.
architecture.h3p2: Igwe ọnụ ọnụ na-ama ụma dị gịrịgịrị. Ọ na-ekpughe ihe dị ka ụzọ 120 gafere osisi `/api/*` gbakwunyere `/ws' maka ịpụpụ oge. A na-atụnye ibuli dị arọ (crypto, ọnụnọ, nhazi oge) na 'ngwa/nchekwa/', 'app/transport/', 'app/peer/'.
architecture.h3p3: Otu ọnụ na ọnọdụ SQLite ndabara na-ejikwa ~ 50 ndị ọrụ na-emekọ ihe ọnụ na M1. Site na nkwado Postgres na Redis, otu koodu ahụ na-agbakọ n'ụzọ kwụ ọtọ - ọnụ ọnụ ọ bụla na-aghọ enweghị steeti gafere DB na onye na-apụ apụ.
architecture.h3l1: Ebe ntinye: `/api/*` HTTPS, `/ws` WebSocket, `/v1/ịdị n'ezi' na `/ahụike' maka ịdị ndụ.
architecture.h3l2: Ndabere: FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2.x, uvicorn, cryptography (OpenSSL), pqcrypto (liboqs), python-multipart, ohiri isi, Rust ndọtị `vortex_chat` maka na-ekpo ọkụ ụzọ crypto.
architecture.h3l3: Nhọrọ: Redis (nnọọ fan-out gafee ọtụtụ ọnụ), Postgres (mmepụta DB), coturn (TURN relay), fluent-bit (mbupu log).
architecture.h3l4: Ọnụọgụgụ ọnụọgụ abụọ: ~ 60 MB Python deps + ~ 10 MB Rust ndọtị. Ihe onyonyo docker ihe dị ka 400 MB tupu skwọsh.
architecture.h4p1: Onye njikwa ahụ bụ usoro Python dị iche (`vortex_controller`) nwere ebumnuche dị warara: bipụta ma nyochaa `INTEGRITY.sig.json`, kpughee URL ntinye, wee soro ahụike nke ndị ọgbọ jikọtara ọnụ.
architecture.h4p2: Na mbido, onye njikwa na-aga n'osisi isi iyi, hashes faịlụ ọ bụla, ma tụọ ya megide ihe ngosi. Ọ bụrụ na hash ọ bụla adabaghị, onye njikwa jụrụ ibido. Nke a pụtara na faịlụ na diski emebi emebi enweghị ike ije ozi `ọnọdụ:" nkwenye"'.
architecture.h4p3: Ndị ahịa kụrụ `/v1/iguzosi ike n'ezi ihe' tupu ha atụkwasị ọnụ ọnụ. Ọ bụrụ na ha ahụ ` status != "verified"' ha ajụ inyefe nzere, oge. Nke ahụ bụ arịlịka ntụkwasị obi.
architecture.h4l1: Eji 'igodo/release.key' bịanye aka na ya (Ed25519). Ọkara ọha butere n'ime mwepụta ndị ahịa.
architecture.h4l2: Egosipụta ndenye: `{ụzọ, sha256, size}` maka faịlụ ọ bụla a na-elegharaghị anya.
architecture.h4l3: wughachi: `python -m vortex_controller.integrity.sign_tool`. Mpụta `INTEGRITY.sig.json' na mgbọrọgwụ repo.
architecture.h4l4: Ntughari: ndị ọrụ na-akpụ Vortex dochie `release.key'. Ndị ahịa haziri jiri igodo pub ha tụkwasa ndụdụ ahụ.
architecture.h5p1: Gagharịa ihe na-eme mgbe Alice zigara Bob "hi":
architecture.h5p2: 1. Onye ahịa na-elele igodo mgbọrọgwụ nke ime ụlọ na ụlọ ahịa mpaghara ya. Ọ bụrụ na anọghị ya, ọ na-ewepụta envelopu ọhụrụ site na `/api/rooms/{id}/keys` maka igodo pub nke ya. Ndị DM oge mbụ na-agba Diffie-Hellman otu okirikiri na prekeys.
architecture.h5p3: 2. Onye ahịa na-ewepụta ụgwọ ọrụ dị ka CBOR `{v:1, ederede:"hi", zaghachi:null, sent_at:...}`, na-ewepụta 96-bit nonce random, akara na AES-256-GCM, na POSTs `/api/rooms/{id}/messages` na: hexpher nonce: hexpher nonce hex}'.
architecture.h5p4: 3. Node na-echekwa ahịrị ahụ wee pụọ '{type:"m", room:..., msg:{id, ct, nonce, sender_pseudo, sent_at}}' na onye ọ bụla ejikọrọ WebSocket debanyere aha na ụlọ ahụ.
architecture.h5p5: 4. Bob si ahịa na-enweta eku, decrypts na otu mgbọrọgwụ igodo, verifies sender pseudo ọkụ na-atụ anya otu, na renders afụ.
architecture.h5p6: 5. Ndị ahịa Bob biputere 'POST /api/rooms/{id}/read' na id ozi agụ ikpeazụ. Nke ahụ na-ebute mgbasa ozi `{type:"r"} ka nke Alice wee gosi akara.
architecture.h6p1: CBOR (RFC 8949) siri ike, ọnụọgụ abụọ na ngwa ngwa itinye koodu. E jiri ya tụnyere JSON ọ na-ebelata nha ụgwọ ọrụ site na ~ 30% na ederede nkata a na-ahụkarị ma na-ewepụ enweghị mgbagha.
architecture.h6p2: Tụnyere Protobuf ọ dịghị achọ onye na-emepụta schema ma ọ dịghị ahapụ nọmba ubi. Nke ahụ dị mkpa n'ihi na Vortex na-etolite - anyị agbakwunyela `thread_id`, `zaghachi_to`, `mmeghachi omume_ọnụ', 'ụdị' n'elu mwepụta na-emebighị ndị ahịa ochie.
architecture.h6p3: CBOR bụkwa ihe Signal, Matrix, na NIP-29 na-eji maka ihe ndị yiri ya. Ịdakọ nhọrọ ha pụtara na protocol anyị dị mfe inyocha site n'aka ndị nyocha nchekwa bụ ndị maralarị koodu ndo.
architecture.h7p1: Eku ọ bụla na-ebu `v:<int>'. Ụdị nke dị ugbu a bụ 1. A na-atụba okpokolo agba nwere ụdị amaghi ama; ndị ahịa debanye aha ịdọ aka ná ntị wee gaa n'ihu na etiti na-esote.
architecture.h7p2: E kwekwara nkwa ndakọrịta azụ maka etiti ọ bụla ka na-ebu `v:1`. Ndakọrịta n'ihu bụ mbọ kacha mma: agbakwunyere ubi ọhụrụ na njedebe nke dict, ndị ahịa ochie na-eleghara ha anya.
architecture.h7p3: Edobere mgbaji siri ike maka mgbanwe nchekwa dị mkpa (dịka ịgbanwee HKDF eriri okirikiri). N'ọnọdụ ndị ahụ mbipute bumps na 2 na a na-ebipụta windo mbugharị.
architecture.h1_a: Netwọk Vortex na-ekewa n'ime usoro atọ. Onye ọ bụla na-agba ọsọ n'onwe ya, na-agwa ndị ọzọ okwu site na usoro waya akọwapụtara nke ọma, enwere ike dochie ya onwe ya. Enweghị monolith - njirimara ọ bụla na-abanye n'ime otu ọrụ atọ ahụ.
architecture.h1_b: Onye ahịa na-ejide igodo ma na-atụgharị UI. Otu ọnụ na-aga n'ihu ederede ciphertext, ndị na-akwado ihe omume karịrị WebSocket, yana ndị na-ere ahịa WebRTC na-egosi. Onye njikwa na-ebipụta URL ndị mbinye aka na ntinye. Ha na-ekwurịta okwu n'elu HTTPS + WebSocket na-eji CBOR ⟫ ⟫ echekwabara n'ime envelopu AES-GCM.
architecture.h1_c: The nkewa e ẹkenam na v0.0.3 mgbe mbụ monolith version efehe n'ime abụọ nsogbu: ntọhapụ attestation e kegidere na-agba ọsọ ọnụ (ya mere a mie ala ọnụ nwere ike ịgha ụgha banyere ya koodu), na federation agaghị ekwe omume n'ihi na ọnụ ala na ntụkwasị obi steeti bi na otu tebụl. Ngosipụta n'ime usoro nke ya nyere onye ọrụ ọ bụla otu igodo pubkey ka ọ tụnye ma mee ka anyị gbakọọ federation n'aka N.
architecture.h1_f:
onye ahịa --HTTPS/WSS--> ọnụ
  ^ |
  |                        v
  ---/v1/iguzosi ike n'ezi ihe-- onye njikwa (egosila akara)
architecture.h2_a: Nkewa/nchịkọta ọnụ na-ekewapụta arịa kacha nwee nchekwa (ngosipụta a bịanyere aka na ya) site na nnukwu ọgụ (ihe nkesa API).
architecture.h2_b: Onye njikwa na-echekwa obere SQLite DB: igodo pub tụkwasịrị obi, URL enyo, yana akara ahụike. Ọ na-ajụ ịmalite ma ọ bụrụ na INTEGRITY.sig.json adabaghị na osisi on-disk - faịlụ emebi emebi enweghị ike ijere 'ọnọdụ:' akwadoro''. Ọnụ ụzọ na-agba ọsọ na Postgres/SQLite nke ya ma ọ dịghị ejide igodo ntọhapụ.
architecture.h2_c: Ụkpụrụ a sitere na mgbawa nke ụlọ ahịa chrome (certs na-ebi na egwu mwepụta ihe nchọgharị, ọ bụghị ebe webụ) na Release.gpg (nke pụtara ìhè bịanyere aka n'akwụkwọ, ngwugwu enweghị mbinye aka). Nakweere n'ihi na ha abụọ aghụghọ lanarị ọtụtụ iri afọ nke adversarial nyochaa.
architecture.h3_a: TLS 1.3 na hop ọ bụla, ụgwọ ezoro ezo na njedebe na njedebe n'ime. TLS eji ebu njem; AES-GCM na-ejikwa ọdịnaya.
architecture.h3_b: N'etiti onye ahịa na ọnụ: HTTPS (`/api/*`) na WSS (`/ws`). N'etiti ọnụ: HTTPS (`/federation/*`). N'etiti ọnụ na njikwa: HTTPS (`/v1/*`). Ihe niile na-eji TLS 1.3 nwere akara mkpịsị aka Chrome 120 iji guzogide DPI.
architecture.h3_c: N'oge Vortex eji raw TCP jiri aka eme mkpọtụ-protocol omenala. Agbanwere gaa na TLS 1.3 na v0.0.4 mgbe ọ matachara na ụkpụrụ omenala na-egosi "mmasị" nye ndị na-ekiri ihe na-adịghị mma. TLS 1.3 na-agwụ ike, ebe niile, yana ECH dị njikere - akụrụngwa atọ anyị chọrọ.
architecture.h3_f:
oyi akwa njem: TLS 1.3 (RFC 8446) + nhọrọ ECH (RFC 9460)
oyi akwa ọdịnaya: AES-256-GCM akara n'ime CBOR
architecture.h4_a: Otu ozi ọpụpụ na-aga site na usoro anọ: etiti → encrypt → post → fan out.
architecture.h4_b: Onye ahịa na-agbakọ igodo ọnụ ụlọ (X25519 + HKDF), kewaa ozi dị ka CBOR, mechie ya na AES-256-GCM site na iji 96-bit nonce, POST gaa `/api/rooms/{id}/messages`. Node na-echekwa ahịrị ederede ciphertext yana ndị na-akwado WebSocket ọ bụla ejikọrọ debanyere aha n'ime ụlọ ahụ. Onye ahịa nnata na-eji otu igodo decryption. Ịla azụ njem okirikiri n'okpuru 50 ms na mpaghara LAN, ~120 ms WAN.
architecture.h4_c: Pipeline nke ụzọ anọ bụ otu akara ngosi ejiri na 2014; anyị gbanwere naanị ụgbọ njem (WebSocket kama nke Signal's TCP) yana ntinye koodu (CBOR kama protobuf). Ịdakọ n'ụdị egosipụtara na-akụpụta nke ọhụrụ.
architecture.h5_a: Anyị ahọrọla CBOR n'elu JSON na Protobuf ka anyị tụlechara nha ụgwọ ọrụ, mgbanwe, na ergonomics debug na ezigbo ọrụ nkata.
architecture.h5_b: CBOR na-arụpụta ụgwọ ọrụ ~ 30% pere mpe karịa JSON na ozi dị arọ nke unicode, enweghị mgbagha oghere, ma na-akwado mgbakwunye ubi na-enweghị ndị na-emepụta atụmatụ. Proto ga-achọ faịlụ .proto kwa ntọhapụ ma hapụ nọmba mpaghara.
architecture.h5_c: Akara ngosi si na protobuf gbanwee gaa na CBOR dị ka framing na 2017 maka otu ihe kpatara ya. Matrix na-eji CBOR na oyi akwa mkpebi steeti ya. CBOR bụ ọkọlọtọ IETF (RFC 8949) na asụsụ ọ bụla anyị lekwasịrị anya nwere ọba akwụkwọ tozuru oke.
architecture.h5_f:
CBOR nha: ~0.7 × JSON na agwakọta utf-8
          ~ 1.05 × protobuf na otu schema
Na-agbakwụnye ubi = mgbakwunye na njedebe. Ndị ahịa ochie na-eleghara anya.
architecture.h6_a: Gịnị kpatara CBOR — akụkụ nke isi ụlọ ọrụ. Nke a bụ otu n'ime isi usoro ndị a na-ezo aka n'oge ntụaka Vortex. Gụọ isiakwụkwọ gbara ya gburugburu maka nkọwa sara mbara; ngalaba a na-abanye n'ime akparamagwa a kapịrị ọnụ.
architecture.h6_b: Nchịkọta mmejuputa maka "Gịnị kpatara CBOR". A na-emejuputa usoro a na modul kwekọrọ n'okpuru 'app/', `ios/Modules/sources/', ma ọ bụ 'android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/'. Modul README na-akpọpụta ụzọ faịlụ ziri ezi.
architecture.h6_c: Usoro "Gịnị kpatara CBOR" sitere na ntọhapụ Vortex. Nhazi ahụ na-esochi nyocha na omume mmepụta nke ndị ozi mbụ bipụtara. Akụkọ ụdị dị na ndekọ `CHANGELOG.md` mgbe ibe ọ bụla rutere na ihe kpaliri ya.
architecture.h7_a: Protocol versioning — akụkụ nke architecture isi. Nke a bụ otu n'ime isi usoro a na-ezo aka n'oge ntụaka Vortex. Gụọ isiakwụkwọ gbara ya gburugburu maka nkọwa sara mbara; ngalaba a na-abanye n'ime akparamagwa a kapịrị ọnụ.
architecture.h7_b: Nchịkọta mmejuputa maka "ụdị Protocol". A na-emejuputa usoro a na modul kwekọrọ n'okpuru 'app/', `ios/Modules/sources/', ma ọ bụ 'android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/'. Modul README na-akpọpụta ụzọ faịlụ ziri ezi.
architecture.h7_c: Usoro "Protocol versioning" malitere n'ofe Vortex ewepụtara. Nhazi ahụ na-esochi nyocha na omume mmepụta nke ndị ozi mbụ bipụtara. Akụkọ ụdị dị na ndekọ `CHANGELOG.md` mgbe ibe ọ bụla rutere na ihe kpaliri ya.

crypto.title: Cryptographic mbụ
crypto.subtitle: Algọridim ọ bụla dị na nchịkọta, ebumnuche ya, paramita ya, RFC.
crypto.intro: Vortex na-eji naanị primitives nyochara ndị ọgbọ. Enweghị ciphers ngọngọ omenala, enweghị KDF ndị tolitere n'ụlọ, enweghị atụmatụ mbinye aka akwụkwọ akụkọ. Isiakwụkwọ a na-edekọ ihe ochie ọ bụla anyị na-eji, paramita kpọmkwem, na ebumnuche dị n'azụ nhọrọ ọ bụla.
crypto.h1p1: Curve25519 (RFC 7748) n'ụdị Montgomery ya, ejiri maka Elliptic-curve Diffie-Hellman. Igodo nzuzo 32-byte, igodo ọha 32-byte, mmepụta nzuzo 32-byte ekekọrịtara.
crypto.h1p2: A na-eji ya maka: njirimara ngwaọrụ static, igodo nnọkọ ephemeral, envelopu ntinye akara akara, mkpuchi igodo ime ụlọ, envelopu federation.
crypto.h1p3: Mmejuputa iOS: `Curve25519.KeyAgreement.PrivateKey` sitere na CryptoKit. Android: `x25519-dalek' site na JNI. Ọnụ: `cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric.x25519' n'elu OpenSSL.
crypto.h1p4: Ha atọ interop bit-for-bit. A nwalere njem okirikiri megide RFC 7748 Alice/Bob vectors test na ụlọ ọ bụla.
crypto.h1p5: Arụmọrụ: ~ 100µs kwa Diffie-Hellman na iPhone 2020, ~ 30µs na Mac 2020. Mkpuchi igodo ime ụlọ maka otu mmadụ 200 na-ewe ihe dịka elekere mgbidi 10 ms.
crypto.h1p6: Oge na-adịgide adịgide: ee, ma n'usoro mgbakọ na mwepụ na ụzọ ngbanwe nke raw-byte.
crypto.h1p7: Ọdịnihu ọwa akụkụ: Ọkọlọtọ Montgomery anaghị egbochiri klaasị nke mwakpo oge nke kụrụ akụkụ Weierstrass; OpenSSL na Swift CryptoKit na-eji ya.
crypto.h1p8: Usoro usoro: 32-byte obere-endian. A na-akụchi igodo ọha na mbubata ka ntinye adịghị eme ka ọ ghara ịkpata ntapu dị ala.
crypto.h1l1: Kedu ihe kpatara X25519 ma ọ bụghị P-256: ngwa ngwa, obere, enweghị nchegbu NIST-curve.
crypto.h1l2: Kedu ihe kpatara mmepụta 32-byte na ọ bụghị 64: dakọtara HKDF-SHA256 ntinye ogologo oge.
crypto.h1l3: Ihe kpatara Montgomery na ọ bụghị Edwards: naanị anyị chọrọ DH, ọ bụghị mbinye aka, na isi ihe a. Edwards ga-achọ nzọụkwụ ntụgharị oge ọ bụla.
crypto.h2p1: EdDSA (RFC 8032) karịrị edwards25519. igodo ọha 32-byte, mbinye aka 64-byte.
crypto.h2p2: A na-eji ya maka: akaebe ọnụ na ozi gọọmentị etiti, mbinye aka ntọhapụ-isi n'elu ngosipụta iguzosi ike n'ezi ihe, bot deploy mbinye aka, njirimara ngwaọrụ ogologo oge maka Double Ratchet.
crypto.h2p3: Mkpebi: ụdị RFC 8032 anyị na-eji na-ewepụta otu mbinye aka ugboro abụọ maka otu igodo ozi + ahụ. Apple's CryptoKit na iOS 17+ na-eji ụdị RFC 8032bis randomized - ha abụọ dị irè ma jiri nkwenye ọ bụla kwadoro.
crypto.h2p4: Ọnụ ego nkwenye: ~ 200µs na CPU ọgbara ọhụrụ. Nyochaa batch (`batch_verify([msg,sig,pk]*N)`) bụ ~10 × ọsọ ọsọ kwa mbinye aka.
crypto.h2p5: Ụdị mbinye aka: `R || S`, 32 bytes nke ọ bụla, obere-endian.
crypto.h2l1: Nnọchite anya igodo ọha: 32-byte abịakọrọ ọnụ. Ọ na-adị irè mgbe niile - ọ nweghị "okwu na njedebe".
crypto.h2l2: Nnọchite anya igodo nzuzo: mkpụrụ 32-byte. A na-enweta scalar gbasaara na ijiji site na SHA-512.
crypto.h2l3: Kedu ihe kpatara na ECDSA: ECDSA chọrọ ezigbo mma RNG maka mbinye aka ọ bụla; ihe na-adịghị mma RNG na-agbapụta igodo nzuzo. Ed25519 bụ mkpebi siri ike, ọ nweghị RNG achọrọ n'oge akara aka.
crypto.h3p1: AES na ọnọdụ Galois/Counter (NIST SP 800-38D). Igodo 256-bit, 96-bit nonces, 128-bit mkpado nyocha.
crypto.h3p2: A na-eji ya maka: envelopu ciphertext ozi, envelopu chunk faịlụ, ụgwọ nkwụghachi azụ ezoro ezo, ngwunye nkwụnye akara akara.
crypto.h3p3: Nrụpụta anaghị arụ ọrụ: ozi ọ bụla na-ewepụta 96-bit ọhụrụ nonce. Ọnụ ụzọ ahụ na-eso 10 ^ 6 nonces ikpeazụ n'otu ọnụ ụlọ wee tufuo oyiri na-agbachitere - onye ahịa agaghị emepụta oyiri na mbụ, mana chere-ọ dịghị ihe dị ọnụ ala.
crypto.h3p4: Kedu ihe kpatara 96-bit nonces na ọ bụghị 128-bit: 96 bits bụ GCM-ọkọlọtọ "deterministic" nonce ogologo, ọ na-enye anyị 2 ^ 32 random nonces tupu mkparịta ụka ụbọchị ọmụmụ ghọrọ nchegbu. Otu igodo ime ụlọ na-atụgharị ogologo oge tupu nke ahụ, ya mere ọ dị mma.
crypto.h3p5: Nha mkpado: zuru 128bits. Anyị anaghị egbutu - nchekwa nchekwa adịghị eleghara anya yana mkpọpu na-abawanye ohere nke adịgboroja.
crypto.h3l1: Ngwa ngwa ngwaike: AES-NI (x86), ARMv8-A crypto ndọtị, ihe mgbochi crypto raara onwe ya nye na Apple Silicon. Ntinye ezoro ezo ~ 3 GB/s.
crypto.h3l2: Na ngwaọrụ ochie ARM na-enweghị mgbakwunye crypto: ~ 300 MB/s site na ngwanrọ. Ọ ka dị ngwa karịa diski IO.
crypto.h3l3: Data ejikọrọ: agafere nkụnye eji isi mee (`{v, room_id, sender_pseudo}`) ka AAD yabụ nkụnye eji isi mee emezighị emezi agaghị enyocha ya.
crypto.h4p1: HKDF (RFC 5869) nwere SHA-256. Na-enweta ọtụtụ igodo obere 32-byte site na otu ntinye 32-byte.
crypto.h4p2: Ejiri ya maka: kewaa X25519 mmepụta n'ime igodo nzuzo + MAC igodo + isi isi; na-enweta igodo ratchet mgbọrọgwụ site na gburugburu Diffie-Hellman; wulite igodo faịlụ kwa-chunk site na mgbọrọgwụ faịlụ.
crypto.h4p3: Eriri ozi na-ekpebi mgbe niile ASCII: `"v1:encryption"`, `"v1:mac", `"v1: nkụnye eji isi mee"`, `"v1:ndabere"`. Ụdị nsụgharị na-ahapụ anyị ka anyị gbanwee usoro igodo niile site na mgbanwe-eriri ozi.
crypto.h4p4: Nnu bụ nhọrọ. Na Vortex anyị na-eji id ụlọ dị ka nnu maka iwepụta igodo ime ụlọ nke mere na ọnụ ụlọ dị iche iche enweghị ike iji igodo ewepụtara na mberede ọ bụrụgodị na otu mmepụta X25519 pụtara.
crypto.h4l1: Gịnị kpatara SHA-256 ma ọ bụghị SHA-512: nyiwe niile nwere ngwaike SHA-256 ngwa ngwa; SHA-512 dị ngwa ngwa na CPU 64-bit mana ọ bụghị na ekwentị.
crypto.h4l2: Gịnị kpatara na KMAC dabere KDF: KMAC bụ niche. HKDF dị n'ọbá akwụkwọ crypto ọ bụla anyị na-eji.
crypto.h5p1: Argon2id (RFC 9106). Oke: m=64 MiB, t=3, p=4, hashLen=32.
crypto.h5p2: A na-eji ya maka: hash okwuntughe n'akụkụ nkesa (`users.password_hash`), igodo nkwado ndabere mpaghara, mbubata mbubata mkpụrụ-okwu.
crypto.h5p3: Gịnị kpatara paramita ndị a: OWASP 2023 ndụmọdụ. 64 MiB + 3 iterations na-ewe ~ 0.5 s na iPhone X - ngwaọrụ anyị na-akwado nwayọ. Onye na-awakpo ASIC nwere 100 × bandwidth ebe nchekwa ekwentị ka chọrọ ~5 ms kwa mbọ. Okwuntughe ogologo (entropy> 40 bits) na-aghọ ihe na-enweghị ike ịgbawa n'ogo.
crypto.h5p4: Ọkpụkpọ nchekwa: `argon2:<encoded>` ebe etinyere ya bụ eriri usoro RFC gụnyere nnu, ebe nchekwa, iterations, na hash.
crypto.h5l1: Kedu ihe kpatara Argon2id ma ọ bụghị Argon2i ma ọ bụ Argon2d: 2id bụ ngwakọ - nke mbụ gafere na-emegide ọwa akụkụ (i-mode), ngafe na-esote na-eguzogide GPU/ASIC (d-mode). Signal na-eji otu ihe ahụ.
crypto.h5l2: Ntụle Dummy-hash: ọbụlagodi mgbe onye ọrụ anaghị adị, anyị ka na-eji hash na-agba ọsọ nyochaa Argon2 adịgboroja. Nke a na-ahazi oge nbanye ka ndị na-awakpo enweghị ike ịgụta aha njirimara site na oge nzaghachi.
crypto.h5l3: Rehash na nbanye: ọ bụrụ na onye nchịkwa ihe nkesa kwụsịrị ụgwọ ebe nchekwa, a na-emegharị hashes ochie na nbanye ọzọ na-aga nke ọma. N'ụzọ doro anya nye onye ọrụ.
crypto.h6p1: FIPS 203 (NIST, 2024). ⟪2 . Igodo ọha 1184-byte, 1088-byte ciphertext, 32-byte ekekọrịtara nzuzo.
crypto.h6p2: Ejiri ya maka: igodo nnọkọ post-quantum ngwakọ. Mgbe ndị ọgbọ abụọ ahụ na-akpọsa Kyber nkwado igodo nnọkọ bụ `HKDF(x25519_mmepụta || kyber_output)`.
crypto.h6p3: Gịnị kpatara ngwakọ: ọ bụrụgodị na Kyber mechaa gbajiri (ọ bụ nwata), akụkụ X25519 ka na-echebe anyị. Ijikọta na-enye nke kacha mma.
crypto.h6p4: Kedu ihe kpatara Kyber na ọ bụghị ndị ọzọ NIST chọrọ: ọ bụ nke ahọpụtara maka nhazi ọkwa. Nnweta koodu sara mbara (liboks, pqcrypto).
crypto.h6l1: Arụmọrụ: isi ọgbọ ~ 100 µs, encapsulation ~ 30 µs, decapsulation ~ 50 µs. Ọ na-adịchaghị mma ma e jiri ya tụnyere nkwụsị njem okirikiri.
crypto.h6l2: Ọnụ bandwit: 1088 bytes kwa ciphertext, 1184 bytes maka igodo ọha. A na-akwụ ụgwọ oge na kọntaktị mbụ; emesia ọ bụ efu.
crypto.h6l3: Akụkụ nkesa: ngwugwu `pqcrypto`Python nwere `kem.ml_kem_768`. Akụkụ ndị ahịa: liboqs site na njikọ ikpo okwu.
crypto.h7p1: Signal's Double Ratchet (dị ka akọwapụtara na nkọwa ọha nke 2016). Na-ejikọta oke Diffie-Hellman na yinye igodo symmetric.
crypto.h7p2: Ejiri ya maka: ozi ozugbo n'etiti ngwaọrụ abụọ. Ime ụlọ otu na-eji atụmatụ “igodo izipu” dị mfe agbanyụpụrụ n'ime ụlọ.
crypto.h7p3: Ngwongwo: nzuzo nzuzo (imebi ngwaọrụ naanị na-ekpughe ozi ọ nataworo, ọ bụghị nke ga-eme n'ọdịnihu), nchekwa nkwụghachi ụgwọ (nkwaliteghachi na-agwọta mgbe nkwekọrịta isi gasịrị), nnyefe na-enweghị usoro (ihe ruru ozi 1000 nke ịwụ).
crypto.h7l1: Okpu ogologo yinye: ozi 1000 kwa yinye tupu mmanye emegharịghachi. Na-amachi mmebi sitere na igodo yinye zuru.
crypto.h7l2: Cache igodo amafere: ihe ruru 1000 igodo anaghị akwụ ụgwọ ka edobere na ebe nchekwa kwa yinye. E wezụga nke ahụ, a jụrụ ozi ahụ ka ọ dị ụkọ.
crypto.h7l3: Ihe mkpuchi nkụnye eji isi mee: na ndabara. nkụnye eji isi mee na-ebu metadata ratchet wee jiri igodo nkụnye eji isi mee nke ewepụtara na mgbọrọgwụ site na HKDF.
crypto.h8p1: Ihe njirimara faịlụ na-abụghị nke cryptographic na iguzosi ike n'ezi ihe na-eji BLAKE3 n'ihi na ọ dị 10 × ọsọ ọsọ karịa SHA-256 na nnukwu blọb.
crypto.h8p2: Ejiri ya maka: faịlụ 'sha256' kọlụm dị na DB (aha akụkọ ihe mere eme; n'ezie BLAKE3 n'okpuru mkpuchi kemgbe v0.1.2), ndep mgbakwunye, nlele-ebugote iguzosi ike n'ezi ihe.
crypto.h8p3: Ọkwa nchekwa: BLAKE3 siri ike nke cryptographically (256-bit); anyị na-akpọ kọlụm 'sha256' maka ndakọrịta mbata naanị.
crypto.h9p1: A na-emepụta ihe ọ bụla na-adịghị, prekeys, ụkpụrụ ịma aka site na OS RNG: 'SecRandom' na iOS, 'java.security.SecureRandom' na gam akporo, 'secrets.token_bytes' na Python (kechie `/dev/urandom` ma ọ bụ otu).
crypto.h9p2: Ọ dịghị mgbe `random.random()`, ọ dịghị mgbe `Math.random()`, ọ dịghị mgbe `rand()`. Iwu lint machibidoro iji ha eme ihe na modul crypto.
crypto.h10p1: Ntụle HMAC, nkwenye mbinye aka, nkwenye hash okwuntughe - ha niile na-eji oge oge niile iji gbochie ọwa akụkụ oge.
crypto.h1_a: X25519 bụ elliptical-curve Diffie-Hellman n'elu Curve25519 n'ụdị Montgomery ya. Igodo 32-byte, 32-byte kesara nzuzo. Igodo nzuzo ọ bụla / njirimara ngwaọrụ static / igodo nnọkọ dị na Vortex na-eji ya.
crypto.h1_b: Alice na Bob nke ọ bụla nwere igodo nzuzo a, b na igodo ọha A = a·G, B = b·G ebe G bụ ebe mgbaba. Ha na-agbakọ s = a·B = b·A. Ihe nzuzo 32-byte kekọrịtara na-abanye na HKDF-SHA256 iji nweta igodo symmetric AES-GCM. A na-eme mgbakọ n'usoro n'oge ọ bụla site na iji ubube Montgomery; enweghị alaka na data nzuzo.
crypto.h1_c: Curve25519 bụ Daniel J. Bernstein bipụtara na 2005 wee họrọ ya site na IETF na RFC 7748 (2016). Ndị Signal, WhatsApp, OpenSSH, WireGuard nabatara ya. Vortex na-eji ya n'ihi na ọ na-agba ọsọ karịa P-256, nwere nnukwu igodo 32-byte siri ike, na-ezere nchegbu NIST, na ikpo okwu ọ bụla na-ebuga mmejuputa siri ike.
crypto.h1_f:
Igodo nkeonwe: ∈ [0, 2²⁵⁵) (32 bytes obere-endian)
Igodo ọha: A = a · G (isi ihe agbakwunyere 32-byte)
Ekekọrịtara nzuzo: s = a · B = b · A (32 bytes, →HKDF ntinye)
crypto.h2_a: Ed25519 bụ nwanne mbinye aka nke X25519, na-eji otu akụkụ ahụ n'ụdị ya gbagọrọ agbagọ-Edwards. 32-byte ọhaneze igodo, 64-byte mbinye aka, deterministic na ndabara.
crypto.h2_b: Iji igodo nzuzo banye ozi m d: gbakọọ r = SHA-512(d, m), R = r·G, c = SHA-512(R, A, m), S = r + c·a. mbinye aka bụ (R, S). Nyocha: lelee R + c·A = S·G. Nbinye aka siri ike na-ezere ihe egwu agaghị eji ya eme ihe kpamkpam - mbinye aka abụọ nke otu ozi nwere otu igodo bụ otu.
crypto.h2_c: Ed25519 (RFC 8032) si na akwụkwọ Bernstein 2011 ya na Duif, Lange, Schwabe, na Yang pụta. A nabatara nke ọma mgbe afọ 2013 gasịrị. Apple's CryptoKit, Google's Tink, libsodium, OpenSSH niile na-eji ya. Vortex jiri Ed25519 bịanye aka n'envelopu gọọmentị ọ bụla yana akaebe ọnụ ọ bụla.
crypto.h2_f:
Akara (d, m): r = SHA-512(d∥m);  R = r·G
              c = SHA-512(R∥A∥m);  S = r + ca
              laghachi (R, S)

Nyochaa: c = SHA-512(R∥A∥m);  R + c·A ≟ S·G
crypto.h3_a: AES na Galois/Counter Mode. Igodo 256-bit, 96-bit random nonces, 128-bit mkpado nyocha. Blọb ọ bụla ezoro ezo na Vortex na-eji GCM.
crypto.h3_b: GCM na-agba AES n'ụdị CTR wee gbakọọ GHASH n'elu ciphertext + AAD site na iji igodo dị iche ewepụtara na igodo nzuzo. Tag = GHASH(AAD, ciphertext) ⊕ AES-CTR(0). Mwepụtaghachi nkwubi okwu GHASH ma atụnyere - otu obere ntụgharị ọ bụla dara nkwenye. Ngwa ngwa ngwa ngwa na CPU ọgbara ọhụrụ site na AES-NI ma ọ bụ ARMv8-A crypto ndọtị.
crypto.h3_c: AES meriri asọmpi NIST AES na 2001. Vortex na-ahọrọ igodo 256-bit n'agbanyeghị 128-bit ga-ezuru ndị mmegide oge gboo - ịwụ elu na 256-bit na-enye anyị ihe dịka 128 bits nke nchekwa post-quantum n'okpuru algorithm Grover.
crypto.h3_f:
Encrypt (k, n, aad, pt): ct = AES-CTR(k, n, pt)
                          mkpado = GHASH_h (aad∥ct∥lens) ⊕ AES(k, n∥1)
                          laghachi ct ∥tag
Ejikwaghị ihe ọzọ ⇒ nzuzo + agbajiri eziokwu.
crypto.h4_a: HKDF (HMAC dabere KDF, RFC 5869) na-atụgharị otu igodo n'ime ọtụtụ. Na-ewere ntinye entropy dị elu yana akara okirikiri; na-ewepụta 32 bytes kwa labelụ.
crypto.h4_b: Nzọụkwụ abụọ: Wepụta na gbasaa. wepụ = HMAC-SHA256(nnu, IKM) → PRK. Mgbasawanye = HMAC-SHA256(PRK, info∥counter) agbakwunyere maka bytes len. Anyị na-eji nke a kewaa mmepụta X25519 n'ime igodo nzuzo, igodo MAC, yana igodo nkụnye eji isi mee nwere eriri ozi "v1: encryption", "v1: mac", "v1: nkụnye eji isi mee".
crypto.h4_c: Hugo Krawczyk bipụtara HKDF na EUROCRYPT 2010 wee hazie ya dị ka RFC 5869 na 2010. Ejiri TLS 1.3 mee ihe maka nhazi oge ya, site na Signal for Double Ratchet, site na WireGuard maka igodo nnọkọ. Ụdị nsụgharị dị na eriri ozi na-eme ka anyị gbanwee usoro isi igodo niile site na ịpị "v1" → "v2".
crypto.h4_f:
PRK = HMAC-SHA256(nnu, IKM)
T(i) = HMAC-SHA256(PRK, T(i-1) ∥ ozi ∥ i)
OKM = T(1) ∥ T(2) ∥ … gbajiri ka len bytes
crypto.h5_a: Argon2id bụ ihe nchekwa okwuntughe siri ike emebere iji guzogide ndị na-awakpo GPU na ASIC. Oke m=64MiB, t=3, p=4, hashLen=32.
crypto.h5_b: Argon2id na-agwakọta Argon2i (na-eguzogide ọwa akụkụ site na ịghara ịbanye na data enwetara paswọọdụ) yana Argon2d (na-ejupụta ebe nchekwa na-atụghị anya ya ka ngwaike yiri ya enweghị ike igbutu akụkụ). Nkeji nke mbụ gafere bụ data na-adabereghị na ya (i-mode); Nke fọduru dabere na data (d-mode). 0.5 sekọnd gbakọọ na iPhone X na paramita anyị, ihe dị ka 5 ms na ASIC - ọsọ ọsọ ~ 100 dị ntakịrị ma e jiri ya tụnyere SHA-256 hashes ebe ASIC meriri site na 1 000 000 ×.
crypto.h5_c: Argon2 meriri 2015 Password Hashing Asọmpi haziri Dmitry Khovratovich na Alex Biryukov. Haziri dị ka RFC 9106 na 2021. Ejiri 1Password, Bitwarden, LastPass. Paragraf Vortex sitere na ndụmọdụ OWASP 2023, na-elele ka ịbanye na ngwaọrụ anyị na-akwado nwayọ nwayọ (iPhone X) n'okpuru 1 sekọnd.
crypto.h5_f:
ọnụ ahịa (m=64MiB, t=3, p=4) ≈ 0.5 s na iPhone X
Ọnụ onye mbuso agha: m × t × (p / attack_parallelism)
Na 10¹⁰ guesses/s nwere 40-bit entropy paswọọdụ:
  10¹² sekọnd = 32 000 afọ
crypto.h6_a: Kyber-768 (ML-KEM-768) bụ NIST-ọkọlọtọ n'usoro nkpuchi isi ihe n'azụ-quantum. Na-enye igodo nnọkọ ọnụ-echekwara yana X25519.
crypto.h6_b: Alice na-emepụta (pk, sk). Bob na-akpọ Encapsulate(pk) → (c, ss); na-eziga c na Alice. Alice kpọrọ Decapsulate(sk, c) → ss. Akụkụ abụọ a na-ekekọrịta ss, ihe nzuzo 32-byte. Nchekwa na-ebelata na nsogbu Module-LWE, nke ekwenyere na quantum- hardd. Anyị na-ejikọta ya na X25519: session_key = HKDF(x25519_output ∥ kyber_output). Ọ bụrụ na ọkara nke ọ bụla dị ndụ, nnọkọ ahụ ga-eme.
crypto.h6_c: NIST họpụtara Kyber na Julaị 2022 ka asọmpi afọ 6 gachara. Haziri dị ka FIPS 203 na Ọgọst 2024. Vortex na-ebuga Kyber dị ka nhọrọ maka na ọ na-agbakwunye ~2 KB n'otu oge aka aka; enyere site na ndabara maka ọkwa akwụ ụgwọ, banye ebe ọzọ. Signal kwadoro usoro ngwakọ a na 2023 ma Chrome nakweere na 2024.
crypto.h6_f:
KeyGen(): (pk ∈ Zq^k, sk ∈ Zq^k) pk = 1184 B, sk = 2400 B
Ihe mkpuchi (pk): (ct ∈ Zq^k, ss ∈ {0,1}²⁵⁶) ct = 1088 B
Mkpọpu (sk,ct): ss ∈ {0,1}²⁵⁶
nnọkọ ngwakọ = HKDF(x25519_out ∥ kyber_out, info=" session-v1")
crypto.h7_a: Signal's Double Ratchet na-enye nzuzo n'ihu na nchekwa nbibi maka mkparịta ụka 1:1.
crypto.h7_b: Agbụ abụọ: eriri izipu na agbụ nnabata. Ozi ọ bụla na-aga n'ihu site na HKDF. Ọtụtụ mgbe, Diffie-Hellman ratchet na-akwalite mgbọrọgwụ, na-atụgharịkwa agbụ abụọ ahụ. Nkwekọrịta igodo yinye na-ekpughere naanị ozi ọ ezoro ezo ozugbo. Mgbe DH ratchet gasịrị, ozi ga-eme n'ọdịnihu adịghị mma ọbụlagodi ma onye mwakpo zuru igodo yinye.
crypto.h7_c: Trevor Perrin na Moxie Marlinspike chepụtara na 2013, ebugara na Signal 2014, nke WhatsApp nakweere (2016), Mkparịta ụka Nzuzo Facebook Messenger, Mkparịta ụka nzuzo nke Skype. Public spec na 2016. Vortex's mmejuputa iwu bụ ọdụ ụgbọ mmiri kpọmkwem; Mmekọrịta ya na ndị ahịa-protocol Signal nọ na map okporo ụzọ v0.4.
crypto.h7_f:
zipu: CK = HKDF(CK, "nzọụkwụ");  MK = HKDF(CK, "msg")
nata: CK' = HKDF(CK', "nzọụkwụ"); MK' = HKDF(CK', "msg")
DH ratchet: RK, CK = HKDF(DH(anyị_eph, ha_eph), RK_prev)
crypto.h8_a: BLAKE3 hashing maka faịlụ - akụkụ nke isi crypto. Nke a bụ otu n'ime isi usoro ndị a na-ezo aka n'oge ntụaka Vortex. Gụọ isiakwụkwọ gbara ya gburugburu maka nkọwa sara mbara; ngalaba a na-abanye n'ime akparamagwa a kapịrị ọnụ.
crypto.h8_b: Nchịkọta mmejuputa maka "BLAKE3 hashing maka faịlụ". A na-emejuputa usoro a na modul kwekọrọ n'okpuru 'app/', `ios/Modules/sources/', ma ọ bụ 'android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/'. Modul README na-akpọpụta ụzọ faịlụ ziri ezi.
crypto.h8_c: Usoro "BLAKE3 hashing maka faịlụ" sitere na ntọhapụ Vortex. Nhazi ahụ na-esochi nyocha na omume mmepụta nke ndị ozi mbụ bipụtara. Akụkọ ụdị dị na ndekọ `CHANGELOG.md` mgbe ibe ọ bụla rutere na ihe kpaliri ya.
crypto.h9_a: Ọgbọ nọmba random — akụkụ nke isi crypto. Nke a bụ otu n'ime isi usoro a na-ezo aka n'oge ntụaka Vortex. Gụọ isiakwụkwọ gbara ya gburugburu maka nkọwa sara mbara; ngalaba a na-abanye n'ime akparamagwa a kapịrị ọnụ.
crypto.h9_b: Nchịkọta mmejuputa maka "ọgbọ nọmba random". A na-emejuputa usoro a na modul kwekọrọ n'okpuru 'app/', `ios/Modules/sources/', ma ọ bụ 'android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/'. Modul README na-akpọpụta ụzọ faịlụ ziri ezi.
crypto.h9_c: Usoro "Ọgbọ nọmba Random" malitere n'ofe Vortex ewepụtara. Nhazi ahụ na-esochi nyocha na omume mmepụta nke ndị ozi mbụ bipụtara. Akụkọ ụdị dị na ndekọ `CHANGELOG.md` mgbe ibe ọ bụla rutere na ihe kpaliri ya.
crypto.h10_a: Arụ ọrụ oge niile - akụkụ nke isi crypto. Nke a bụ otu n'ime isi usoro a na-ezo aka n'oge ntụaka Vortex. Gụọ isiakwụkwọ gbara ya gburugburu maka nkọwa sara mbara; ngalaba a na-abanye n'ime akparamagwa a kapịrị ọnụ.
crypto.h10_b: Nchịkọta mmejuputa maka "arụmọrụ oge niile". A na-emejuputa usoro a na modul kwekọrọ n'okpuru 'app/', `ios/Modules/sources/', ma ọ bụ 'android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/'. Modul README na-akpọpụta ụzọ faịlụ ziri ezi.
crypto.h10_c: Usoro "arụ ọrụ oge niile" malitere n'ofe Vortex ewepụtara. Nhazi ahụ na-esochi nyocha na omume mmepụta nke ndị ozi mbụ bipụtara. Akụkọ ụdị dị na ndekọ `CHANGELOG.md` mgbe ibe ọ bụla rutere na ihe kpaliri ya.

cryptoWire.title: Ụdị waya Crypto
cryptoWire.subtitle: Nhazi byte kpọmkwem maka blọb ezoro ezo.
cryptoWire.intro: Isiakwụkwọ a na-akọwapụta bytes na waya. Onye ọ bụla na-emejuputa onye ahịa ọzọ ma ọ bụ ngwa nyocha nwere ike ịgụ ya.
cryptoWire.h1p1: Nhazi: `{v:1, nonce:<12-byte hex>, ciphertext:<variable hex>, sender_pseudo:<32-hex>, sent_at:<unix_ms>}`. Ezitere n'elu HTTPS (POST) na WebSocket (ụdị etiti `m`).
cryptoWire.h1p2: ọdịnaya `ciphertext` mgbe AES-GCM decryption: CBOR `{v:1, ederede?:<string>, mgbakwụnye?:[<file_id>, …], zaghachi_to?:<msg_id>, na-edezi?:[<prior_text>, …], na-ekwu?:[<user_id>, …]
cryptoWire.h1p3: Mkpado na-eso: eriri 'ciphertext' byte bụ (ụgwọ akwụrụ ezoro ezo || mkpado 16-byte). Onye ahịa na-ekewa n'ogologo.
cryptoWire.h1p4: AAD: A na-agafe id ụlọ hex obere dị ka data ejikọtara. Ijikọ id ọnụ ụlọ na-egbochi ịmegharị ọnụ ụlọ.
cryptoWire.h2p1: Igodo mgbọrọgwụ faịlụ bụ 32 bytes enweghị usoro. Igodo ọ bụla: `HKDF(mgbọrọgwụ, ozi: "file:chunk:" + <offset>, oghere: 32)'.
cryptoWire.h2p2: Ederede ederede: AES-GCM nwere igodo chunk ọ bụla, 96-bit enweghị usoro, AAD: `<file_id> || <offset>'. Nke kacha nta 512 KiB.
cryptoWire.h2p3: Iguzosi ike n'ezi ihe nke faịlụ niile: onye ahịa na-agbakọ BLAKE3 n'elu ederede doro anya wee zigara onye nnata dị ka 'plain_blake3' site na ozi ụlọ. Onye nnata na-agbakọ ọzọ ma ọ budata ma nyochaa ya.
cryptoWire.h3p1: Onye ahịa bulitere `p256dh_pub` (32-byte X25519) n'ọnụ ọnụ.
cryptoWire.h3p2: Mgbe ntunye ruru, ọnụ na-ewepụta igodo ephemeral X25519, jiri `p256dh_pub` mee DH, na-enweta igodo AES-GCM site na HKDF.
cryptoWire.h3p3: Akara akara: `{njedebe, p256dh: ụlọ mmanya ndị ahịa, auth: 16 bytes, data: ciphertext||tag}`. APNs/FCM hụ naanị 'data'.
cryptoWire.h3p4: Onye ahịa na-eji igodo nzuzo ya na `p256dh` decrypts na nnata ya (nke bụ n'ezie ụlọ mmanya ephemeral ọnụ na envelopu).
cryptoWire.h4p1: Okwuntughe na-enweta igodo ndabere site na Argon2id (m=64MiB, t=3, p=4, nnu=<random 16B>, hashLen=32).
cryptoWire.h4p2: Blob: `{nnu, nonce, ciphertext}`. Ciphertext bụ CBOR nke `{v:1, ụlọ:[{id,key,ct_refs}...], profaịlụ:{...}, kọntaktị:[...]}`.
cryptoWire.h4p3: Echekwara ya na mpaghara (iCloud / Google Drive) ma ọ bụ n'ọnụ ọnụ n'ime ụlọ nke onye ọrụ.
cryptoWire.h5p1: Ozi ọnụ ụzọ: `{source_node: <pubkey>, target_user: <id>, n'ime: {... dị ka envelopu ime ụlọ ...}, akara: <64-byte Ed25519>}'.
cryptoWire.h5p2: `sig` na-ekpuchi CBOR-usoro '{source_node, target_user, inner}'. Ebumnuche na-enyocha megide 'isi iyi_node' pubkey sitere na 'ọnụ_nodes'.
cryptoWire.h1_a: Ozi otu ọnụ ụlọ dị na waya bụ CBOR dict nwere ụgwọ ezoro ezo, NOnce, pseudonym onye ezipụ, na akara oge. The envelopu bụ otu ma ọ na-agba HTTPS (POST) ma ọ bụ WebSocket (frame ụdị `m`).
cryptoWire.h1_b: Onye ahịa na-ewepụta usoro ozi ahụ `{v:1, ederede, zaghachi, zitere_at}` dị ka CBOR → `pt`. Na-emepụta enweghị 12-byte enweghị usoro. Na-agbakọ `aad = hex(room_id)`. Kpọọ `ct = AES-GCM-256-Encrypt(key_room, nonce, pt, aad)`. Kechie n'ime `{v:1, ciphertext: hex(ct), nonce: hex(nonce), sender_pseudo: hex(pseudo), zitere_na: unix_ms}` wee zipu. Onye nnata na-enyocha mkpado GCM n'oge a na-ewepụ ihe, wee CBOR-na-atụgharị ederede dị larịị.
cryptoWire.h1_c: A na-akpado ụdị waya ahụ ụdị kemgbe v0.0.4 ka ewepụtara v0.0.3 na-ete ime nke na-enweghị ubi `v` - anyị ga-akụtu usoro ahụ dum mgbe anyị gbakwunyere `thread_id' n'ihi na ndị ahịa ochie dara na igodo amaghị. Ihe mmụta: udi waya ọ bụla ga-abịa n'ihu na-ebu `v:N' n'ubi mbụ ya ka ndakọrịta n'ihu pụtara ìhè.
cryptoWire.h2_a: A na-ekewa faịlụ n'ime nchikota nke nwere oke, nke ọ bụla nwere igodo nke ya sitere na mgbọrọgwụ faịlụ yana nkwụsị nke chunk. Izo ya ezo n'otu-nkụkọ na-ahapụ onye na-ezipụ ya ka ọ kwụsịtụ/ maliteghachi n'oke mkpọ ọ bụla.
cryptoWire.h2_b: Igodo mgbọrọgwụ faịlụ bụ 32 bytes enweghị usoro. Igodo nke ọ bụla bụ `HKDF(mgbọrọgwụ, info="file:chunk:" + str(offset), len=32)'. Ejiri igodo nke ya AES-GCM ezoro ezo nke ọ bụla, 96-bit nonce na 'aad = file_id ∥ offset`. Chunks ndabara na 512 KiB; 4 MB okpu. A na-eziga faịlụ zuru ezu BLAKE3 dị ka `plain_blake3` n'ime ozi ime ụlọ nke na-ezo aka na faịlụ ahụ ka ndị nnata wee nwee ike nyochaa ma mebie ya.
cryptoWire.h2_c: Mega.nz butere ihe nzuzo E2E izo ya ezo nke nwere igodo chunk na 2013 wee nụchaa ya site na nkwado nnukwu faịlụ nke Signal na 2019. Vortex's 512 KiB ndabara bụ nha nke TCP na-achịkwa ịgba ọsọ na-eme ka ọkpọkọ zuru ezu n'enweghị ogologo ogologo 4G. Anyị nwalere 256/512/1024/4096 KiB na 512 bụ ebe dị ụtọ na nha anyị.
cryptoWire.h3_a: Envelopu nke emechiri emechi na-ezochi ụgwọ ngosi ngosi site na Apple / Google / Mozilla site na iji igodo X25519 akọwapụtara ngwaọrụ.
cryptoWire.h3_b: Onye ahịa na-edeba aha `p256dh_pub` na 'auth' n'ọnụ ọnụ. Mgbe ntugharị ruru, ọnụ na-agba ephemeral-ECDH na p256dh_pub, na-enweta igodo + nonce site na HKDF na nzuzo nzuzo dị ka nnu. Jiri AES-GCM zoo '{ aha, ahụ, ụlọ_id, ozi_id}'. Na-eziga ndekọ ahụ dị ka ubi 'data' nke na-adịghị ahụkebe na onye na-eweta ihe. Mgbatị ngwaọrụ na-enwetaghachi, decrypts, na-atụgharị.
cryptoWire.h3_c: Mpempe akwụkwọ emechiri emechi bụ nkọwa nzuzo nzuzo nke Weebụ Push (RFC 8291, 2017). Apple nakweere ya na iOS 16's Notification Service Extensions. Tupu akwadoro nkwado nke mechiri emechi, Signal na WhatsApp zipụrụ pings "ihe rutere" na-enweghị ọdịnaya ma mee ka ngwa ahụ weta ozi ahụ n'ụra - nke dị nwayọ. Ntụnye akara akara na-enye anyị nzuzo njedebe-na-ọgwụgwụ gbakwunyere nrụnye ozugbo.
cryptoWire.h4_a: Nchekwa nchekwa ezoro ezo na-ahapụ onye ọrụ iweghachi igodo ụlọ + profaịlụ + ụbọchị 90 gara aga na ngwaọrụ ọhụrụ site na paswọọdụ naanị.
cryptoWire.h4_b: Igodo ndabere na-enweta paswọọdụ site na Argon2id nwere nnu 16-byte na-enweghị usoro. Ibu a na-akwụ ụgwọ bụ CBOR: `{v:1, ụlọ: [{id, igodo, msg_ref_ids}], profaịlụ, kọntaktị}`. Ezobere ya na AES-GCM n'okpuru igodo ewepụtara. Echekwara ya na mpaghara (iCloud / Google Drive) ma ọ bụ dị ka faịlụ n'ime ụlọ ígwé ojii nkeonwe nke onye ọrụ. Weghachite: tinye paswọọdụ → Argon2id → decrypt → igodo mbubata na ntụnyere aka.
cryptoWire.h4_c: Emebere usoro a na 1Password's OPVault (2013) na mbupụ ezoro ezo nke Bitwarden (2017). Ha abụọ na-eji KDF-mgbe-AEAD na metadata jikọtara nnu. Vortex gbakwunyere mbelata ụbọchị 90 n'ihi na nkwado ndabere nke akụkọ ihe mere eme bụ 100 MB+ na nnwale; Ọnụ ọgụgụ ka ukwuu nke iweghachite naanị ozi ndị na-adịbeghị anya chọrọ, yana ọdịnaya ochie ka enwere ike iru site na ederede safa mgbe onye ọrụ nwere njikọta.
cryptoWire.h5_a: Ozi ọgbakọ ọnụ ụzọ gafere n'ime envelopu ezoro ezo nke dị ugbu a n'ime envelopu mpụta bịanyere aka na ya na-egosi ọnụ isi mmalite.
cryptoWire.h5_b: Node A na-ewepụta usoro '{source_node, target_user, inner_ct, inner_nonce, ezitere na}` dị ka CBOR. Jiri igodo ntọhapụ nzuzo Ed25519 → `sig` banye. POST '{envelopu, sig}' gaa n'ọnụ B's `/federation/contever'. B na-enyocha 'sig' megide igodo pub maka 'source_node' na 'federations', na-elele stampụ n'ime mpio skew nkeji 5, wee dee ciphertext dị n'ime na tebụl 'ozi' nke ya maka onye ọrụ.
cryptoWire.h5_c: A na-agbaziri envelopu mpụta mbinye aka site na Matrix's federation spec (2015) na ActivityPub's HTTP Signatures (2018). Window nkeji 5 dakọtara na ndụmọdụ SMTP's RFC 5321 wee gbochie mwakpo ọzọ ebe onye mwakpo weghaara otu gọọmentị POST ma megharịa ya ka awa gachara. Vortex họọrọ Ed25519 karịa RSA-PSS n'ihi na Ed25519 mbinye aka bụ 64 bytes vs RSA-PSS-2048's 256 bytes - okwu mgbe gọọmentị na-akparịta ụka.
cryptoWire.h2_f:
file_root = rand (32)
chunk_key (o) = HKDF(faịlụ_root, "file:chunk:" + o, 32)
chunk_ct (o) = AES-GCM(chunk_key(o), rand(12), plaintext, aad=file_id ∥ o)
full_hash = BLAKE3(plaintext_bytes_of_full_file) // ezitere dị ka plain_blake3
cryptoWire.h3_f:
ephemeral = (priv, ụlọ mmanya);  ikm = ECDH(ephemeral.priv, p256dh_pub)
prk = HMAC-SHA256(auth, ikm)
igodo = HKDF-gbasawanye(prk, "Content-Encoding: aes128gcm\0", 16)
nonce = HKDF-gbasawanye(prk, "Content-Encoding: nonce\0", 12)
ct = AES-GCM(igodo, nonce, CBOR{aha, ahụ, ụlọ_id, ozi_id})
waya = nnu (16) ∥ rs (4) ∥ na-abaghị uru (1) ∥ ephemeral.pub(32) ∥ ct
cryptoWire.h4_f:
nnu = rand (16)
igodo = Argon2id (okwuntughe, nnu, m = 64MiB, t=3, p=4, len=32)
enweghị ego = rand (12)
ct = AES-GCM( igodo, nonce, CBOR{ọnụ ụlọ, profaịlụ, kọntaktị}, aad="vortex-backup-v1")
faịlụ = {v:1, nnu, nonce, ct}

auth.title: Nyocha
auth.subtitle: Debanye aha, banye, nweta ume, kagbuo. JWT + X25519 + paswọọdụ nhọrọ / mkpụrụ / 2FA.
auth.intro: Vortex na-ewepụta JWT dị mkpụmkpụ (nnweta nkeji 15, ume ọhụrụ ụbọchị 30) jiri igodo ọha X25519 onye ọrụ jikọtara. Ntụle njedebe njedebe ọ bụla nwere mmetụta JWT + na-achọpụta na emebeghị igodo ahụ. Isiakwụkwọ a na-ekpuchi ihe ọ bụla na-asọ asọ site na njedebe ruo na njedebe.
auth.h1p1: Onye ahịa na-amalite site na iji OS RNG wepụta igodo nzuzo 32-byte X25519 ọhụrụ. Ọ na-enweta igodo ọha, na-etinye koodu dịka chars hex 64.
auth.h1p2: Onye ahịa ahụ ji '{username, password, x25519_public_key, display_name, phone, email, avatar_emoji, kyber_public_key?}' biputere `POST /api/authentication/register'.
auth.h1p3: Node kwadoro: aha njirimara dakọtara `^[a-z0-9_]{3,30}$` (obere obere iji zere squats homograph); paswọọdụ na-agafe ike ụdị zxcvbn (akara nkeji 2); ekwentị dakọtara E.164 ma ọ bụrụ na e nyere ya; email matches RFC 5322 basic regex ma ọ bụrụ na enyere ya.
auth.h1p4: Node na-enyocha `x25519_public_key` pụrụ iche -key pubkey ọ bụla nwere ike ịdebanye aha kpọmkwem otu akaụntụ. Nke a na-akwụsị mbuso agha ndebanye aha na-ejigharị otu igodo pub.
auth.h1p5: Node na-agba Argon2id na paswọọdụ (m=64MiB, t=3, p=4) wee chekwaa `argon2:$...$` na `users.password_hash`.
auth.h1p6: Node mint JWT abụọ: nnweta (Nkeji 15, `jti:<ngwaọrụ_id>`) na nweta ume (30 d). Na-ekwu: `{sub: user_id, jti: device_id, typ: access|nweta ume, exp: ...}`. Binyere aka HS256 n'elu ihe nkesa 64-byte nke sitere na `.env` kwajuru.
auth.h1p7: Node na-emepụta ahịrị `onye ọrụ_ngwaọrụ': `{user_id, device_id, user_agent, created_at}`. A na-ejikọta ume ọhụrụ ọ bụla na ngwaọrụ_id ya; ịkagbu ngwaọrụ na-egbu naanị iyi ahụ.
auth.h1p8: Azịza: `{ok, user_id, username, access_token, refresh_token, x25519_public_key, kyber_public_key, display_name, avatar_url, phone, email}`.
auth.h1p9: Ndị ahịa na-echekwa akara na Keychain (iOS) / EncryptedSharedPreferences (Android) / HttpOnly SameSite=Kuki siri ike (web).
auth.h1l1: Oke oke: ndebanye aha 5 kwa sekọnd 60 kwa IP. TESTING=ezigbo na-ewepụ nke a.
auth.h1l2: Ụdị ịkpọ òkù: ọ bụrụ 'REGISTRATION_MODE=ịkpọ òkù', ahụ ga-agụnyerịrị 'code_code' bara uru. A na-emepụta koodu site na admin API.
auth.h1l3: Ụdị emechiri emechi: `REGISTRATION_MODE=emechiela'. Naanị onye nchịkwa mkpụrụ nwere ike ịdebanye aha. Ndị ọrụ na-esote na-abata site na njikọ ịkpọ oku n'ime ụlọ ndị akọwapụtara.
auth.h2p1: Biputere ndị ahịa 'POST /api/authentication/login' na '{aha njirimara, paswọọdụ}'.
auth.h2p2: Node jụrụ 'ndị ọrụ' site na aha njirimara dị obere. Ọ bụrụ na ahụghị ya, ọ ka na-agba ọsọ Argon2 nke dummy megide hash oge niile iji hazie oge (~ 0.5 s n'ụzọ ọ bụla).
auth.h2p3: Ọ bụrụ na Argon2 nyochaa na-aga nke ọma na akaụntụ ahụ enweghị nkwarụ, ọnụ na-eweghachite otu envelopu dị ka aha aha. Emepụtara ahịrị 'ngwaọrụ' ọhụrụ; Ahịrị ndị dị adị ka ahapụ naanị ka onye ọrụ nwee ike ịbanye n'ọtụtụ ngwaọrụ.
auth.h2p4: Ọ bụrụ na nkwenye daa, ọnụ ga-eji `{njehie:" nzere na-ezighi ezi"}' weghachi 401. Enweghị ọdịiche dị n'etiti "aha njirimara ezighi ezi" na "paswọọdụ ezighi ezi" na nzaghachi.
auth.h2l1: Oke oke: Mgbalị 10 dara n'ime sekọnd 60 kwa IP. N'ịgafe 429 nwere nkụnye eji isi 'Tigharịa-Mgbe'.
auth.h2l2: Mkpọchi akaụntụ: Mgbalị 20 dara ada n'ime awa 24 tulee akaụntụ maka nyocha onye nchịkwa. Ndị ọrụ Legit naanị paswọọdụ-tọgharịa ụzọ ha.
auth.h2l3: Nchicha oge: `/api/authentication/ngwaọrụ' depụtara oge niile na-arụ ọrụ; onye ọrụ nwere ike ịkagbu ihe ọ bụla.
auth.h3p1: Mgbe akara ohere ahụ dị nso na njedebe (egwu ndị ahịa 'exp' na mpaghara) ma ọ bụ mgbe arịrịọ weghachiri 401 na 'token kubie ume', onye ahịa ahụ na-eji `{refresh_token}' biputere `POST /api/authentication/refresh`.
auth.h3p2: Node na-akọwapụta ume ọhụrụ ahụ, lelee `jti` ka dị na 'ngwaọrụ_ọrụ' (anaghị kagbuo), na-elele 'exp', wee chepụta akara nnabata ọhụrụ.
auth.h3p3: Agbanyụrụ ntụgharị ume ọhụrụ na ndabara. Kwado na `ROTATE_REFRESH=true` iji nyekwa ume ọhụrụ.
auth.h3p4: Ọ bụrụ na ume ọhụrụ kubie ume, kagbuo, ma ọ bụ adịgboroja, ọnụ ga-eweghachi 401. Onye ahịa na-apụ na mpaghara wee rịọ maka ịbanye ọzọ.
auth.h4p1: Ndị ahịa webụ nwere ike ịdebanye aha nyocha ikpo okwu (Touch ID, Face ID, Windows Hello, Android biometric). Ihe nkesa na-echekwa `{credential_id, public_key, counter}`.
auth.h4p2: Nbanye: `POST /api/authentication/passkey/begin` → ihe nkesa na-eweghachite ịma aka; akara ndị ahịa nwere akara passkey na nzuzo (dị na Secure Enclave / TPM); `POST /api/authentication/passkey/finish` → ihe nkesa na-enyocha na okwu JWT.
auth.h4p3: Nyocha monotonicity Counter: nkwenye ọ bụla ga-abawanyerịrị counter. Ọ bụrụ na ọ meghị, a na-emeso passkey ahụ ka emechiri emechi ma jụ.
auth.h5p1: Dịka ụzọ mgbake ọdachi, onye ọrụ nwere ike mbupụ mkpụrụ okwu 24 BIP-39. Ịbubata ya na ngwaọrụ ọ bụla na-ewughachi njirimara X25519 (mkpụrụ → HKDF → igodo static) wee gosipụta inwe ya site na ịma aka bịanyere aka na ya.
auth.h5p2: Mkpụrụ anaghị ahapụ ngwaọrụ ahụ. Ọnụ ụzọ na-ahụ naanị igodo ọha X25519 ewepụtara yana mbinye aka maka ịma aka sava.
auth.h5p3: Entropy: 256 bit (32 bytes). BIP-39 checksum bụ ọkọlọtọ, yabụ a na-ejide typos tupu ha erute na sava ahụ.
auth.h6p1: TOTP (RFC 6238) nwere usoro 30-s yana koodu ọnụọgụ isii. Nhọrọ kwa onye ọrụ.
auth.h6p2: Ndebanye aha: `POST /api/authentication/2fa/setup` weghachite ihe nzuzo + otpauth URI + QR. Onye ọrụ jiri Google Authenticator / Authy / 1Password nyocha. Onye ọrụ na-ezigaghachi koodu ọnụọgụ isii nke nlele iji gosi na ngwa ahụ na-arụ ọrụ.
auth.h6p3: Jiri 2FA wee banye: ka okwuntughe gafere, ọnụ ga-eweghachi `{needs_2fa: true}`. Onye ahịa kpaliri maka koodu yana biputere '/api/authentication/login/2fa`.
auth.h6p4: Oke oke: Mgbalị 5 TOTP kwa nkeji 5 kwa onye ọrụ. Ịgafefe na-ebute nkwụsịtụ 60 sekọnd yana ịdọ aka ná ntị email.
auth.h6p5: Koodu nkwado: Koodu ọnụọgụ 12 × 10 gosipụtara otu ugboro na ndebanye aha. Enwere ike iji koodu ọ bụla mee otu ugboro.
auth.h7p1: Ekwentị abanyela nwere ike ịbanye na mbadamba ihe ọhụrụ nwere koodu QR. Ngwaọrụ A biputere `POST /api/authentication/qr/begin` → ihe nkesa na-alaghachi otu ugboro na TTL.
auth.h7p2: Ngwaọrụ A na-egosiputa QR nwere 'nonce + user_id + server_url'. Ngwaọrụ B na-enyocha na biputere `POST /api/authentication/qr/verify` na enweghị otu.
auth.h7p3: Sava na-achọpụta na ọ dịghị ihe ka dị ndụ (TTL 60 s, otu-shot), jikọtara ngwaọrụ B ọhụrụ X25519 pubkey na akaụntụ onye ọrụ A (ahịrị 'ngwaọrụ' ọhụrụ), wee laghachi JWT na ngwaọrụ B.
auth.h7p4: Ngwaọrụ A na-enweta ọkwa WebSocket `{ụdị:"n", ihe omume:"ngwaọrụ ọhụrụ"}' ka onye ọrụ wee nwee ike kwado/kagbuo ozugbo.
auth.h8p1: Anyị kpachaara anya weghachi otu njehie ahụ maka "aha njirimara amaghi ama" na "paswọọdụ ezighi ezi". Oke ndebanye na-ezochi aha njirimara dị.
auth.h8p2: Ebe njedebe profaịlụ (`/api/users/{username}`) chọrọ nyocha. Onye mwakpo enweghị ike ịgụta aha njirimara na-enweghị ezigbo akara.
auth.h8p3: Oke oke na `/api/authentication/login` na-eme ka ike dị egwu na-arị arị.
auth.h1_a: Ndebanye aha na-emepụta njirimara ọhụrụ: X25519 keypair na ngwaọrụ ahụ, Argon2id paswọọdụ hash na ihe nkesa, JWT ụzọ ewepụtara na ịga nke ọma.
auth.h1_b: Kwụpụ 1: onye ahịa na-agba 'crypto.randomBytes(32)' maka igodo nzuzo X25519, na-enweta igodo ọha (~ 100 µs na ekwentị). Kwụpụ 2: POST /api/authentication/debanye aha na `{username, password, x25519_public_key, display_name, phone, email, avatar_emoji}`. Nzọụkwụ 3: ọnụ na-akwado site na Pydantic (aha njirimara regex, paswọọdụ ≥ 8 chars, ekwentị E.164, email RFC-5322-lite). Kwụpụ 4: ọnụ na-agba Argon2id(paswọọdụ) → `argon2:...`, na-echekwa na `users.password_hash`. Kwụpụ 5: ịnweta ọnụ ụzọ JWT (Nkeji 15) + nweta ume JWT (ụbọchị 30), na-aga n'ihu 'ahịrị_ngwaọrụ'.
auth.h1_c: Ọsọ a bụ mgbanwe ọgbara ọhụrụ nke oge mysql_real_escape_string PHP. Nchịkọta auth ọ bụla nke ọgbara ọhụrụ - Auth0, Firebase, Supabase - na-eme ụdị nke a. Ntugharị a kapịrị ọnụ na Vortex na-eziga X25519 pubkey n'ime oku ndekọ aha: ọ pụtara na ejikọtara akaụntụ ahụ na njirimara E2E ogologo oge site na etiti otu, etinyeghị ya ma emechaa. N'ike mmụọ nsọ site n'ichepụta protocol nke Signal 2013.
auth.h2_a: Nbanye na-enyocha paswọọdụ megide hash Argon2 echekwara wee wepụta ụzọ abụọ JWT ọhụrụ ma ọ dabara.
auth.h2_b: POST /api/authentication/login na `{username, password}`. Node jụrụ 'ndị ọrụ' site na aha njirimara dị obere. Ọ bụrụ na achọtara, na-enyocha Argon2id n'oge ọ bụla megide 'users.password_hash'. Ọ bụrụ na ahụghị ya, ka na-agba ọsọ Argon2 nke dummy megide eriri oge niile iji hazie oge. Ihe ịga nke ọma → ọhụrụ JWT abụọ + ahịrị 'ngwaọrụ_ọrụ' ọhụrụ (otu n'ime ngwaọrụ abanyela). Ọdịda → 401 nwere “ nzere na-ezighi ezi” - enweghị ọdịiche dị n'etiti aha njirimara ọjọọ na okwuntughe ọjọọ, iguzogide ngụkọ.
auth.h2_c: Nkwenye oge na-adị mgbe niile na hashing maka ndị ọrụ adịghị adị bụ akara ngosi anabatara na 2014 mgbe ndị nyocha gosipụtara ngụkọ oge na njedebe nbanye ha. Kemgbe ahụ a nakweere ya n'ọtụtụ ebe - django-axes, authelia, Keycloak niile na-eji ya. Omume a na-agbakwunye ~ 0.5 s na mbọ nbanye ọ bụla dara ada, nke dị mma; anyị ọnụego-oke nbanye nbanye na 10/min/IP agbanyeghị.
auth.h2_f:
dummy_hash = Argon2id ("__timing_equaliser__", nnu = edoziri, ...)

nbanye (u, p):
  ahiri = ndị ọrụ. chọta (aha njirimara=u.lower())
  Ọ bụrụ na ahịrị abụghị nke:
      Argon2Verify(dummy_hash, p) // hazie oge
      bulie 401
  ọ bụrụ na ọ bụghị Argon2Verify(row.password_hash, p):
      bulie 401
  weghachi mbipụta_jwt(ahịrị)
auth.h3_a: Nnweta akara ga-ekubi ume ka nkeji iri na ise gachara. Ntugharị na-agbanwe akara ngosi ume ọhụrụ dị ogologo ndụ maka akara nnweta ọhụrụ na-ajụghị onye ọrụ maka paswọọdụ ha.
auth.h3_b: egwu ndị ahịa 'exp' na mpaghara. Mgbe `ugbu a + 30s> exp`, ma ọ bụ mgbe arịrịọ weghachiri 401 na `token_kubie ume', onye ahịa na-eziga akara ngosi ume ọhụrụ na `/api/authentication/fresh'. Node na-achọpụta koodu, lelee `jti` nọ na 'ngwaọrụ_ọrụ' ma ọ bụghị 'kagbuo_na', na-enyocha 'exp', wee chepụta akara ohere nkeji iri na ise ọhụrụ. Ntụgharị ume ọhụrụ na-abanye site na `ROTATE_REFRESH=eziokwu` - gbanyụọ na ndabara n'ihi na ntugharị ntughari ume ọhụrụ na ohere ọ bụla na-emepụta asọmpi mgbe ndị ahịa abụọ na-enweta ume n'otu oge.
auth.h3_c: OAuth 2.0 (RFC 6749, 2012) webatara ohere + nweta nkewa. Ogologo ndụ nkeji iri na ise bụ nke etiti n'ofe ụlọ ọrụ - Google na-eji elekere 1, Auth0 na-akwụghị ụgwọ ruo awa 24, Okta ruo elekere 1. Anyị ewerela nkeji iri na ise ka ibelata mpio mgbe ihe nrịbama ohere ezuru ezuru bara uru. Ntugharị ụbọchị 30 dakọtara ihe ọtụtụ ngwa mkpanaka chọrọ iji mee ka ndị ọrụ banye n'ime otu ọnwa nke enweghị ọrụ.
auth.h4_a: Nbanye WebAuthn / passkey na-eji ihe nyocha ikpo okwu (Touch ID, Face ID, Windows Hello, Android biometric) kama paswọọdụ.
auth.h4_b: Ndebanye aha: ihe nkesa biputere ihe ịma aka; onye nyocha nke onye ahịa na-ewepụta keypair ọhụrụ n'ime oghere nchekwa ya wee zighachi igodo ọha + akaebe. Ihe nkesa na-echekwa `{credential_id, public_key, counter}`. Nbanye: `POST /api/authentication/passkey/begin` → ihe nkesa weghachiri ihe ịma aka; akara ndị ahịa na igodo nzuzo nke onye nyocha (nke echekwara na Secure Enclave, anaghị ahapụ mgbawa); `POST /api/authentication/passkey/finish` → sava na-enyocha mbinye aka megide igodo ọha echekwara. Ihe ngụgụ monotonic na-achọpụta ihe nyocha nke cloned.
auth.h4_c: FIDO2 / WebAuthn bụ ndị W3C haziri na 2019 mgbe ọtụtụ afọ nke FIDO Alliance rụchara ọrụ. Apple agbakwunyere nkwado ikpo okwu na iOS 16 (2022); Google, Microsoft, 1Paswọọdụ sochiri. Vortex anabatara WebAuthn na v0.0.8. Ọ bụ nhọrọ mana akwadoro nke ukwuu - ndị ọrụ passkey ahụghị iweghara akaụntụ dabere na phishing n'ihi na igodo nzuzo anaghị agafe oke ngwaọrụ.
auth.h5_a: Mgbake mkpụrụ-okwu na-ewughachi njirimara X25519 na ngwaọrụ ọhụrụ site na okwu 24 BIP-39 mnemonic. Ọ dịghị mgbe ọ bụla na-achọ ka ihe nkesa na-ejide ihe ọ bụla decryption.
auth.h5_b: Onye ọrụ na-edetu mnemonic na mbido mbụ (nhọrọ, ngwa ngwa otu oge). Iji nwetaghachi: na ngwaọrụ ọhụrụ, onye ọrụ na-abanye na mnemonic; onye ahịa na-agba PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512(mnemonic, "mnemonic", 2048 okirikiri) → 64 bytes nke mkpụrụ. Bytes 32 mbụ nke mkpụrụ ahụ ghọrọ igodo nzuzo X25519; a na-ewepụta igodo ọha. A na-agwa sava naanị igodo ọha ọhụrụ; ọ na-enyocha ihe onwunwe ya na nzaghachi ịma aka Ed25519 (aka mbinye aka), wee wepụta JWT.
auth.h5_c: BIP-39 (Bitcoin Improvement Proposal 39, 2013) bụ ụzọ canonical iji tinye nzuzo nzuzo nzuzo dị ka ndepụta okwu agaghị echefu echefu.
