Akwụkwọ ọkọwa okwu 2048-okwu Bekee nwere checksum 4-byte na njedebe. Vortex na-eji okwu 24 n'ihi na ọkọlọtọ ụlọ ọrụ maka obere akpa nchekwa dị elu (Trezor, Ledger) bụ 24. Okwu 12 ga-ezuru maka nchekwa 128-bit mana ọ naghị adị oke oke maka ọtụtụ ndị ọrụ.
auth.h5_f:
okwu = BIP39_Encode(entropy=256_bits + 8_bit_checksum)
mkpụrụ = PBKDF2-SHA512(okwu, "mnemonic", okirikiri=2048, len=64)
sk = mkpụrụ[0:32] // X25519 nzuzo
pk = sk · G // X25519 ọha
auth.h6_a: Nnwale ihe abụọ na-agbakwunye usoro paswọọdụ otu oge (TOTP) dabere na oge mgbe nkwenye paswọọdụ gasịrị.
auth.h6_b: Ndebanye aha: `POST /api/authentication/2fa/setup` → ihe nkesa na-ewepụta ihe nzuzo 160-bit, na-eweghachi ya dị ka eriri base32 + otpauth: // URI maka nyocha QR. Onye ọrụ jiri Google Authenticator / Authy / 1Password nyocha; biputere azụ ihe nlele koodu ọnụọgụ isii iji gosi na ọ rụpụtara ọrụ. Nbanye: ka okwuntughe gafere, ihe nkesa na-eweghachi `{needs_2fa: true}` kama iji JWT. Onye ahịa kpaliri maka koodu ọnụọgụ isii yana POST '/api/authentication/login/2fa`. Ihe nkesa na-enyocha HOTP( nzuzo, T = now_unix / 30) megide koodu.
auth.h6_c: A haziri TOTP dị ka RFC 6238 na 2011 site n'aka Mark Pei. Tupu nke ahụ, RSA SecurID jiri algọridim nke nwe ya; Mgbe emechara, ngwa 2FA ọ bụla dabara na TOTP. VortexSzọụkwụ nke abụọ nke abụọ na ogologo ọnụọgụ isii bụ RFC ndabara. Ebitere koodu nkwado ndabere (12 × 10-digit, egosiri otu ugboro) site na imewe GitHub site na 2012.
auth.h6_f:
nzuzo = rand (20 bytes) // 160 ibe n'ibe kwa RFC 6238
TOTP(ihe nzuzo, t) = HOTP(ihe nzuzo, ⌊t / 30⌋)
HOTP(k, c) = mkpọpu ( HMAC-SHA1 (k, c) ) mod 10⁶

windo: ±1 nzọụkwụ anabatara maka skew elekere
auth.h7_a: QR nbanye na-ejikọta ngwaọrụ ọhụrụ n'ime akaụntụ dị adị na-enweghị idegharị paswọọdụ. Ekwentị abanyelarị na-egosi na ngwaọrụ ọhụrụ ahụ na-eji nyocha.
auth.h7_b: Ngwaọrụ A biputere `/api/authentication/qr/begin`. Ihe nkesa na-ewepụta 128-bit nonce na TTL 60s, kechie ya na user_id A, weghachi ya. A na-egosiputa ndenye aha ka QR (gụnyere `nonce + user_id + server_url`). Ngwaọrụ B na-enyocha, biputere `/api/authentication/qr/verify` na enweghị otu. Ihe nkesa: ọ bụghị eziokwu na otu-shot? Associate B's fresh X25519 pubkey nwere user_id (ahịrị 'onye ọrụ_ngwa ọhụrụ'), mint JWT maka B. Ngwaọrụ A na-enweta ọkwa WebSocket ka onye ọrụ nwee ike ịhụ wee weghachi ya na nhọrọ.
auth.h7_c: Njikọ QR bụ nke WhatsApp webatara na mbụ na 2015. Telegram sochiri; Signal depụtaghachiri ya maka nkwado ngwaọrụ ha dị iche iche na 2021. Ntugharị Vortex: ihe omume jikọtara ọnụ na-ebuli na ngwaọrụ mbụ yana bọtịnụ “kwenye”, yabụ onye na-awakpo jidere QR site na nseta ihuenyo enweghị ike ịmecha njikọ na-enweghị mmekọrịta onye ọrụ na ngwaọrụ A.
auth.h8_a: Akaụntụ enumeration eguzogide - akụkụ nke auth isi. Nke a bụ otu n'ime isi usoro a na-ezo aka n'oge ntụaka Vortex. Gụọ isiakwụkwọ gbara ya gburugburu maka nkọwa sara mbara; ngalaba a na-abanye n'ime akparamagwa a kapịrị ọnụ.
auth.h8_b: Nchịkọta mmejuputa maka "Nguzogide ngụkọ akaụntụ". A na-emejuputa usoro a na modul kwekọrọ n'okpuru 'app/', `ios/Modules/sources/', ma ọ bụ 'android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/'. Modul README na-akpọpụta ụzọ faịlụ ziri ezi.
auth.h8_c: Usoro "Nguzogide ngụkọ akaụntụ" sitere na ntọhapụ Vortex. Nhazi ahụ na-esochi nyocha na omume mmepụta nke ndị ozi mbụ bipụtara. Akụkọ ụdị dị na ndekọ `CHANGELOG.md` mgbe ibe ọ bụla rutere na ihe kpaliri ya.

rooms.title: Ụlọ na ozi
rooms.subtitle: Ụdị ọnụ ụlọ anọ ahụ, otu, ntụgharị igodo, ozi.
rooms.intro: Ụdị ọnụ ụlọ anọ niile - DM, otu nzuzo, otu ọha, ọwa - kesaa tebụl 'ọnụ ụlọ' dị n'okpuru. A na-eji ọkọlọtọ boolean kpuchie omume.
rooms.h1p1: **DM**: kpọmkwem ndị otu abụọ, `bụ_dm=eziokwu`, `bụ_onwe = eziokwu`. Aha akpaaka ka edobere n'aka onye nke ọzọ.
rooms.h1p2: ** Otu nkeonwe**: naanị ịkpọ oku, `bụ_private=eziokwu`, `bụ_channel=ụgha`. Ndị otu kacha 5000 na ndabara.
rooms.h1p3: **Ohaneze**: `bụ_private=ụgha`. Onye ọ bụla nwere njikọ ịkpọ òkù nwere ike isonyere; edepụtara na akwụkwọ ndekọ aha ọha ma ọ bụrụ na onye nwe ya ahọrọ.
rooms.h1p4: ** Ọwa ***: naanị mgbasa ozi, `bụ_channel = eziokwu`. Naanị ndị nwe/admin nwere ike biputere; ndị òtù oge niile na-agụ.
rooms.h2p1: Ọrụ: 'onye nwe', 'admin', 'otu'. Naanị otu onye nwe kwa ọnụ ụlọ (nwere ike inye).
rooms.h2p2: Ndị nlekọta nwere ike ịkpọ, gbaa, ogbi, ma dezie ntọala ụlọ. Ndị otu nwere ike izipu ozi, meghachi omume, dezie nke ya, hichapụ nke ya.
rooms.h2p3: Ikikere cascade: ndị nwe nwere ikike nchịkwa ọ bụla. Ndị nlekọta enweghị ike iwetu onye nwe ya ala.
rooms.h2p4: Mgbanwe ọrụ na-ewepụta ozi sistemụ ('ụdị: "role_changed") nke ndị otu ọ bụla ga-ahụ.
rooms.h3p1: Ime ụlọ ọ bụla nwere igodo 32-byte ** mgbọrọgwụ ** emepụtara na okike site na `secrets.token_bytes(32)' na ngwaọrụ onye okike.
rooms.h3p2: Onye ọ bụla so na-enweta envelopu `{member_id, envelopu: X25519_encrypt(member_pubkey, root_key)}' echekwara na 'igodo_ime ụlọ'.
rooms.h3p3: Mgbe otu onye sonyere, onye ahịa onye ọ bụla dị adị na-ewepụtara ha envelopu ọhụrụ. Mining envelopu bụ O(1) kwa otu.
rooms.h3p4: Mgbe onye otu na-apụ, ụlọ ahụ na-atụgharị: onye okike (ma ọ bụ onye nchịkwa mbụ na-arụ ọrụ) na-enweta mgbọrọgwụ ọhụrụ, re-envelopes nye ndị fọdụrụ, biputere `{ụdị:"k", ụlọ:..., new_envelopes:[...]}` site na WebSocket. Ederede ederede ochie ka enwere ike ịgụ ya na igodo ochie nke ndị ahịa ka echekwabara.
rooms.h3l1: Igodo Variant-B na-ebipụta: maka ọnụ ụlọ ọha na> ndị otu 1000, envelopu kwụsịrị ịchacha. Kama, onye nwe ya binyere aka ma bipụta igodo mgbọrọgwụ na tebụl `room_ọha_ọha'. Ndị ahịa na-enyocha mbinye aka megide pubkey onye nwe ụlọ ahụ. Ntugharị na ezumike onye otu bụ enweghị op maka ime ụlọ Variant-B.
rooms.h3l2: Pseudo nke otu ọnụ ụlọ: ọnụ ụlọ ọ bụla nwekwara 'ọnụ ụlọ_pseudo_nnu'. Aha pseudonym ndị otu nọ na ozi bụ `HMAC-SHA256(nnu, user_id)' gbajiri ka ọ bụrụ cha cha hex iri na isii. Node enweghị ike ịkọ onye ọrụ zitere ozi na-enweghị nkewa n'akụkụ ndị ahịa.
rooms.h4p1: Ozi nwere NJ monotonic kwa ọnụ ụlọ (mmụba akpaaka 64-bit, 'bigserial' na Postgres, `INTEGER PRIMARY KEY` na SQLite).
rooms.h4p2: Enyere ihe nkesa iwu ịtụ. Ndị ahịa anaghị alụ ọgụ maka akara oge; ha na-enye n'usoro ID wee gosi oge elekere mgbidi onye zitere ya dị ka UI metadata naanị.
rooms.h4p3: ndezi: ọhụrụ ciphertext na-anọchi ochie na-ebe, `edited_na` mmelite. Ndị ahịa na-egosi akara '(edezie)'.
rooms.h4p4: Nhichapụ: tọọ 'ehichapụ_na', ewepụghị ciphertext. `{ụdị:"m", ehichapụ:true}` mgbasa ozi.
rooms.h4p5: Azịza: `azịza_to` = ozi e zoro aka na ya. Ndị ahịa na-enye obere ntụnye isi okwu.
rooms.h5p1: Mmeghachi omume bụ ahịrị dị na `mmeghachi omume(ozi_id, user_id, emoji, kere_na)`. POST ndị ahịa `/api/messages/{id}/reactions/{emoji}`. DELETE maka enweghị mmeghachi omume.
rooms.h5p2: Ndị na-akwado ọnụ na-ewepụ '{ụdị:"m", mmeghachi omume:[...]}' nye onye ọ bụla debanyere aha. Ndị ahịa na-agbakọta.
rooms.h5p3: Enweghị mmachi na emoji — Unicode ọ bụla. Ndị ahịa wepụrụ ma nyekwa ọnụ ọgụgụ.
rooms.h6p1: Eriri bụ ọnụ ụlọ pseudo gbanyere mkpọrọgwụ na ozi. `POST /api/messages/{id}/thread` na-emepụta `{id: <new_room_id>, parent_message_id: <msg_id>, parent_room_id: <original>}`.
rooms.h6p2: Ime ụlọ eri na-eketa ịbụ onye nne na nna. Onye ọ bụla nne na nna nwere ike biputere na eri ọ bụla.
rooms.h6p3: Mwepụta igodo: igodo mgbọrọgwụ eri = `HKDF(parent_root, info: "thread:" + <parent_message_id>, oghere: 32)'. Nkwekọrịta nke igodo eri anaghị agbapụta nne na nna.
rooms.h7p1: Ndị nlekọta nwere ike itinye ihe ruru ozi iri n'otu ọnụ ụlọ. `POST /api/rooms/{id}/pin` nwere `{message_id}`.
rooms.h7p2: A na-akwakọba ihe nkwụnye pin na ime ụlọ mepere emepe; ndị ahịa na-atụgharị nkụnye eji isi mee n'elu.
rooms.h8p1: Ederede otu ọnụ ụlọ na-aga n'ihu na ọnụ: `PUT /api/rooms/{id}/draft` nwere `{text}`. `GET` na-alaghachi ugbu a. `DELETE` na-ekpochapụ.
rooms.h8p2: Ndị ahịa na-emekọrịta ihe n'ofe ngwaọrụ ka ịpịnye na ekwentị ga-agwụ na desktọpụ. Adịghị ezoro ezo site na ngwụcha ruo na ngwụcha - ha bụ ederede doro anya nke sava na-ahụ. Nke ahụ bụ azụmaahịa kpachara anya maka ngwaọrụ obe UX. Ndị ọrụ jụrụ nwere ike gbanyụọ mmekọrịta kwa ọnụ ụlọ.
rooms.h9p1: `POST /api/scheduled` na `{room_id, ciphertext, send_at}`. Na-echekwa ọnụ ọnụ n'ime 'ozi ahaziri ahazi'; onye na-arụ ọrụ cron na-eme n'oge.
rooms.h9p2: Enwere ike dezie yana ịkagbu ruo mgbe akọrọ send_at gbara ọkụ. Mgbe izipuchara, ozi ga-aghọ ahịrị nkịtị na 'ozi'.
rooms.h1_a: Ụdị ọnụ ụlọ anọ niile (DM, otu nzuzo, otu ọha, ọwa) na-ekerịta otu tebụl `ọnụ ụlọ. Ọdịiche dị na ọkọlọtọ boolean atọ.
rooms.h1_b: Ọkọlọtọ: `bụ_dm`, `bụ_onwe`, `bụ_ọwa`. DM: is_dm=ezi, bụ_private=ezi, otu 2. Otu onwe: is_private=ezigbo, is_channel=ụgha, ruru ndị otu 5000. Otu ọha: is_private=ụgha, edepụtara na ndekọ aha ma ọ bụrụ na onye nwe ya abanye. Ọwa: is_channel=ezi, naanị ndị nwe/admins biputere. Ha niile na-ekekọrịta igodo njikwa, onye na-eme ihe nkiri, mmeghachi omume, eri.
rooms.h1_c: Otu tebụl polymorphism bụ ụkpụrụ sitere na Martin Fowler's *Patterns of Enterprise Application Architecture* (2002). Telegram na-eji ụdị ọnụ ụlọ atọ dị iche iche n'ime; Slack na-eji ọwa + DM + DM ọtụtụ otu dị ka ụdị anọ; Discord na-eji "ọwa" maka ihe niile. Anyị họọrọ otu-tebụl mgbe profiling gosiri isi na-eri bụ fan-out (nke bụ edo gafee ụdị) na mgbe v0.0.3 refactor merged atọ yiri tebụl n'ime otu.
rooms.h1_f:
CREATE TABLE ime ụlọ (
  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  ụdị VARCHAR(16), -- ihe nketa, ejighi ọkọlọtọ
  aha VARCHAR(256),
  bụ_onwe BOOLEAN,
  bụ_channel BOOLEAN,
  bụ_dm BOOLEAN,
  Ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị otu INT,
  avatar_url VARCHAR(512),
  kere_na TIMESTAMP,
  kere_nke BIGINT REFERENCES ndị ọrụ(id)
);
rooms.h2_a: Ọrụ bụ ọkwa atọ: onye nwe, onye nchịkwa, onye otu. Kpọmkwem otu onye nwe kwa ọnụ ụlọ, opekata mpe otu admin, ọtụtụ ndị otu aka ike.
rooms.h2_b: 'Ndị otu ọnụ ụlọ (ọnụ ụlọ_id, onye ọrụ_id, ọrụ, sonyere_na, ogbi ruo mgbe)'. Ọrụ cascade: ndị nwe nwere ikike nchịkwa ọ bụla. Ndị nlekọta nwere ike ịkpọ, gbaa, ogbi, ma dezie ntọala ụlọ mana enweghị ike iwetu onye nwe ya. Ndị otu nwere ike izipu ozi, meghachi omume, dezie nke ya, hichapụ nke ya. Nyefe onye nwe site na `PATCH /api/rooms/{id}` nwere `onye nwe_ọhụrụ_id` — onye nwe ochie dabara na nchịkwa.
rooms.h2_c: Onye nwe / onye nchịkwa / onye otu bụ tripartite IRC op / olu / ihe onye ọrụ sitere na 1988, nke Slack, Discord nakweere, Telegram. Nhọrọ a kapịrị ọnụ inwe otu onye nwe ya (ọ bụghị ọtụtụ) sitere na nleba anya nke iwu: na ikike nwere iwu gbasara otu, inwe otu onye nwe ya doro anya na-eme ka ọ dị mfe DMCA na arịrịọ ndị yiri ya.
rooms.h2_f:
CREATE TABLE ndị otu_ọnụ ụlọ (
  ụlọ_id BIGINT,
  onye ọrụ_id BIGINT,
  ọrụ
  sonyere_na TIMESTAMP,
  mechie_ruo TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (ụlọ_id, onye ọrụ_id)
);
rooms.h3_a: Ime ụlọ ọ bụla nwere igodo mgbọrọgwụ symmetric nke 32-byte. Ndị otu na-ejide akwụkwọ ndị kechiri n'okpuru igodo pubkey X25519.
rooms.h3_b: Na okike, onye ahịa na-ewepụta `mgbọrọgwụ_key = secrets.token_bytes(32)`. Maka otu ọ bụla, onye ahịa na-ezochi 'mgbọrọgwụ_key' n'okpuru `X25519(member_pubkey)` → envelopu. Envelopu bi na ` igodo ime ụlọ(room_id, user_id, envelopu)`. Mgbe onye ọrụ sonyere, onye ahịa otu ọ bụla dị adị na-ewepụtara ha envelopu ọhụrụ. Mgbe onye ọrụ ga-apụ, onye nwe ya ma ọ bụ onye nchịkwa mbụ nọ n'ọrụ na-atụgharị - na-ewepụta igodo mgbọrọgwụ ọhụrụ, re-envelopes maka ndị otu fọdụrụ, gbasaa ''ụdị:"k", ụlọ:..., envelopu ọhụrụ:[...]}' n'elu WebSocket.
rooms.h3_c: Mkpuchi onye otu onye bụ ụkpụrụ ọsụ ụzọ na 2014 maka otu ya-v2. Matrix's Megolm na-eji usoro "igodo izipu" yiri ya. Vortex jiri envelopu onye otu ọ bụla were n'ihi na ọ dị mfe ịtụgharị uche: enweghị nzuzo nzuzo n'etiti ndị na-ezigara ya. The ahia-apụ bụ O(N) envelopu minting na otu onye, ​​nke dị mma ruo ~5000 òtù; Ọwa ọhaneze Variant-B kwụpụrụ oke.
rooms.h3_f:
na imepụta:
  mgbọrọgwụ_key = rand (32)
  maka m na ndị otu:
    envelopu[m] = X25519_Encrypt(m.pubkey, root_key)

na ezumike:
  new_root = rand (32)
  rebroadcast(envelopu ọhụrụ maka ndị otu fọdụrụ)
rooms.h4_a: Mbipụta igodo variant-B na-eji otu igodo bịanyere aka na ya dochie envelopu onye ọ bụla, ezisara na tebụl na-agụ ọha. Akara ndị otu 100k+.
rooms.h4_b: Kama O(N) envelopu minting, onye nwe ya na-abanye akara mgbọrọgwụ na biputere 'room_public_key(room_id, key, sign_by, signature_at)`. Ndị ahịa wetara, nyochaa megide ed25519 pubkey onye nwe ya, wee jiri ya. Ntughari bụ enweghị op maka mgbanwe otu - onye ọ bụla nwere igodo ka nwere ya ọbụlagodi na agbaala ya. Nke ahụ bụ ihe a na-anabata maka ọwa mgbasa ozi ọha ebe "akụkọ ihe mere eme dị omimi" abụghị ihe atụ egwu kama iru na ọnụ ọgụgụ dị.
rooms.h4_c: Emebere Variant-B na Matrix's "ụwa a na-agụ" ọhụhụ akụkọ ihe mere eme jikọtara ya na ntụgharị igodo bịanyere aka na ya. Agbakwunyere na Vortex na v0.0.8 ka beta ahụ nwechara ọwa ọha mmadụ 50k nke envelopu nke na-emegharị oge oge juputara ọnụ. Ụzọ a bịanyere aka n'akwụkwọ nkwado na-ebipụta na-adabere n'ahịrị n'ahịrị na ntụgharị igodo (nke dị ụkọ) karịa na mgbanwe ndị otu (nke na-adịgide adịgide).
rooms.h4_f:
Ụdị-B:
  akara onye nwe: sig = Ed25519Akara akara (owner_priv, room_id ∥ root_key ∥ ụdị)
  bipụta: room_public_keys += {room_id, root_key, version, sig}
  onye ahịa: GET /api/rooms/{id}/public-key → nyochaa akara megide owner_pubkey
rooms.h5_a: Koodu ọkpụkpọ oku bụ 32 hex Chars. Nhọrọ max_uses, expires_at, ekenye_role, mbughari.
rooms.h5_b: `POST /api/rooms/{id}/invite` (naanị onye nchịkwa) na-emepụta ahịrị n'ime 'akwụkwọ ịkpọ òkù(koodu, ụlọ_id, nke e mere_site na, max_uses, used_count, expires_na, inye_role, wepụrụ_na)`. `POST /api/rooms/jikọọ' na koodu nyocha ndaba (anaghị kagbuo, anaghị agwụ agwụ, ejirighị ọnụ <max_uses), abawanye 'jiri_count', mepụta ahịrị ndị otu ụlọ, weghachi metadata ụlọ. Kagbuo site na `DELETE /api/invites/{code}` — sonye mechaa daa.
rooms.h5_c: Koodu ọkpụkpọ oku dị ka oge ochie dị ka nke IRC's `+i` mode (1988). Telegram's public invitation links with expiry and use limits were in 2017. Vortex's variant gbakwunyere `ekenye_ọrụ` ka ndị nwe nwee ike inyefe admin-enye codes n'enweghị nsogbu n'ụdị otu-shot — bara uru maka ịbanye onye nhazi ọhụrụ n'achọghị ịma kpọmkwem id onye ọrụ ha n'ihu.
rooms.h5_f:
na-akpọ ahịrị:
  koodu: VARCHAR(64) -- 32 hex chars
  ụlọ_id: BIGINT
  max_uses: INT -- NULL = enweghị oke
  eji_count : INT
  expires_na: TIMESTAMP -- NULL = mgbe
  ekenye_ọrụ : VARCHAR(16) -- NULL = onye otu
  kagburu_na: TIMESTAMP -- NULL = dị ndụ
rooms.h6_a: Ahịrị ozi na-echekwa ciphertext + metadata; A naghị echekwa onye na-ezipụ ozi na ederede doro anya.
rooms.h6_b: `ozi( id, room_id, sender_id, ciphertext, nonce, sender_pseudo, sent_at, edited_at?, deleted_na?, zaghachi_to?, thread_id?, ụdị)`. 'sender_id' dị maka njikwa ohere wee depụta ya. `sender_pseudo` bụ ihe na-ekpebi hash nke sender_id nke ọ bụla n'ime ọnụ ụlọ, yabụ onye na-eme ihe adịghị mkpa imetụ tebụl ndị ọrụ aka. 'ụdị' bụ otu n'ime: ederede, onyonyo, faịlụ, olu, oku, sistemụ. 'ciphertext' bụ opaque AES-GCM mmepụta; Naanị ndị otu ọnụ ụlọ nwere igodo nwere ike ibelata.
rooms.h6_c: Echiche sender_pseudo sitere na Signal sealed-sender (2018). Signal na-eji ya kpuo ìsì ihe nkesa iji zipu njirimara; anyị na-eji ya maka ebumnuche yiri nke ahụ mana dowe 'sender_id' cleartext maka ACL yana oke ọnụego. Nkewa ahụ na-ahapụ anyị ka anyị manye "naanị ndị otu nwere ike biputere" na-enweghị mmụta ihe nkesa nke kwuru ihe na mkpofu DB zuru ezu.
rooms.h7_a: Na-edezigharị 'ciphertext' n'ebe wee daa 'deziri_na'. Na-ehichapụ ciphertext wee tọọ 'ehichapụ_na'.
rooms.h7_b: Dezie: `PATCH /api/messages/{id}` nwere ọhụrụ `{ciphertext, nonce}`. Naanị onye zitere ya nwere ike dezie ozi nke ya. Edozighị ciphertext/nonce nke ahịrị, `edited_at = now`, `ụdị` agbanwebeghị. Onye ofufe `{ụdị:"m", id, ct, nonce, dezie_at}`. Hichapụ: `DELETE /api/messages/{id}`. Onye zitere ma ọ bụ onye nchịkwa nwere ike ihichapụ. 'ehichapụ_na = ugbu a', `ciphertext = NULL`. Ahịrị na-anọ ka azịza ka bara uru. Onye ofufe `{ụdị:"m", ehichapụ:eziokwu, id}`.
rooms.h7_c: Dezie na-ebe bụ Telegram/Slack ụkpụrụ; Discord debere akụkọ ndezi zuru oke na mbụ wee tụba ya maka nzuzo. Vortex na-edobe naanị ihe kachasị ọhụrụ - akụkọ ndezi bụ isi mmalite nke ihe omume PR mgbe enwere ike nwetaghachi ehichapụ-ehichapụ. Nhichapụ dị nro nwere ciphertext efu sitere n'otu akwụkwọ egwuregwu Telegram ma chekwaa ụdọ nzaghachi na-ejigideghị ọdịnaya.
rooms.h7_f:
dezie: UPDATE ozi SET ciphertext = $1, nonce = $2, edited_at = NOW() WHERE id = $3
ihichapụ: UPDATE ozi SET deleted_at = NOW(), ciphertext = NULL WHERE id = $1
rooms.h8_a: Drafts - akụkụ nke isi ụlọ. Nke a bụ otu n'ime isi usoro a na-ezo aka n'oge ntụaka Vortex. Gụọ isiakwụkwọ gbara ya gburugburu maka nkọwa sara mbara; ngalaba a na-abanye n'ime akparamagwa a kapịrị ọnụ.
rooms.h8_b: Nchịkọta mmejuputa maka "Drafts". A na-emejuputa usoro a na modul kwekọrọ n'okpuru 'app/', `ios/Modules/sources/', ma ọ bụ 'android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/'. Modul README na-akpọpụta ụzọ faịlụ ziri ezi.
rooms.h8_c: Usoro "Drafts" malitere n'ofe Vortex ewepụtara. Nhazi ahụ na-esochi nyocha na omume mmepụta nke ndị ozi mbụ bipụtara. Akụkọ ụdị dị na ndekọ `CHANGELOG.md` mgbe ibe ọ bụla rutere na ihe kpaliri ya.
rooms.h9_a: Ozi ahaziri - akụkụ nke isi ụlọ. Nke a bụ otu n'ime isi usoro a na-ezo aka n'oge ntụaka Vortex. Gụọ isiakwụkwọ gbara ya gburugburu maka nkọwa sara mbara; ngalaba a na-abanye n'ime akparamagwa a kapịrị ọnụ.
rooms.h9_b: Nchịkọta mmejuputa maka "ozi akwadoro". A na-emejuputa usoro a na modul kwekọrọ n'okpuru 'app/', `ios/Modules/sources/', ma ọ bụ 'android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/'. Modul README na-akpọpụta ụzọ faịlụ ziri ezi.
rooms.h9_c: Usoro "ozi ahaziri" malitere n'ofe Vortex ewepụtara. Nhazi ahụ na-esochi nyocha na omume mmepụta nke ndị ozi mbụ bipụtara. Akụkọ ụdị dị na ndekọ `CHANGELOG.md` mgbe ibe ọ bụla rutere na ihe kpaliri ya.

files.title: Faịlụ na mgbakwunye
files.subtitle: Otu-agba maka obere, resumable maka nnukwu, nzuzo-n'akụkụ ndị ahịa maka ha abụọ.
files.intro: Nbulite faịlụ ọ bụla na-aga site na otu pipeline ezoro ezo. Ọdịiche dị n'etiti ụzọ bụ naanị maka nkwụghachi netwọkụ: resumable na-anabata njikọ dị nro.
files.h1p1: Isi: 5 MB Eji maka foto, ndetu olu, obere mkpachị.
files.h1p2: Onye ahịa ji AES-GCM, 96-bit nonce na-ezochi faịlụ ahụ niile, igodo = `file_root = secrets.token_bytes(32)`.
files.h1p3: POST 'multipart/form-data' na '/api/files' nwere mpaghara 'file' (ciphertext), `plain_blake3' (nkwupụta n'ezi ihe), `mime_ụdị' (ndụmọdụ; enyochaghachikwa ihe nkesa na 'python-magic').
files.h1p4: Na-echekwa ọnụ ụzọ n'okpuru `ebugo/ <ụdị>/<sha256>.bin` wee weghachi `{file_id, url}`.
files.h1p5: Onye ahịa na-eziga ozi ime ụlọ nke na-ezo aka na file_id ma buru faịlụ_root na ciphertext ya ka ndị otu ụlọ nwere ike mebie.
files.h2p1: Okpu: 5 GB (enwere ike ịhazi ya site na `RESUMABLE_MAX=5368709120`).
files.h2p2: Nkeji 1: `POST /api/files/resumable/init` na `{filename, size, chunk_size_hint}`. Node na-ekenye id bulite, were nha nha (nke izizi 512 KiB, nke etinyere na 4 MiB), weghachi `{upload_id, chunk_size}`.
files.h2p3: Nkeji 2: maka chunk ọ bụla, `PUT /api/files/resumable/{upload_id}/chunk/{offset}` nwere aru ciphertext raw. Nkwụsị ga-adakọrịrị na 'nha_nha'.
files.h2p4: Nkeji 3: `POST /api/files/resumable/{upload_id}/finalise` na `{plain_blake3}`. Node na-agbakọta, na-enyocha nha, na-echekwa, weghachi '{file_id, url}`.
files.h2p5: Ijikwa ọdịda: nbudata akwụsịre akwụsị nwere ike ịmaliteghachi site na biputegharị naanị nkwụghachi na-efu. Node egwu nke nkwụghachi rutere na Redis (ma ọ bụ ebe nchekwa maka ọnọdụ SQLite).
files.h2p6: TTL: A na-ehichapụ ihe ebulite na-emechabeghị ka elekere 24 gachara.
files.h3p1: Mbulite onyogho (MIME `oyiyi/*`) na-ebute generator nke dabere na pillow na 256×256 JPEG q=80. Echekwara n'okpuru 'bulite/thumbs/<hash>.jpg'.
files.h3p2: ezoro ezo thumbnails n'akụkụ ndị ahịa - onye nnata chọrọ faịlụ_root ka ọ mee. Na-echekwa bandwit maka nlele ndepụta.
files.h3p3: Nbulite vidiyo (MIME `video/*`) na-ebute mmịpụta akwụkwọ mmado dabere na ffmpeg na 10% nke ogologo oge clip, echekwara otu ụzọ ahụ.
files.h4p1: Ụdị 'mime_ụdị' nke ndị ahịa nyefere bụ ihe atụ. Ihe nkesa na-agba 'python-magic' megide 1 KB nke mbụ wee jụ ma ọ bụrụ na ụdị sniff dị na listi agọnarị: 'application/x-dosexec', 'application/x-sharedlib', 'application/x-mach-binary'.
files.h4p2: Nke a na-egbochi ndị ọrụ enweghị uche ikesa malware na mberede site na onye ozi ahụ. Ndị na-awakpo mkpali ka nwere ike iji arịa nwere akara nke ọma gafere - ihe nchekwa bụ ọjụjụ mwepu n'akụkụ ndị ahịa, ọ bụghị imi n'akụkụ nkesa.
files.h5p1: Ihe ndabara: sistemụ faịlụ mpaghara. Good maka otu-node deploys.
files.h5p2: S3: tọọ `STORAGE_BACKEND=s3` + `S3_BUCKET=...`. A na-ebugharị faịlụ ozugbo na S3 na-emetụghị diski ọnụ ọnụ. A na-eji URL ndị ahaziri ahazi maka nbudata.
files.h5p3: IPFS: nnwale. Nbulite na-ekwupụta CID site na DHT; nbudata na-enweta ọnụ ntụtụ ọ bụla.
files.h1_a: Nbulite otu-shot bụ ụzọ ngwa ngwa maka ihe ọ bụla n'okpuru 5 MB - foto, ndetu olu, obere vidiyo. Otu HTTPS POST, otu blob ezoro ezo, otu ahịrị na 'faịlụ'.
files.h1_b: Onye ahịa na-eji AES-GCM ezoo bytes faịlụ ahụ site na ngwụcha ruo na ngwụcha n'okpuru 'faịlụ_root' 32-byte enweghị usoro. POST 'multipart/form-data' na '/api/files' nwere oghere 'file' (ciphertext), `plain_blake3' (nkwupụta n'ezi ihe), 'mime_ụdị' (ntụgharị uche). Node na-amanye okpu 5 MB na ọkwa nnata, na-agba 'python-magic' maka ụdị nchọpụta, jụrụ ma MIME nọ na listi agọnarị, na-echekwa n'okpuru `ebugo/ <category>/<hash>.bin`, weghachi `{file_id, url, mime_type. Onye ahịa biputeziri ozi ime ụlọ na-ezo aka 'file_id' ma buru 'faịlụ_root' n'ime ederede ya.
files.h1_c: Okpu 5 MB bụ otu ọnụọgụ Slack na Telegram iji maka ụzọ mbulite "inline" ha. Faịlụ buru ibu na-aga n'ụzọ enwere ike ịmaliteghachi. N'oge Vortex nwere okpu otu mgbọ 100 MB; anyị gbadara na 5 MB mgbe ịkọwapụtachara gosipụtara na nbudata otu-shot karịrị 5 MB nwere mbelata 40% na netwọkụ mkpanaka. Ụzọ nke resumable dị nnọọ mma maka nnukwu faịlụ n'agbanyeghị na ọ na-agbagharị karịa n'ụzọ obi ụtọ.
files.h2_a: Nbulite eweghachite bụ ụzọ maka nnukwu faịlụ. Ndị ahịa na-ebugo ngịka ndị nwere oke, nwere ike kwụsịtụ, nwee ike ịmaliteghachi n'oke nhịahụ ọ bụla, nwere ike nwetaghachi site na blips netwọk.
files.h2_b: Usoro usoro atọ. Init: `POST /api/files/resumable/init` na `{filename, size, chunk_size_hint}` → node na-ekenye `bulite_id` + na-akwado nha nha. Chunks: maka nkwụghachi nke ọ bụla, `PUT /api/files/resumable/{upload_id}/chunk/{offset}` nwere aru ciphertext raw. Nkwụsị ga-abụrịrị ọtụtụ chunk_size. Ngwucha: `POST /api/files/resumable/{upload_id}/finalise` na `{plain_blake3}` — ọnụ ụzọ achịkọta, na-enyocha nha + mkpado, na-echekwa, na-eweghachi `{file_id, url}`.
files.h2_c: Usoro usoro atọ bụ otu udi ka tus.io (Nbulite Resumable, 2013), AWS S3 nbulite ọtụtụ akụkụ, yana Google Driven bulite resumable. Vortex nakweere ọdịdị tus.io n'ihi na ọ bụ egwuregwu kachasị mfe maka mgbasa ozi FastAPI +. Oge awa 24 TTL na egwuregwu ebugo agwụbeghị S3 ndabara yana itule maliteghachi mgbanwe megide ojiji diski ihe nkesa.
files.h3_a: A na-emepụta thumbnails n'akụkụ ihe nkesa n'oge ebugo mana nọrọ na nzuzo n'okpuru otu mgbọrọgwụ faịlụ, yabụ naanị ndị otu ime ụlọ nwere ike ịnye ha.
files.h3_b: Maka `oyiyi/*` MIME, Ohiri isi na-ewepụta 256×256 JPEG q=80 site na nhụchalụ ezoro ezo. Chere - mba, ihe nkesa enweghị ederede doro anya. Ọgbara ziri ezi: onye ahịa na-ewepụta mkpịsị aka ya na mpaghara, jiri otu faịlụ_root + ezoro ezo, bulite dị ka blob nwanne, yana ntụnyere `thumb_id' n'ime ozi ụlọ. Ihe nkesa na-echekwa ederede ciphertext. Maka `vidiyo/*`, onye ahịa na-eme otu ihe ahụ na igodo ffmpeg ewepụtara.
files.h3_c: N'oge mbụ Vortex nwere ọgbọ thumbnail nke akụkụ nkesa site na ederede doro anya - anyị wepụrụ ikike ahụ na v0.0.4 mgbe nyochachara nchekwa gosipụtara na ọ mebiri nkwa E2E. Isi mkpịsị aka n'akụkụ ndị ahịa bụ akara ngosi ejirila kemgbe 2018 yana WhatsApp kemgbe 2020. Ọnụ ego bandwit bụ nke enweghị atụ - 256 × 256 JPEG dị n'okpuru 20 KB.
files.h4_a: Ihe nkesa ahụ na-amanye ndepụta ịgọnarị MIME na oyi akwa sniff iji kwụsị ihe ndị a na-ekesa na mberede.
files.h4_b: Mgbe nbudata zuru ezu (otu-shot) ma ọ bụ mechaa (resumable), ihe nkesa ahụ na-agba 'python-magic' n'ime 1 KB nke mbụ nke ngwa nnabata ciphertext iji chọpụta ụdịdị. Ọ bụrụ na sniff na-akọ 'ngwa/x-dosexec' (Windows PE), 'ngwa/x-sharedlib' (Linux ELF), ma ọ bụ 'ngwa/x-mach-binary' (macOS Mach-O), a na-ajụ ibulite ya na ụdị mgbasa ozi 415 na-akwadoghị. Nke a bụ iwu ihe nkesa, ọ bụghị oke nchekwa - ndị otu ọnụ ụlọ nke onye ahịa ka nwere ike ịwụnye usoro ihe mkpuchi nke na-agafe sniff.
files.h4_c: MIME sniffing dị ka amụma agọnarị bụ IETF draft-mime-sniffing-0X site na 2012. Discord / Slack / Telegram niile na-eme ya. Amara mmachi ahụ (zipped/enwere executables bypass sniff) kemgbe afọ 2016 - echekwabara nchekwa anyị: gbakwunyere ịdọ aka ná ntị akụkụ onye ọrụ na faịlụ ọ bụla nwere ndọtị enwere ike ime ya.
files.h5_a: Ihe ndabere nchekwa - akụkụ nke isi faịlụ. Nke a bụ otu n'ime isi usoro a na-ezo aka n'oge ntụaka Vortex. Gụọ isiakwụkwọ gbara ya gburugburu maka nkọwa sara mbara; ngalaba a na-abanye n'ime akparamagwa a kapịrị ọnụ.
files.h5_b: Nchịkọta mmejuputa maka "Nchekwa azụ azụ". A na-emejuputa usoro a na modul kwekọrọ n'okpuru 'app/', `ios/Modules/sources/', ma ọ bụ 'android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/'. Modul README na-akpọpụta ụzọ faịlụ ziri ezi.
files.h5_c: Usoro "Nchekwa backend" malitere n'ofe Vortex ewepụtara. Nhazi ahụ na-esochi nyocha na omume mmepụta nke ndị ozi mbụ bipụtara. Akụkọ ụdị dị na ndekọ `CHANGELOG.md` mgbe ibe ọ bụla rutere na ihe kpaliri ya.
files.h1_f:
POST /api/files
  Ụdị ọdịnaya: multipart/ụdị-data
  faịlụ: <ciphertext bytes ≤ 5_242_880>
  plain_blake3: <64 hex chars>
  mime_type: "ihe oyiyi/jpeg" (ndụmọdụ; nyochagharị ọnụ ụzọ)

→ 201 {file_id, url:"/bulite/...", mime_type, nha }
files.h3_f:
onye ahịa na-ewepụta thumb_plain = megharịa nha (zuru, 256, 256, JPEG, q=80)
thumb_ct = AES-GCM(faịlụ_root, new_nonce, thumb_plain, aad=thumb_id)
bulite thumb_ct, ntụaka thumb_id n'ime ozi ime ụlọ n'akụkụ file_id

presence.title: Ngosi ọnụnọ na nnyefe
presence.subtitle: Ihe nrịbama akara, gụọ nnata, hụchara ikpeazụ — ihe niile ephemeral.
presence.intro: Mgbama ndị a na-eme mkpọtụ. Vortex na-eme ka ha ghara ịdịgide na ndabara: ịpị ndụ na Redis (ma ọ bụ na ebe nchekwa), akwụkwọ nnata bụ naanị akara na-adị ndụ ma malitegharịa.
presence.h1p1: Onye ahịa na-eziga `{ụdị:"t", ụlọ:..., steeti:"bido"|"kwụsị"}' na igodo igodo. Akwụsịrị ya na otu mmemme kwa nkeji 3.
presence.h1p2: Mgbasa ọnụ ụzọ `{ụdị:"t", ụlọ:..., onye ọrụ:..., steeti:...}` ndị niile debanyere aha WebSocket.
presence.h1p3: Akwụsị na akpaghị aka: 'mmalite' na-enweghị oge 'nkwụsị' na-esote mgbe nkeji iri gachara n'akụkụ onye ahịa.
presence.h2p2: Node na-aga n'ihu na 'read_receipts(room_id, user_id, message_id, read_at)` na mgbasa ozi `{ụdị:"r", ụlọ:..., onye ọrụ:..., message_id:...}`.
presence.h2p3: Ndị ahịa na-atụgharị "N hụrụ" n'okpuru ozi ọpụpụ.
presence.h2p4: Nzuzo: onye ọrụ nwere ike gbanyụọ "hụrụ" kpamkpam; mgbe ahụ ọnụ anaghị akwụsị ịnata ha. Azụmahịa: ha anaghị ahụkwa akwụkwọ nnata ndị ọzọ (symmetry).
presence.h3p1: Node na-eso 'presence.last_seen_at` (unix ms) maka onye ọrụ ọ bụla. Emelitere na etiti WebSocket ọ bụla.
presence.h3p2: Ọkwa granularity (onye ọrụ nwere ike ịhọrọ): kpọmkwem, gbachie nkeji 5 kacha nso, gbachie elekere kacha nso, "na nso nso a", ma ọ bụ gbanyụọ.
presence.h3p3: Ajuju site na `GET /api/users/{id}/presence'. Edebanye aha site na `{ụdị:"sub_presence", onye ọrụ:...}`.
presence.h4p1: Onye ọrụ bụ "online" ma ọ bụrụ na ha nwere opekata mpe otu WebSocket na-arụ ọrụ na ngwaọrụ ha ọ bụla.
presence.h4p2: A na-ahụ anya na kọntaktị naanị - ndị na-abụghị kọntaktị na-ahụ anya ikpeazụ mana ọ bụghị ntụpọ dị ndụ.
presence.h1_a: A na-eziga ihe ngosi akara site na WebSocket frame `{ụdị:"t", ụlọ, steeti: "mmalite"|"kwụsị"}` wee gbasaa site na ọnụ ụzọ nye onye ọ bụla debanyere aha n'ime ụlọ ahụ.
presence.h1_b: Onye ahịa na-agbagha na 3 s - igodo mbụ na-eziga 'mmalite', na-esote n'ime 3 s emeghị ihe ọ bụla. 10 s ka emechara igodo ikpeazụ, onye ahịa na-eziga 'kwụsị'. Node na-agbasa fremu verbatim, prefixed with 'user_id'. Enweghị nnọgidesi ike - pịnye steeti na-ebi n'ime ebe nchekwa kwa ọnụ ụlọ (ma ọ bụ Redis pub/sub maka ọtụtụ ọnụ ọnụ). Nchekwa onwe-ekubie ume 10 s n'akụkụ nnata: ọ bụrụ na enweghị mmelite abịara, ndị ahịa chere na ọ kwụsịrị.
presence.h1_c: Ihe ngosi akara laghachiri na AIM / ICQ (1997). Modern debounced aghụghọ trace na Skype 2006 na iMessage 2011. The 3 s / 10 s nọmba si iMessage si hụrụ omume - anyị A/B nwalere 2/5, 3/10, 5/15 na 3/10 nwere kasị mma isiokwu "matches rhythm mmadụ" nzaghachi.
presence.h2_a: Nnata agụ ka na-aga n'ihu: POST ndị ahịa gụchara id ozi ikpeazụ; na-echekwa ọnụ n'akwụkwọ 'receipts' na mgbasa ozi.
presence.h2_b: `POST /api/rooms/{id}/agụ` na `{ last_read_message_id}`. Na-emelite ọnụ ụzọ `read_receipts(room_id, user_id, message_id, read_at)` nwere UPSERT semantics. Na-agbasa `{ụdị:"r", ụlọ, onye ọrụ, message_id, read_at}`. Ndị ahịa na-atụgharị "N hụrụ" n'okpuru ozi ọpụpụ. Nzuzo: onye ọrụ nwere ike gbanyụọ nnata kpamkpam; mgbe ahụ node anaghị adịgide maka ha AND ha ahụghị akwụkwọ nnata ndị ọzọ (symmetric).
presence.h2_c: Gụọ nnata ghọrọ ebe niile mgbe iMessage 2011 na WhatsApp 2014. Usoro symmetry (ọ bụrụ na ị zoo nke gị, ị gaghị ahụ ndị ọzọ) sitere na Telegram 2014 na bụ naanị ụzọ isi zere ọwa onyunyo otu ụzọ. Vortex na-amanye symmetry na ihe nkesa - ọ bụghị naanị onye ahịa - yabụ ndị ahịa na-agha ụgha gbasara ọkọlọtọ anaghị enweta ọhụụ.
presence.h3_a: Ahụrụ ikpeazụ bụ stampụ otu onye ọ bụla, emelitere na etiti WebSocket ọ bụla yana ịka nká mgbe enweghị okpokolo agba bịarutere.
presence.h3_b: Node na-eso 'ọnụnọ. ikpeazụ_hụrụ_na' dị ka unix ms. Emelitere na etiti WebSocket ọ bụla enwetara site na onye ọrụ ahụ. Gụọ site na `GET /api/users/{id}/presence'. Idenye aha site na `{type:"sub_presence", onye ọrụ}` ka ị nweta nkwalite na mgbanwe. Enwere ike ịhazi granularity nke onye ọrụ: stampụ oge, gbachie ya na nkeji 5, gbachie ya na 1 h, "na nso nso a", ma ọ bụ gbanyụọ.
presence.h3_c: Ọkwa granularity na-achọpụta mmelite nzuzo nke WhatsApp nke afọ 2012 mgbe mkpesa gbasara ịchụso ikpeazụ hụrụ. Telegram na 2013 gbakwunyere bọket "na nso nso a / n'ime otu izu / n'ime otu ọnwa". Vortex's 5 min / 1 h / "na nso nso a" na-ekwughachi Telegram. Nhọrọ "gbanyụọ" na-ezochi onye ọrụ ka ọ ghara ịhụ ikpeazụ ndị ọzọ maka otu ihe kpatara agụ akwụkwọ nnata.
presence.h4_a: Ihe ngosi n'ịntanetị: onye ọrụ bụ "online" ma ọ bụrụ na ha nwere opekata mpe otu ndụ WebSocket na ngwaọrụ ha ọ bụla.
presence.h4_b: Node na-edobe 'active_ws_count(user_id)' na ebe nchekwa. Mmụba na WS nkwalite, mbelata na nso. `online = active_ws_count(user_id) > 0`. A na-ahụ anya na kọntaktị naanị - ndị na-abụghị kọntaktị na-ahụ anya ikpeazụ (n'okpuru granularity) mana ọ bụghị ntụpọ ndụ ndụ ndụ. Gbanwee ihe omume ọkụ mgbe ọnụọgụ ahụ gafere efu n'akụkụ ọ bụla.
presence.h4_c: Ọhụụ naanị kọntaktị bụ ihe nlere anya onye ozi ọ bụla sirila na ya ka emechara ọtụtụ mkpesa (WhatsApp 2014, Telegram 2015). N'oge Vortex mere ka onye ọ bụla hụ na ịntanetị; anyị tụgharịrị ndabara mgbe onye nyocha beta rụtụrụ aka na ọnụ ụlọ ọha ga-ahapụ ọnụnọ nke puku kwuru puku ndị bịara abịa na puku kwuru puku ndị bịara abịa.
presence.h2_f:
POST /api/rooms/{id}/gụọ { last_read_message_id }

ọ bụrụ user.hides_receipts:
   anọgidela; agbasakwala
   enyela onye ọrụ a akwụkwọ nnata ndị ọzọ
ọzọ:
   UPSERT akwụkwọ_receipts VALUES (ụlọ_id, onye ọrụ_id, ozi_id, NOW())
   mgbasa ozi {ụdị:"r", ụlọ, onye ọrụ, message_id}
presence.h3_f:
granularity:
  kpọmkwem → laghachi last_seen_at
  5_min → nloghachi ⌊ ikpeazụ_seen_at / 300000⌋ · 300000
  1_hour → nloghachi ⌊ ikpeazụ_seen_at / 3600000⌋ · 3600000
  n'oge na-adịbeghị → laghachi 'na nso nso a' ma ọ bụrụ (ugbu a - last_seen_at) < 7d ọzọ 'ogologo oge gara aga'
  gbanyụọ → laghachi efu; onye ọrụ a enweghịkwa ike ịhụ ndị ọzọ
presence.h4_f:
online(u) = (|{ws ∈ open_ws : ws.user_id == u}| > 0)
visibiliti: kọntaktị-nanị (ndị na-abụghị kọntaktị hụrụ naanị ikpeazụ)
gbanwee ihe omume ọkụ ma ọ bụrụ na ntanetị(u) ntụgharị 0 ↔ 1

calls.title: WebRTC oku
calls.subtitle: Vidiyo olu +, 1: 1 na otu, akara n'elu WebSocket, nke sitere na coturn.
calls.intro: Vortex na-eji ngwaahịa WebRTC tojupụtara. Node bụ naanị akara ngosi. Ozugbo ndị ọgbọ jikọtara ndị chọrọ ICE ha, mgbasa ozi na-aga ozugbo (ndị ọgbọ na ndị ọgbọ) ma ọ bụ site na TURN relay on bad NAT.
calls.h1p1: Onye na-akpọ: `POST /api/calls/{room_id}/bido` na `{video: bool, audio: bool}`. Node na-ekenye call_id, na-agbasa `{ụdị:"c", ụdị:"invite", call_id, video, audio}` n'ime ụlọ.
calls.h1p3: Ngbanwe enye/aza: `{ụdị:"onyinye", sdp:...}` → `{ụdị:"aza", sdp:...}` → `{ụdị:"onye ndoro-ndoro ochichi", ice:...}` × N ruo mgbe ejikọtara ya.
calls.h1p4: Oku na-akwụsị: `POST /api/calls/{call_id}/end`. Akụkụ ọ bụla nwere ike kwụgide. Node na-edekọ 'ndekọ_oku( call_id, duration_s, video, audio, party)'.
calls.h2p1: Ntọala Njikọta mmekọrịta nke sava. Ndị na-eme mgbanwe ndị ọgbọ (onye ọbịa, srflx, prflx, relay).
calls.h2p2: STUN: jikọtara ya na coturn. Ụdị naanị stun ejiri maka nchọpụta symmetric-NAT.
calls.h2p3: TURN: coturn nwere nzere HMAC bịanyere aka na ya dị mkpụmkpụ. Oku ọ bụla na-enweta nzere ọhụrụ dị irè maka awa 24.
calls.h2p4: nzere: `{aha njirimara: <timestamp>:<user_id>, okwuntughe: base64(HMAC-SHA1( nzuzo, aha njirimara))}'. Ọkọlọtọ RFC 5389 okirikiri nhọrọ ukwuu.
calls.h3p1: Audio: Opus 48 kHz mgbanwe bitrate (6-128 kbps). DTX ga n'ihu maka nkwụsị nkịtị.
calls.h3p2: Vidiyo: VP9 (ọ masịrị) / H.264 / AV1 (ịhọrọ). Simulcast maka oku otu: onye na-akpọ oku na-etinye koodu nkwenye atọ n'otu oge.
calls.h3p3: FEC: na-adị mgbe niile maka ọdịyo; maka vidiyo ma ọ bụrụ na isi ụlọ bitrate na-enye ohere.
calls.h4p1: Maka> ndị sonyere 2, Vortex na-ewepụta SFU (Ngalaba ebugharị) n'ọnụ ọnụ. Onye ọ bụla so na ya bulite otu ugboro, SFU Fans pụọ.
calls.h4p2: Ugbu a audio-naanị ihe ruru 100 sonyere; Otu vidiyo gbara na 8 na v0.1 (vidiyo SFU hardening na v0.3 map ụzọ).
calls.h4p3: SFU na-eji otu agba agba agba maka njem; enweghị ọrụ ọzọ achọrọ.
calls.h5p1: Site na 'getDisplayMedia'. Onye ahịa na-agbakwụnye egwu ọhụrụ na PeerConnection dị ugbu a; renegotiates enye/aza.
calls.h5p2: Ndị nnata na-eme ihuenyo nkekọrịta ka egwu vidiyo dị iche. Na mkpanaka, ikesa ihuenyo chọrọ ikike ọkwa OS - iOS kpaliri, gam akporo na-egosi mkparịta ụka sistemụ.
calls.h6p1: NetEQ arụnyere WebRTC na-ejikwa mfu na ọgbaghara. Na nbibi siri ike, onye ahịa ahụ tụfuru mkpebi ma ọ bụ gbanyụọ vidiyo kpamkpam mgbe ọ na-edobe ọdịyo dị ndụ.
calls.h6p2: Nkwụsị nke ms 500 na-akpalite mbọ ijikọ ọzọ (ICE malitegharịa). Ndị ọrụ na-ahụ "Ijikọ ọzọ..." machie.
calls.h1_a: Ngosipụta oku na-agba otu WebSocket eji eme nkata. Node na-egosi naanị - ọ na-ere ahịa SDP na ICE n'etiti ndị ọgbọ mana anaghị emetụ mgbasa ozi aka.
calls.h1_b: Onye na-akpọ POST `/api/calls/{room_id}/bido` na `{video, audio}`. Node na-ekenye `call_id`, mgbasa ozi `{ụdị:"c", ụdị:"ịkpọ", call_id, video, audio}` n'ime ụlọ. Calee biputere `/api/call/{call_id}/anabata` → `{ụdị:"c", ụdị:"anabatara"}`. SDP inye/aza mgbanwe: `{ụdị:"onyinye",sdp}` → `{ụdị:"aza", sdp}`. Ndị anamachọihe ICE: `{ụdị:"onye ndoro-ndoro ochichi", ice}` × N ruo mgbe PeerConnection na-akọ 'jikọrọ'.
calls.h1_c: SDP + ICE nrịbama bụ ọkọlọtọ WebRTC ụkpụrụ a kọwara na RFC 8839 na 8841. Vortex anaghị echepụta ihe ọ bụla ebe a; Ọ bụ otu ihe na-erugharị Chrome, Firefox, yana ngwa ọba akwụkwọ ọ bụla WebRTC. Nhọrọ ọnụ-dị ka akara-naanị nhọrọ sitere na nghọta na ụdị mgbasa ozi ụdị SFU na-ejikọ bandwit ma chọọ ngwaike anyị achọghị ibubata na ntọala ntọala.
calls.h2_a: ICE na-achọta ụzọ site na NAT site na iji ndị nnabata + ihe nkesa-reflexive + relay. ejiri aka coturn STUN na TURN n'akụkụ Vortex.
calls.h2_b: Ndị ọgbọ ọ bụla na-edepụta ndị ga-aga ime: onye ọbịa (IPs mpaghara), srflx (ihe nkesa-reflexive site na STUN), relay (TURN-ekenyela). Ndị ọgbọ na-agbanwe ndị niile na-aga ime; Otu ụzọ abụọ ọ bụla na-etolite "pair", nlele njikọ na-eziga arịrịọ STUN ijikọ karịa UDP. Otu ụzọ aga nke ọma ga-abụ ụzọ ahọpụtara. N'azụ symmetric NAT, naanị ụzọ relay na-arụ ọrụ - nke ahụ bụ mgbe TURN relay na-ebugharị mgbasa ozi n'ezie.
calls.h2_c: ICE bụ ọkọlọtọ dị ka RFC 5245 na 2010 wee nweta ume dị ka RFC 8445 na 2018. N'azụ ọkwa ọkwa-NAT, STUN na-ada ihe dịka 15% nke oge na-agaghị ekwe omume. coturn bụ ihe nkesa mepere emepe TURN; anyị na-ebuga ya n'ihi na ọzọ (azụmahịa Twilio/Vonage TURN) na-efu kwa nkeji nke ọdịyo ebugharị.
calls.h3_a: TURN nzere na-adịte aka HMAC aha njirimara/password ụzọ abụọ enyere n'otu oku, ọ bụghị ihe nzuzo dị ogologo ndụ.
calls.h3_b: Na mbido oku, ọnụ na-ebute `aha njirimara = "<expiry_unix>:<user_id>"" na 'password = base64(HMAC-SHA1(ihe nkesa_nzuzo, aha njirimara))'. Ha abụọ nwere TTL 24h. Onye ahịa na-eji ha na nhazi RTCPeerConnection ya. coturn na-enyocha HMAC na nhazi nnọkọ. Akwụkwọ ikike agwụla agwụ HMAC nlele - ha na-akwụsị ịrụ ọrụ na-akpaghị aka na-enweghị nchekwa data mwepu.
calls.h3_c: Akwụkwọ ikike HMAC dị mkpụmkpụ na-abịa site na RFC 5389 (STUN) ma bụrụ ụkpụrụ mmepụta ọ bụla WebRTC eji ebuga ya. Twilio, Google, Xirsys niile na-eme ya. Nhọrọ ọzọ - static TURN creds - na-agbapụta ma ọ bụrụ na onye ahịa ọ bụla emebiela. Akwụkwọ ikike dị mkpụmkpụ na-ejedebe windo mmebi ka awa 24.
calls.h4_a: Audio bụ Opus na 48 kHz nwere DTX; vidiyo bụ VP9 primary / H.264 fallback / AV1 nbanye.
calls.h4_b: Audio: Opus 48 kHz, 6-128 kbps VBR. DTX (Akwụsị Akwụsị) na-akwụsị izipu n'oge nkịtị, maliteghachi na olu. FEC na mgbe niile. Vidiyo: VP9 na mbido; H.264 kpọsara maka ngwaọrụ na-enweghị ngwaike VP9 decode (iOS tupu A10 Bionic); AV1 enyere dị ka Nwepu maka adịchaghị na ngwaike ọgbara ọhụrụ. Simulcast maka oku otu: onye na-akpọ oku na-edobe mkpebi atọ n'otu oge, SFU na-akwado onye na-ekiri ọ bụla nke ziri ezi.
calls.h4_c: Opus bụ codec ọdịyo na-enweghị eze (RFC 6716, 2012). VP9 bụ Google meghere H.265 dakọtara. H.264 na-adaghachi azụ n'ihi na Apple ejidere VP9 nkwado ruo 2021. AV1 ghọrọ ike na ekwentị mgbe iPhone 15 Pro (2023) na Pixel 8 (2023) gbakwunyere decode ngwaike. Ngwakọta codec Vortex bụ otu Google Meet ojiji.
calls.h5_a: Oku otu na-eji SFU (Ngalaba ebugharị) n'ọnụ ọnụ. Onye ọ bụla so na-ebugote otu ugboro; SFU na-aga n'ihu onye ọ bụla.
calls.h5_b: Maka> 2 ndị ọgbọ onye ọkpụkpọ biputere `/api/calls/{room_id}/group/start`. Node na-atụgharị ihe atụ SFU jikọtara na oku a. Onye ọ bụla so na-emepe PeerConnection na SFU kama ịbụ ndị ọgbọ ọ bụla ọzọ. Uplink: onye ọ bụla na-eziga iyi 1. Downlink: SFU na-ebuga iyi N-1. N'ígwé simulcast pụtara SFU na-ahọrọ mkpebi dabara adaba na bandwidth onye ọ bụla nwere.
calls.h5_c: SFU ụbọchị ihe owuwu ụlọ na Jitsi's Videobridge (2013). Tupu SFU, oku otu WebRTC bụ ntupu zuru oke - iyi iyi N-1 nke ọ bụla nwere akara, nke na-agbakọ akụkụ anọ. Bugharịa, Google Zute, Jitsi, otu mgbaama na-akpọ ihe niile ejiri SFU. Vortex Oku-naanị otu ezigara na v0.0.8; Oku otu vidiyo dị na map ụzọ v0.3.
calls.h6_a: Nkesa ihuenyo bụ egwu mgbasa ozi ọhụrụ na PeerConnection dị adị, kparịtara ụka site na inye/aza.
calls.h6_b: Onye ọrụ kpatụ ihuenyo Kekọrịta → ihe nchọgharị / iOS / gam akporo na-akpọ 'getDisplayMedia()'. MediaStream weghachiri eweghachi na-agbakwunyeTrack-ed na PeerConnection. Mkparịta ụka ọzọ na-agba ọkụ: onyinye/aza ọhụrụ nwere egwu agbakwunyere. Ndị nnata na-eme ihuenyo nkekọrịta ka ihe vidiyo dị iche. Na iOS, nkesa ihuenyo chọrọ Mgbatị Bulite Mgbasa Ozi; na gam akporo, ikike ihu ihu + MediaProjection ikike.
calls.h6_c: getDisplayMedia bụ ọkọlọtọ na 2017 ma dị na ihe nchọgharị ọ bụla kemgbe 2019. Mgbasa mgbasa ozi mgbasa ozi nke iOS bịara na iOS 11 (2017). Android MediaProjection kwụsiri ike kemgbe Lollipop (2015). Ebufere Vortex enyo nkesa na v0.0.8.
calls.h2_f:
ndi choro:
  onye ọbịa: rtp: addr (mpaghara IP)
  srflx : STUN achọpụtara adreesị ọha
  relay: adreesị relay ekenye TURN

nlele abụọ: STUN ịrịọ arịrịọ n'elu UDP
ụzọ abụọ ahọpụtara: mbụ ga-aga nke ọma
calls.h3_f:
aha njirimara = "{expiry_unix}:{user_id}"
paswọọdụ = base64 (HMAC-SHA1(ihe nzuzo nke sava, aha njirimara))
TTL = awa 24
coturn: kwadoro HMAC na arịrịọ AUTH; na-ajụ ma emebie ya
calls.h4_f:
audio: Opus 48 kHz, 6-128 kbps VBR, DTX na, FEC na
Vidiyo: VP9 (isi)
         ↓ ọdịda
        H.264 ntọala (amachibidoro)
         ↓ Nwepu
        AV1 (achọrọ ngbanwe ngwaike)
otu: simulcast L1 + L2 + L3 mkpebi n'otu oge
calls.h5_f:
ntupu zuru ezu (N ọgbọ): onye ọ bụla na-eziga iyi N-1 → O(N²) uplink
SFU (N ọgbọ): onye ọ bụla na-eziga 1 iyi → O(N) uplink kwa otu ọgbọ
calls.h6_f:
getDisplayMedia ({vidiyo: {cursor: "mgbe niile"}, ọdịyo: ụgha})
  → MediaStream
pc.addTrack (kekọrịta VideoTrack, shareStream)
  → megharia mkparịta ụka (createOffer → setLocalDescription → mgbanwe)

federation.title: Federation
federation.subtitle: Igodo pub nke ntụkwasị obi, asịrị bịanyere aka na ya, DM cross-node.
federation.intro: Federation na-ahapụ ndị ọrụ na ọnụ A ozi ndị ọrụ na ọnụ B. Ọ bụ Nwepu n'otu onye ọrụ. A tụkwasịrị obi n'ụzọ doro anya igodo pubk ọnụ; ọ dịghị akpaka "ọ bụla ọnụ nwere ike federate na nke m" mode.
federation.h1p1: Ọnụ ọ bụla na-ejigide `federations(pubkey, endpoint, health_score, added_at, add_by)'.
federation.h1p2: Ịgbakwunye onye ọgbọ chọrọ ihe nchịkwa onye ọrụ bịanyere aka na ya. Onye nchịkwa UI na-egosi akara mkpisiaka nke remote ka ndị na-ahụ maka ọrụ nwee ike ịchọpụta na-anọghị na band.
federation.h1p3: Ndị ọgbọ ewepụrụ na-anọgide na DB akara 'wepụrụ_na' maka nyocha. Ajụjụ arịrịọ ọgbakọ ọhụrụ site n'otu igodo pub ahụ ruo mgbe onye nchịkwa ewepụghị ya.
federation.h2p1: Ọpụpụ site na A gaa na onye ọrụ@B: node A na-ekechi envelopu ozi ahụ na blọb mbinye aka yana POST '/federation/confiver' na ọnụ B.
federation.h2p2: Envelopu: `{source_node, target_user, inner_ciphertext, inner_nonce, sent_at, sig}`. Sig na-ekpuchi ihe niile ma e wezụga sig n'onwe ya.
federation.h2p3: Node B na-enyocha mbinye aka megide 'isi iyi_node' pubkey site na tebụl 'federations' ya. Ihe omume nyocha na-ezighi ezi → 401+
federation.h3p1: Ọ bụrụ na enweghị ike iru B, A kwụ n'ahịrị na `federation_outbox(target_node, payload, mgbalị, next_retry_at)`.
federation.h3p2: Nkwụghachi ụgwọ: 1s, 5s, 30s, 2min, 10min, 1h, nke etinyere na 6h. Ọdịda na-adịgide adịgide mgbe ụbọchị iri na anọ gachara.
federation.h3p3: Onye na-arụ ọrụ na-agba ọkụ mgbe omimi igbe igbe> ozi 1000 - na-egosi njikọ njikọ njikọ.
federation.h4p1: Kwa 60s ọ bụla ọnụ pings `GET /v1/health' na ndị ọgbọ ọ bụla. A na-enyocha oge nzaghachi + ọkwa.
federation.h4p2: Akara ahụike: mbido 100. Oge ngwụcha nke ọ bụla na-ewepụ 1; ihe ịga nke ọma ọ bụla na-agbakwụnye 1 (okpu 100). Akara 0 → federation kwụsịrị maka ndị ọgbọ ahụ.
federation.h4p3: Ebipụtara site na `GET /v1/peers` maka dashboard onye ọrụ.
federation.h1_a: Federation na Vortex bụ mmekọrịta ntụkwasị obi n'etiti ndị ọrụ ọnụ abụọ. Ọnụ ọ bụla na-ebipụta igodo ọha 32-byte Ed25519; ọnụ ọnụ nke ọzọ na-agbakwunye ya na tebụl `trusted_nodes' n'akụkụ njedebe ya na akara ahụike.
federation.h1_b: Ịtinye igodo pub ntụkwasị obi chọrọ onye ọrụ ka o jiri igodo ntọhapụ nke ọnụ nke aka ya bịanye aka na arịrịọ nchịkwa. Ihe UI na-egosi akara mkpisiaka nke ime obodo n'ụdị 64-hex-char ka ndị nchịkwa wee nwee ike ịchọpụta na ha enweghị band. Ozugbo agbakwunyere, a na-enyocha envelopu gọọmentị mbata ọ bụla megide mbinye aka Ed25519 pubkey - a na-achọpụta ụgha ozugbo wee banye. Mweghachi dị nro: ahịrị a na-edobe akara `wepụrụ_at` maka nyocha, mana mbinye aka envelopu ahụ ada ada.
federation.h1_c: E nwetara ụkpụrụ ahụ site na Matrix's federation (ebe sava ọ bụla na-akpọsa igodo nbinye aka yana mmemme ọ bụla ejiri ya bịanye aka) yana site na email's DKIM (ebe DNS na-ebipụta pubkey mbinye aka). Matrix gosipụtara na ihe nlereanya a na-arụ ọrụ n'ọtụtụ - netwọk ha nwere ihe karịrị 100k sava federated. Ọdịiche nke Vortex dị iche site n'ịchọ nbanye nbanye n'ụzọ doro anya kama Matrix's "ihe nkesa ọ bụla nwere ike ịmekọrịta site na ndabara" iwu; anyị na-azụ ahịa mma maka nchebe siri ike megide ndị agha rogue.
federation.h1_f:
Ahịrị ntụkwasị obi_nodes:
  isi okwu: 32 bytes Ed25519
  njedebe: https://…
  ahụike_score: int [0, 100]
  add_na: unix_ms
  add_by: admin_user_id
  wepụrụ_na : unix_ms | NULL
federation.h2_a: Ozi ọnụ obe na-agba otu envelopu E2E dị ka nke mpaghara, kechie n'ime envelopu mpụta bịanyere aka na ya nke na-egosipụta ọnụ izipu na ọnụ nnabata.
federation.h2_b: Node A chọrọ ibuga onye ọrụ@B. Kwụpụ 1: A na-ahazi usoro `{source_node, target_user, inner_ciphertext, inner_nonce, sent_at}`. Kwụpụ 2: A ga-eji igodo nzuzo Ed25519 → `sig` gosi bytes nke serialized. Kwụpụ 3: A na-eziga tuple ahụ ka ọ bụrụ 'POST /federation/deliver' na ọnụ B. Nzọụkwụ 4: B na-eleba anya 'source_node' na 'trusted_nodes' ya, na-enyocha 'sig', lelee 'ezigara' na windo replay, ma nọgide na envelopu dị na tebụl 'ozi' mpaghara ya. Onye ahịa nnata na-ahụ ya kpọmkwem dị ka ozi mpaghara - oyi akwa federation adịghị ahụ anya maka ndị ọrụ njedebe.
federation.h2_c: Ebitere envelopu bịanyere aka na mpụta site na mmemme gọọmentị Matrix'm.room.message'. Window mkpọgharị (nkeji 5) na ihe achọrọ na stampụ oge abịanyere aka na isi mmalite dabara na elekere mgbidi ka agbaziri site na DKIM. N'oge Vortex (v0.0.2) nwara ụlọ ọrụ na-edebanyeghị aha ya na asambodo ndị ahịa TLS; anyị gbanwere na mbinye aka ịkwụ ụgwọ na v0.0.5 mgbe anyị ghọtara asambodo ndị ahịa anaghị adị ndụ ndị na-ebu ibu ma zoo ezigbo nkwenye site na oyi akwa ngwa.
federation.h3_a: Mgbe oghere dịpụrụ adịpụ enweghị ike iru, ọnụ na-ezipụ kwụ n'ahịrị envelopu ahụ n'igbe 'federation_outbox' wee maliteghachi azụ azụ.
federation.h3_b: Usoro nkwụghachi azụ: 1s, 5s, 30s, 2min, 10min, 1h, nke etinyere na 6h. Na mbọ ọ bụla dara ada, agbakwunyere kọlụm 'mgbalị' ahịrị yana 'na-emegharị_na' ka edobere ugbu a + nzọụkwụ ugbu a. Onye na-arụ ọrụ n'okirikiri ('app/federation/outbox_worker.py`) na-eteta kwa nkeji ise ọ bụla wee buru ahịrị ebe ` na-esote_retry_na <= now()'. Ihe ịga nke ọma na-ehichapụ ahịrị; Ụbọchị 14 nke ọdịda na-egosi na ọ na-adịgide adịgide ma zipụ ọkwa nchịkwa.
federation.h3_c: Nkwụghachi azụ nke nwere elu ụlọ bụ otu ụkpụrụ Kafka na-eji maka nyochaghachi ndị nrụpụta yana SMTP na-eji maka ozi bounced. Okpu ụbọchị 14 dakọtara na ntụnye SMTP's RFC 5321. Ụdị nke mbụ na-eji nyochagharị nkeji iri isii na nke abụọ nke mere ka égbè eluigwe na-agba ọsọ mgbe onye ọgbọ lọghachiri na ntanetị mgbe ọ kwụsịrị; exponential gbasaa doziri na v0.0.7.
federation.h3_f:
igbu oge (n) = min (6h, 1s · 2ⁿ) maka n = 0, 1, 2,…

Nnwale oge: 1s, 2s, 4s, 8s, 16s, 32s, 64s, 128s, 256s, …, 6h
njikere: outbox_depth> 1000 maka> 5 nkeji
federation.h4_a: Kwa sekọnd 60 ọ bụla ọnụ ọnụ ọ bụla na-amata njedebe '/v1/health' nke ọgbọ ọ bụla. Akara na-ebuli elu na ihe ịga nke ọma, gbadaa na ọdịda, kechiri na [0, 100].
federation.h4_b: Akara na-amalite na 100 na mgbakwunye. Ihe ịga nke ọma ọ bụla na-agbakwụnye +1 (nke etinyere na 100), oge nkwụsị oge ọ bụla na-ewepụ -1 (gbara ala na 0). Akara 0 kwụsịrị federation nye ndị ọgbọ ahụ — kwụ n'ahịrị ozi ọhụrụ n'ime igbe, enweghị mbọ mbupụ ọhụrụ ruo mgbe akara arịgoro azụ n'elu 20. A na-ekpughe akara ahụ site na `GET / v1/ndị ọgbọ' maka dashboard ndị ọrụ yana site na `/metrics` maka Prometheus. Akara mberede dara n'ofe ọtụtụ ndị ọgbọ n'ime obere windo na-ebute "nkebi netwọk a na-enyo enyo".
federation.h4_c: Akara ụdị AIMD sitere na windo mkpọnwụ nke TCP na ihe mgbochi ahụike Akamai. Nzọụkwụ asymmetric ± 1 (kama TCP halving) na-eme ka mgbake dị nwayọ karịa ọdịda, nke na-emebi sistemu ahụ na ịkpachara anya - ọ ga-akara anyị mma ịkwụsịtụ Federation mgbe ejighị n'aka izipu ozi oyiri site na njikọ na-akụ. Agbakwunyere na v0.0.6 ka onye ọgbọ na-eme omume ọjọọ rigoro ezigbo ndị ọgbọ abụọ na-emegharị.
federation.h4_f:
na ihe ịga nke ọma: akara = nkeji (100, akara + 1)
n'oge nkwụsị: akara = max (0, akara - 1)
ọ bụrụ akara == 0: kwụsịtụ_federation(ogbo)
ma ọ bụrụ akara>= 20: resume_federation(ogbo) // hysteresis

gossip.title: Go ssp na nchọpụta ndị ọgbọ
gossip.subtitle: Olee otú ọnụ ụzọ chọta onye ọ bụla ọzọ na-enweghị a Central ndekọ.
gossip.intro: Na agafe ndepụta nke onye njikwa ahụ, Vortex nodes na-asịrị ndị ọgbọ n'etiti onwe ha. Nke a na-achọpụta ọnụ ọhụrụ ka ndị na-arụ ọrụ na-atụgharị ha, ọ bụrụgodị na onye njikwa ahụ akwadobeghị ha.
gossip.h1p1: Kwa afọ 60, ọnụ na-ahọrọ ndị ọgbọ na-enweghị usoro wee zipu nzacha oge ntoju 256-bit nke ndị ọgbọ ama ama. Ndị ọgbọ zara ndị ọgbọ NOT na nzacha, gbakwunyere nzacha nke ya. Bandwit bụ 'O(ohu ọhụrụ × 32 bytes)', na-adịkarị n'okpuru 1 KiB kwa okirikiri.
gossip.h1p2: Ndị ọgbọ mgbasa ozi ọ bụla na-abịanye aka na ọnụ mgbasa ozi. Ndị ahịa na-enyocha mbinye aka na kọntaktị mbụ - onye na-awakpo enweghị ike iwepụta onye ọgbọ n'ime asịrị.
gossip.h1p3: Agba a na-ejedebe oke: otu mgbanwe kwa onye ọgbọ kwa 30 s (window na-amị amị).
gossip.h2p1: Ọnụ ọhụrụ na-amalite site na njikwa bootstrap 8 hardcoded. Asịrị mbụ na-achọpụta ọtụtụ ndị ọgbọ; netwọk na-agbakọta na ~ 1 nkeji.
gossip.h2p2: A na-edezi ndepụta bootstrap site na `.env` `BOOTSTRAP_PEERS=pubkey1@endpoint1,pubkey2@endpoint2,...`.
gossip.h3p1: Ndị ọgbọ mgbasa ozi ọ bụla ga-enwerịrị igodo ntọhapụ Ed25519 onye ọrụ. Ịmepụta ọkwa ọkwa ndị ọgbọ chọrọ izu ohi igodo ziri ezi.
gossip.h3p2: Ihe akaebe nke ọrụ (mgbanwe, ndabara 2^18 na-eduga efu) na ndebanye aha ndị ọgbọ ọhụrụ na-eme ka nnukwu ebili mmiri Sybil-bot ghara ịdị irè.
gossip.h3p3: Usoro aha ọma: ndị ọgbọ na-akpa àgwà ọjọọ (mbinye aka ọjọọ, mkpọsa ụgha, oge nkwụsị ugboro ugboro) na-emebi aha ha. Aha efu → ndetu ojii.
gossip.h1_a: 60s ọ bụla ọnụ ọnụ na-ahọrọ ndị ọgbọ na-enweghị usoro wee zipu nzacha Bloom 256-bit na-achịkọta ndị ọgbọ ama ama. Ndị ọgbọ na-aza ndị ọgbọ ọhụrụ + nzacha nke ya. Bandwit bụ 'O(ọhụrụ_ọgbọ × 32 bytes)'.
gossip.h1_b: Nzacha oge ntoju k=5 hashes, m=256 ibeji. Node A na-etinye ihe peer_ids niile ama ama. Na-ezigara ndị ọgbọ B. B jụrụ nzacha ya na ndị ọgbọ ya nke ọ bụla; ihe ọ bụla na-efunahụ, B na-ezigara A (gbakwunyere nzacha nke ya). A na-eme otu nlele ahụ azụ. Mgbe mgbanwe ahụ gachara, ọnụ abụọ ahụ na-ekerịta otu ihe ọmụma. Ụdị mgbanwe: 200-800 bytes. Mmelite na-agbakọta n'ofe netwọkụ na gburugburu ~5 (nkeji 5) ekele maka ihe asịrị.
gossip.h1_c: Ụbọchị nzacha Bloom-filter na Cornell's 1998 bimodal multicast paper. Apache Cassandra na-eji ya maka ịbụ otu; Bitcoin maka nnyefe azụmahịa; IPFS maka ndozi DHT. Ngwongwo njikọta nke O(log N) bụ ihe na-eme ka ọ dị mma maka ojiji anyị - anyị achọghị echiche zuru ụwa ọnụ, naanị n'ikpeazụ-ọmụma ọgbọ na-agbanwe agbanwe. A na-edobe nha nzacha (bits 256) nke mere na ọnụego adịgboroja bụ <1 % na ndị ọgbọ 100.
gossip.h2_a: Ọnụ ọhụrụ na-amalite site na njikwa bootstrap 8 hardcoded. Mbụ asịrị gburugburu na-achọpụta ihe ọzọ; na-agbakọta n'ime ~ 1 nkeji.
gossip.h2_b: Ụgbọ mmiri `.env` nwere `BOOTTRAP_PEERS=pubkey1@endpoint1,pubkey2@endpoint2,...`. Na mmalite, ọnụ na-anwale nke ọ bụla n'usoro. Nke mbụ ịzaghachi na-enye ndepụta ndị ọgbọ mbụ (site na `GET /v1/trusted_nodes`). Node na-etinye ndị ahụ n'ime tebụl ndị ọgbọ ya, kaa ha akara ka akpụkpọ ụkwụ, wee malite akara asịrị nke 60s. Agba ndị na-esote na-achọpụta ndị ọgbọ.
gossip.h2_c: Akpụkpọ ụkwụ akpụkpọ ụkwụ siri ike bụ otu ụkpụrụ Bitcoin, Ethereum, IPFS iji. Nhọrọ ọzọ - DHT chọpụtara dabere - chọrọ ntinye mbụ na agbanyeghị. Vortex's 8 bootstrap count ka ahọpụtara n'ihi na inwe> 4 na-enye resilience megide 2-3 n'otu oge downtime omume, na <16 na-edobe `.env` faịlụ. Hazie kwa-ebunye site na edezi `BOOTTRAP_PEERS`.
gossip.h3_a: Ndị ọgbọ mgbasa ozi ọ bụla ga-abanyerịrịrịrị igodo ntọhapụ Ed25519 onye ọrụ izizi ya. Onye na-awakpo enweghị ike ịmepụta ndị ọgbọ na netwọk.
gossip.h3_b: Mgbe ọnụ A na-akpọsa ndị ọgbọ P na asịrị gaa na ọnụ B, A na-agụnye `P.pubkey`, `P.endpoint`, na akara timestamp, ha niile ji igodo ntọhapụ nke P bịanyere aka na ya. B na-enyocha mbinye aka tupu ịtụkwasị P. Ọ bụrụ na B emechaa kọntaktị P na P's TLS cert + obi mgbawa mbụ adabaghị na mkpịsị ugodi mgbasa ozi, a na-akara mgbasa ozi ahụ nsi wee gbasaa ala.
gossip.h3_c: Mgbasa ozi ndị ọgbọ mbinye aka bụ ọkọlọtọ mgbochi Sybil primitive sitere na Chord (2001) na Kademlia (2002). Ozi addr Bitcoin na-eji ụdị adịghị ike (enweghị mbinye aka, dabere na ọnụ ahịa njikọ dị ka Sybil deterrent); Akara ngosi discv5 nke Ethereum. Vortex nakweere mgbasa ozi mbinye aka na v0.0.6 mgbe onye na-awakpo testnet kpọsara ndị ọgbọ adịgboroja 1000 site na otu ọnụ ọnụ ziri ezi.
gossip.h1_f:
nzacha: k=5, m=256 ibeji
tinye (x) = maka m na 0.k: nzacha [hash_i (x) mod m] = 1
ajụjụ(x) = maka i na 0.k: lelee nzacha[hash_i(x) mod m]
adịgboroja na ndị ọgbọ 100, 256 bits, k=5: ~ 0.4%
gossip.h2_f:
.env:
  BOOTSTRAP_PEERS=abcd…@https://a.example,efgh…@https://b.example

mmalite:
  maka ndị ọgbọ na BOOTSTRAP_PEERS:
    gbalịa: ndị ọgbọ ← peer.get('/v1/trusted_nodes'); agbaji
    ma ewezuga: gaba
  bido asịrị

stealth.title: Netwọk nzuzo
stealth.subtitle: Ise n'ígwé, 28 usoro. Ihe niile sitere na TLS padding ruo ọrụ yabasị Tor.
stealth.intro: Vortex na-ewere onye iro ọkwa ọkwa mba. A na-akwakọba ihe mkpofu stealth nke mere na ọ bụrụgodị na a gafechara elu elu, ndị nke dị n'ime ka na-enye ọrụ rụrụ arụ ma na-arụ ọrụ.
stealth.h1p1: Layer 1 - mkpisi aka normalization. Kwụsị klaasị na-agafe agafe.
stealth.h1p2: Layer 2 — udi / nha morphing. Kwụsị klaasị-nyocha okporo ụzọ.
stealth.h1p3: Layer 3 — camouflage protocol. Kwụsị ọrụ DPI.
stealth.h1p4: Layer 4 - ihe ndị nwere ike ibugharị. Na-arụ ọrụ na netwọk na-egbochi isi anyị.
stealth.h1p5: Layer 5 - ọdịda ọdịda ikpeazụ. Yabasị, BMP, ọtụtụ hop relay. Na-arụ ọrụ mgbe ọ dịghị ihe ọzọ na-eme.
stealth.h2p1: TLS 1.3 ClientHello dakọtara Chrome na Windows 11 byte-for-byte. JA3/JA4 hash dakọtara Chrome 120 — enweghị akara mkpisiaka Vortex akọwapụtara.
stealth.h2p2: Ihe mkpuchi oyi akwa: ihe ndekọ TLS niile etinyere na 16 KB. Nha ngwungwu dabara na okporo ụzọ ihe nchọgharị buru ibu.
stealth.h2p3: Nzipu ọnụego oge niile: kwụ n'ahịrị na-ewepụta otu etiti N ms ọ bụla n'agbanyeghị ọrụ ngwa. Oge na-adịghị agwụ agwụ na-ebupụ okpokolo agba nkpuchi akara n'ime envelopu nke ime ka ndị nnata tụfuo ha.
stealth.h2p4: Oge jitter: 0-50 ms igbu oge na-egbu oge na egress iji merie dabere latency DPI.
stealth.h3p1: YouTube-720p morpher: nkesa nha ngwungwu, ịgbawa agbawa, na oghere ịgbachi nkịtị dabara na iyi ndụ YouTube. Ndị na-ahụ maka ọkwa ọkwa na-achọ nkụda mmụọ ozi adabaghị.
stealth.h3p2: Multipath: Otu usoro ahụ na-agbawa n'elu Wi-Fi, cellular, na ihe ọ bụla na-arụ ọrụ VPN n'out oge. Nhazigharị na nnata. Na-emeri nhazi otu ụzọ.
stealth.h3p3: Ọwara ọwa data WebRTC: mgbe TLS egbochiri mana WebRTC na-arụ ọrụ, Vortex tunnels site na ọwa DTLS-SRTP nye onye ọgbọ ama ama.
stealth.h3p4: Njikọ ndị na-achọ mma: 3 nọrọ ogologo oge na-adịghị arụ ọrụ TLS nnọkọ ruo Google, YouTube, na Cloudflare. Onye nleba anya na-ahụ omume nchọgharị nkịtị.
stealth.h4p1: DoH (RFC 8484): niile DNS kpebiri site na DoH ka Cloudflare / Google / Quad9. ISP na-ahụ naanị HTTPS nye ndị mkpebi ahụ, ọ bụghị ndepụta ngalaba n'ezie.
stealth.h4p2: ECH (Ndewo onye ahịa ezoro ezo): SNI ezoro ezo ya na igodo ebipụtara na ndekọ DNS HTTPS. Ndị na-ekiri ihe na-eme njem enweghị ike ịhụ aha nnabata ebe aga.
stealth.h4p3: Nchọpụta nyocha: ọnụ na-eso arịrịọ arịrịọ na-enweghị nnọkọ nyocha. Nnyocha atọ dara ada site na IP n'ime nkeji ise na-akpalite ọnọdụ "saịtị aghụghọ" - nke ahụ IP na-ahụ ibe ọdịda larịị HTML nwere 200 OK.
stealth.h4p4: DGA (Algorithm Ọgbọ ngalaba): onye na-emepụta ngalaba na-ekpebi ihe ejiri ụbọchị taa. Ọ bụrụ na akpọchie isi njedebe, ndị ahịa na-agbakọ onye ga-esote wee nwaa.
stealth.h5: Ọkwa 4 - Ụgbọ njem nwere ike ịgbanye
stealth.h5p1: vmess / vless / trojan / shadowtls: ọkọlọtọ V2Ray ụdị ụgbọ njem nwere ihe nkwụnye JSON nhazi.
stealth.h5p2: Eziokwu: TLS-in-TLS ọwara. Ebumnuche aka aka elu www.microsoft.com; aka n'ime bụ Vortex. A na-ebuga nyocha megide mpụta na Microsoft yabụ nyocha na-arụsi ọrụ ike anaghị ekpughe ihe ọ bụla.
stealth.h5p3: Snowflake: ihe nchọgharị ndị ọrụ afọ ofufo na-ebugharị Vortex okporo ụzọ gafere WebRTC. Ndị ọrụ na-etinye mgbakwunye Snowflake na-enye mkpuchi.
stealth.h5p4: NaiveProxy: na-agbanwe nyocha HTTPS iji gwakọta agwa Chromium nke onwe ya ruo obere nkeji.
stealth.h6p1: Ọrụ yabasị: ọnụ ọ bụla na-ekpughekwa onwe ya dị ka `. yabasị'. Ndị ahịa nwere nkwado Tor na-adaba na nke a mgbe ihe ndị ọzọ dara.
stealth.h6p2: Protocol igbe ozi kpuru ìsì (BMP): ụlọ ahịa na-aga n'ihu maka ozi na-amaghị aha. Lee isi BMP.
stealth.h6p3: Multi-hop relay: ozi nwere ike ibia elu ruo 5 etiti ọnụ ọnụ, nke ọ bụla na-agbakwụnye oyi akwa nke envelopu. Dị ka Tor mana na ntupu nke anyị.
stealth.h6p4: OHTTP (RFC 9458): amaghị ihe HTTP site na ọsọ agbagharị. Ọ dịghị otu onye na-ahụ ma arịrịọ na nzaghachi.
stealth.h1_a: A haziri Stealth dị ka ọkwa ise kwụụrụ onwe ya. Onye ọ bụla oyi akwa meriri a dị iche iche klas nke mmegide. Ọdịda nke otu oyi akwa na-eweda nke ọzọ - ọ naghị agbaji.
stealth.h1_b: Layer 1 na-emezi akara mkpisiaka TLS anyị nke mere na enweghị ike ịkewa DPI. Layer 2 morphs okporo ụzọ ka ọ dị ka nkwanye. Layer 3 na-ekpuchi protocol site na ECH / DoH / aghụghọ nzaghachi nyocha. Layer 4 na-atụgharị gaa na mbufe pluggable (vmess, eziokwu, Snowflake) mgbe egbochiri nke mbụ nke ọma. Layer 5 bụ ebe ikpeazụ: Tor eyịm, BMP, multi-hop relay.
stealth.h1_c: Ihe nlere nke nwere akwa na-abịa site na ihe owuwu nke Tor's pluggable-transport architecture (2013). Vortex gbakwunyere akwa ise kama nke Tor atọ n'ihi na ka ọ na-erule 2025 mpaghara mmegide gụnyere DPI nke ghọtara na Tor na-ebufe onwe ya (Great Firewall 2020, Iran 2022). Ewebatara oyi akwa ọ bụla Vortex mgbe ihe omume ubi gasịrị: L1 mgbe Kazakhstan gbochiri (2019-dabara), L2 mgbe Iran gbasasịrị 2022, L3 mgbe nchọpụta China nke 2020 DoH gasịrị, L4 2023 na Turkey blocks.
stealth.h1_f:
klas onye iro | meriri ya
------------------ | ------------
ngafe DPI | L1 (akara mkpịsị aka)
nyocha okporo ụzọ | L2 (ụdị)
arụ ọrụ DPI | L3 (camouflage)
igbochi site IP | L4 (ụgbọ njem)
ihe ọ bụla ọzọ | L5 (eyịm / BMP)
stealth.h2_a: Layer 1 na-eme ka okporo ụzọ Vortex enweghị ike ịmata ọdịiche dị na Chrome na Windows 11 na oyi akwa TLS.
stealth.h2_b: ClientHello ịtụ, ndepụta ndọtị, ndepụta cipher suite, ụkpụrụ ALPN - ha niile na-ege ntị ka ọ dabara na baiti nke Chrome 120. JA3/JA4 hash dabara na ntọhapụ Chrome dị ugbu a. TLS Mpempe akwụkwọ ndekọ ruo 16 KB. Onye na-ezigara ọnụ ahịa mgbe niile na-ebunye otu freek N ms ọ bụla nwere ihe njuju n'oge ọrụ. Oge jitter 0-50 ms iji merie nyocha latency. Njikọ ihe ndozi na Google, YouTube, Cloudflare na-agba ọsọ n'azụ na nkeji iri anọ na ise.
stealth.h2_c: Ndị injinia Salesforce bipụtara akara mkpịsị aka JA3/JA4 na 2017. Site na 2019 ọ bụ ọkọlọtọ na ụlọ ọrụ DPI. Vortex A na-eme ka akara mkpịsị aka mkpịsị aka dị na uTLS, ọba akwụkwọ Go nke Snowflake na-eji maka otu ebumnuche. Ndị na-ezigara ọnụ ahịa mgbe niile bụ ọdụ ụgbọ mmiri ozugbo nke WireGuard's "cover trafic" atụmatụ.
stealth.h3_a: Layer 2 na-eme ka okporo ụzọ dị ka mgbasa ozi mgbasa ozi karịa karịa nkata mmekọrịta.
stealth.h3_b: YouTube-720p morpher: nkesa nha nha dakọtara na iyi ndụ YouTube 720p (tebụl na-ahụ anya), egwuregwu ịgbawa agbawa, dakọtara gaps gaps. Multipath: otu iyi ezi uche dị na ya kewara n'elu Wi-Fi, cellular, na ihe ọ bụla na-arụ ọrụ VPN n'otu oge; onye nnata na-agbakọta n'usoro nọmba usoro. WebRTC data chanel fallback: mgbe TLS egbochiri mana WebRTC na-agafe, ọwara Vortex site na ọwa data DTLS-SRTP nye onye ọgbọ ama ama.
stealth.h3_c: Nnyocha morphing okporo ụzọ na-alaghachi na Wright et al. 2009. Obfs4 mejuputa ya dị ka "morph" sub-mode na 2014. Meek + ngalaba-fronting kụziiri anyị na udi mkpa dị ukwuu dị ka ezoro ezo. Ahọpụtara YouTube-kpọmkwem n'ihi na ọ bụ otu saịtị anaghị egbochi ya na ọtụtụ netwọkụ amachibidoro - izobe n'ime okporo ụzọ YouTube yiri "na-ezo n'ime igwe mmadụ".
stealth.h3_f:
packet_size[i] ~ P(nha | YT-720p)
send_delay[i] ~ P (egbu oge | YT-720p)
dummy_frames etinyere n'oge arụ ọrụ iji kwado ọdịdị envelopu
stealth.h4_a: Layer 3 na-ekpuchi njirimara protocol n'onwe ya - SNI, DNS, koodu nzaghachi.
stealth.h4_b: DoH (RFC 8484): niile DNS na-agafe DNS-over-HTTPS ruo Cloudflare/Google/Quad9. ISP na-ahụ naanị HTTPS nye ndị mkpebi ahụ. ECH (RFC 9460): SNI ejiri igodo ebipụtara na ndekọ DNSHTTPS ezoro ezo. Ndị na-ekiri ihe na-eme njem na-ahụ naanị njedebe ihu IP. Nchọpụta nyocha: ọnụ ụzọ na-esochi IPs unauth'd kụrụ `/api/*`; ọdịda atọ na 5 min tụgharịa IP ka ọ bụrụ "ọnọdụ aghụghọ" - nke ahụ IP na-ahụ ibe ọdịda static HTML nwere 200 OK. DGA: deterministic ngalaba generator mkpụrụ ụbọchị taa ka ndị ahịa chọta ọdịda mgbe egbochiri nke mbụ.
stealth.h4_c: DoH bidoro na Firefox 2018 wee bụrụ ndabara maka Chrome na 2019. ECH gafere usoro ise tupu nhazi ọkwa na 2024 - Vortex ebugharị nkwado n'oge draft-13 ma ugbu a na-akwado nkọwa ikpeazụ. A na-agbaziri ihe nleba anya na-aza ajụjụ site na imewe 2014 dị nwayọọ ma nụchaa na 2023 mgbe ndị nyocha Iran na-arụsi ọrụ ike chọpụtara ịdị nwayọọ site n'oge nzaghachi ya.
stealth.h5_a: Layer 4 na-eji ụgbọ njem pluggable - ọwara ndị ọzọ dị ka ihe ọzọ kpamkpam.
stealth.h5_b: vmess/vless/trojan: ụgbọ njem ọpụpụ ọkọlọtọ V2Ray ụdị; nhazi JSON. Eziokwu: TLS-in-TLS ọwara ebe a na-achọ mmanye aka elu www.microsoft.com; aka n'ime bụ Vortex. A na-ebuga nyocha na-arụ ọrụ na mpụta na Microsoft, yabụ nyocha anaghị ekpughe ihe ọ bụla. Snowflake: ihe nchọgharị ndị ọrụ afọ ofufo relay Vortex over WebRTC; enweghị infra n'akụkụ anyị. NaiveProxy: na-agbanwe nyocha HTTPS iji gwakọta na omume Chromium.
stealth.h5_c: Ndị obodo mgbochi mmachi China webatara V2Ray's Vmess na 2015. Ewepụtara Trojan na 2019. Eziokwu sitere na 2022 - nzaghachi na nchọpụta mkpịsị aka Great Firewall TLS. Snowflake bụ onye nnọchi Tor Project nke 2020 maka obfs4; Vortex agbakwunyere nkwado na v0.0.9 ka Iran 2023 zuru oke nke ntinye Tor.
stealth.h5_f:
atụ inbound eziokwu:
  Aha nkesa: www.microsoft.com
  Ebe: www.microsoft.com:443
  shortIds: ["<random>"]
Onye ahịa na-ejikọ na IP anyị, SNI=www.microsoft.com, anyị na-anọchi anya nzaghachi n'ezie Microsoft
ọ bụrụ na ụzọ dabara shortId+auth ⇒ ụzọ gaa Vortex
stealth.h6_a: Layer 5 bụ akpa aghụghọ ikpeazụ: ọrụ yabasị, BMP store-and-forward, multi-hop relay, OHTTP.
stealth.h6_b: Ọnụ ọ bụla na-ebipụta adreesị '. yabasị'. Ndị ahịa nwere onye nnabata Tor na-adaba mgbe TLS + L1-L4 niile dara. BMP (Protocol igbe ozi kpuru ìsì): onye na-ezipụ na-atụba blọb ezoro ezo n'ọnụ ọnụ ọ bụla nke `HKDF( nnata_pubkey, "bmp-v1") kpuchiri; asịrị na-agbasa; onye nnata na-akwali n'ọnụ ụlọ ha. Multi-hop: ozi na-erute ihe ruru ọnụ ụzọ etiti ise, nke ọ bụla na-agbakwunye akwa envelopu - dị ka Tor mana n'ime ntupu nke anyị. OHTTP (RFC 9458): amaghị HTTP site na relay ka ọ nweghị otu onye hụrụ ma arịrịọ na nzaghachi.
stealth.h6_c: Ọrụ yabasị malitere na 2004 na Tor. BMP bụ ihe anyị mepụtara, nke e mere na asịrị nkọwa ọrụ zoro ezo nke Tor. Multi-hop relay enyo onye ezipu akara akara gbakwunyere ụzọ yabasị. OHTTP sitere na 2024, nke Cloudflare na Apple chepụtara maka telemetry na-echekwa nzuzo; anyị nakweere ya na v0.0.9 dị ka ọdịda ikpeazụ.
stealth.h6_f:
BMP mailbox_id = HKDF(onye nnata_pk, "bmp-v1", 32)
Nkwụnye ego: POST /bmp/deposit {mailbox_id, blob}
Bulite: GET /bmp/messages (auth'd)
TTL: 7200 s |  Ihe kacha mma: 1 MB |  Oke n'otu ọnụ: 500 MB

bmp.title: Protocol igbe ozi kpuru ìsì
bmp.subtitle: Ụlọ ahịa na-aga n'ihu na-amaghị aha maka ozi site na ntupu asịrị.
bmp.intro: BMP ekwe ka onye na-ezipụ tinye ozi n'ọnụ ọnụ ọ bụla na-egosighi njirimara. Ozi a na-agba asịrị ruo mgbe ọ rutere n'ọnụ ụlọ nke onye nnata, ebe ọ na-apụ apụ dị ka ọ na-adị.
bmp.h1p1: Onye izipu nwetara `mailbox_id = HKDF( nnata_pubkey, ozi: "bmp-v1", oghere: 32)`. Naanị onye zitere (onye maara recipient_pubkey) nwere ike ịgbakọ ya; onye nnata marakwa.
bmp.h1p2: Biputere akwụkwọ ozi `POST /bmp/deposit` nwere `{mailbox_id, blob}` n'ọnụ asịrị ọ bụla.
bmp.h1p3: Ọnụ ụzọ ụlọ ahịa ọnụ maka 7200 s. Node tinyekwara igbe ozi_id na nzacha Bloom na-esote asịrị.
bmp.h1p4: Ọnụ ụzọ ndị ọzọ na-adọta blọb maka mailbox_ids ha na-eche banyere ya (ndị nnata na ọnụ ha).
bmp.h1p5: Ntuli aka nke ndị ahịa nnata `GET /bmp/messages' wee mebie blobs ọhụrụ ọ bụla site na iji ihe ọ na-emebu.
bmp.h2p1: Ọ dịghị ọnụ nwere ike ijikọ blob na onye na-ezipụ - njikọ TLS onye na-ezipụ na-achọpụta isi mmalite IP, mana yinye nke yabasị hops n'etiti onye na-ezipụ na nke mbụ BMP ọnụ na-ewepụkwa nke ahụ.
bmp.h2p2: Onye nnata-zobe: ezoro ezo blob na pubkey nke nnata. Ọnụ ụzọ etiti na-ahụ naanị eriri byte na-adịghị ahụkebe yana mailbox_id random.
bmp.h2p3: Ọnweghị nkwenye nnyefe nye onye ezipụ. Semantics kacha karịa otu ugboro.
bmp.h3p1: Ogo blob kacha: 1 MB. A ga-akụjisị ibu ugwo buru ibu site na ntinye faịlụ nkịtị.
bmp.h3p2: Oke nchekwa kwa ọnụ: 500 MB nke nkwụnye ego na mkpokọta. LRU nchụpụ na okpu. Ndị na-arụ ọrụ nwere ike ịmalite.
bmp.h3p3: Spam: kwa-IP ọnụego nkwụnye ego ejedebere na 10 / min. NJ igbe akwụkwọ ozi hụrụ ihe karịrị ugboro 3 / elekere n'otu ọnụ ọnụ nwere oke dị ka idei mmiri a na-enyo enyo.
bmp.h4p1: Ndị nnata mmachi dị elu: onye na-ezipụ agaghị achọ ịma ọnụ ụlọ onye nnata.
bmp.h4p2: Njikọta na-adịte aka: blobs chere ruo mgbe nnata ga-ejikọta ọzọ na ntuli aka.
bmp.h4p3: Ọfụfụ na-amaghị aha: yabasị n'akụkụ onye zitere + BMP = enweghị metadata na onye debere ihe.
bmp.h1_a: BMP bụ ụlọ ahịa na-aga n'ihu na-amaghị aha. Onye na-ezipụ ozi na-atụba ntụpọ n'ọnụ asịrị ọ bụla nwere ike; blọgụ ahụ na-echere na igbe ozi etinyere naanị igodo ọha nke nnata.
bmp.h1_b: Onye na-ezigara gbakọọ `mailbox_id = HKDF( nnata_pubkey, "bmp-v1", 32)`. Naanị onye maara 'nnata_pubkey' nwere ike ịgbakọ ya - onye nnata maara, onye zitere mara, onye nke atọ amaghị. Ziga POST `{mailbox_id, blob}` n'ọnụ asịrị ọ bụla. Node na-echekwa ụzọ abụọ ahụ ruo 7200 s (2 h), wee kwupụta mailbox_id na mgbanwe asịrị na-esote Bloom filter. Ọnụ ụzọ ndị ọzọ na-ahụ igbe ozi_id na mpaghara dabara na igbe ozi echekwara nke onye ọrụ na-adọta ntụpọ ahụ wee ziga onye ahịa ahụ.
bmp.h1_c: Ndị otu Vortex mere BMP site na ọkọ. Anyị wuru ya n'ihi na ọ nweghị onye ozi ọ bụla dị njikere imefu ego achọrọ iji zoo metadata njedebe na njedebe - ngwaahịa ọ bụla siri ike butere ọdịnaya nzuzo mana hapụ oghere nnyefe ahụ mepere emepe, yabụ sava ka mara onye gwara onye na mgbe. N'ime otu ahụ, anyị nọgidere na-ekwu "onye ozi echekwara nke na-agbapụta eserese mmekọrịta bụ naanị ọkara nchekwa." BMP bụ azịza anyị: onye na-ezipụ, onye nnata, na ọdịnaya niile na-aghọ ihe na-adịghị mma; Ọ dịghị otu ọnụ ọnụ na ntupu na-ejide iberibe zuru ezu iji wughachi mkparịta ụka. Ọ na-agafe akwa asịrị nke Vortex kama ịbụ akụrụngwa na-agbachi agbachi, nke mere ka ọnụ ahịa azụmaahịa bụrụ ihe ezi uche dị na ya na imewe ahụ nwere ike ịhụ ya n'ime ụlọ.
bmp.h1_f:
mailbox_id = HKDF(onye nnata_pubkey, info="bmp-v1", len=32)

Nkwụnye ego: POST /bmp/deposit {mailbox_id: 32B, blob: ≤1 MB}
Kpọsa: asịrị Bloom filter += mailbox_id
Bulite: GET /bmp/messages (auth'd) → blobs maka igbe ozi onye ọrụ_ids
TTL: 7200 s |  okpu nchekwa kwa ọnụ: 500 MB |  Ọnụ ego nkwụnye ego: 10/min/IP
bmp.h2_a: BMP na-enye ihe nzuzo atọ nwere onwe ha: izobe onye na-ezipụ, izobe onye nnata, izobe ọdịnaya.
bmp.h2_b: Onye na-ezipụ-ezo: TLS njikọ na ọnụ nkwụnye ego na-ekpughe isi iyi IP; ịgbakwụnye Tor hop ma ọ bụ yinye a ga-eji yabasị gafere na ọnụ ụzọ BMP nke mbụ na-ewepụ nke ahụ. Onye nnata-ezo: mailbox_id bụ hash nke nnata_pubkey nwere nnu nwere eriri ụdị BMP - oghere etiti na-ahụ njirimara 32-byte na-enweghị isi. Ọdịnaya-ezo: blob abanyela E2E-ezoro ezo maka onye nnata site na iji igodo nkịtị Vortex ọnụ ụlọ / DM, yabụ ọnụ etiti na-ahụ naanị ederede ciphertext.
bmp.h2_c: Nhazi nke ụlọ atọ bụ ka Pond siri kọwaa ebumnuche ya na 2014. Vortex nụchara ya site n'ime ka mailbox_id collision na-eguzogide (256-bit hash) yabụ ndị ọrụ abụọ enweghị njikọ enweghị ike ịkekọrịta igbe ozi na mberede. 7200-sekọnd TTL sitere na nleba anya na 95% nke ndị nnata na beta wetara n'ime awa 2; nchekwa ogologo ọnụ TTL nwere oke ọnụ na-enweghị uru nnyefe pụtara ìhè.
bmp.h2_f:
Onye iro na-ahụ steeti ọnụ:
  - mara na mailbox_id dị n'oge T
  - ọ mara onye zitere (bụ TLS/Tor hop pụọ)
  -ma NOT mara onye nnata (mailbox_id bụ hash otu ụzọ)
  - ọ maara ọdịnaya NOT (blob bụ E2E ezoro ezo)
bmp.h3_a: Oke siri ike na nha blob, nchekwa ọnụ ọnụ, yana ọnụego nkwụnye ego na-egbochi BMP ka ọ ghara ịbụ ihe nwụrụ anwụ maka data aka ike.
bmp.h3_b: Ogo blob kacha: 1 MB. Ibu ụgwọ buru ibu ga-agbaji site na sistemụ faịlụ nkịtị, nke nwere ụzọ nchekwa nke ya. Ebe nchekwa kacha n'otu ọnụ: 500 MB mkpokọta BMP nkwụnye ego. Mgbe erutere okpu ahụ, nchụpụ kacha ochie na-adaba tupu TTL - ndị ọrụ nwere ike ịhazigharị site na 'BMP_MAX_BYTES` env var. Ọnụ ego nkwụnye ego kwa IP: 10 kwa nkeji, iji guzogide iju mmiri sitere n'otu onye na-awakpo. NJ igbe akwụkwọ ozi hụrụ ihe karịrị ugboro 3 / elekere n'ofe netwọk nwere oke dị ka "atụmatụ idei mmiri a na-enyo enyo".
bmp.h3_c: Ihe 1 MB blob okpu dakọtara IRC DCC-eziga mgbakọ na okpu izipu akara nke Signal - zuru oke maka ozi dị mkpirikpi na obere mkpịsị aka, obere nke onye mwakpo enweghị ike iji BMP maka nnabata faịlụ. 500 MB kwa ọnụ ọnụ bụ OSS-ndabara ezi uche; nnukwu ndị ọrụ na-ebuli ya 'BMP_MAX_BYTES'. Oke ọnụego bịara ka v0.0.8 beta gasịrị ebe script ule onye nyocha juputara ọnụ iri ise na nkwụnye ego n'ime nkeji 20.
bmp.h3_f:
oke:
  BMP_BLOB_MAX_BYTES = 1_000_000 # 1 MB
  BMP_NODE_MAX_BYTES = 500_000_000 # 500 MB
  BMP_DEPOSIT_RATE = 10 # kwa nkeji kwa IP
  BMP_FLOOD_THRESHOLD = 3 # otu igbe ozi_id kwa elekere
bmp.h4_a: BMP na-enwu n'ọnọdụ atọ: ndị nnata nyocha dị elu, njikọta na-adịte aka, ịsa ahịhịa na-amaghị aha.
bmp.h4_b: Nnyocha dị elu: onye na-ezipụ amaghị ọnụ ụlọ onye nnata (ma eleghị anya ọ nweghị ike iru ya). Debe onye ọgbọ ọ bụla, hapụ ụzọ asịrị. Njikọta na-adịte aka: onye nnata na-anọghị n'ịntanetị ruo ọtụtụ awa; blob na-echere, ọnweghị nyochagharị achọrọ. Ọfụfụ na-amaghị aha: yabasị n'akụkụ onye zitere + BMP = enweghị metadata gbasara onye debere ihe. Ejikọtara ya na igodo ọnụ ụlọ mara naanị maka ndị nwere ntụkwasị obi, ọdịnaya ahụ adịghịkwa ezoro ezo nye onye ọ bụla.
bmp.h4_c: Ihe atọ a na-esochi mkpali akụkọ ihe mere eme maka ọdịda nwụrụ anwụ na nledo anụ ahụ (Soviet-era), maka 'alt.anonymous.messages' na Usenet (1990s), na maka SecureDrop (2013 na-aga n'ihu). BMP bụ mbọ anyị webata akụkọ ihe mere eme ahụ n'ime onye ozi ọgbara ọhụrụ na-achọghị ngwa ọrụ dị iche.

push.title: Pịa amamọkwa
push.subtitle: APNs, FCM, Weebụ Push - ha niile nwere envelopu mechiri emechi ka ndị na-eweta enweghị ike ịgụ ihe.
push.intro: Ọkọlọtọ ọrụ push (APNs, FCM, Weebụ Push) hụ ibu ụgwọ ọ bụla. Vortex na-ekekọta ọkwa ọ bụla na oyi akwa E2E dị iche ka onye na-eweta ya na-ahụ naanị oghere na-enweghị ntụpọ na-enweghị id ụlọ, onye na-ezipụ ma ọ bụ ederede.
push.h1p1: Onye ahịa na-enweta akara ngosi ikpo okwu (Token ngwaọrụ APN, ID ndebanye aha FCM, ma ọ bụ ndenye aha Push Weebụ JWT).
push.h1p2: Onye ahịa na-ewepụta igodo 32-byte X25519 ọhụrụ `p256dh_pub` yana ihe nzuzo 16-byte 'auth'. Posts `/api/push/subenye aha' na `{njedebe, p256dh, auth, ikpo okwu}`.
push.h1p3: Node na-aga n'ihu `push_subscriptions(user_id, endpoint, p256dh, auth, platform, created_na)`.
push.h2p1: Mgbe amara ruru (ozi ọhụrụ n'ime ụlọ emechiri emechi nke edobere ka ọ mara, kwuo, ịkpọ òkù), ọnụ na-eji AES-GCM ezoro ibu ọrụ ahụ site na iji igodo ewepụtara na `ECDH(p256dh_pub, ephemeral_priv)` site na HKDF.
push.h2p2: Ngwunye ọnụ `{njedebe, TTL, ngwa ngwa, isiokwu: <collapse_key>, data: <ciphertext>}` wee ziga na APNs / FCM / sava webụ Push.
push.h2p3: Onye na-eweta na-ahụ naanị 'data' (ciphertext) + 'isiokwu'. Ọnweghị mwepu ederede.
push.h3p1: Igodo isiokwu nke otu ọnụ ụlọ: `ọnụ ụlọ:<id>`. Otutu ozi n'otu ọnụ ụlọ dara n'otu ọkwa n'ogo OS.
push.h3p2: Isiokwu otu oku: `oku:<id>`. Ịza ma ọ bụ ịla azụ na-adọta ọkọlọtọ; oku ọhụrụ na-akpọ òkù n'otu ọnụ ụlọ dochie nke ochie.
push.h4p1: iOS: Mgbatị ọrụ ngosi decrypts na usoro NSE (iche na ngwa ngwa). Na-eji otu CryptoKit primitives.
push.h4p2: Android: FirebaseMessagingService na-ewepụ ihe nzuzo na ọrụ ndabere. JobScheduler na-ahazi mmelite UI n'ezie mgbe etinyere ngwa ngwa.
push.h4p3: Weebụ: Onye ọrụ ọrụ decrypts na ọnọdụ SW, biputere ọkwa mpaghara site na Ọkwa Weebụ API.
push.h5p1: APNs: na-achọ ka a na-enweta ume ọhụrụ kwa nkeji 60 ọ bụla. A na-emegharị ume ọhụrụ Token site na faịlụ igodo Apple's 'auth-team-id' + `auth-key-id` + p8.
push.h5p2: FCM: ihe nketa HTTP ebe njedebe kwụsịrị; anyị na-eji HTTP v1 njedebe nwere nzere akaụntụ ọrụ OAuth2. Na-atụgharị kwa elekere 1 ọ bụla.
push.h5p3: Weebụ Push: VAPID igodo (otu igodo n'otu ọnụ). TTL kpuchiri ụbọchị 28 site na ọtụtụ ihe nchọgharị.
push.h1_a: Onye ahịa na-edebanye aha ngwaọrụ (APNs/FCM/Web Push) yana igodo ọha X25519 ọhụrụ yana nzuzo nzuzo 16-byte.
push.h1_b: Onye ahịa na-ewepụta 'p256dh_priv = rand(32)' na 'auth = rand(16)'. Nweta `p256dh_pub = p256dh_priv · G`. POSTs `/api/push/subscribe` na `{njedebe, p256dh, auth, ikpo okwu, onye ọrụ_agent}`. Node na-aga n'ihu `push_subscriptions(user_id, endpoint, p256dh, auth, platform, created_na, last_refreshed_na)`. Ntughari: onye ahịa na-edebanye aha na mbido ngwa ọ bụla, nke na-enye ume 'ikpeazụ_frefresh_na'. A na-ehichapụ ndenye aha ndị karịrị ụbọchị 30.
push.h1_c: Oghere p256dh + auth sitere na Weebụ Push RFC 8291 (2017). Anyị jikwa ha ọzọ maka APN na FCM n'agbanyeghị na ọrụ ndị ahụ achọghị usoro ahụ emechiri emechi - ime nke a na-edobe otu ụzọ koodu gafee ha atọ. Tupu v0.0.5 Vortex ezipula ụgwọ ọrụ ederede doro anya site na ọrụ ntinye; mgbe nkwalite nzuzo Apple 2022 na-emelite na ihe omume dị iche ebe a na-ahazi FCM ngo ezighi ezi, anyị kpaliri ihe niile na envelopu mechiri emechi.
push.h1_f:
p256dh_priv = rand (32)
p256dh_pub = p256dh_priv · G // X25519
auth = rand (16)

POST /api/push/subscribe
  {njedebe, p256dh: hex(p256dh_pub), auth: hex(auth), ikpo okwu }
push.h2_a: Mgbe ọkwa ruru, ọnụ na-ezobe ibu a na-akwụ ụgwọ ka naanị ngwaọrụ onye nnata nwere ike ịgụ ya. Ọrụ ntinye (Apple / Google / Mozilla) na-ahụ naanị oghere na-adịghị mma.
push.h2_b: Node na-ahọrọ mkpịsị ugodi ephemeral X25519. Na-enweta 'ikm = ECDH(ephemeral_priv, p256dh_pub)'. Na-agba ọsọ HKDF(nnu =auth, ikm, info = "aesgcm", len=32) → igodo. Na-ezobe `{aha, ahụ, room_id, message_id}` ka CBOR → AES-GCM jiri igodo ewepụtara + 96-bit na-enweghị usoro. Na-eziga `{njedebe, TTL, ngwa ngwa, isiokwu: mkpọda_key, data: ciphertext, aes128gcm: {nnu, pub_ephemeral}}' na APNs/FCM/Web-Push. Ngwaọrụ na-anata, ndọtị / onye ọrụ ọrụ na-agba otu mwepu igodo n'ụzọ ọzọ, decrypts, gosi ọkwa.
push.h2_c: Mpempe akwụkwọ emechiri emechi bụ kpọmkwem Web Push Message spec spec sitere na 2017 (RFC 8291 + RFC 8188). Apple's 2022 iOS 16 nwelite agbakwunyere nkwado klaasị mbụ maka ndọtị ọrụ ngosi na-eme nkwubi okwu; Android akwadola ya site na ozi data FCM ruo ọtụtụ afọ. Vortex bụ otu n'ime ndị ozi ole na ole na-eji otu koodu arụ ọrụ zuru oke na nyiwe atọ niile - iOS na-eji 'NotificationServiceExtension', Android na-eji 'FirebaseMessagingService', Weebụ na-eji onye ọrụ ọrụ.
push.h2_f:
ephemeral_priv = rand(32);  ephemeral_pub = ephemeral_priv · G
ikm = ECDH(ephemeral_priv, p256dh_pub)
prk = HMAC-SHA256(auth, ikm)
igodo = HKDF-gbasawanye(prk, "Content-encoding: aes128gcm\x00", 16)
nonce= HKDF-gbasawanye(prk, "Content-encoding: nonce\x00", 12)
ct = AES-GCM-Encrypt (igodo, enweghị, ụgwọ akwụ ụgwọ)
zipu {njedebe, data: nnu∥record_size∥idlen∥ephemeral_pub∥ct}
push.h3_a: Igodo mebiri emebi na-egbochi ọtụtụ ọkwa sitere na otu nkata ịdokọ dị ka ọkọlọtọ n'otu n'otu - OS na-ejikọta ha n'otu.
push.h3_b: Ndakpọ n'otu ọnụ ụlọ: isiokwu = 'ọnụ ụlọ:<id>'. APN's 'apns-collapse-id' na FCM's 'collapse_key' na-agwa OS ka ọ were otu isiokwu dochie ọkwa mbụ. Onye ọrụ na-ahụ otu ọkọlọtọ kwa ọnụ ụlọ n'agbanyeghị ozi ole rutere. Ndakpọ oku kwa-otu: isiokwu = `oku:<id>'; oku ọhụrụ na-akpọ òkù n'otu ọnụ ụlọ dochie ndị gara aga. Otu okwu: isiokwu = 'kpọtụrụ: <onye ọrụ>: <ọnụ ụlọ>'; otu ọkọlọtọ aha maka ụzọ ọnụ ụlọ onye ọrụ.
push.h3_c: Agbakwunyere igodo ndakpọ na APNs na iOS 10 (2016) yana na FCM na 2014. Tupu nke ahụ, mgbawa ọtụtụ ozi na-emepụta stacks multi-banner nke ndị ọrụ kpọrọ asị n'otu n'otu. Telegram sụrụ ụzọ ọdịda otu ọnụ ụlọ UX na 2015; onye ozi ukwu ọ bụla sochiri ya. Nkewa nke Vortex n'ime ụlọ / oku / ịkpọ aha sitere na nzaghachi onye ọrụ na v0.0.6 beta na "oku ịkpọ oku na-anọchi ọkọlọtọ nkata" chere ezighi ezi - isiokwu dị iche iche doziri ya.
push.h3_f:
APNs: apns-collapse-id = ụlọ:42 → dochie ọkọlọtọ ndị bu ụzọ
FCM: collapse_key = oku:17 → dochie ọkọlọtọ ndị bu ụzọ
Weebụ: isiokwu = aha: u12: r5 → dochie ọkọlọtọ ndị bu ụzọ
push.h4_a: Nke ọ bụla n'elu ikpo okwu nwere ya gotchas. iOS chọrọ ndọtị ọrụ ngosi; Android chọrọ FCM ozi data; Weebụ chọrọ onye ọrụ ọrụ + VAPID.
push.h4_b: iOS: ngwugwu ngwa na-ebuga ebumnuche 'NotificationServiceExtension'. Sistemu na-ebufe ụgwọ ọrụ ezoro ezo na NSE; NSE nwere 30 s nke CPU + 25 MB nke ebe nchekwa iji mebie ma gbanwee ngosi tupu egosi ya. FCM: anyị na-eziga ozi 'data' (ọ bụghị' ngosi') yabụ ọrụ FirebaseMessaging nke ngwa ahụ na-aga na mbata - nke na-enye anyị ikike ịchịkwa ma anyị ga-egosi ọkọlọtọ. Weebụ Push: onye ọrụ na-egbochi mmemme 'push', decrypts, egosi site na'self.registration.showNotification'.
push.h4_c: Ewebatara ụkpụrụ NSE site na Apple na iOS 10 (2016) kpọmkwem maka ikpe iji decryption ozi. Tupu nke ahụ, ndị ozi ezoro ezo na ngwụcha ruo na ngwụcha ga-ahọrọ n'etiti ụgwọ ịkwụ ụgwọ ederede doro anya (nzuzo-onye iro) na naanị akara bajị (UX- iro). WhatsApp, Signal, Telegram niile wulitere na NSE n'ime otu afọ. Vortex na-agbaso otu ụkpụrụ ahụ.
push.h5_a: quirks kpọmkwem onye na-enye - akụkụ nke isi ihe ntinye. Nke a bụ otu n'ime isi usoro a na-ezo aka n'oge ntụaka Vortex. Gụọ isiakwụkwọ gbara ya gburugburu maka nkọwa sara mbara; ngalaba a na-abanye n'ime akparamagwa a kapịrị ọnụ.
push.h5_b: Ntụle mmejuputa maka "quirks akọwapụtara nke onye na-eweta". A na-emejuputa usoro a na modul kwekọrọ n'okpuru 'app/', `ios/Modules/sources/', ma ọ bụ 'android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/'. Modul README na-akpọpụta ụzọ faịlụ ziri ezi.
push.h5_c: Usoro nke "ndị na-enye ndị na-enye nkọwa" malitere n'ofe Vortex ewepụtara. Nhazi ahụ na-esochi nyocha na omume mmepụta nke ndị ozi mbụ bipụtara. Akụkọ ụdị dị na ndekọ `CHANGELOG.md` mgbe ibe ọ bụla rutere na ihe kpaliri ya.

controller.title: Ọrụ njikwa
controller.subtitle: Ngosipụta iguzosi ike n'ezi ihe, nchọpụta ntinye, nlekota ahụike.
controller.intro: Onye njikwa bụ usoro Python dị iche. Mwakpo ya dị ntakịrị (ihe dị ka ụzọ iri na abụọ) na ntụkwasị obi ya dabere na otu igodo ọha Ed25519 etinyere na ndị ahịa.
controller.h1p1: `GET /v1/iguzosi ike n'ezi ihe' - nsonaazụ akaebe. Nhazi: `{ọnọdụ, bịanyere aka na ya_by, trusted_pubkey, ụdị, wuru_at, dakọtara, ekwekọghị, efu, mgbakwunye, ozi}`.
controller.h1p2: `GET /v1/health` — ịdị ndụ. Schema: `{status: "ok", version, pubkey, stats:{online, kwadoro, mkpokọta}}'.
controller.h1p5: `GET /v1/trusted_nodes' - ndị ọgbọ nwere njikọ ama ama.
controller.h1p6: `GET /v1/heartbeat/{pubkey}` — node liveness probe. Eji ọnụ ọnụ ndị jikọtara ọnụ mee ka ndebanye aha ha dị ọhụrụ.
controller.h1p7: `POST /v1/register` — ọnụ ọhụrụ na-emetụta maka ntụkwasị obi. Achọrọ nkwado nchịkwa belụsọ 'AUTO_APPROVE=ezi'.
controller.h2p1: Faịlụ pụtara: `INTEGRITY.sig.json`. Nwere otu faịlụ BLAKE3 hash + Ed25519 mbinye aka.
controller.h2p2: Ọgbọ: `python -m vortex_controller.integrity.sign_tool`. Ọ na-agụ igodo ntọhapụ na 'keys/release.key', na-aga n'osisi, dee ihe ngosi.
controller.h2p3: Nkwenye: onye njikwa na-agụ ihe ngosi na mmalite ma tụnyere diski. Mmalite na-ada ụda nke ukwuu na ndakọrịta.
controller.h3p1: Igwefoto na-eji otu koodu njikwa na-eji otu igodo ntọhapụ depụtaghachiri ya. Ndị ahịa na-ahụ ihe 'binyere aka_site' n'ofe enyo - otu ụzọ isi achọpụta enyo adịgboroja bụ ịtụle igodo mmanya.
controller.h3p2: DNSLink / SNS / IPFS na-ebipụta ntụnye aka n'otu n'ime enyo dị iche iche. Ndị ahịa na-agbalị n'usoro nke mbụ na oge nkwụsị.
controller.h3p3: Akwụkwọ ndekọ 'vortex.sol-mirror/` dị na repo a bụ enyo trycloudflare dị njikere ịga maka mmepe.
controller.h1_a: Ọhaneze API njikwa bụ ihe dịka ụzọ iri na abụọ. Ha niile dị obere, ha niile lekwasịrị anya na akaebe na ntinye - URL nchọpụta.
