controller.h1_b: `/v1/iguzosi ike n'ezi ihe' - akaebe pụtara ìhè bịanyere aka na ya. `/v1/ahụ ike` — ndụ + pubkey + stats. `/v1/ntinye' - URL ntinye maka njikọ. `/ v1/enyo' - ndị na-ahụ maka enyo. `/v1/nodes_trusted_nodes' - ndị ọgbọ otu. `/v1/heartbeat/{pubkey}` - nyocha ndụ node. `/v1/ndebanye aha' - ọnụ ọhụrụ na-emetụta maka ntụkwasị obi (nkwado onye nchịkwa belụsọ 'AUTO_APPROVE=ezi'). Nke ahụ bụ ya - kpachaara anya dị warara iji mee ka elu ọgụ dị ntakịrị.
controller.h1_c: A na-eme ka nhazi ahụ dị warara dị warara site na nleba anya na usoro ịgba akaebe na-aghọ ihe mgbaru ọsọ kachasị elu mgbe ndị ahịa tụbara ya. Obere koodu = obere elu. Tụnyere ọnụ ọnụ nke nwere ụzọ 120+; Onye njikwa ahụ nwere 12. Usoro yiri nke a: Debian's apt-get tụkwasịrị obere usoro 'Release.gpg' dị iche na nchịkọta ngwugwu.
controller.h2_a: `python -m vortex_controller.integrity.sign_tool` na-aga n'osisi isi iyi, kpochaa faịlụ ọ bụla, jiri igodo mwepụta akara, dee `INTEGRITY.sig.json'.
controller.h2_b: Ngwá ọrụ na-agụ `igodo/release.key` (igodo nzuzo 32-byte Ed25519). Na-eje ije `vortex_controller/` + `app/` (wepụrụ faịlụ ndị ewepụghị). Maka faịlụ ọ bụla: `blake3(ọdịnaya) → hash`. Na-ewulite '{ụdị, wuru_at, faịlụ: [{ụzọ, sha256, nha}]}'. Na-agbakọ `canonical_bytes = CBOR(gosiri)`. Akara: `sig = Ed25519-Akara (igodo mwepụta, canonical_bytes)`. Na-ede `INTEGRITY.sig.json = {gosipụta, bịanyere aka na ya: pubkey, sig}`.
controller.h2_c: Ngosipụta mbinye aka laghachi na Ntọhapụ Debian.gpg (1997) na Linux kernel tarballs bịanyere aka na PGP. Sigstore (2021) kpochara ihe nlere anya maka ịgba akaebe nnyenye. Ụdị Vortex dị fechaa karịa n'ihi na ọ na-egosi otu mbugharị, ọ bụghị agbụ mwepụta ọtụtụ otu. Anyị nwere ike were Sigstore na v0.4 maka mwepụta ọha.
controller.h3_a: Igwefoto na-eji otu igodo ntọhapụ na-agba otu koodu njikwa. Ntinye otutu DNS / SNS / IPFS ndenye na-arụtụ aka n'otu n'ime enyo dị iche iche.
controller.h3_b: Ndị na-arụ ọrụ na-edozi enyo N (ọ na-abụkarị 3-5). Onye ọ bụla na-eji otu koodu 'vortex_controller' nwere otu igodo 'igodo/release.i'. Ndị ahịa na-ahụ 'binyere aka_site' n'ofe enyo - ezigbo nlele ahụike. DNS/SNS/IPFS ndekọ ndekọ enyo nwere ihe ndị ka mkpa. Ndị ahịa na-agbalị n'usoro nke mbụ, na-enwe oge nkwụsị nke sekọnd 7 kwa mgbalị ọ bụla. Akwụkwọ ndekọ aha `vortex.sol-mirror/` dị na repo a bụ ihe atụ enyo enyo enyo enyo tupu mgbe ahụ.
controller.h3_c: Otutu enyo nwere nlebanya kacha mkpa bụ otu ụkpụrụ SMTP eji maka ndekọ MX na HTTPS eji maka ndekọ SRV. Ndị isi ndekọ aha Tor bụ ihe nlere metụtara — 9 hardcoded DAs + votes. Vortex họrọ "họrọ enyo nke na-arụ ọrụ" karịa " quorum votu " n'ihi na atụmatụ ndị dabere na votu na-enwe ike nkwụsi ike mana ọ na-eji nwayọọ nwayọọ na-akpụ akpụ.
controller.h1_f:
/v1/iguzosi ike n'ezi ihe: GET → nsonaazụ akaebe
/v1/ahụ ike: GET → {ọnọdụ, ụdị, pubkey, stats}
/v1/ntinye: GET → [{protocol, url}, ...]
/v1/ mirror: GET → [controller_url, ...]
/v1/trusted_nodes: GET → [{pubkey, endpoint, health}, ...]

storage.title: oyi akwa nchekwa
storage.subtitle: SQLite maka dev, Postgres maka prod, Alembic maka mbugharị, GRDB/Ụlọ/IndexedDB na ndị ahịa.
storage.intro: Ebe nchekwa ọnụ Vortex bụ SQL. Ịgbanwe n'etiti SQLite (dev) na Postgres (prod) bụ mgbanwe DATABASE_URL - enweghị ndụdụ koodu.
storage.h1p1: `users( id, username, password_hash, x25519_public_key, kyber_public_key?, display_name, avatar_url, phone, email, created_at, is_active)` — isi tebụl njirimara.
storage.h1p2: `user_Devices(id, user_id, device_id, user_agent, last_seen_at, devoked_at)` — ahịrị nnọkọ otu ngwaọrụ.
storage.h1p3: `rooms( id, ụdị, aha, bụ_private, is_channel, is_dm, member_count, avatar_url, created_at, created_by, description)` — tebụl ọnụ ụlọ, otu ahịrị kwa ọnụ ụlọ.
storage.h1p4: `Ndị otu_ọnụ ụlọ(ọnụ ụlọ_id, onye ọrụ_id, ọrụ, sonyere_na, ogbi ruo mgbe)` — otu + ACL.
storage.h1p5: `Ozi( id, room_id, sender_id, ciphertext, nonce, sender_pseudo, sent_at, edited_at?, deleted_at?, zaghachi?, thread_id?, ụdị)` — ozi ọ bụla, indexed na `(room_id, id)`.
storage.h1p6: 'mmeghachi omume(ozi_id, user_id, emoji, kere_at)` — isi ihe mejupụtara `(ozi_id, user_id, emoji)`.
storage.h1p7: 'faịlụ( id, user_id, mime_type, size, sha256 /* n'ezie BLAKE3 */, ebe nchekwa_ụzọ, uploaded_at)` — metadata faịlụ.
storage.h1p8: `read_receipts(room_id, user_id, message_id, read_at)` — ntụnye ọgụgụ kacha ọhụrụ maka onye ọrụ kwa ọnụ ụlọ.
storage.h1p9: 'ọnụnọ (onye ọrụ_id, ikpeazụ_hụrụ na, bụ_ịpị_n'ime_room_id?)` — ephemeral, Redis-backed in prod.
storage.h1p10: 'federations(keykey pub, endpoint, health_score, added_at, added_by, devorated_at)' - ndepụta ndị ọgbọ.
storage.h1p11: `box outbox( id, target_node, ugwo, mbọ, next_retry_at)` — kwụ n'ahịrị na-apụ apụ.
storage.h1p12: `Ozi_ahaziri(id, room_id, ciphertext, nonce, send_at, kere_site, kere_na, kagbuo_na)`.
storage.h1p13: 'kọntaktị (user_id, contact_user_id, aha njirimara, tinye_na)` - akwụkwọ adreesị.
storage.h1p14: 'echekwara_gif (onye ọrụ_id, url, obosara, ịdị elu, agbakwunyere_na)' - mkpokọta onye ọrụ GIF.
storage.h1p15: 'folda (user_id, id, aha, room_ids, is_system, created_at)' - nchekwa nkata.
storage.h1p16: `bot_installations(user_id, bot_id,install_at)` — wụnye bot nke onye ọ bụla.
storage.h1p17: 'Nnọkọ (jti, user_id, device_id, expires_at)' - ndebanye aha akara ume ọhụrụ.
storage.h1p18: `Push_subscriptions(onye ọrụ_id, njedebe njedebe, p256dh, auth, ikpo okwu, kere_na)` - ndebanye aha.
storage.h2p1: Alembic na `alembic/ụdị/`. Akụkọ ihe mere eme nke ahịrị, otu ngbanwe kwa ntọhapụ (mgbe ụfọdụ ole na ole kwa ntọhapụ).
storage.h2p2: Ụdị mmepụta: 'mepụta_niile + ALTER TABLE ọdịda' maka mmegharị ngwa ngwa.
storage.h2p3: Ụdị Prod: 'isi nkwalite alembic' tupu mmalite. Ihe onyonyo docker na-agba ya na ebe ntinye.
storage.h3p1: `ozi(ime ụlọ_id, id DESC)` — isi ndeksi maka mbute paginated.
storage.h3p2: `Ozi(ime ụlọ_id, ezitere_na DESC)` - maka ịtụ oge dabere na ndezi.
storage.h3p3: 'mmeghachi omume(ozi_id)' - maka nchịkọta na ime ụlọ mepere emepe.
storage.h3p5: `ngwaọrụ_onye ọrụ(user_id)` - maka ịdepụta ngwaọrụ nọ n'ọrụ.
storage.h3p6: FTS tebụl mebere (FTS5 SQLite / tsvector Postgres) maka ịchọ ederede zuru oke.
storage.h4p1: 'mee db-ndabere' na-ewepụta ebe nchekwa oge nwere akara. Eji igodo onye ọrụ ezoro ya na izu ike.
storage.h4p2: Njide: kwa ụbọchị maka ụbọchị iri na anọ, kwa izu maka izu anọ, kwa ọnwa maka ọnwa iri na abụọ.
storage.h4p3: Mweghachi: `mee db-restor FILE=<ụzọ>'. Na-agba ọsọ n'ọgba egwuregwu DB mbụ; Onye ọrụ na-enyocha ma gbanwee.
storage.h1_a: Nchekwa ọnụ bụ SQL. SQLite maka dev na obere onye kwadoro onwe ya; PostgreSQL maka mmepụta nke jikọtara ọnụ ma ọ bụ ọtụtụ ọnụ. Otu SQLAlchemy 2.x async code na-anya abụọ.
storage.h1_b: Hazie site na `DATABASE_URL=sqlite+aiosqlite:///vortex.db` ma ọ bụ `postgresql+asyncpg://user:pw@host/db`. Otu nhazi, enweghị koodu ndụdụ. SQLite na-agba ọsọ na-arụ ọrụ; Postgres na-agba iche iche. Arụmọrụ: SQLite na-eji ~ 50 ndị ọrụ na-emekọ ihe ọnụ na M1; Postgres ruru puku kwuru puku. Mbugharị Postgres → SQLite bụ otu ụzọ site na `pg_dump --data-only` + SQLite mbubata; uzo ozo bu otu.
storage.h1_c: Ụkpụrụ "otu ORM, abụọ azụ azụ" bụ omume SQLAlchemy afọ iri. Vortex na-eji async 2.x API yabụ ajụjụ ọ bụla na-echere. Anyị ahọrọla SQLAlchemy Core n'elu Django ORM / Mbe ORM / raw `asyncpg` maka akụkọ ọpụpụ ka ukwuu yana egwuregwu ahụ nwere akpaala okwu async nke FastAPI.
storage.h2_a: Tebụl isi 18: ndị ọrụ, ngwaọrụ_ọrụ, ụlọ, ụlọ_members, ozi, mmeghachi omume, faịlụ, receipts, ọnụnọ, federations, federation_outbox, ndokwa_messages, kọntaktị, echekwara_gifs, nchekwa, bot_installations, sessions, push_subscriptions.
storage.h2_b: Tebụl ndị ọrụ bụ mgbọrọgwụ njirimara. room_members na-ejide (ọnụ ụlọ, onye ọrụ, ọrụ, join_at, muted_ruo mgbe). ozi na-ebu ciphertext + metadata; indexed na (room_id, id) maka iweta paginated. mmeghachi omume bụ ngwakọta-isi-isi tebụl. Ihe ọ bụla ọzọ kwụ ọtọ. Nchekwa na-eto n'ahịrị na ọnụ ọgụgụ ozi - ihe dị ka 1 KB kwa ozi na diski mgbe index gafechara.
storage.h2_c: Atụmatụ ahụ kwụsiri ike mgbe v0.0.4. Na mbụ, anyị nwere tebụl `dm_messages' na 'ozi otu' dị iche iche; jikọtara na v0.0.3 ka emechara koodu fanout n'ofe abụọ ahụ. Tebụl iri na asatọ bụ opekempe maka njirimara-ozi zuru oke; nnukwu mbugharị na-agbakwunye tebụl nyocha mana nke ahụ adịghị mkpa maka ịrụ ọrụ.
storage.h3_a: Alembic na-achịkwa mbugharị. Akụkọ ngbanwe Linear, otu nlegharị anya kwa ntọhapụ. Ndozigharị ọ bụla nwere ọrụ 'mmelite()' na 'downgrade()'.
storage.h3_b: 'alembic/ụdị/' na-ejide nlegharị anya. Nke ọ bụla bụ faịlụ Python nwere nkwalite/mbelata. CI na-agba 'alembic upgrade head' + `alembic downgrade -1` + `alimbic upgrade head` iji nyochaa njem okirikiri. Mmepụta: 'mee db-migrate' na-eme na ntinye Docker tupu ebido ngwa. Ọnọdụ Dev na-eji `create_all + ALTER TABLE fallback` yabụ nrụgharị na-adị ngwa ngwa na-achọghị mbugharị na ntọala ọ bụla.
storage.h3_c: Alembic (Michael Bayer, 2011) bụ ngwa ọrụ Mbugharị SQLAlchemy nke canonical. Linear akụkọ ihe mere eme (abụghị alaka) bụ nhọrọ - ọ na-ezere nsogbu "ndị mmepe abụọ na-emepụta otu nọmba nlegharị anya". Mbugharị nke Django na-eji otu ụzọ ahụ. Ụgbọ okporo ígwè si n'ahịrị gaa n'ụdị oge na 2014 mana anabataghachiri linear-na-jikota na 2020.
storage.h4_a: A na-eji nlezianya na-ahọrọ ndepụta ntụaka ka ọ na-ekpo ọkụ (ozi, mmeghachi omume, akwụkwọ nnata agụ) kụrụ diski adịkarịghị.
storage.h4_b: `Ozi(ime ụlọ_id, id DESC)` — isi nrịbama index. `Ozi(ime ụlọ_id, ezitere_na DESC)` - ndaghachi azụ nke oge nyere iwu maka ndezi. 'mmeghachi omume(ozi_id)' - nchịkọta na ime ụlọ mepere emepe. 'agụ_receipts(room_id, message_id)` — “hụrụ site N” ọnụ. `ngwaọrụ_onye ọrụ(user_id)` — ndepụta ngwaọrụ. FTS tebụl mebere maka ọchụchọ (FTS5 na SQLite, tsvector na Postgres).
storage.h4_c: Nhọrọ ndeksi sitere na nkọwa nkọwa-atụmatụ n'oge ule ibu v0.0.4. Anyị malitere site na ntụnye efu wee gbakwunye/wepụ dabere na usoro ajụjụ ahụrụ. 'Ozi(ime ụlọ_id, id DESC)' bụ otu ndepụta kacha ewu ewu - ihe dị ka 80% nke ndị agụpụtara kụrụ ya. Idobe ya warara (enweghị agụnye ogidi) na-ahapụ ya ka ọ dabara na ebe nchekwa.

bots.title: Bot kpuchie
bots.subtitle: Gravitix DSL + Python SDK + ahịa + mgbochi spam.
bots.intro: Bots bụ ndị sonyere ime ụlọ nke mbụ. Eji igodo bot Ed25519 bịanyere aka na ozi ka a na-achọpụta ụgha.
bots.h1p1: Nhọrọ abụọ: Python SDK ma ọ bụ Gravitix DSL. Python bụ maka usoro ọrụ siri ike; Gravitix maka bots nkata na-eme ihe omume chọrọ ibupu ngwa ngwa.
bots.h1p2:
Python ọmụmaatụ: `site na vortex_bot mbubata Bot
bot = Bot(token=...)
@bot.on_message
async def echo(msg): chere bot.send(msg.room_id, msg.text)
bot.run()`. Ihe eji SDK WebSocket, njikọta, mgbanwe igodo nzuzo.
bots.h1p3: Gravitix ọmụmaatụ: `na / malite { emit "Ndewo, {ctx.first_name}!" }'. Na-achịkọta na bytecode ma na-agba ọsọ na ntụgharị okwu nwere igbe ájá.
bots.h1p4: A na-enye akara bot na okike bot. Ihe akara efu? `POST /api/bots/{id}/rotate-token' weputara nke ohuru.
bots.h2p1: Ụdị mbugharị abụọ: na-arụ ọrụ (coroutine n'ime ọnụ ọnụ) na mpụga (bot polls `/api/bots/{id}/updates`).
bots.h2p2: Na-arụ ọrụ: netwọk hop efu, kacha ọsọ, mana onye ọrụ ga-atụkwasịrịrị koodu bot. ⟪0 dị mma maka bots nke ya.
bots.h2p3: Mpụga: webhook ma ọ bụ ogologo ntuli aka. Ọnweghị ntụkwasị obi ọkwa ọkwa dị mkpa. Good maka bots ndị ọzọ na ebe ahịa.
bots.h2p4: Bots Gravitix bots na-agba ọsọ mgbe niile n'ime igbe igbe - ha enweghị sistemụ faịlụ ma ọ bụ ohere netwọkụ ma ewezuga API doro anya.
bots.h3p1: Bots ọha nwere ike nyefee n'ahịa ahịa. Ndị nyocha na-achọpụta na koodu anaghị phish, anaghị eme spam, anaghị ewepu data onye ọrụ.
bots.h3p2: Otu: nrụpụta, egwuregwu, akụkọ, akụrụngwa, ai, ntụgharị asụsụ.
bots.h3p3: Wụnye: otu pịa. Node na-edebanye aha onye ọrụ na aha njirimara bot ka DM wee gaa nke ọma.
bots.h3p4: Ị nweta ego: n'efu, ịzụrụ otu oge, ndenye aha. Ụgwọ ikpo okwu 10% nke mkpokọta.
bots.h4p1: A na-enyocha ụlọ ọ bụla site na bot antispam na-adịghị ahụ anya. Nyochaa: njupụta njikọ> 3 kwa nkeji, oke mkpụrụedemede-70% maka chars 10+, kwugharịa ozi, mgbawa mberede nke ndị sonyere akaụntụ ọhụrụ.
bots.h4p2: Omume: dọọ aka ná ntị → nkwụsịtụ (Nkeji 5) → igba → mmachibido iwu. Mkpegharị na-aga onye nchịkwa ụlọ.
bots.h4p3: A na-emegharị kwa ọnụ ụlọ site na nhazi bot.
bots.h1_a: Bots bụ ndị sonyere ime ụlọ nke mbụ. Nke ọ bụla nwere igodo Ed25519 na akara; A na-edenye aka na ozi ọ bụla ha na-eziga, ya mere, a na-achọpụta ụgha.
bots.h1_b: Mepụta: onye nwe POST `/api/bots` nwere `{username, display_name, code}`. Node na-emepụta ahịrị ndị ọrụ na 'is_bot=eziokwu', na-ewepụta igodo Ed25519, weghachi onye nwe akara igodo igodo nzuzo (gosiri otu ugboro). Gbaa ọsọ: bot ma na-ebi n'ime usoro dị ka corutine ma ọ bụ ntuli aka mpụga `/api/bots/{id}/updates' na akara ya. Ozi sitere na bots bu ọkọlọtọ `from_bot: ezi` ma ejiri igodo nzuzo binye aka.
bots.h1_c: Bot API bụ Slack (2014) sụrụ ụzọ wee nụchaa site na Telegram (2015). Ntugharị nke Vortex: mbinye aka bot na-ejikọta ozi na njirimara bot, yabụ ọnụ na-emebi emebi enweghị ike imepụta "@bot kwuru X". Nkwado bot nke Matrix gbakwunyere ihe onwunwe a na 2021 site na mbinye aka agbakwunyere; Vortex nwere ya kemgbe v0.0.5.
bots.h2_a: Gravitix bụ asụsụ akọwapụtara ngalaba maka ide bots na-ebute mmemme. Obere, na-egosipụta, achịkọtara na bytecode nwere igbe ájá.
bots.h2_b: Syntax: `na / malite { emit "Ndewo, {ctx.first_name}!" }'. Ndị na-ahụ maka njikwa na-ejikọta na ihe mkpali (iwu, regex, emume). Ahụ bụ usoro 'emit', 'ka', 'if', 'schedule', wdg. Ndị nchịkọta na-ewepụta bytecode; Oge ịgba ọsọ na-atụgharị n'ime igbe ájá na-enweghị sistemụ faịlụ, enweghị netwọk aka ike, naanị Vortex's API. Ntụaka zuru oke na isi akwụkwọ Gravitix.
bots.h2_c: Emebere Gravitix n'oge v0.0.6 mgbe ọ hụchara na ọtụtụ koodu bot bụ 80% ji esi mmiri ọkụ were waya VortexSDK, yana kernel nke ezi uche dị n'etiti. A DSL na-ahapụ echiche ahụ ka ọ na-enwu ma gbochie ịsa shọvel aka ike Python n'ime bot-dev gburugburu ebe enwere ike ịgbapụ igbe ájá.
bots.h3_a: Ime ụlọ ọ bụla nwere bot antispam na-adịghị ahụ anya nke na-ekiri idei mmiri, njikọ spam, ozi ugboro ugboro, na njikọ akaụntụ ọhụrụ.
bots.h3_b: Iwu: njikọ njupụta> 3 kwa nkeji site na otu onye ọrụ, ALL-CAPS ratio> 70% na ozi ≥ 10 chars, ozi ikwugharị> ugboro 3 na 30 s, gbawara nke joiners na akaụntụ afọ <24 h> 20 na 60 s. Omume na-abawanye: ịdọ aka ná ntị → Oge nkwụsị nkeji 5 → ịgbatị elekere 1 → mmachibido iwu (nkwado nchịkwa maka mmachibido iwu). A na-emegharị kwa ọnụ ụlọ site na '/ antispam config'.
bots.h3_c: Antispam heuristics sitere na njikọ nke iwu bot IRC-era (Eggdrop, BitchX) yana sistemụ ọgbara ọhụrụ dị ka Discord AutoMod. Edebere ọnụ ụzọ ndị akọwapụtara na Vortex megidere beta corpus nke ọnwa isii nke ozi 200k; Ọnụego ziri ezi ụgha bụ ~ 0.3% kwa ọnụego mkpesa mmachibido iwu a hụrụ.
bots.h4_a: Bots ọha na-edo onwe ha n'ahịa. Ndị nyocha na-achọpụta na ọ nweghị phishing / enweghị spam / enweghị mgbapu data. Ndị ọrụ na-eji otu ọpịpị chọgharịa site na udi wee wụnye ya.
bots.h4_b: Nrubeisi: onye nwe biputere isi mmalite bot + nkọwa. Onye nleba anya na-agba koodu ahụ n'ime igbe ájá, gụọ ya maka ụkpụrụ mgbochi amaara, lelee oku netwọk ọ bụla na-aga site na API ndị ekwenyere, na-enyocha amụma nzuzo. Ndepụta: Atiya, ọnụahịa, ọkwa, ọnụọgụ wụnye. Wụnye: `POST /api/bots/{id}/install` - ọnụ na-emepụta ndenye aha onye ọ bụla. Ị nweta ego: n'efu / otu oge / ndebanye aha; ikpo okwu na-ewe 10%.
bots.h4_c: Ebe ahịa ngwa na-alaghachi na 2008 App Store. Akwụkwọ ndekọ aha ngwa Slack (2015), Ndepụta Discord Bot (2017), Telegram Bot Store (2024). Mbelata Vortex 10% dị ala karịa Apple's 30% ma dịtụ ala karịa nke Shopify's 20 %, ahọpụtara iji kpalie ndị mmepe bipụta. Edebere ụkpụrụ ntụlegharị ahụ na "nyocha na ndabara, delist na mkpesa" nke GitLab.
bots.h3_f:
ihe na-akpalite:
  link_density> 3/min → dọrọ aka ná ntị
  all_caps_ratio> 0.7 (≥10c) → dọrọ aka ná ntị
  repeat_count> 3 na 30s → dọrọ aka ná ntị
  new_joiner_burst> 20 na 60s → mkpọchi ụlọ

mmụba:
  2 ịdọ aka ná ntị → 5 nkeji oge agwụla
  3 ịdọ aka ná ntị → 1 h igba
  4 ịdọ aka ná ntị → mmachibido iwu (onye nchịkwa kwadoro)
bots.h4_f:
edemede: nrụpụta, egwuregwu, akụkọ, akụrụngwa, ai, ntụgharị asụsụ
ọnụahịa: free | otu oge (USD ego) | ndenye aha (USD/ọnwa)
ịkpụ: 90% nye onye nrụpụta, 10% ruo Vortex
nyochaa: akwụkwọ ntuziaka, ~ 3 ụbọchị azụmahịa lekwasịrị anya ntụgharị

ops.title: Ọrụ
ops.subtitle: Bugharịa, nyochaa, nlọghachi azụ.
ops.intro: Ọrụ ọ bụla na-arụ ọrụ nwere ebumnuche 'mere' ma ọ bụ iwu CLI. Ibe ops bi na 'ebuga/'.
ops.h1p1: 'docker compose up' na-ewelite ọnụ, onye njikwa, Postgres, Redis, coturn, Caddy.
ops.h1p2: Mpịakọta: `/data/vortex.db`, ​​`/data/ebugote`, `/data/logs`. Ugwu ga-anabata maka nnọgidesi ike.
ops.h1p3: Environment: `.env' na mgbọrọgwụ repo. Ekwela nkwa. `.env.eample' bụ ndebiri.
ops.h1p4: Caddy auto-fetches Let's Encrypt asambodo. A na-etinye oke ọnụego Let's Encrypt - jiri nhazi maka nnwale.
ops.h2p1: 'mere install' - wụnye Python deps + ngwaọrụ dev.
ops.h2p2: 'mere dev' - uvicorn nwere ibugharị na ọdụ ụgbọ mmiri 9000.
ops.h2p4: 'mee lint' - ruff + mypy. CI ngọngọ na ọdịda.
ops.h2p5: 'mee docker-build' - wuo ihe onyonyo nke akpọrọ `vortex:<VERSION>'.
ops.h2p8: `make ci` — gbapụta pipeline CI zuru ezu na mpaghara.
ops.h3p1: `Vortex Wizard.app` bụ ngwugwu PyInstaller nwere ihe nlele pyweb GUI.
ops.h3p2: Na-agba ọsọ nke mbụ: họrọ aha ọnụ → mepụta igodo ntọhapụ → hazie TLS (Let's Encrypt / weta-nke gị / nke aka gị bịanyere aka na ya) → họrọ URL ntinye → mee ka stealth → mepee ọdụ ụgbọ mmiri firewall.
ops.h3p3: Mgbe ịtọlitechara, ọkachamara na-anọ dị ka njikwa njikwa: mmalite/kwụsị ọnụ ọnụ, lelee ndekọ, igodo tụgharịa, tinye ndị ọgbọ jikọtara ọnụ.
ops.h4p1: Akpadoro mwepụta ọ bụla na git. Mkpado nyekwara igodo ntọhapụ bịanye aka na ya ka enwere ike ikwenye mkpado ahụ n'onwe ya.
ops.h4p2: Rollback: `git checkout <tag> && mee docker-build && docker compose up -d`. Ọnụ ụzọ na-agba ọsọ na-agbapụ ma malitegharịa.
ops.h4p3: DB: Alembic `downgrade <rev>` kwadoro maka otu obere ụdị azụ. Azụ ọzọ chọrọ enyemaka aka.
ops.h1_a: 'docker compose up' na-ewepụta nchịkọta Vortex zuru ezu: ọnụ, onye njikwa, Postgres, Redis, coturn, Caddy.
ops.h1_b: 'docker-compose.yml' na mgbọrọgwụ repo. Mpịakọta `/data/vortex.db`, ​​`/data/ebugote`, `/data/logs` kwadoro ka ọ nọrọ n'ụlọ ka data na-aga n'ihu n'ofe mmalite. Nyocha ahụike: ọnụ ahụ dị mma ma ọ bụrụ na ''/ahụ ike/njikere' laghachi 200; onye njikwa iff `/v1/iguzosi ike n'ezi ihe gaghachigoro nkwenye. Caddy auto-fetches Let's Encrypt asambodo. `.env` na-enye ihe nzuzo (anaghị eme). `.env.eample' bụ ndebiri.
ops.h1_c: Docker Compose bụ ụkpụrụ de-facto maka ọrụ ejiri ọtụtụ akpa akpa. Umami, Ghost, Plausible, Miniflux niile na-eji ya. Vortex's dere faịlụ ka emebere site na v0.0.2 gawa; Ụdị dị ugbu a kwụsiri ike na v0.0.5. A hapụrụ ndị ọzọ (k8s, nomad) dị ka mmega ahụ maka nnukwu ndị ọrụ.
ops.h2_a: Makefile bụ ebe ntinye etiti maka mmemme dev na ops ọ bụla. 'Mee enyemaka' ndepụta ebumnuche.
ops.h2_b: `mere install` → `pip install -r needs.txt`. 'mee dev` → uvicorn nwere ibugharị. `eme ule` → pytest + mkpuchi, wepụta `cover.xml`. 'mee lint' → ruff + mypy. `mee docker-build` → `docker build -t vortex:$VERSION`. 'mee db-migrate' → 'isi nkwalite alembic'. 'mee db-ndabere' / `mee db-weghachi FILE=...'. `mere ci` → zuru CI pipeline na mpaghara.
ops.h2_c: Makefile dị ka ntinye akwụkwọ canonical bụ omume Unix kemgbe ọtụtụ iri afọ, nke nnukwu ọrụ Python ọ bụla nakweere (pytest, django, flask, fastapi). Ngwa ndị ọzọ (Poetry, Hatch, uv) bụ ụtọ nke afọ; Mee bụ ihe na-agwụ ike na eluigwe na ala.
ops.h3_a: Ọkachamara ntọlite ​​​​bụ ngwugwu PyInstaller (`Vortex Wizard.app`) nwere pywebview GUI nke na-aga onye ọrụ oge mbụ site na mbugharị.
ops.h3_b: Na-agba ọsọ nke mbụ: họrọ aha ọnụ → mepụta igodo ntọhapụ (Ed25519 keypair echekwara na `igodo/release.key`) → hazie TLS (Let's Encrypt / weta-nke gị / nke aka gị bịanyere aka na ya) → họrọ URL ntinye (vortexx.sol / ngalaba omenala / .onion mepere emepe) → (iptables/ufw/pf). Mgbe agbachara nke mbụ, ọkachamara na-anọ dị ka njikwa njikwa: mmalite/kwụsị ọnụ, lelee ndekọ, igodo tụgharịa, gbakwunye ndị ọgbọ jikọtara ọnụ.
ops.h3_c: Ọkachamara ntọlite ​​bụ ụkpụrụ maka ngwaọrụ ejikọtara onwe ya na-ezubere ndị ọrụ na-abụghị sysadmin: Ghost's onboarding (2015), Ntọala ihe nkesa Standard Notes, ajụjụ nwụnye Mastodon. PyInstaller na-ahapụ anyị ka anyị bute otu ọnụọgụ abụọ enwere ike ịpị abụọ; pywebview na-atụgharị ibe HTML mpaghara nke onye nchịkwa FastAPI na-achịkọta API na 127.0.0.1 - ihe nchọgharị UX na-enweghị mgbagwoju anya nke iwulite nwa amaala GUI.
ops.h4_a: Akpado ntọhapụ ọ bụla na git. Rollback bụ 'git checkout <tag> && mee docker-build && docker compose up -d`. Mbugharị nwere ọrụ 'downgrade()'.
ops.h4_b: Eji igodo ntọhapụ bịanye aka na mkpado ka enwere ike ikwenye mkpado ahụ n'onwe ya. Usoro mweghachi: ndenye mkpado ochie, wughachi onyonyo, megharịa arịa - njikọ na-agba ọsọ na-adaba na SIGTERM (amara 15 s ndabara). DB: `alumbic downgrade <rev>` tụgharịa otu nlegharị anya. Mwepu data ọnwụ: anyị anaghị atụba ogidi n'otu ntọhapụ; ọdịda na-eme N+1 mgbe koodu kwụsịrị ịgụ ha.
ops.h4_c: Ụkpụrụ mbugharị "koodu-mgbe ahụ-koodu" (gbasawanye-migrate-nkwekọrịta) bụ ọkọlọtọ maka ntinye oge nkwụsị efu. Ntuziaka njem Stripe (2019) kọwara ya nke ọma. Vortex nakweere ya mgbe ihe mere na v0.0.3 ebe ọdịda kọlụm manyere windo mmezi nkeji iri atọ.
ops.h1_f:
ọrụ:
  ọnụ: onyonyo: vortex: ọdụ ụgbọ mmiri kacha ọhụrụ: [9000:9000]
  njikwa: onyonyo: ọdụ ụgbọ mmiri na-achịkwa vortex: [8800:8800]
  postgres: onyonyo: postgres: mpịakọta 16: [./data/pg:/var/lib/postgresql/data]
  redis: onyonyo: reds:7
  uwe: oyiyi: ọdụ ụgbọ mmiri coturn/coturn: [3478:3478/udp, 49152-65535:49152-65535/udp]
  caddy: onyonyo: ọdụ ụgbọ mmiri: [80:80, 443:443]
ops.h2_f:
mee ka wụnye pip install -r needs.txt
mee dev uvicorn --reload
mee ule pytest + mkpuchi
mee lint ruff + mypy
mee docker-buil docker build -t vortex:$VERSION
mee db-migrate alembic upgrade head
mee ci lint + test + migrate check
ops.h3_f:
Vortex Wizard.app
  → ngwugwu PyInstaller
  → weputara windo pywebview (mpaghara HTML)
  → na-agwa onye nchịkwa FastAPI okwu na 127.0.0.1: ọdụ ụgbọ mmiri
  → na-ewepụta igodo, dee .env, na-ebuga mbugharị mbụ
ops.h4_f:
eruba ntọhapụ:
  1. tinye koodu ọhụrụ; ochie na nke ọhụrụ ma gụọ "v1"
  2. migration: koodu ọhụrụ na-ede "v2"; ochie ka na-agụ "v1"
  3. backfill "v1" → "v2"
  4. ọzọ ntọhapụ: dobe ochie koodu ụzọ
  5. migration: dobe kọlụm "v1".

mobile.title: Ndị ahịa mkpanaka
mobile.subtitle: iOS na gam akporo — nwa afọ UI, otu ụkpụrụ.
mobile.intro: Ndị ahịa mkpanaka abụọ a bụ ndị ọgbọ zuru oke, ọ bụghị ihe mkpuchi weebụ dị mkpa. Ọdịdị ọdịdị, arụmọrụ ala, njikọta nke ala (CallKit, Ọrụ Njikọ, wijetị mkpọchi ihuenyo).
mobile.h1p1: Ngwugwu Swift na 'ios/Modul/'. Modul atụmatụ 30+, nke ọ bụla SOLID-ekewa `api/` + `impl/` + `ui/`.
mobile.h1p2: Ezubere ngwa na 'ios/VortexApp/'. XcodeGen spec na 'ios/project.yml' na-emegharị xcodeproj.
mobile.h1p3: Crypto: CryptoKit (X25519, Ed25519, AES-GCM, HKDF) + Argon2Swift (Argon2id).
mobile.h1p4: DB: GRDB + FTS5. Mgbanwe niile na-aga na 'db.write'.
mobile.h1p6: Push: APNs site na `UNUserNotificationCenter` + Mgbatị ọrụ ngosi maka mwepu.
mobile.h2p1: Ọrụ Gradle na 'android/'. 22 modul nwere Hilt DI, otu 'api / impl / di / ui' kewara.
mobile.h2p4: DB: Ime ụlọ nwere FTS4 ihe na-akpalite.
mobile.h3p1: Otu ngwugwu mpaghara 146 nwere aha ala (`Русский ru`, `Bekee en`, `中文 zh`, …).
mobile.h3p2: Otu katalọgụ 1500-emoji nwere ụdị 9 + ụda akpụkpọ + MRU + ọchụchọ.
mobile.h3p3: Otu akaụntụ multi-aka X25519 ihe ịma aka- nzaghachi maka ịgbanwee.
mobile.h3p4: Otu nchekwa nkata (Niile / echekwara / omenala) nwere nhazigharị ịdọrọ na dobe.
mobile.h3p5: Otu ndepụta GIF echekwara (enweghị Tenor - naanị mkpokọta nkeonwe).
mobile.h3p6: Otu ozi ahaziri UI, ihuenyo kọntaktị, ibe ọkwa adịchaghị.
mobile.h1_a: Ndị ahịa iOS bụ ngwugwu Swift nwere modul atụmatụ 30+. Otu HTTPS + WebSocket + WebRTC protocol dị ka ndị ahịa ọ bụla ọzọ.
mobile.h1_b: Modul haziri site na njirimara: 'Bootstrap', 'Auth', 'Chat', 'Files', 'Oku', 'Push', 'Emoji', 'folders', 'Accounts', 'SavedGifs', 'Contacts', 'Edobere', 'Premium', 'Reactions',…. Nke ọ bụla kewara n'ime `api/` (protocol), `impl/` (Klas concrete), `ui/` (ele SwiftUI). Crypto: CryptoKit maka X25519 / Ed25519 / AES-GCM; Argon2Swift maka Argon2id. DB: GRDB nwere FTS5. WebRTC: stasel/WebRTC XCFramework. Push: APN nwere ndọtị ọrụ ngosi maka mwepu-ntunye akara.
mobile.h1_c: Ngwunye modular bụ ọkọlọtọ Swift omume kemgbe Swift Package Manager 5.0 (2019). Nkewa anyị n'ime api/impl/ui bụ SOLID-ish: ntụgharị ịdabere (modul dabere na api/ naanị), nkewa nke nchegbu, nnwale (swap impl maka ule). Ọnụọgụ modul 30+ bụ nhọrọ maka ịmepụta myirịta - modul ọ bụla na-achịkọta ya iche.
mobile.h2_a: Android ahịa enyo iOS: Kotlin + Compose + Hilt DI. 22 modul atụmatụ, otu 'api / impl / di' kewara.
mobile.h2_b: minSdk 26 (Android 8), targetSdk 34 (Android 14). Crypto: AndroidX nche + Tink maka AES-GCM; argon2-jvm maka Argon2id. DB: Ime ụlọ nwere FTS4 ihe na-akpalite. WebRTC: Stream WebRTC gam akporo. Push: FCM site na FirebaseMessagingService + mkpuchi mkpuchi mkpuchi mkpuchi. Gradle multi-modul, Hilt na-ejikọ modul atụmatụ na-enweghị ndabere ozugbo.
mobile.h2_c: Compose is Google's declarative UI Toolkit, kwụsie ike kemgbe 2021. Hilt (2020) is the Google-akwado DI framework n'elu Dagger 2. Ọnụ ha dakọtara SwiftUI + onwunwe wrappers na iOS maka nso-identical architectural. Vortex anabatara Compose/Hilt site na v0.0.4 gaa n'ihu; Android gara aga dabere na View.
mobile.h3_a: Ma iOS na gam akporo jikọtara otu 146-Locale JSON nke nwere aha obodo yana katalọgụ 1500-emoji - onye ọrụ na-ede 🥹 na iOS 17 na-atụgharị 🥹 na gam akporo 9.
mobile.h3_b: `ios/Modul/isi mmalite/I18N/Resources/locales/*.json` mirrors `android/app/src/main/assets/locales/*.json`. Ngwa abụọ a na-ebu mpaghara ziri ezi na mbido mbụ (ihuenyo onye na-ahọrọ asụsụ) wee nọgide na-ahọrọ. Katalọgụ emoji bụ ụdị 9 JSON ebufere na ngwugwu abụọ ahụ; ọ n'akụkụ OS-level emoji-setịpụrụ iche iche nke na-ebuteghị '?' glyphs na OS ndị ochie.
mobile.h3_c: Mbupu katalọgụ emoji nke gị bụ ụkpụrụ Telegram na-eji (ndụ Twemoji ha) na WhatsApp ejiri ruo 2022. Azụmahịa: ~300 KB mgbakwunye kwa ngwa maka emoji + ~ 1.2 MB maka mpaghara. Kwesịrị ya maka ngbanwe n'usoro ikpo okwu.

  ngwugwu.swift
  Isi mmalite/
    Auth/api/, Auth/impl/, Auth/ui/
    Kpaa nkata/api/, Mkparịta ụka/impl/, Nkata/ui/
    Oku/api/, Kpọọ/impl/, Kpọọ/ui/
    ... 30+ modul
    Ngwa/ (mgbọrọgwụ mejupụtara)
ios/VortexApp/ (app lekwasịrị anya, ngwa mbubata ngwa modul)

android/
  ngwa/
    wuo.gradle.kts
    src/isi/java/sol/vortexx/android/
      auth/api/, auth/impl/, auth/di/, auth/ui/
      nkata/...
      oku/...
      ... 22 modul atụmatụ
      App.kt (mgbọrọgwụ mgbọrọgwụ)
mobile.h3_f:
mpaghara: faịlụ 146 JSON, nke ọ bụla ~ 8 KB nkezi (aha obodo + niile UI eriri)
emoji: 1 JSON nwere igodo 9 (ụdị) × 1500 ndenye
onye na-ahọrọ: taabụ kwụ ọtọ maka otu, grid 8 glyphs kwa ahịrị, MRU nnọgidesi ike

webclient.title: Onye ahịa webụ
webclient.subtitle: PWA, vanilla JS, ọnọdụ offline, onye ọrụ.
webclient.intro: Onye ahịa webụ bụ vanilla-JS PWA. Enweghị mmeghachi omume, enweghị ngwugwu gafere ESM. ~ 400 KB gzipped mkpokọta, gụnyere mpaghara 146.
webclient.h1p1: 'static/js/main.js' bụ ntinye. Ụdị modul dị umengwụ na ojiji mbụ.
webclient.h1p2: Steeti: mgbanaka mgbanaka otu ọnụ ụlọ na IndexedDB, cache decrypted na ebe nchekwa. Ndị na-arụ ọrụ na-arụ ọrụ na-emekọrịta ihe.
webclient.h1p3: UI: Mmetụta Glass Liquid site na CSS backdrop- filter. Enweghị usoro; ndị nnọchi anya mmemme + ndị nwere ike inye aka.
webclient.h2p1: Edemede ọ bụla emere mgbe kwụ n'ahịrị na-anọghị n'ịntanetị na IndexedDB. SW na-efegharị mgbe njikọ laghachiri.
webclient.h2p2: Igodo ikike na POST ọ bụla na-eme ka nnwagharị oyiri gaa nke ọma n'enweghị nsogbu.
webclient.h2p3: Ọgụgụ na-arụ ọrụ nke ọma na-anọghị n'ịntanetị - ederede ciphertext niile emekọrịtara na-ebi na IndexedDB.
webclient.h3p1: Mpaghara 146 dị na 'static/locales/*.json'. Ihuenyo nnabata (`lang-picer.js`) na-aga n'ihu site na ntụnye aha obodo.
webclient.h3p2: Mgbanwe mpaghara ojiri oge: `document.documentElement.lang = koodu` + weghachi akara site na njirimara `data-i18n`.
webclient.h1_a: Onye ahịa webụ bụ vanilla-JS PWA. Enweghị mmeghachi omume, enweghị usoro nrụpụta gafere ESM nchịkọta. Mkpokọta JS ebupu: ~400 KB gzipped.
webclient.h1_b: 'Templates/base.html' bụ shei arụgharịrị Jinja2. 'static/js/main.js' bụ ntinye ES-modul. Ụdị modul dị na `static/js/<atụmatụ>/' ibu ume ngwu na ojiji mbụ. CSS na 'static/css/' nwere mgbakọ otu-faịlụ kwa akụkụ. Onye ọrụ ọrụ na-ejikwa cache; ibu mbụ sitere na netwọkụ, na-esote site na cache; melite nlele na nsoroụzọ.
webclient.h1_c: Ịkwụsị n'usoro bụ mkpebi v0.0.1 kpachapụrụ anya ka emechara akara ngosi React na Vue PWA na ~ 1.5 MB gzipped nwere njiri mara ya. Vanilla JS + ES modul na-enye anyị ~ 400 KB. Azụmahịa ahụ bụ ihe mgbapụta mmiri ọkụ DOM-mmanipulation, nke anyị na-eji obere enyemaka belata na `static/js/lib/dom.js`.
webclient.h2_a: Ọnọdụ na-anọghị n'ịntanetị: ọpụpụ na-ede kwụ n'ahịrị na IndexedDB; Onye ọrụ na-awụpụ mgbe njikọ laghachiri.
webclient.h2_b: Ihe ọ bụla POST / PATCH onye ọrụ na-eme n'ịntanetị na-enweta igodo idempotency wee banye na 'outbox' (IndexedDB). Onye ọrụ na-ege ntị maka mmemme 'online' wee weghachi ya na igodo idempotency dị ka nkụnye eji isi mee. Sava na-amata oyiri site na igodo idempotency wee weghachi nzaghachi mbụ. Ọgụgụ na-arụ ọrụ nke ọma na-anọghị n'ịntanetị - ederede ciphertext niile synced na-ebi na IndexedDB wee jiri igodo ebe nchekwa decrypts na mpaghara.
webclient.h2_c: Igodo ikike maka POST enwere ike ịnwale bụ mgbakọ Stripe 2017, nke ọtụtụ API ọgbara ọhụrụ nakweere. IndexedDB dị ka igbe igbe bụ ụkpụrụ Google Drive webụ na-eji maka ndezigharị na-anọghị n'ịntanetị. Mmejuputa Vortex bụ ~ ahịrị 200 na `static/js/lib/outbox.js'.
webclient.h3_a: Ngwungwu asụsụ 146 na `static/locales/*.json'. Nabata okirikiri ihuenyo site na nrịbama aha obodo (`Выберите языk` / `Họrọ asụsụ gị` / `选择语言` / …).
webclient.h3_b: Mwepụta nke mbụ: `lang-picer.js' na-egosi akara typewriter-animated nke na-atụgharị site na mpaghara 97 na 45 ms/char, kwụsịtụrụ 1.8 s, na-ehichapụ na 30 ms/char, ọganihu. Onye ọrụ na-ahọrọ asụsụ; nọgidere na `localStorage.vortex_lang'. Ọsọ ọ bụla na-esote na-agụ nhọrọ echekwara. Mgbanwe oge ịgba ọsọ: `setLang(koodu)' na-ebu JSON, na-atụgharịkwa ihe 'data-i18n'.
webclient.h3_c: Ụdị ihe nrịbama typewriter bụ nkwanye ùgwù maka ihuenyo njedebe njedebe ochie ma nakweere ya maka ọkụ UX mgbe beta v0.0.6 gosiri na ndị ọrụ leghaara mwepu kwụ ọtọ. Atụmatụ ịgba ígwè na-enye mpio nke abụọ nke abụọ maka onye ọrụ ọ bụla ịhụ aha asụsụ ha wee mata ya ozugbo.
webclient.h1_f:
shei: ndebiri/base.html (Jinja2 nke ejiri ihe nkesa sụgharịa)
ntinye: static/js/main.js (ES modul)
atụmatụ: static/js/{chat,room,auth, call,files,bots}/...
SW: static/service-worker.js
nha: ~ 400 KB gzipped ngụkọta
webclient.h2_f:
usoro ederede na-anọghị n'ịntanetị:
  1. gbakọọ idempotency_key = rand (16).hex
  2. db.outbox.put ({url, usoro, ahụ, idempotency_key, ts})
  3. na 'online': mbupu igbe
     maka ahịrị ọ bụla: fetch (url, {usoro, ahụ, nkụnye eji isi mee: {"Idempotency-Key": ikey}})
       → 2xx: wepụ ahịrị
       → 4xx: ahịrị dobe (ọdịda na-adịgide adịgide)
       → 5xx/anọghị n'ịntanetị: nwaa ọzọ ma emechaa
webclient.h3_f:
lang- picker.js:
  hints = ["Выберите языk", "Họrọ asụsụ gị", "Elige tu idioma", ...]
  tinye ndumodu na 45 ms/char → kwụsịtụ 1.8 s → hichapụ na 30 ms/char → kwụsịtụ 0.2 s → ọzọ

mgba ọkụ oge ojiri gaa:
  localStorage.vortex_lang = koodu

security.title: Ọnọdụ nchekwa
security.subtitle: Ụdị egwu, nchekwa-n'omimi, WAF, Ụzọ nyocha, canary.
security.intro: Vortex na-eji nchekwa-n'omimi: imebi otu oyi akwa ezughị, onye na-awakpo n'ezie chọrọ ọtụtụ mmeri onwe ya.
security.h1p1: ** Onye nleba anya netwọkụ na-agafe agafe ***: na-ahụ ngwugwu TLS; na-eme nyocha nha / oge. E meriri site n'ọkwa 1 stealth.
security.h1p2: ** Onye na-awakpo netwọkụ na-arụsi ọrụ ike ***: nwere ike ịdaba / igbu oge / igba. E meriri ya site n'ọkwa 2-4 stealth.
security.h1p3: ** Onye ọrụ node mebiri emebi**: na-ahụ ciphertext + metadata. Ọdịnaya ozi na-anọgide na nzuzo.
security.h1p4: ** Ngwaọrụ ndị ahịa ezuru ohi ***: ekpughere ederede ederede gara aga. Oke Ratchet okpukpu abụọ na nnọkọ dị ugbu a; ehichapụ-na-esote-mkpọghe dị.
security.h1p5: ** Onye mmegide nke nwere okporo ụzọ echekwara n'oge gara aga ***: nke ngwakọ Kyber-768 igodo nnọkọ meriri mgbe ndị ọgbọ abụọ kpọsara PQ.
security.h2p1: Rịọ onye nleba anya: Usoro SQLi, ntugharị ụzọ, ntụtụ ndebiri, LFI, NoSQLi. Na-agbada tupu koodu ngwa.
security.h2p2: Oke oke: okpu dị nro nke 1000 req/s zuru ụwa ọnụ nwere mgbawa; kwa ụzọ (nbanye 10 / min, debanye aha 5 / min); onye ọrụ ọ bụla 100 req/s mgbe autth gasịrị.
security.h3p1: Ihe omume metụtara nchekwa (ọrụ nchịkwa, mgbanwe gọọmentị, nkwalite ntọhapụ, ihichapụ ụjọ) hash-chained site na 'app/security/canary.py`.
security.h3p2: Achọpụtara nbiji agbụ ⇒ nbibi. Oti mkpu.
security.h3p3: `/api/admin/audit' na-ekpughere ndekọ ahụ (naanị nchịkwa nchịkwa). Mgbakwunye-naanị.
security.h4p1: Canary faịlụ ejiri igodo ntọhapụ bịanyere aka kwa ụbọchị. Anọghị ⇒ nkwenye a na-enyo enyo.
security.h4p2: Mwepụ ihe mberede: onye nchịkwa na-agbasa `{ụdị:"n", mmemme:"compromise", ...}` na WebSocket ọ bụla. Ndị ahịa na-ehichapụ igodo echekwara.
security.h4p3: Ntughari: igodo ntọhapụ ọhụrụ, degharịa akara ngosi, bipụtaghachi. Ndị ahịa re-bootstrap.
security.h1_a: Klaasị anọ nke mmegide na-eme atụmatụ ahụ: onye na-ekiri ihe na-agafe agafe, onye na-awakpo na-arụsi ọrụ ike, onye ọrụ mebie, ngwaọrụ mebiri emebi. Onye ọ bụla meriri site na oyi akwa dị iche iche.
security.h1_b: Onye na-ekiri ihe na-eme njem: na-ahụ ngwugwu TLS ezoro ezo, na-enyocha okporo ụzọ. E meriri site n'ọkwa 1-2 stealth. Onye mmegide na-arụsi ọrụ ike: nwere ike dobe/egbu oge/gbanye ngwugwu. E meriri site n'ọkwa 3-4 stealth. Onye ọrụ emejọrọ: na-ahụ ciphertext + metadata. E meriri E2E crypto + mbelata metadata. Ngwaọrụ emejọrọ: na-ahụ ederede doro anya nke ozi gara aga. Mmebi sitere na nzuzo nzuzo (Double Ratchet) na hichapụ ụjọ.
security.h1_c: Ụdị klaasị anọ ahụ sitere na Schneier's 1999 "Applied Cryptography" taxonomy ụdị iyi egwu, gbatịpụrụ na nlebanya post-Snowden gbasara ndị na-ekiri ọkwa steeti. Nhazi ọ bụla nwere nchekwa nke ọgbara ọhụrụ na-ehota ihe dị ka ya. Ntugharị Vortex na-agbakwunye klas nke ise maka map okporo ụzọ v0.4: onye mmegide na-akwado quantum nwere okporo ụzọ gara aga echekwara, nke Kyber na-ejikwa.
security.h2_a: The WAF na-enyocha arịrịọ ọ bụla tupu ya erute koodu ngwa, na-ajụ SQL-i, traversal traversal, template injection, NoSQLi.
security.h2_b: 'app/security/middware.py:: WAFMiddleware' na-eme nyocha regex 50 megide URL, ajụjụ na ahụ. Usoro eji mara amara (`UNION SELECT`, `../`, `{{ config }}`, `$where`) → 403. Oke oke: okpu dị nro 1000 req/s zuru ụwa ọnụ nwere ndidi; kwa ụzọ `/ nbanye` 10/min, `/ deba aha` 5/min; onye ọrụ ọ bụla 100 req/s mgbe autth gasịrị. Nhọrọ igbochi geo site na `GEO_BLOCK=RU,CN,IR` iji meju ihe mmachi chọrọ maka ndị na-arụ ọrụ kwekọrọ.
security.h2_c: WAF dị ka middleware bụ ụkpụrụ emebere - mod_security (2002), Cloudflare's WAF, AWS WAF. Vortex's kpachaara anya pere mpe n'ihi na WAF dị arọ na-emepụta echiche ụgha na-erikpu ezigbo egwu. Edekọbara ndepụta regex site na OWASP Top 10 mbinye aka wee nụchaa na v0.0.5 mgbe iwu beta WAF gbochiri eriri nkịtị "DROP TABLE" n'ime ozi nkata gbasara SQL.
security.h3_a: Ihe omume ndị metụtara nchekwa na-adaba na ndekọ nyocha ejiri hash. Nkwụsị n'agbụ a na-egosi imebi.
security.h3_b: A na-etinye ihe nchịkwa ọ bụla, mgbanwe gọọmentị, nkwalite mwepụta, ma ọ bụ mkpochapụ ụjọ na 'audit_log(ts, event, actor_id, target_id, details_cbor)'. Ahịrị ọ bụla na-ebu `prev_hash = hash(prev_row)`. A na-agbakọ hash nke ahịrị ugbu a karịa mmemme 'ts ∥ ∥ prev_hash'. Ọ bụrụ na ehichapụ ma ọ bụ gbanwee ahịrị ọ bụla, ahịrị ndị na-esote ''prev_hash` yinye na-agbaji - enwere ike ịhụ ya site na ịkpọgharịa yinye.
security.h3_c: Ndekọ nyocha hash-chained bụ ochie ochie (hash-linked timestamping, 1991). Linux auditd na-eji ha. Git's commitment DAG bụ n'ezie otu nhazi. Vortex gbakwunyere ha na v0.0.6 mgbe onye ndụmọdụ rụchara aka na ọnụ na-emebi emebi nwere ike ihichapụ ahịrị osisi.
security.h4_a: Emebere ụzọ nzaghachi ihe omume: canary gosipụtara igodo ntọhapụ enweghị nkwekọrịta; mwepu ihe mberede na-ehichapụ igodo echekwara n'ofe ndị ahịa niile.
security.h4_b: 'canary.txt' kwa ụbọchị nke igodo ntọhapụ bịanyere aka, nke ebipụtara n'akụkụ onye njikwa. Ndị ahịa na-enyocha nhọrọ na mmalite - enweghị ⇒ mebie ihe a na-enyo enyo. Ọ bụrụ na akwadoro nkwenye: onye nchịkwa na-agbasa `{type:"n", mmemme:"compromise", reason}` n'elu WebSocket ọ bụla. Ndị ahịa na-ehichapụ igodo echekwara, manye nbanye ọzọ. Igodo ntọhapụ ọhụrụ ewepụtara, mbinye aka n'akwụkwọ, ndị ahịa degharịrị bootstrap site na njedebe njedebe nke iguzosi ike n'ezi ihe. Ederede ederede ochie emere enweghị ike ịgụ ya site na imewe.
security.h4_c: Faịlụ Canary na-agbaso akwụkwọ ikike Apple's 2013 yana ọrụ 'canarywatch.org'. Signal na-eji ha. Vortex's bụ akpaaka: akara cron 'canary.txt' na igodo mwepụta kwa elekere 24 ọ bụla. Mgbasa mgbasa ozi mwepu ihe mberede bụ otu ụkpụrụ Let's Encrypt eji eme kagbuchapụ oke asambodo.
security.h1_f:
klas | agbachitere
---------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------
onye na-ekiri netwọk na-agafe agafe | L1+L2 stealth (mkpịsị aka mkpịsị aka+)
onye na-awakpo netwọkụ na-arụ ọrụ | L3+L4 stealth (ECH, pluggable)
onye ọrụ mebie | E2E crypto + ezipụ pseudo
ngwaọrụ mebie | nzuzo na-aga n'ihu + hichapụ ụjọ
quantum (odinihu) | Kyber-768 ngwakọ nnọkọ
security.h2_f:
na-enyocha arịrịọ ọ bụla:
  SQL ịgba ogwu: chọpụta UNION SELECT, DROP TABLE,; -- wdg.
  ụzọ ngafe: chọpụta ../, ..%2f, URL-iche iche agbakwunyere
  template injection: chọpụta {{, {%
  XSS : chọpụta <script, javascript:
  NoSQLi: chọpụta $ne, $ebe, $regex
oke ọnụego: 1000/s zuru ụwa ọnụ, 10/min nbanye, 5/min ndekọ
security.h3_f:
ahiri: {ts, mmemme, onye na-eme ihe nkiri, target_id, details_cbor, prev_hash, row_hash}
row_hash = SHA-256(ts ∥ mmemme ∥ onye na-eme ihe nkiri
nyochaa: log log, megharịa row_hash ọ bụla, tụnyere uru echekwara
nkwụsịtụ ⇒ achọpụtara ime ihe n'ahịrị ahụ

privacy.title: Nzuzo na nnabata
privacy.subtitle: GDPR, nri-nhichapụ, mbelata metadata, mbugharị data.
privacy.intro: Vortex ụgbọ mmiri GDPR na CCPA na-eji ngwa n'ime igbe. Ndị na-arụ ọrụ na okpuru ọchịchị achịziri nwere otu njedebe nchịkwa maka arịrịọ ọ bụla iwu kwadoro.
privacy.h1p1: Enweghị IP ndekọ na ndabara. Weghachite ibe proxy `X-Real-IP` belụsọ ma onye ọrụ abanyela.
privacy.h1p2: 'sender_pseudo' na ahịrị ozi hashes ezigbo onye izipu NJ - mkpofu DB na-ekpughe naanị pseudonyms nke otu ọnụ ụlọ.
privacy.h1p3: Ọchụchọ na-eji akara ezoro ezo. Onye ahịa na-eji igodo ime ụlọ zoo mkpụrụokwu; ọnụ na-echekwa akara ngosi opaque; nchọcha dabara adaba na akara ciphertext.
privacy.h1p4: Ahụrụ ikpeazụ ka agbajila ka ọ bụrụ granularity nke onye ọrụ họọrọ.
privacy.h2p1: `POST /api/privacy/erase' na-eme ka ahịrị onye ọrụ ghara ịmata aha, hichapụ ozi ezitere ha (metadata e debere maka quorum), na-ehichapụ faịlụ na diski.
privacy.h2p2: Federation: asịrị mbinye aka na-agwa ndị ọgbọ; ha na-ehichapụ n'akụkụ ha n'ime awa 72.
privacy.h2p3: Nyochaa: ihichapụ na-abanye na timestamp yana (hashed) id onye ọrụ ka onye ọrụ nwee ike gosipụta nnabata.
privacy.h3p1: 'GET /api/privacy/export` iyi zip: profaịlụ JSON, ezitere/anatara ciphertext, ntụnyere faịlụ nwere igodo mgbọrọgwụ ọ bụla, ndepụta kọntaktị.
privacy.h3p2: Oge ọgbọ: ~ 5 min maka ozi 10 k, nke IO gbara ya.
privacy.h3p3: Onye nnata ga-ewepụrịrị ciphertext na mpaghara; A na-ebufe ngwá ọrụ mbupụ n'akụkụ.
privacy.h4p1: Ogologo pịa akara 5 s → hichapụ mpaghara ozugbo: igodo, ozi echekwara, mgbakwunye.
privacy.h4p2: Hichapụ njikọ chiri anya: `/api/privacy/panic' na-atụkwa okwute nke akaụntụ akụkụ nkesa.
privacy.h1_a: Enweghị IP ndekọ na ndabara. Enweghị metadata nke onye ọrụ na ahịrị ozi. Ọchụchọ ederede zuru oke maka akara ezoro ezo.
privacy.h1_b: Reverse proxy strips `X-Real-IP` tupu ọnụ ọnụ ahụ ahụ ya belụsọ ma onye ọrụ ahọrọla maka oke ọnụego. Ụlọ ahịa ahịrị ozi 'sender_id' (maka ACL) na 'sender_pseudo' (maka onye na-apụ apụ); sender_pseudo is HMAC(room_salt, sender_id) yabụ mkpofu DB anaghị ekpughe onye kwuru ihe n'ofe ụlọ. Chọọ: onye ahịa na-eji igodo ime ụlọ ezobe isi okwu; ọnụ na-echekwa akara ngosi opaque; nchọcha dabara na akara ciphertext, enweghị ndeksi ederede doro anya.
privacy.h1_c: Mbelata metadata bụ nkwenye nke post-Snowden - Signal na-agbasa ya na 2014, WhatsApp sochiri onye zitere-pseudo na 2019. Nchọgharị ezoro ezo n'elu akara akara ciphertext bụ usoro CryptDB (2011) na ShadowCrypt (2014). Mmejuputa Vortex bụ ụdị ewepụrụ nke na-azụta mgbanwe ajụjụ ụfọdụ maka ịdị mfe.
privacy.h2_a: `POST /api/privacy/erase' na-akọwapụta aha ahịrị onye ọrụ, hichapụ ciphertext ha ezigara, na-ehichapụ faịlụ ma na-agwa ndị ọgbọ nwere njikọ.
privacy.h2_b: Akụkụ nkesa: 'ahịrị ndị ọrụ' enweghị mmetụta efu ('aha njirimara = "ehichapụ-<id>"", `phone = null`, `email = null`, `display_name = "[ehichapụ]""); `messages.ciphertext` tọọ NULL maka ahịrị niile ebe `sender_id = u.id`; faịlụ jikọtara na ozi ndị ahụ ehichapụrụ na diski. Ndị ọgbọ emekọrịtara ọnụ na-anata 'mmemme: "ehichapụ", user_id, sign_by}` asịrị; ha na-agba otu mkpochapụ n'akụkụ ha n'ime awa 72 (SLA).
privacy.h2_c: Ikike ikpochapụ bụ GDPR Nkeji edemede 17 chọrọ kemgbe 2018. CCPA sochiri na 2020; LGPD (Brazil) na 2021. Vortex na-ebupụ ihe ochie na-apụ apụ n'igbe ka ndị na-arụ ọrụ na ikike iwu agaghị arụ ya. 72 h federation SLA dakọtara GDPR mpio nzaghachi ụbọchị iri atọ nwere ebe isi maka mgbasa.
privacy.h3_a: 'GET /api/privacy/export` iyi zip: profaịlụ JSON, ezitere/anatara ciphertext, ntụnyere faịlụ nwere igodo mgbọrọgwụ ọ bụla, ndepụta kọntaktị.
privacy.h3_b: Ọgbọ bụ async n'ihi na nnukwu akaụntụ na-ewe nkeji. Arịrịọ POST ndị ahịa → node enqueues ọrụ → ọrụ na-aga n'azụ → ntuli aka ndị ahịa `/api/privacy/export/{job_id}` → 200 nwere URL bịanyere aka na ya mgbe ọ dị njikere. Ọdịnaya zip: `profile.json`, `rooms.jsonl` (otu ọnụ ụlọ), `messages.jsonl.enc` (ciphertext + kwa igodo mgbọrọgwụ faịlụ), `faịlụ/` (budata-dị ka-bụ blobs).
privacy.h3_c: Mbugharị data bụ ejima chọrọ yana ihichapụ na GDPR. Apple, Google, Telegram, Signal niile nwere ihe eji eme ihe. Vortex's na-agbakwunye isi ihe (file_root kwa faịlụ) ka ndị ọrụ nwee ike mebie mbupụ mbupụ na mpaghara - ma ọ bụghị ya, mbupụ abaghị uru. Enweghị nkọwapụta a, ihe Apple / Google ewepụtara bụ nke ọma ederede-naanị n'ihi na emebielarị ya.
privacy.h4_a: Hichapụ ụjọ: ogologo pịa akara ngosi Vortex maka sekọnd ise ka ibibi igodo niile yana data echekwara na ngwaọrụ ozugbo. Agaghị agbanwe agbanwe.
privacy.h4_b: Ndị ahịa-akụkụ: na 5-sekọnd ogologo-pịa, gosi nkwenye; na nkwenye, kpọọ 'wipeKeychainItems()' / `clearKeystore()' / `localStorage.clear() + indexedDB.databases() .n'ihi na nke ọ bụla(ehichapụDatabase)'. Ederede ciphertext echekwabara agaala, igodo adịkwaghị, JWT apụọla. Hichapụ nhọrọ jikọtara ọnụ: `POST /api/privacy/panic' na-atụkwa okwute n'akụkụ ihe nkesa akaụntụ wee mebie asịrị.
privacy.h4_c: Bọtịnụ ụjọ / ndị nwụrụ anwụ nwere ogologo akụkọ ihe mere eme na ozi echekwara echekwabara: Wickr's 2014 "Shred", Cryptocat's 2013 "Chefu", amụma "Nchekwa Nchekwa" nke mgbaàmà (2016, ebubataghị ya). Vortex's 5-sekọnd ogologo-pịa bụ ụma na-esiri ike ịkpalite na mberede - anyị mụrụ nzaghachi haptic na iPhone 15 na Pixel 8 wee họrọ 5 s dị ka ebe dị ụtọ n'etiti "ngwa ngwa zuru oke na mberede" na "enweghị ike ịgba ọkụ site na bọtịnụ akpa".
privacy.h1_f:
sender_pseudo = HMAC-SHA256(ọnụ ụlọ, onye na-ezipụ_id)[:16]
  ⇒ DB mkpofu: {ime ụlọ, sender_pseudo, ciphertext}

debugging.title: Debugging na nchoputa
debugging.subtitle: Ngwa maka ịchọpụta okwu na dev, staging na prod.
debugging.intro: Sistemụ nke ọ bụla nwere ahaziri osisi na elu/metrics. Nke a bụ akwụkwọ egwuregwu nyocha nke mbụ.
debugging.h1p1: JSON - ejiri ndabara hazie ya. `logger.info("action", extra={"user_id": ...})` na-ewepụta `{"ts":..., "lvl":"INFO", "msg":"action", "user_id": ...}`.
debugging.h1p2: Tụgharịa na 100 MB; debe gens 14 gzipped.
debugging.h1p4: Id njikọ: arịrịọ ọ bụla na-enweta 'Arịrịọ-Id' X; RPC dị n'okpuru ala jikwa ya.
debugging.h2p1: Ọkpụkpọ Prometheus na `/metrics' (onye nchịkwa kwadoro na prod).
debugging.h2p2: RED: ọnụego / njehie / oge kwa ụzọ.
debugging.h2p3: USE: itinye n'ọrụ / saturation / njehie kwa DB ọdọ mmiri, WebSocket fan-out, TURN relay.
debugging.h2p4: Omenala: ime ụlọ nọ n'ọrụ, ozi/s, histogram ọkwa stealth.
debugging.h3p1: 'py-nledo' maka nlele oge ojiri gaa. Jikọọ ọnụ ọnụ na-agba ọsọ PID.
debugging.h3p2: 'memray' maka ịkọwapụta ikpo okwu. Foto nkeji nkeji 1 na-ekpughe ntapu ngwa ngwa.
debugging.h3p3: Rust ndọtị `vortex_chat` na-ebupụ ọkọlọtọ `-profile' nke na-ede traktị dakọtara flamegraph.
debugging.h4p1: `scripts/smoke/all.sh` na-agba aha ndekọ/nbanye/eziga/nata/wepụ megide ọnụ ọnụ mpaghara. Apụ na-abụghị efu na ọdịda ọ bụla.
debugging.h4p2: CI na-agba anwụrụ ọkụ na PR ọ bụla yana na njikọta na isi.
debugging.h4p3: Anwụrụ ọkụ na-emepụta: nyocha mpụga na-akụ akaụntụ canary otu ugboro n'otu nkeji.
debugging.h1_a: A na-ahazi ndekọ JSON site na ndabara. Ahịrị ndekọ ọ bụla gụnyere ts, ọkwa, modul, ozi, yana id njikọ.
debugging.h1_b: `logger.info("user_created", extra={"user_id": u.id})` na-emepụta `{"ts":"2026-04-21T10:23:14.127Z", "lvl":"INFO", "mod":"auth", "msg":"user_id":"kere:"user_2" "..."}'. Id njikọ na-abịa site na nkụnye eji isi mee 'X-Request-Id'; ọ bụla downstream RPC na-eji ya ọzọ. Ntughari na 100 MB; debe ọgbọ iri na anọ gzipped. Ọkwa kwa-modul site na `LOG_LEVEL_<MODULE>=DEBUG`.
debugging.h1_c: Ndebanye aha ahaziri JSON bụ nkwenye dị ugbu a - nke Stripe, Datadog nakweere, ndị na-ere ihe nleba anya ọgbara ọhụrụ. NJ mmekọ na-achọpụta X-Arịrịọ-Id (RFC 4557) wee bụrụ akwụkwọ nsọ na microservices site na Jaeger / Zipkin (2015). Vortex na-eji akara nhụsianya na-agbasa isi dị mfe karịa nkesa n'ihi na ngwa ọrụ nkesa na-agbakwunye mgbagwoju anya anyị achọghị.
debugging.h2_a: Metiriks Prometheus na `/metrics' (onye nchịkwa kwadoro na mmepụta ya). Ebubanyere dashboards Grafana na `deploy/grafana/`.
debugging.h2_b: RED metrik kwa ụzọ: ọnụego arịrịọ, ọnụego mperi, histogram oge. USE metrics kwa-akụrụngwa: DB ojiji ọdọ mmiri, WebSocket fan-out saturation, TURN relay bandwit. Omenala: ime ụlọ na-arụ ọrụ, ozi kwa nkeji, histogram ọkwa stealth. dashboard nchịkwa na `/admin/metrics' na-egosi chaatị ndị dị n'elu; Prometheus scraping maka akụkọ zuru oke.
debugging.h2_c: RED (ọnụego / njehie / ogologo oge) bụ Weaveworks' 2016 acronym. USE (ọrụ / saturation / njehie) bụ usoro Brendan Gregg nke 2013. Ha jikọtara ọnụ na-ekpuchi akara ọkwa ọrụ yana ọkwa akụrụngwa. Prometheus + Grafana bụ ndabara mepere emepe kemgbe 2016.
debugging.h3_a: 'py-nledo' maka nlele oge ojiri gaa; 'memray' maka obo snapshots; `vortex_chat` Rust ndọtị nwere `-profile' maka traktị flamegraph.
debugging.h3_b: `py-spy record -o profile.svg --pid <node>` maka 60 s na-emepụta flamegraph SVG na-egosi nchịkọta Python na-ekpo ọkụ. 'memray run -o mem.bin <cmd>' oke oke egwu; 'memray flamegraph mem.bin' na-atụgharị. Rust ndọtị na-ebupụ profaịlụ dị n'ime ka Chrome-tracing JSON mgbe ejiri `-profile' kpọọ ya. Jikọta nke ọ bụla n'ime ihe ndị a na ule ibu na-aga site na `scripts/smoke/all.sh' maka ụdị na-agbanwe agbanwe.
debugging.h3_c: py-spy (2018) bụ profaịlụ ndekọ ọnụ ọgụgụ na-adịghị emetụta nke na-ejikọta na usoro Python na-agba ọsọ na-enweghị mgbanwe koodu - Go nke Python profaịlụ. memray (Bloomberg, 2022) bụ ọkacha mmasị Python ikpo okwu taa. Rust usoro gburugburu ebe obibi nke nwere profaịlụ tozuru oke mana ọ naghị ejikọta ya; Mgbatị anyị na-ebupụ Chrome-nchọgharị kpọmkwem n'ihi na ihe nchọgharị ọ bụla nwere ihe nleba anya arụnyere.
debugging.h4_a: `scripts/smoke/all.sh` omume ndekọ/nbanye/zipu/nata/wepụ megide ọnụ ọnụ mpaghara. CI na-agba ya na PR ọ bụla.
debugging.h4_b: Anwụrụ ọkụ na-agba n'ime ~5 sekọnd. Mepụta akaụntụ ọhụrụ abụọ, mepee DM, zipu ozi, nyochaa nnyefe, depụta ha abụọ. Apụ na-abụghị efu na ọdịda ọ bụla. CI na-akpọku ya ka emechara ya. Canary prod-smoke dị iche na-agba kwa nkeji site na nyocha mpụga megide akaụntụ nnwale raara onwe ya nye na ọnụ mmepụta.
debugging.h4_c: Nnwale anwụrụ ọkụ bụ ihe atụ ụlọ ọrụ Toyota (1950s) - mee nyocha ngwa ngwa iji gosi na usoro ahụ agbajibeghị. Na ngwanrọ, ha ghọrọ ọkọlọtọ mgbe Michael Feathers' "Na-arụ ọrụ nke ọma na Code Legacy" (2004). Ederede anwụrụ ọkụ Vortex bụ ahịrị bash + 200.
debugging.h1_f:
{
  "ts": "2026-04-21T10:23:14.127Z",
  "lvl": "INFO",
  "mod": "auth",
  "msg": "user_created",
  "user_id": 42,
  "req_id": "7f3a1e9c-..."
}

ntụgharị: 100 MB × 14 gens gzipped
kwa modul: LOG_LEVEL_TRANSPORT=DEBUG

testing.title: Atụmatụ ule
testing.subtitle: Ahịrị ule 29k gafere Python, Swift, Kotlin, JS.
testing.intro: Igwe oyibo ọ bụla nwere ụlọ nyocha nke ya. CI na-agba ha niile n'ihe na-erughị nkeji iri.
testing.h1p1: Ngwa 'pytest/nwale' na-ekpuchi ndị na-anya ụgbọ mmiri, nchekwa, ụgbọ njem, bots.
testing.h1p2: Nnwale dabere n'ihe onwunwe na-eche echiche na crypto: ` decrypt (encrypt(m,k), k) == m` maka 1000 random m.
testing.h1p3: Ụdị fuzz AFL dị na WAF: nde nde ndenye adịghị arụ ọrụ - na-ekwupụta na ọ nweghị ntapu 5xx.
testing.h2p1: 'Swift test' na 'ios/Modules/' na-agba ule nkeji megide vectors RFC 7748/8032/5869/8446.
testing.h2p2: Nnwale XCUI na-akwalite echiche SwiftUI na simulator enweghị isi; foto-tụnyere.
testing.h3p1: './gradlew test' na-agba ule naanị JVM (ngwa ngwa).
testing.h3p2: `./gradlewconnectCheck' na-agba ule nwere ngwá ọrụ na emulator na-agba ọsọ.
testing.h4p1: Onye na-egwu egwuregwu na-anya onye ahịa weebụ, Chrome + Firefox na-enweghị isi. A na-eji `--use-fake-ui-for-media-stream' mee oku.
testing.h4p2: Ihe ndapụta: debanye aha akaụntụ abụọ → DM → zipu faịlụ → hichapụ → nyochaa mmekọrịta → njedebe.
testing.h1_a: Nnwale Python na-eji mkpuchi pytest +. Onye ọ bụla rawụta, nchekwa oge ochie, modul njem ọ bụla nwere ule. ~ 80% mkpuchi.
testing.h1_b: Ngwa/ule 'pytest' na-agba ọsọ zuru ezu n'ihe na-erughị nkeji 2 n'otu isi. Nnwale dabere n'ihe onwunwe na-eche echiche na primitives crypto: `kwuputa decrypt(encrypt(m,k), k) == m` maka ozi 1000 random. Nnwale fuzz ụdị AFL dị na WAF: nde nde ndenye arụrụ arụ kwuputara iji wepụta nzaghachi 4xx (ọ bụghị 5xx). `pytest --cov=app` maka mkpuchi.
testing.h1_c: pytest (Holger Krekel, 2009) bụ onye na-agba ọsọ ule de-facto Python. Hypothesis (2015) maka nnwale dabere na ihe onwunwe gosipụtara echiche QuickCheck sitere na Haskell. AFL (Michał Zalewski, 2013) maka fuzz bụ fuzzer mkpuchi na-eduzi. Ngwunye Vortex bụ isi; naanị ụtọ bụ mmasị anyị maka pytest parametrisation karịa ihe nketa-klas ule.
testing.h2_a: Nnwale ngwa ngwa na 'ios/Modules/' na-ekpuchi crypto primitives megide vectors RFC gbakwunyere nleba anya nke SwiftUI.
testing.h2_b: 'Swift test' sitere na 'ios/Modules/' na-agba ule otu n'okpuru 1 s. RFC 7748 (X25519) vectors. RFC 8032 (Ed25519) vectors. RFC 5869 (HKDF) vectors. RFC 8446 (TLS 1.3) nhazi. SwiftUI preview snapshots tụnyere site na onyonyo diff megide ntọala git-soro; regression na pikselụ ọ bụla na-akụda ụlọ ahụ.
testing.h2_c: Nnwale crypto megide vectors ule gọọmentị bụ omume kachasị mma - ọ bụrụ na koodu gị kwenyere na vector RFC, ọ dabara na nkọwapụta. Nnwale onyonyo maka SwiftUI bụ ~2022 steeti nka, nke pointfreeco/swift-snapshot-testing na-ewu ewu. Vortex na-eji opekata mpe n'ime ụlọ iji zere ịdabere.
testing.h3_a: Nnwale Kotlin: JVM-naanị site na `./gradlew test'; Ejiri './gradlewconnectCheck' na emulator na-agba ọsọ.
testing.h3_b: './gradlew test' na-agba n'ime sekọnd ole na ole - enweghị usoro gam akporo achọrọ, naanị JUnit + Hilt-android-testing. Ebumnuche nnwale-otu: crypto, ndị na-eweta ihe ngosi, mgbaba dabere na coroutine. `./gradlewconnectCheck' tụgharịrị emulator, wụnye ngwa, na-agba ule UI site na Espresso. E2E na-asọ: nbanye → zipu ozi → hụ na nkata.
testing.h3_c: Ikewa JVM-naanị ule na ule eji arụ ọrụ bụ mgbakọ Android 2019+. JVM ule dị ngwa ngwa (sekọnd); Nnwale eji arụ ọrụ na-eji nwayọ (nkeji). Robolectric (2014) na-ejichikota oghere ahụ mana nkewa a na mmepe gam akporo ọgbara ọhụrụ dochie ya nke ukwuu.
testing.h4_a: Onye na-egwu egwuregwu na-ebugharị onye ahịa weebụ na Chrome na Firefox na-enweghị isi, na-egosipụta ezigbo aha → DM → oku na-aga.
testing.h4_b: 'Onye na-ede egwuregwu-ule/' na-ejide ọnọdụ na TypeScript. A na-agbakọta ọnụ ụzọ atụfu + Postgres kwa oge ule site na ide ihe docker. Nnwale na-ebugharị webụ UI: debanye aha akaụntụ abụọ, mepee DM, zipu ozi, nyochaa nnyefe, mee oku vidiyo na `--use-fake-ui-for-media-stream` + `--eji-fake-device-for-media-stream` flags ka Chrome mepụta audio/video sịntetik. Ihe atụ na-aga n'otu n'otu site na ndị ọrụ Playwright.
testing.h4_c: Onye na-egwu egwu (Microsoft, 2020) nọchiri Selenium maka ọtụtụ nyocha webụ E2E n'ihi na ọ na-adị ngwa ngwa, nwee ntụkwasị obi ma nwee nbibi ka mma. Nnwale WebRTC na ihe nchọgharị enweghị isi bụ ihe mgbu ruo mgbe Chrome 69 gbakwunyere ọkọlọtọ adịgboroja ngwaọrụ; kemgbe ahụ, ọ ghọrọ ụkpụrụ omume.

apiSurface.title: API elu
apiSurface.subtitle: Ebe ngwụcha HTTP ọ bụla, ọnụ na-ekpughere, chịkọtara ya na mpaghara.
apiSurface.intro: Nke a bụ ndepụta ikike nke ụzọ ọha. Kaadị njedebe ọ bụla na-agbasawanye iji gosipụta ebumnuche, ọkwa nyocha, atụmatụ arịrịọ / nzaghachi, tebụl njehie, na ihe atụ curl. Amụma ewepụrụ ụzọ nchekwa ime n'okpuru `/ime/*`.

auth.title: Nyocha
auth.subtitle: Debanye aha, nbanye, nweta ume, kagbuo - yana ụzọ mgbake.
auth.intro: Ụzọ niile n'okpuru `/api/authentication/*`. JWT nke na-esi na nbanye na-aga nke ọma na-ebu `{sub: user_id, jti: device_id, typ: access| nweta ume}` bịanyere aka na ya HS256 n'elu nzuzo nzuzo. Ịnweta na-ewe nkeji 15, nweta ume ụbọchị 30.

register.title: POST /api/authentication/register
register.subtitle: Mepụta onye ọrụ ọhụrụ nwere njirimara X25519 + Argon2id paswọọdụ.
register.h1_a: Na-emepụta akaụntụ onye ọrụ ọhụrụ wee wepụta ụzọ mbụ JWT. Na-ejikọta igodo ọha ogologo ndụ X25519 onye ọrụ na akaụntụ ahụ site na oku mbụ.
register.h1_b: Node na-akwado mpaghara niile site na Pydantic, na-enyocha aha njirimara na x25519_public_key pụrụ iche, na-agba Argon2id (m=64MiB, t=3, p=4) na okwuntughe, tinye n'ime 'ndị ọrụ', 'ọrụ_ngwaọrụ', 'push_subscriptions', nkeji ịnweta + nwetaghachi JWTs.
register.h1_c: Ebufere na v0.0.1 dị ka njedebe mbụ. Agbakwunyere paramita X25519 pubkey na v0.0.2 mgbe ị chọpụtachara njirimara yana mkpa ka emepụtara akaụntụ - ma ọ bụghị ya, ihe nkesa ahụ nwere ike MITM onye ọrụ n'etiti ndebanye aha na bulite igodo mbụ.
register.h2_a: Achọrọ: ** ọ dịghị **. Middleware `app/security/middware.py::auth_required` na-enu ụzọ a wee jụ na`401 enwetabeghị` ma ọ bụrụ na nzere achọrọ na-efu ma ọ bụ adịghị mma.
register.h2_b:
- `ọ dịghị onye` — akwadoghị (mbanye tupu nbanye).
- `jwt` - Onye na-ebu JWT nweta akara n'isi 'ikike'.
- 'ume ọhụrụ' - Onye na-ebu JWT akara ume ọhụrụ.
- `admin` — JWT onye nkwuputa ya nwere `bụ_admin: eziokwu'.
'Ndị ọgbọ bịanyere aka n'akwụkwọ' - arịrịọ nke igodo Ed25519 ndị ọgbọ ntụkwasị obi bịanyere aka na ya.
register.h2_c: The auth tier na-egosipụta ụkpụrụ nke kacha nta ihe ùgwù: tupu nbanye endpoints bụ nnọọ mmachi na akaụntụ e kere eke na mgbake; ihe niile n'azụ JWT na-ahụ ezigbo onye ọrụ; njedebe njedebe admin na-egosi baajị na UI yabụ na-ahụta ihe n'ụzọ na-ezighị ezi.
register.h3_a: JSON ahụ nwere aha njirimara amanyere iwu + paswọọdụ + x25519_ọha_key; ekwentị nhọrọ (E.164), email (RFC 5322 Lite), display_name, avatar_emoji, invite_code, kyber_public_key.
register.h3_f:
{
  "username": "alice", // [a-z0-9_]{3,30}
  "paswọọdụ": "..."", // ≥ 8 chars
  "x25519_public_key": "<64-hex>", // 32 bytes hex
  "display_name": "Alice", // nhọrọ
  "ekwentị": "+15551234567", // nhọrọ, E.164
  "email": "a@example.com", // nhọrọ
  "avatar_emoji": "🦊", // nhọrọ, 1 emoji
  "invite_code": "..."", // nhọrọ ma ọ bụrụ na ọnọdụ INVITE
  "kyber_public_key": "<1184 hex>" // nhọrọ, maka PQ
}
register.h4_a: Emepụtara 201 site na ụzọ abụọ JWT yana profaịlụ canonical onye ọrụ ọhụrụ.
register.h4_f:
{
  "ok": eziokwu,
  "access_token": "eyJ…", // 15 min TTL
  "refresh_token": "eyJ…", // 30 ụbọchị TTL

login.title: POST /api/authentication/login
login.subtitle: Nyochaa aha njirimara + paswọọdụ, laghachi JWT ụzọ abụọ.
login.h1_a: Ọ gbanwere nzere maka otu ụzọ JWT. Ekwenyere okwuntughe megide hash Argon2id na `users.password_hash`. Oge bụ oge na-adịgide adịgide ọbụna maka aha njirimara amaghi ama iji gbochie ngụkọ.
login.h1_b: Na-enyocha onye ọrụ site na obere aha njirimara, na-agba 'argon2.PasswordHasher.verify(echekwara, nyefee)'. Ọ bụrụ na onye ọrụ anaghị adị, na-enyocha hash nke agbakọrọ agbakọrọ agbakọọ iji hazie oge. Ihe ịga nke ọma → mbipụta JWT + `ngwaọrụ_ọrụ` ahiri.
login.h1_c: E zigara ya na ndekọ na v0.0.1. Hashing oge na-adịru oge agbakwunyere na v0.0.2 mgbe ndị nyocha gosipụtara ngụkọ oge na nhazi mbụ.
login.h2_a: Achọrọ: ** ọ dịghị **. Middleware `app/security/middware.py::auth_required` na-enu ụzọ a wee jụ na`401 enwetabeghị` ma ọ bụrụ na nzere achọrọ na-efu ma ọ bụ adịghị mma.
login.h2_b:
- `ọ dịghị onye` — akwadoghị (mbanye tupu nbanye).
- `jwt` - Onye na-ebu JWT nweta akara n'isi 'ikike'.
- 'ume ọhụrụ' - Onye na-ebu JWT akara ume ọhụrụ.
- `admin` — JWT onye nkwuputa ya nwere `bụ_admin: eziokwu'.
'Ndị ọgbọ bịanyere aka n'akwụkwọ' - arịrịọ nke igodo Ed25519 ndị ọgbọ ntụkwasị obi bịanyere aka na ya.
login.h2_c: The auth tier na-egosipụta ụkpụrụ nke kacha nta ihe ùgwù: tupu nbanye endpoints bụ nnọọ mmachi na akaụntụ e kere eke na mgbake; ihe niile n'azụ JWT na-ahụ ezigbo onye ọrụ; njedebe njedebe admin na-egosi baajị na UI yabụ na-ahụta ihe n'ụzọ na-ezighị ezi.
login.h5_a: Ọkọlọtọ Vortex njehie envelopu `{ njehie, ọnọdụ, ụzọ}`. '401' na nzere ọjọọ; `403' na ezughị oke ohere; `422' na nkwado; '429' na oke ọnụego; '5xx' na mperi ime.
login.h5_f:
401 invalid_credentials ọjọọ aha njirimara ma ọ bụ paswọọdụ
Akwụsịla akaụntụ 401 account_ kwụsịtụrụ
401 totp_chọrọ inye totp wee nwaa ọzọ
Ọnụego 429 nwere oke> Mgbalị 10 / nkeji / IP

draftGet.h1_b: Onye njikwa ụzọ a na-ebi na modul kwekọrọ n'okpuru `app/`. Ekwuputara ụkpụrụ `/api/rooms/{id}/draft` na `@router.get('/api/rooms/{id}/draft')`.
draftGet.h1_c: Ebufere na mbido Vortex dị ka akụkụ nke ikike 'draft'.
draftGet.h2_a: Achọrọ: **jwt**. Middleware `app/security/middware.py::auth_required` na-enu ụzọ a wee jụ na`401 enwetabeghị` ma ọ bụrụ na nzere achọrọ na-efu ma ọ bụ adịghị mma.
draftGet.h2_b:
- `ọ dịghị onye` — akwadoghị (mbanye tupu nbanye).
- `jwt` - Onye na-ebu JWT nweta akara n'isi 'ikike'.
- 'ume ọhụrụ' - Onye na-ebu JWT akara ume ọhụrụ.
- `admin` — JWT onye nkwuputa ya nwere `bụ_admin: eziokwu'.
'Ndị ọgbọ bịanyere aka n'akwụkwọ' - arịrịọ nke igodo Ed25519 ndị ọgbọ ntụkwasị obi bịanyere aka na ya.
draftGet.h2_c: The auth tier na-egosipụta ụkpụrụ nke kacha nta ihe ùgwù: tupu nbanye endpoints bụ nnọọ mmachi na akaụntụ e kere eke na mgbake; ihe niile n'azụ JWT na-ahụ ezigbo onye ọrụ; njedebe njedebe admin na-egosi baajị na UI yabụ na-ahụta ihe n'ụzọ na-ezighị ezi.
draftGet.h5_a: Ọkọlọtọ Vortex njehie envelopu `{ njehie, ọnọdụ, ụzọ}`. '401' na nzere ọjọọ; `403' na ezughị oke ohere; `422' na nkwado; '429' na oke ọnụego; '5xx' na mperi ime.
draftGet.h5_f:
401 enweghị nkwenye na-efu/efu efu
403 amachibidoro oke oke
422 validation_error mmachi ubi mebiri
Ọnụego 429 kpara oke oke mbọ
Mmejọ nkesa 500 internal_error na-atụghị anya ya

403 amachibidoro oke oke
422 validation_error mmachi ubi mebiri
Ọnụego 429 kpara oke oke mbọ

roadmap.title: Roadmap
roadmap.subtitle: Kedu ihe a na-eme atụmatụ na mgbe.
roadmap.intro: Echiche dị elu. Ụbọchị na-achọsi ike; nsogbu nchekwa tupu ewepu ọrụ atụmatụ.
roadmap.h1p1: Kyber-768 PQ kwadoro site na ndabara na nrụnye ọhụrụ.
roadmap.h1p2: Otu dị ihe ruru ndị otu 50 000 nwere igodo Variant-B bipụta.
roadmap.h1p3: Ngwunye Desktop (Tauri) maka macOS / Windows / Linux.
roadmap.h1p4: Ebe ahịa Bot mepere maka ntinye ọhaneze.
roadmap.h2p1: Otu naanị ọdịyo na-akpọ ihe ruru 100 sonyere site na SFU.
roadmap.h2p2: Opus DTX + simulcast + bitrate na-agbanwe agbanwe.
roadmap.h2p3: Onye ọ bụla so na ya dara ogbi / gbaa oku na oku UI.
roadmap.h3p1: Canvas na-emekọ ihe n'ụdị Miro karịrị CRDT (Yjs-flavored) site na oyi akwa ozi.
roadmap.h4p1: On-chain escrow maka ịzụrụ bot (Solana + EVM).
roadmap.h4p2: Oke ego ndị ọrụ, 10%% ụgwọ ikpo okwu.
roadmap.h4p3: Gbanyụọ ma ọ bụ gbanyụọ Fiat site na Stripe jikọọ.
roadmap.h5p1: N'elu kwụsiri ike, nyocha nchekwa nkịtị, ihe nrụpụta nwere ike imegharị, SemVer jụrụ oyi.
roadmap.h5p3: Opekempe, otu nlebanya nchekwa nọọrọ onwe ya nwere ederede ọha.
roadmap.h1_a: v0.2 - mwepụta ọha nke abụọ. Kyber PQ na ndabara, nnukwu ọnụ ụlọ ọha site na Variant-B, ngwugwu desktọpụ Tauri, ebe ahịa bot mepere emepe.
roadmap.h1_b: Kyber-768 ndabara ka enyere maka nrụnye ọhụrụ; ndị ahịa na-enweghị nkwado na-agbada n'ụzọ amara. Ime ụlọ ruru ndị otu 50 000 site na igodo Variant-B na-ebipụta - enweghị onye otu otu envelopu fanout na ntụgharị. Desktọpụ (Tauri 2 wrapper gburugburu onye ahịa weebụ) bipụtara maka macOS, Windows, Linux nwere otu ngwugwu. Ebe ahịa Bot na-emepe maka ntinye ọhaneze na nyocha ụbọchị azụmahịa atọ SLA.
roadmap.h1_c: v0.2 bụ maka ikpochapụ ihe ochie dị ugbu a kama imepụta nke ọhụrụ. Kyber nọ mgbe niile na map okporo ụzọ; ngbanwe na ndabara na-adabere na nkwụsi ike n'okpuru ibu. A họọrọ Tauri karịa Electron n'ihi na ngwugwu bụ ~ 5 MB vs ~ 150 MB. A gbochiri nnyefe ọha n'ahịa Bot na akụrụngwa nyocha nke rutere na v0.1.
roadmap.h2_a: v0.3 - oku otu. Otu ọdịyo dabere SFU ruo 100; otu vidiyo ruru 32; ịmegharị simulcast.
roadmap.h2_b: SFU etinyere na Rust maka ịrụ ọrụ. Opus DTX + FEC + simulcast maka ọdịyo. VP9 L1/L2/L3 simulcast maka vidiyo nwere oyi akwa SFU na-ewere oyi akwa onye na-ekiri dabere na mgbada ala akọpụtara. Onye ọ bụla so na ya dara ogbi wee tie ihe site na UI. Ndekọ oku (nkwenye-gbapụrụ, gbanyụọ na ndabara) echekwara ezoro ezo n'okpuru igodo oku ọ bụla na-ekekọrịta n'etiti ndị sonyere.
roadmap.h2_c: Oku otu bụ otu njirimara a na-arịọkarị site na v0.1 beta. Nhazi SFU na-eso usoro Jitsi Videobridge + Janus. Rust mmejuputa iwu kama ijikwa mediasoup n'ihi na mediasoup's Node.js runtime na-agbakwụnye latency anyị achọghị n'ụzọ dị ọkụ.
roadmap.h3_a: v0.4 - kwaaji imekọ ihe ọnụ. bọọdụ ịkekọrịta ụdị ụdị Miro karịrị CRDT (Yjs-flavored) site na oyi akwa ozi dị.
roadmap.h3_b: CRDT akwụkwọ mekọrịta piggybacks na ozi ime ụlọ dị. Edezi bọọdụ ọ bụla bụ ọrụ CRDT ahaziri dị ka CBOR, nke ejiri igodo ime ụlọ ezoro ezo, ezisara dị ka ozi 'ụdị:"board_op"'. Ndị ahịa deserialise, tinye, nye ya. Ọnụnọ cursor ozugbo site na ụdị ozi `board_cursor'' dị iche. Mbupu gaa na PNG / SVG / PDF site na ịsụgharị kwaaji ndị ahịa.
roadmap.h3_c: CRDT (Shapiro et al. 2011) ghọrọ mmepụta-ike na Yjs (Kevin Jahns, 2017). Figma wulitere mmekorita ha na usoro omenala CRDT. Echiche ijigharị oyi akwa ozi anyị ezoro ezo karịa iwulite ọwa WebSocket dị iche na-abịa site na ụkpụrụ: ụzọ ụgbọ njem pere mpe, mpe mpe mpe mpe akwa.
roadmap.h4_a: v0.5 - ịkwụ ụgwọ. On-chain escrow (Solana + EVM) + mgbanyụ ma ọ bụ gbanyụọ fiat site na Stripe Connect.
roadmap.h4_b: Bot na-azụta ụzọ site na nkwekọrịta escrow on-chain. Onye na-azụ ahịa kwadoro; 24 h nkwụsịtụ; wee wepụta ego nye onye na-ere ahịa mwepu 10% ụgwọ ikpo okwu. Esemokwu na-agara ndị na-ekpe ikpe obodo ahọpụtara site na staking. Fiat on-ramp: Stripe Jikọọ akaụntụ maka onye ọrụ ma ọ bụ onye na-ere bot; Off-ramp: mbufe ụlọ akụ ozugbo ma ọ bụ mmezi USDC. Nkwado Crypto: SOL, USDC, USDT na Solana na Ethereum.
roadmap.h4_c: Escrow smart contracts bụ ochie (OpenBazaar 2016) mana ka siri ike n'akụkụ n'usoro nke UX. Vortex na-eketa mgbagwoju anya mana ọ na-ezochi ọtụtụ n'ime ya - ndị na-azụ ahịa na-ahụ bọtịnụ "ịzụta" maara nke ọma. Ụgwọ ikpo okwu 10% dabara na mgbakọ App Store (n'agbanyeghị Apple na-ewe 30%); mbelata nke ala na-ama ụma na-adọta ndị na-ere ere.
roadmap.h5_a: v1.0 - kwụsie ike. Nyochaa nchekwa, na-emegharịgharị n'ofe nyiwe niile, SemVer jụrụ oyi.
roadmap.h5_b: Nyocha nke ndị ọzọ akwadoro tupu 1.0 ifriizi - ikekwe Trail of Bits ma ọ bụ NCC Otu dabere na ngụ azụmaahịa. Nrụgharị na-ewuli elu pụtara otu osisi isi iyi na-emepụta ọnụọgụ abụọ yiri ya na igwe ihe abụọ ọ bụla; nke a na-achọpụta mmetuta ụdọ ọkọnọ. SemVer oyi kpọnwụrụ pụtara usoro waya, atụmatụ nchekwa, na ihu ọha SDK elu nweta nkwa azụ-compat n'ime 1.x. Mmemme bounty bug ji mmalite $25k dị elu maka mkpochapụ koodu dịpụrụ adịpụ na ọnụ.
roadmap.h5_c: Usoro nkwụsi ike-audit-freeze bụ akara ngosi, Tor, I2P na WireGuard niile sochiri. Mwube ndị a na-emegharịgharị ghọrọ ihe a na-ahụkarị mgbe ọrụ Reproducible Builds (2014) gasịrị. Vortex na-eji ngwa ọrụ Reproducible Builds. Nta ahụhụ bụ ọkọlọtọ maka ọrụ ọ bụla na-ejikwa data onye ọrụ; $25k bụ etiti ọkwa site na ụkpụrụ 2025.
