glossary.title: Nkọwa okwu
glossary.subtitle: Okwu ọ bụla ejiri na Vortex docs, akọwapụtara ya.
glossary.intro: Ntuziaka mkpụrụedemede. Kaadị okwu ọ bụla na-agbasawanye na nkọwa zuru oke, ebe ejiri ya, akụkọ ya, yana usoro ma ọ bụ ọmụmaatụ mgbe ọ dị.

aead.title: AEAD
aead.subtitle: Eji Data emetụtara ezoro ezo.
aead.intro: AEAD (Ezo ya ezoro ezo na Associated Data) bụ ihe ochie nke na-ejikọta nzuzo na iguzosi ike n'ezi ihe n'otu oku. Nyere igodo, nonce, plaintext, na data agbakwunyere nhọrọ (AAD), ọ na-ewepụta akara njirimara ciphertext + nke na mmejọ ọ bụla nwere ederede doro anya, ederede ciphertext, ma ọ bụ AAD adaghị nyocha.
aead.h1_a: AEAD (Ezo ya ezoro ezo na Associated Data) bụ ihe ochie nke na-ejikọta nzuzo na iguzosi ike n'ezi ihe n'otu oku. Nyere igodo, nonce, plaintext, na data agbakwunyere nhọrọ (AAD), ọ na-ewepụta akara njirimara ciphertext + nke na mmejọ ọ bụla nwere ederede doro anya, ederede ciphertext, ma ọ bụ AAD adaghị nyocha.
aead.h1_b: Vortex's AEAD na-abụkarị AES-256-GCM. Oghere AAD ahụ na-ebu ọnọdụ onye nnata ga-amarịrị ka ọ decrypt nke ọma (ID ụlọ, id faịlụ, nkwụghachi). Njide AAD na-egbochi ikwugharị ihe dị n'okirikiri - ederede ederede sitere na ime ụlọ A enweghị ike igbanwe ya dị ka ụlọ B.
aead.h1_c: AEAD dị ka aha a na-akpọ primitive traces na Rogaway 2002. GCM (Galois/Counter Mode) bụ NIST na SP 800-38D (2007). Ọ ghọrọ ndabara AEAD na TLS 1.3 (RFC 8446, 2018). Usoro nchekwa nchekwa ọgbara ọhụrụ ọ bụla na-eji AEAD.
aead.h1_f:
AEAD.Enc(k, n, pt, aad) = (ct, mkpado) // ct = len(pt) bytes, mkpado = 16 bytes
AEAD.Dec(k, n, ct, mkpado, aad) = pt ma ọ bụ ⊥

alembic.title: Alembic
alembic.subtitle: Ngwá ọrụ mbugharị ọdụ data maka SQLAlchemy.
alembic.intro: Alembic bụ usoro mbugharị canonical maka SQLAlchemy. Mbugharị ọ bụla bụ faịlụ Python nwere ọrụ 'mmelite()' na 'downgrade()' na-akọwa mgbanwe schema dị ka ọrụ SQL ma ọ bụ ORM.
alembic.h1_a: Alembic bụ usoro mbugharị canonical maka SQLAlchemy. Mbugharị ọ bụla bụ faịlụ Python nwere ọrụ 'mmelite()' na 'downgrade()' na-akọwa mgbanwe schema dị ka ọrụ SQL ma ọ bụ ORM.
alembic.h1_b: Vortex na-eji Alembic nwere akụkọ nlegharị anya n'ahịrị (enweghị alaka). 'isi nkwalite alembic' na-agba na mmalite akpa Docker ọ bụla. 'alembic downgrade -1' na-atụgharị otu nzọụkwụ maka nlọghachi azụ. Ọnọdụ Dev na-eji `create_all + ALTER TABLE fallback` yabụ nrụgharị mpaghara anaghị achọ mbugharị na ntọala ntọala ọ bụla.
alembic.h1_c: Mike Bayer (onye edemede nke SQLAlchemy) dere Alembic na 2011 dị ka onye nọchiri 'sqlalchemy-migrate'. Mbugharị arụnyere n'ime Django (2014) gbaziri ụdị isi. Alembic nọgidere na-aga n'ihu na njirimara - rollback, autogenerate, branching - n'agbanyeghị Vortex anaghị eji alaka.
alembic.h1_f:
alembic/ụdị/
  20240101_<ntụgharị>_<slug>.py nke ọ bụla nwere nkwalite()/downgrade()

apns.title: APNs
apns.subtitle: Apple Ọrụ ngosi Push.
apns.intro: APNs bụ ọrụ ntinye ọkwa Apple maka iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, tvOS. Ngwa na-edebanye aha akara ngwaọrụ ma ndị na-eweta ya na-ezigara APN ụgwọ ngosi nke na-akwado ha na ngwaọrụ.
apns.h1_a: APNs bụ ọrụ ntinye ọkwa Apple maka iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, tvOS. Ngwa na-edebanye aha akara ngwaọrụ ma ndị na-eweta ya na-ezigara APN ụgwọ ngosi nke na-akwado ha na ngwaọrụ.
apns.h1_b: Vortex na-eji APN nwere envelopu mpịachi mechiri emechi: ọnụ na-ezobe ibu ọkwa ọkwa ọ bụla maka X25519 pubkey onye nnata; APNs na-ahụ naanị mpe mpe mpe akwa. Mgbatị ọrụ ngosi nke onye ahịa iOS decrypts na usoro dị iche tupu ewepụta ọkọlọtọ.
apns.h1_c: APN ji iOS 3.0 (2009) malite. Nkwado ọdịnaya nke push / mutable wetara na iOS 10 (2016). Token dabeere auth (.p8) dochie auth dabeere akwụkwọ dị ka ndabara na 2016. Vortex na-eji token auth na nkeji 60 na-eweta token.
apns.h3_a: FCM, Weebụ Push, akara akara, Mgbatị ọrụ ngosi

argon2id.title: Argon2id
argon2id.subtitle: Hash paswọọdụ siri ike ebe nchekwa (RFC 9106).
argon2id.intro: Argon2id bụ ebe nchekwa siri ike, ọrụ hashing okwuntughe na-egbochi ọwa. Oke: nha ebe nchekwa (m), ọnụ ahịa oge (iterations, t), myirịta (ụzọ, p), na ogologo hash. Ụdị 'id' ahụ na-agwakọta data na-adabereghị na ya (Argon2i) na data dabere (Argon2d) gafere.
argon2id.h1_a: Argon2id bụ ebe nchekwa siri ike, ọrụ hashing okwuntughe na-egbochi ọwa. Oke: nha ebe nchekwa (m), ọnụ ahịa oge (iterations, t), myirịta (ụzọ, p), na ogologo hash. Ụdị 'id' ahụ na-agwakọta data na-adabereghị na ya (Argon2i) na data dabere (Argon2d) gafere.
argon2id.h1_b: Vortex na-eji Argon2id na m=64MiB, t=3, p=4, hashLen=32. Nke a na-ewe ~ 0.5 s na iPhone X (ngwaọrụ anyị na-akwado ngwa ngwa) yana ihe dị ka 5 ms na njedebe dị elu ASIC - ọsọ ọsọ 100 × bụ ihe na-adịghị mma ma e jiri ya tụnyere SHA-256 hashes ebe ASIC meriri ọtụtụ nde.
argon2id.h1_c: Argon2 meriri 2015 Password Hashing Asọmpi haziri Dmitry Khovratovich na Alex Biryukov. Haziri dị ka RFC 9106 na 2021. Ejiri 1Password, Bitwarden, LastPass. Vortex's parameters si na OWASP 2023 ntụnye.
argon2id.h1_f:
Argon2id (okwuntughe, nnu, m, t, p, hashLen) → hash
ndabara: m=64MiB, t=3, p=4, hashLen=32
ọnụ ahịa ≈ 0.5s na iPhone X; ~ 5ms na ASIC (100× onye na-awakpo ọsọ)

blake3.title: BLAKE3
blake3.subtitle: Hash cryptographic ngwa ngwa.
blake3.intro: BLAKE3 bụ ọrụ hash cryptographic sitere na BLAKE2 na BLAKE. Na-emepụta mmepụta ogologo aka ike site na ntinye aka ike; 10 × ngwa ngwa karịa SHA-256 na nnukwu blobs ekele maka hashing osisi dị n'ime.
blake3.h1_a: BLAKE3 bụ ọrụ hash cryptographic sitere na BLAKE2 na BLAKE. Na-emepụta mmepụta ogologo aka ike site na ntinye aka ike; 10 × ngwa ngwa karịa SHA-256 na nnukwu blobs ekele maka hashing osisi dị n'ime.
blake3.h1_b: Vortex na-eji BLAKE3 maka iguzosi ike n'ezi faịlụ: faịlụ ọ bụla ebugotere na-ebu 'plain_blake3` hash nke ọdịnaya ya mebiri emebi ka ndị nnata wee nwee ike nyochaa mgbe nbudata + decrypt. A na-akpọ kọlụm DB 'sha256' n'akụkọ ihe mere eme maka ndakọrịta mbata mana nwere mmepụta BLAKE3.
blake3.h1_c: Jack O'Connor et al tọhapụrụ BLAKE3. na 2020. Si na BLAKE rịdata, nke bụ SHA-3 finalist na 2012. The tree-hashing design lets BLAKE3 scale with cores for big input. SHA-256 ka dị ngwa ngwa maka obere ntinye; BLAKE3 na-achịkwa ihe ọ bụla> 4 KiB.
blake3.h1_f:
BLAKE3(bytes) = 32 bytes // mmepụta ndabara
BLAKE3(bytes, len) = len bytes (XOF)
ntinye: ~ 3 GB/s na Apple Silicon vs SHA-256 ~ 500 MB/s
blake3.h3_a: SHA-256, faịlụ iguzosi ike n'ezi ihe, mkpado

bmp.title: BMP
bmp.subtitle: Protocol igbe ozi kpuru ìsì.
bmp.intro: BMP bụ Vortex oyi akwa na-aga n'ihu na-amaghị aha. Ndị na-ezipụ ego na-edobe blọb ezoro ezo n'ọnụ ọnụ asịrị ọ bụla, nke ejiri otu ụzọ hash nke pubkey onye nnata tinye ya. Blobs na-agba asịrị ruo mgbe ọnụ nke onye nnata dọtara.
bmp.h1_a: BMP bụ Vortex oyi akwa na-aga n'ihu na-amaghị aha. Ndị na-ezipụ ego na-edobe blọb ezoro ezo n'ọnụ ọnụ asịrị ọ bụla, nke ejiri otu ụzọ hash nke pubkey onye nnata tinye ya. Blobs na-agba asịrị ruo mgbe ọnụ nke onye nnata dọtara.
bmp.h1_b: BMP na-enye ihe nzuzo atọ nwere onwe ha: zoro ezo onye na-ezipụ (TLS + yabasị nhọrọ), onye nnata-ezo (igbe ozi_id bụ ihe na-adịghị mma na oghere etiti), na-ezobe ọdịnaya (blob adịlarị E2E-ezoro ezo). Max blob 1 MB, otu ọnụ okpu 500 MB, ọnụego nkwụnye ego 10/min/IP, TTL 7200 s.
bmp.h1_c: Ndị otu Vortex mere BMP site na ọkọ. Anyị wuru ya n'ihi na ọ nweghị onye ozi ọ bụla dị njikere ịkwụ ụgwọ injinia nke izobe ngwụcha ngwụcha ruo ngwụcha metadata - ha na-ezochi ọdịnaya mana ha na-agbapụta eserese mmekọrịta. Ọnọdụ anyị site n'ụbọchị mbụ bụ na onye ozi echekwara nke na-agbapụta onye na-agwa ya okwu nwere naanị ọkara nchebe. BMP na-emechi ọkara ahụ site n'ime ka onye na-ezipụ, onye nnata, na ọdịnaya nwere onwe ya na-edoghị anya, n'elu asịrị nke Vortex nke asịrị karịa ka etinyere na akụrụngwa.
bmp.h3_a: asịrị, ọrụ yabasị, onye na-ezite akara, ọdọ mmiri

cbor.title: CBOR
cbor.subtitle: Nnọchite anya ihe ọnụọgụ abụọ dị nkenke.
cbor.intro: CBOR (RFC 8949) bụ usoro data ọnụọgụ abụọ emebere maka obere koodu na ntinye ngwa ngwa. Superset nke ụdị data JSON, nwere koodu ọnụọgụ abụọ, na-ekpebisi ike.
cbor.h1_a: CBOR (RFC 8949) bụ usoro data ọnụọgụ abụọ emebere maka obere koodu na ntinye ngwa ngwa. Superset nke ụdị data JSON, nwere koodu ọnụọgụ abụọ, na-ekpebisi ike.
cbor.h1_b: Vortex na-eji CBOR dị ka usoro ịkwụ ụgwọ n'ime envelopu AES-GCM. ~ 30% pere mpe karịa JSON na unicode-oke nkata; ntule siri ike (enweghị ihe mgbagwoju anya na-acha ọcha) na-eguzogide mwakpo parser-differential; enweghị atụmatụ ya mere ịgbakwunye ubi anaghị achọ nchikota .proto.
cbor.h1_c: A haziri CBOR dị ka RFC 7049 na 2013, emelitere ka ọ bụrụ RFC 8949 na 2020. Eji Signal na-eme ya (ịkpụkọ n'ime kemgbe 2017), Matrix's state-resolution Layer, WebAuthns. Nke Vortex họpụtara na v0.0.2 mgbe atụnyere megide JSON na protobuf.
cbor.h1_f:
CBOR ntinye koodu: {isi_ụdị (bit 3), arụmụka (bit 5), [data]}
map: ụdị=5 ụzọ abụọ
array: type=4 element
ederede: ụdị=3 bytes
bytes: ụdị = 2 raw
cbor.h2_a: Envelopu ozi ọ bụla, ugwo nkwụnye ego ejiri akara akara, envelopu gọọmentị ọ bụla.

controller.title: Onye njikwa
controller.subtitle: Ọrụ akaebe + Vortex.
controller.intro: Onye njikwa bụ usoro Python dị iche (`vortex_controller`) nke naanị ọrụ ya na-ebipụta akwụkwọ ngosi mbinye aka (`INTEGRITY.sig.json`) na URL ntinye. Ndị ahịa na-atụnye mkpịsị ugodi Ed25519 onye njikwa na oge ntọhapụ.
controller.h1_a: Onye njikwa bụ usoro Python dị iche (`vortex_controller`) nke naanị ọrụ ya na-ebipụta akwụkwọ ngosi mbinye aka (`INTEGRITY.sig.json`) na URL ntinye. Ndị ahịa na-atụnye mkpịsị ugodi Ed25519 onye njikwa na oge ntọhapụ.
controller.h1_b: Na-ekpughe ntakịrị API elu (~ ụzọ 12). Elu dị warara bụ ụma — ọ bụ ebumnuche ọgụ kachasị ọnụ ahịa ozugbo ndị ahịa tụbara ya. Igwefoto na-agba otu koodu na otu igodo ntọhapụ; DNS/SNS/IPFS bipụta ndepụta enyo.
controller.h1_c: Ewebata na v0.0.3 mgbe mbụ monolith version kegide ọnụ ịgba akaebe na ọnụ onwe ya (a mie ala ọnụ nwere ike ịgha ụgha banyere koodu nke ya). Ịkewa akaebe n'ime usoro dị iche nke emere ka ahapụchara Debian.gpg + ụlọ ahịa mgbọrọgwụ Chrome.
controller.h3_a: ngosipụta iguzosi ike n'ezi ihe, igodo ntọhapụ, enyo, trusted_nodes

doubleRatchet.title: Ratchet ugboro abụọ
doubleRatchet.subtitle: Usoro nzuzo kwa-DM Signal.
doubleRatchet.intro: Ugboro abụọ Ratchet na-ejikọta ratchet Diffie-Hellman na yinye igodo symmetric. Ozi ọ bụla na-aga n'ihu agbụ ya; periodic DH rattchets re-key mgbọrọgwụ. Na-ebuga nzuzo nzuzo (ozi gara aga dị mma ma emebie ya) yana nchekwa nbibi (ozi ga-eme n'ọdịnihu dị mma ma emezigharị ya).
doubleRatchet.h1_a: Ugboro abụọ Ratchet na-ejikọta ratchet Diffie-Hellman na yinye igodo symmetric. Ozi ọ bụla na-aga n'ihu agbụ ya; periodic DH rattchets re-key mgbọrọgwụ. Na-ebuga nzuzo nzuzo (ozi gara aga dị mma ma emebie ya) yana nchekwa nbibi (ozi ga-eme n'ọdịnihu dị mma ma emezigharị ya).
doubleRatchet.h1_b: Vortex na-eji Double Ratchet maka ụdọ ozi ozugbo. Ime ụlọ otu na-eji atụmatụ igodo izipu dị mfe agbapụ na mgbọrọgwụ ụlọ. Ogologo yinye kpuchiri ozi 1000 tupu mmanye emegharịghachi; cache igodo wụsara ruru 1000 na-enweghị usoro; ezoro ezo nkụnye eji isi mee na ndabara.
doubleRatchet.h1_c: Trevor Perrin na Moxie Marlinspike chepụtara na 2013; etinyere na Signal 2014; WhatsApp nakweere (2016), Mkparịta ụka Nzuzo Facebook, Mkparịta ụka nzuzo nke Skype. Public spec 2016. Vortex's mmejuputa iwu bụ ọdụ ụgbọ mmiri ozugbo.
doubleRatchet.h1_f:
yinye izipu: CK_send → HKDF(CK_send, "nzọụkwụ") → CK_send'
                    MK → HKDF(CK_send, "msg")
Ịnata yinye: CK_recv → HKDF(CK_recv, "nzọụkwụ") → CK_recv'
DH ratchet: RK, CK = HKDF(DH(anyị_eph, ha_eph), RK_prev)
doubleRatchet.h3_a: nzuzo na-aga n'ihu, nchekwa ga-esochi nkwekọrịta, X25519

ech.title: ECH
ech.subtitle: Ndewo onye ahịa ezoro ezo (RFC 9460).
ech.intro: ECH na-ezochi SNI (Ngosipụta Aha Server) na TLS 1.3 site na ijichi ClientHello dị n'ime n'ime ClientHello ezoro ezo n'okpuru igodo ọha na-ebipụta na ndekọ DNS HTTPS.
ech.h1_a: ECH na-ezochi SNI (Ngosipụta Aha Server) na TLS 1.3 site na ijichi ClientHello dị n'ime n'ime ClientHello ezoro ezo n'okpuru igodo ọha na-ebipụta na ndekọ DNS HTTPS.
ech.h1_b: Vortex nodes na-ebipụta ECHConfigs na ndekọ DNS HTTPS ha. Ndị ahịa nwere nkwado ECH na-eji aha nnabata mpụga (dịka `vortex-public.cloudflare.com`) dị ka ihe a na-ahụ anya SNI; ndị na-ekiri ihe na-adịghị mma na-ahụ naanị aha elu ahụ. DPI enweghị ike ịgwa onye ahịa Vortex n'aka onye ahịa Cloudflare ọ bụla ọzọ.
ech.h1_c: ECH wee site 5 IETF drafts tupu standardization dị ka RFC 9460 na 2024. Ndị dị iche iche nke mbụ: ESNI (2018-2019, gbahapụrụ), ECH draft-00 ka draft-13-2042. Agbanyere Chrome ECH site na ndabara na 2023; Firefox na 2024. Vortex na-akwado ya kemgbe v0.0.9.
ech.h1_f:
outer SNI: "public.cloudflare.com" ← ndị na-ekiri ihe na-ahụ anya
ime SNI: "node.vortex.example" ← ezoro ezo
ECHConfig: bipụtara na DNS HTTPS ndekọ nke ngalaba mpụta

ed25519.subtitle: EdDSA mbinye aka n'elu edwards25519 (RFC 8032).
ed25519.intro: Ed25519 bụ atụmatụ mbinye aka elliptical-curve. 32-byte ọhaneze igodo, 64-byte mbinye aka, deterministic bịanyere aka na ndabara. Nnwale ngwa ngwa (~ 200µs na CPU ọgbara ọhụrụ), enwere ike ịnwapụta ogbe.
ed25519.h1_a: Ed25519 bụ atụmatụ mbinye aka elliptical-curve. 32-byte ọhaneze igodo, 64-byte mbinye aka, deterministic bịanyere aka na ndabara. Nnwale ngwa ngwa (~ 200µs na CPU ọgbara ọhụrụ), enwere ike ịnwapụta ogbe.
ed25519.h1_b: Vortex bịanyere aka na envelopu gọọmentị ọ bụla, iguzosi ike n'ezi ihe ọ bụla gosipụtara, nkwupụta ọnụ ọ bụla, yana ozi bot ọ bụla na Ed25519. Apple's CryptoKit na iOS 17+ na-eji ụdị RFC 8032bis enweghị usoro; Vortex na-anabata nke ọ bụla - ihe nyocha ọ bụla na-akwado ha abụọ.
ed25519.h1_c: Ed25519 bụ Bernstein, Duif, Lange, Schwabe, Yang bipụtara na 2011. Haziri dị ka RFC 8032 na 2017. OpenSSH 6.5 (2014) nabatara ya, TLS 1.3, Apple Signal-prochain, Keytocol. Ahọpụtara mbinye aka n'ụzọ doro anya karịa ECDSA iji zere ECDSA RNG-ejigharị klaasị adịghị ike.
ed25519.h1_f:
Akara (d, m): r = SHA-512(d ∥ m)
              R = r · G
              c = SHA-512(R ∥ A ∥ m)
              S = r + c · a
              laghachi (R, S)
Nyochaa: c = SHA-512(R ∥ A ∥ m);  R + c·A ≟ S·G
ed25519.h3_a: X25519, ECDSA, mbinye aka, nzuzo nzuzo

fanout.title: Fans-apụ
fanout.subtitle: Na-agbasa mmemme site n'otu ebe gaa na ọtụtụ ndị debanyere aha.
fanout.intro: Fan-out bụ ụkpụrụ ụkpụrụ ụlọ ebe otu onye na-emepụta ihe na-ewepụta mmemme na ndị na-azụ ahịa N na-enweta ya. Na oyi akwa Vortex's WebSocket, otu ozi POST na-akpalite oghere N na-eziga - otu onye debanyere aha n'ime ụlọ.
fanout.h1_a: Fan-out bụ ụkpụrụ ụkpụrụ ụlọ ebe otu onye na-emepụta ihe na-ewepụta mmemme na ndị na-azụ ahịa N na-enweta ya. Na oyi akwa Vortex's WebSocket, otu ozi POST na-akpalite oghere N na-eziga - otu onye debanyere aha n'ime ụlọ.
fanout.h1_b: Emebere ya dị ka ihe njikwa ọnụ ụlọ ọ bụla nke WebSocket ejiri asyncio.Lock chekwa ya. Dee enwetara, detuo ihe a tọhapụrụ, wepụta ya, megharịakwa otu nke na-eche `ws.send_bytes(ibu ụgwọ)' na oge nkwụsị nke otu socket 1. Ndị na-eri ihe na-eji nwayọ nwere kwụ n'ahịrị 256 tupu okpomoku adapụ.
fanout.h1_c: Fans-out laghachiri ibipụta/ịdenye aha sistemu na 1980s (POP, TIBCO). Eserese ọgbara ọhụrụ (Kafka, Redis pub/sub, NATS) na-eme ka usoro ahụ ruru nde nde ndị debanyere aha. Vortex's per-room in-memory fan-out bụ nke pere mpe n'ihi na ọ chọghị mmegharị ọnụ ụzọ n'otu ụdị ọnụ; Redis pub/sub na-arụ ọrụ na ụyọkọ ọnụ ọtụtụ.
fanout.h1_f:
Mgbasa ozi(room_id, ụgwọ ọrụ):
  ndebanye aha = fanout[room_id] # O(1) nyocha dict
  maka ws na foto ọnya (ndebanye aha): # detuo ka ọ na-emegharị n'enweghị nsogbu
      chere ws.send_bytes(ngwunye, oge nkwụsị =1s)
fanout.h2_a: 'app/chats/fanout.py', ụzọ kacha mma maka ozi ọ bụla, mmeghachi omume, mmemme pịnye, mgbama oku.
fanout.h3_a: WebSocket, onye debanyere aha, Redis pub/sub, kwụ n'ahịrị

fcm.title: FCM
fcm.subtitle: Izi ozi igwe ojii Firebase.
fcm.intro: FCM bụ ọrụ ntinye ọkwa Google maka gam akporo, iOS, webụ. Dochiri nke ochie Google Cloud Messaging (GCM) na 2016. Nabata OAuth2 ọrụ-akaụntụ.
fcm.h1_a: FCM bụ ọrụ ntinye ọkwa Google maka gam akporo, iOS, webụ. Dochiri nke ochie Google Cloud Messaging (GCM) na 2016. Nabata OAuth2 ọrụ-akaụntụ.
fcm.h1_b: Vortex na-eji FCM n'ụdị 'data' (ọ bụghị 'ụdị ngosi') yabụ ọrụ FirebaseMessaging nke ngwa ahụ na-aga mgbe ọ bịarutere wee mebie ụgwọ ntinye akara tupu ekpebie ma ọ ga-egosi ọkọlọtọ. Mwelite nnyefe nke jụụ na-ejikwa ozi data FCM.
fcm.h1_c: FCM bidoro na 2016 dochie GCM. Akwụsịla ihe nketa HTTP njedebe na 2024; Vortex na-eji HTTP v1 njedebe na OAuth2. A na-akpachi anya ntụgharị akara elekere ọ bụla site na nzere akaụntụ ọrụ agbakwunyere.
fcm.h3_a: APNs, Weebụ Push, ntinye akara akara, OAuth2

federation.title: Federation
federation.subtitle: Mgbasa ozi ntụkwasị obi n'etiti ọnụ ụzọ Vortex nọọrọ onwe ya.
federation.intro: Federation bụ njikọ ntụkwasị obi n'etiti ndị ọrụ ọnụ abụọ. Onye ọ bụla na-agbakwụnye igodo pub Ed25519 na tebụl 'federations' ya. Ndị ọrụ nọ na ọnụ A nwere ike iziga ndị ọrụ na ọnụ B site na iji envelopu na-ebugharị site na 'POST / federation/deliver' bịanyere aka na ya.
federation.h1_a: Federation bụ njikọ ntụkwasị obi n'etiti ndị ọrụ ọnụ abụọ. Onye ọ bụla na-agbakwụnye igodo pub Ed25519 na tebụl 'federations' ya. Ndị ọrụ nọ na ọnụ A nwere ike iziga ndị ọrụ na ọnụ B site na iji envelopu na-ebugharị site na 'POST / federation/deliver' bịanyere aka na ya.
federation.h1_b: Ịbanye n'otu onye ọrụ: enweghị "ọnụ ọ bụla nwere ike ịmekọrịta" ndabara. Ịgbakwunye onye ọgbọ chọrọ ihe nchịkwa onye ọrụ bịanyere aka na ya. Akara ahụike (AIMD ±1) kwụsịtụrụ n'etiti ndị ọgbọ na-akpa àgwà ọjọọ. Igbe mbupụ na-emegharị nnyefe dara ada yana ihe nkwụghachi ụgwọ ruru ụbọchị iri na anọ.
federation.h1_c: Federation bụ njirimara egbu egbu nke Matrix (2014) na tupu nke ahụ XMPP/Jabber (1999). Nhazi Vortex sitere na ha abụọ: envelopu bịanyere aka na ya (Matrix), arịlịka ntụkwasị obi doro anya (ma - anyị siri sie ike), akara ahụike (AIMD sitere na TCP). Agbakwunyere na v0.0.5.

fts5.title: FTS5
fts5.subtitle: Tebụl mebere ederede SQLite zuru oke.
fts5.intro: FTS5 bụ nchọta ederede zuru oke nke ọgbọ ise nke SQLite. Na-emepụta tebụl mebere nke na-echekwa akara ngosi akara maka ajụjụ ọsọ ọsọ LIKE / MATCH.
fts5.h1_a: FTS5 bụ nchọta ederede zuru oke nke ọgbọ ise nke SQLite. Na-emepụta tebụl mebere nke na-echekwa akara ngosi akara maka ajụjụ ọsọ ọsọ LIKE / MATCH.
fts5.h1_b: Vortex mirrors tokens plaintext (onye ahịa ezoro ezo dị ka mkpado opaque) n'ime tebụl mebere FTS5 wee chọọ wee daa `O(log n)` kama nyocha 'O(n)'. N'ime ime ụlọ Android, FTS4 na-eji ihe mkpalite na-emekọrịta ihe na tebụl mebere. Nbugharị postgres na-eji `tsvector` / `tsquery` maka otu ebumnuche.
fts5.h1_c: FTS laghachiri na SQLite 3.7 (2010). FTS5 ezigara na SQLite 3.9 (2015). Nabata nke ọma; ngwa ozi izizi mpaghara ọ bụla na iOS / Android na-eji ya. Postgres enweela 'tsvector' kemgbe 8.3 (2008).

gossip.title: ⟪0 ⟫Spip
gossip.subtitle: Mgbanwe ndepụta ndị ọgbọ oge n'etiti ọnụ ọnụ Vortex.
gossip.intro: Gossip bụ usoro na-arụ ọrụ nke ọma bandwidth ebe ọnụ nke ọ bụla na-eji ndị ọgbọ na-agbanwe ihe ọmụma achịkọtara kwa oge. Ka oge na-aga, ọnụ ọnụ ọ bụla na-ejikọta n'otu nlele ahụ na-enweghị akwụkwọ ndekọ aha etiti.
gossip.h1_a: Gossip bụ usoro na-arụ ọrụ nke ọma bandwidth ebe ọnụ nke ọ bụla na-eji ndị ọgbọ na-agbanwe ihe ọmụma achịkọtara kwa oge. Ka oge na-aga, ọnụ ọnụ ọ bụla na-ejikọta n'otu nlele ahụ na-enweghị akwụkwọ ndekọ aha etiti.
gossip.h1_b: Vortex nodes na-agba asịrị kwa sekọnd 60 ọ bụla. Onye ọ bụla mgbanwe bụ 256-bit Bloom nyo na-achịkọta ndị ọgbọ ama ama; akụkụ nke ọzọ na-aza ndị ọgbọ na-efu na nzacha gbakwunyere nzacha nke ya. Bandwit bụ O (ndị ọgbọ ọhụrụ × 32 B), na-adịkarị n'okpuru 1 KiB kwa okirikiri.
gossip.h1_c: Ụbọchị nzacha Bloom-filter na Cornell's 1998 bimodal multicast paper. Apache Cassandra na-eji ya maka ịbụ otu; Bitcoin maka nnyefe azụmahịa; IPFS maka ndozi DHT. Njikọ O(log N) bụ ihe na-eme ka ọ baa uru maka nnukwu netwọkụ.
gossip.h1_f:
mgbanwe (A, B):
  A → B: filter_A = itinye_all (ndị ọgbọ_A, k=5, m=256)
  B → A: new_peers_for_A = {p ∈ peers_B : p ∉ filter_A}, filter_B
  A extracts yiri
oke ọnụego: 1 mgbanwe kwa ọgbọ kwa 30 s
gossip.h3_a: Nzacha oge ntoju, eriri akpụkpọ ụkwụ, federation, ndị ọgbọ

gravitix.title: Gravitix
gravitix.subtitle: Vortex's DSL maka ide bots.
gravitix.intro: Gravitix bụ asụsụ akọwapụtara ngalaba ahaziri maka ide bots Vortex. Ndị na-ahụ maka ihe omume ('on/start { emit "hi"}`), steeti arụnyere, obere efere efere. Achịkọtara na bytecode wee mee n'ime ntụgharị okwu nwere igbe ájá.
gravitix.h1_a: Gravitix bụ asụsụ akọwapụtara ngalaba ahaziri maka ide bots Vortex. Ndị na-ahụ maka ihe omume ('on/start { emit "hi"}`), steeti arụnyere, obere efere efere. Achịkọtara na bytecode wee mee n'ime ntụgharị okwu nwere igbe ájá.
gravitix.h1_b: Nhọrọ nke Python SDK. Bots Gravitix enweghị ike ịnweta sistemụ faịlụ ma ọ bụ netwọk aka ike - naanị Vortex's API elu. Compiler na-emepụta bytecode; oge ọsọ Rust na ntụgharị `Gravitix/`. Ntụaka zuru oke na isi akwụkwọ Gravitix.
gravitix.h1_c: Emebere ya n'oge v0.0.6 mgbe ọ hụchara na ọtụtụ koodu bot bụ 80% SDK efere efere gburugburu obere kernel nke ezi uche. A DSL na-ahapụ echiche ahụ na-enwu na ihe egwu igbe ájá. Yiri n'ime mmụọ na Hubot (2011) mana nwere igbe igbe siri ike yana njikọta Vortex.
gravitix.h2_a: `Gravitix/` repo mgbọrọgwụ, bot code field in `POST /api/bots`.

hkdf.title: HKDF
hkdf.subtitle: Ọrụ isi wepụta HMAC (RFC 5869).
hkdf.intro: HKDF bụ ọrụ mwepu ụzọ ụzọ abụọ: Wepụ mkpakọ ihe igodo ntinye n'ime igodo pseudo-random (PRK); Mgbasawanye na-agbatị PRK n'ime ihe igodo mmepụta nke ogologo ọ bụla, nke akara ozi kewapụrụ.
hkdf.h1_a: HKDF bụ ọrụ mwepu ụzọ ụzọ abụọ: Wepụ mkpakọ ihe igodo ntinye n'ime igodo pseudo-random (PRK); Mgbasawanye na-agbatị PRK n'ime ihe igodo mmepụta nke ogologo ọ bụla, nke akara ozi kewapụrụ.
hkdf.h1_b: Vortex na-eji HKDF-SHA256 ebe niile: kewaa X25519 kesara nzuzo na nzuzo + MAC + igodo nkụnye eji isi mee, na-enweta igodo faịlụ ọ bụla, na-enweta igodo ndabere na mmepụta Argon2id. Uriri ozi mgbe niile na-ebu prefix ụdịdị (dịka "v1: izo ya ezo") ka usoro igodo niile nwere ike ịtụgharị site na ịpị v1 → v2.
hkdf.h1_c: Hugo Krawczyk bipụtara na EUROCRYPT 2010; ahaziri dịka RFC 5869 n'otu afọ ahụ. Ejiri TLS 1.3 mee ihe maka nhazi oge ya, akara ngosi maka Ratchet Double, WireGuard maka igodo nnọkọ.
hkdf.h1_f:
Mwepụta: PRK = HMAC-SHA256(nnu, IKM)
Gbasaa: T (1) = HMAC-SHA256(PRK, ozi ∥ 0x01)
          T(i) = HMAC-SHA256(PRK, T(i-1) ∥ ozi ∥ i)
          OKM = T (1) ∥ T (2) ∥ … gbajiri na oghere.

hmac.title: HMAC
hmac.subtitle: Koodu nyocha ozi dabere na Hash (RFC 2104).
hmac.intro: HMAC bụ ihe owuwu na-atụgharị hash cryptographic ọ bụla (SHA-256, SHA-512) ka ọ bụrụ MAC. Na-enye iguzosi ike n'ezi ihe na nkwenye nyere nzuzo nzuzo.
hmac.h1_a: HMAC bụ ihe owuwu na-atụgharị hash cryptographic ọ bụla (SHA-256, SHA-512) ka ọ bụrụ MAC. Na-enye iguzosi ike n'ezi ihe na nkwenye nyere nzuzo nzuzo.
hmac.h1_b: Vortex na-eji HMAC-SHA256 na HKDF, maka JWT mbinye aka (HS256), maka ntinye_pseudo n'ime ụlọ, yana maka mbinye aka nzere TURN. Achọrọ ntụle oge niile n'akụkụ nkwenye - `hmac.compare_digest` na Python.
hmac.h1_c: Bellare, Canetti, Krawczyk webatara HMAC na 1996. Haziri dịka RFC 2104 (1997) na FIPS 198 (2002). Bụrụ onye ndabara MAC na TLS, IPsec, SSH. Signal, Matrix, Discord, Slack niile na-eji HMAC-SHA256 maka akara ngosi JWT na nnọkọ.
hmac.h1_f:
HMAC(igodo, msg) = H ( (igodo ⊕ opad) ∥ H( (key ⊕ ipad) ∥ msg ) )
  ebe opad = 0x5c ugboro ugboro, ipad = 0x36 ugboro ugboro, ngọngọ nha nha H.
hmac.h2_a: Ebe ọ bụla na nchịkọta crypto. Grep maka `hmac_sha256` ma ọ bụ `HKDF`.
hmac.h3_a: HKDF, JWT, SHA-256, atụnyere oge niile

ice.title: ICE
ice.subtitle: Mmebe Njikọta mmekọrịta (RFC 8445).
ice.intro: ICE bụ usoro WebRTC maka ịchọta ụzọ netwọkụ n'etiti ndị ọgbọ abụọ n'azụ NAT. Ndị ọgbọ na-edepụta ndị ga-aga ime (onye ọbịa, ihe nkesa-reflexive, relay), gbanwee ha, ma gbalịa ụzọ abụọ ruo mgbe otu ga-aga nke ọma.
ice.h1_a: ICE bụ usoro WebRTC maka ịchọta ụzọ netwọkụ n'etiti ndị ọgbọ abụọ n'azụ NAT. Ndị ọgbọ na-edepụta ndị ga-aga ime (onye ọbịa, ihe nkesa-reflexive, relay), gbanwee ha, ma gbalịa ụzọ abụọ ruo mgbe otu ga-aga nke ọma.
ice.h1_b: Ndị na-ere ahịa ọnụ Vortex ICE mgbanwe nhoputa ndi ochichi site na akara ngosi WebSocket. coturn na-enye STUN (maka nchọpụta srflx) na TURN (maka relay ma ọ bụrụ na ụzọ awara awara ada). A na-enye nzere HMAC dị mkpụmkpụ n'otu oku.
ice.h1_c: A haziri ICE dị ka RFC 5245 (2010) wee nweta ume dị ka RFC 8445 (2018). N'azụ ọkwa ọkwa NAT, ụzọ kwụ ọtọ na-ada ~ 15% nke oge - TURN relay bụ ihe a na-apụghị izere ezere. WebRTC mere ICE mainstream; ngwaahịa oku vidiyo ọ bụla na-eji ya.
ice.h1_f:
ndi choro:
  onye ọbịa: rtp://192.168.1.5:49152 (mpaghara IP)
  srflx : rtp://203.0.113.5:49152 (STUN-achọpụtara adreesị ọha)
  relay : rtp://turn.vortex:49153 (TURN-ekenyefe relay)
nlele abụọ: STUN Arịrịọ Binding; ụzọ abụọ ga-aga nke ọma = họrọ
ice.h3_a: WebRTC, TURN, STUN, coturn, NAT njem

jwt.title: JWT
jwt.subtitle: JSON Web Token (RFC 7519).
jwt.intro: JWT bụ kọmpat token usoro nwere akụkụ atọ nwere base64-url: nkụnye eji isi mee, ibu ụgwọ (nzọrọ), mbinye aka. Ejiri ya maka nyocha nnọkọ na-enweghị steeti.
jwt.h1_a: JWT bụ kọmpat token usoro nwere akụkụ atọ nwere base64-url: nkụnye eji isi mee, ibu ụgwọ (nzọrọ), mbinye aka. Ejiri ya maka nyocha nnọkọ na-enweghị steeti.
jwt.h1_b: Vortex na-eji HS256 (HMAC-SHA256) JWT. Nweta akara na-ebu `{sub: user_id, jti: device_id, typ: access, exp}`, 15 min TTL. Ihe ngosi ume ọhụrụ 'ụdị: ume ọhụrụ', 30 d TTL. Binyere aka na nzuzo 64-byte site na `.env`. Enweghị nkwuputa nwere mmetụta gafere user_id.
jwt.h1_c: A haziri JWT dị ka RFC 7519 (2015). OAuth 2.0 emewo ka ha gbasaa kemgbe 2012. Afọ iri nkatọ: ọgụ mgbagha alg, enweghị mwepu. Vortex na-ebelata: HS256 naanị (enweghị RS/ES mgbagwoju anya), jti-keyed ngwaọrụ (nwere ike iwepụ ya site na onye ọrụ_ngwaọrụ).
jwt.h1_f:
HEADER.PAYLOAD.SIGNATURE
nkụnye eji isi mee = base64url ({alg: "HS256", ụdị: "JWT")
ugwo = base64url ({sub, jti, typ, exp})
sig = base64url (HMAC-SHA256 (ihe nzuzo, nkụnye eji isi mee + "." + akwụ ụgwọ))
jwt.h3_a: HMAC, OAuth 2.0, nweta ume, akara ohere

kyber.title: Kyber-768
kyber.subtitle: Mkpuchi igodo n'ihu-quantum (FIPS 203).
kyber.intro: Kyber-768 (nke a na-akpọ ML-KEM-768) bụ NIST NIST nwere usoro nkpuchi isi ihe nkpuchi post-quantum. Igodo ọha 1184-byte, 1088-byte ciphertexts, 32-byte kesara nzuzo. Nchekwa na-ebelata ka Module-LWE, ekwenyere na quantum-hard.
kyber.h1_a: Kyber-768 (nke a na-akpọ ML-KEM-768) bụ NIST NIST nwere usoro nkpuchi isi ihe nkpuchi post-quantum. Igodo ọha 1184-byte, 1088-byte ciphertexts, 32-byte kesara nzuzo. Nchekwa na-ebelata ka Module-LWE, ekwenyere na quantum-hard.
kyber.h1_b: Vortex na-eji Kyber mee nhọrọ na ngwakọ: ` session_key = HKDF(x25519_out ∥ kyber_out, info=" session-v1")`. Ọ bụrụ na ọkara nke ọ bụla na-ejide, nnọkọ ahụ adịghị mma. Ịbanye na v0.1, na-site na ndabara emebere maka v0.2. Ọnụ: ~ 2 KB mgbakwunye n'otu aka aka; latency negligible.
kyber.h1_c: Kyber bụ otu n'ime ~70 ntinye aka na asọmpi NIST's PQ (2016). Ahọpụtara maka nhazi ọkwa na Julaị 2022; emechara ka FIPS 203 n'August 2024. Chrome nyeere ngwakọ Kyber aka na TLS 1.3 na 2024. Signal tinye ya na protocol ha n'otu afọ ahụ.
kyber.h1_f:
KeyGen(): (pk ∈ Zq^k, sk ∈ Zq^k) pk = 1184 B, sk = 2400 B
Ihe mkpuchi (pk): (ct ∈ Zq^k, ss ∈ {0,1}²⁵⁶) ct = 1088 B
Mkpọpu (sk,ct): ss ∈ {0,1}²⁵⁶
ngwakọ = HKDF(x25519_out ∥ kyber_out, "nnọkọ-v1")
kyber.h3_a: X25519, HKDF, quantum eguzogide, ngwakọ KEM

mailbox.title: Igbe ozi
mailbox.subtitle: Oghere nchekwa azara onye nnata na BMP.
mailbox.intro: Igbe ozi bụ abstraction nke BMP maka "ebe ozi maka echere onye nnata nyere". Achọpụtara ya site na 'igbe ozi_id' nke 32-byte ewepụtara site na igodo pub nke nnata site na HKDF.
mailbox.h1_a: Igbe ozi bụ abstraction nke BMP maka "ebe ozi maka echere onye nnata nyere". Achọpụtara ya site na 'igbe ozi_id' nke 32-byte ewepụtara site na igodo pub nke nnata site na HKDF.
mailbox.h1_b: Naanị onye zitere (onye maara recipient_pubkey) na onye nnata (onye maara pubkey nke ha) nwere ike gbakọọ igbe ozi mail_id nyere. Ọnụ etiti na-ahụ naanị ihe nchọpụta 32-byte na-adịghị ahụkebe. Igbe ozi ọ bụla nwere TTL 7200 s yana okpu nchekwa 500 MB kwa ọnụ.
mailbox.h1_c: Okwu a sitere na email oge gboo. BMP na-agbaziri ihe atụ mana ọ na-eme ka onye nnata igbe ozi nweta karịa ihe nkesa nyere - enweghị usoro “igbe igbe ozi”, enweghị ihe nkesa na-ama adreesị dị.
mailbox.h1_f:
mailbox_id = HKDF(onye nnata_pubkey, info="bmp-v1", len=32)
naanị onye zitere (maara nnata_pk) na onye nnata (maara pk nke ya) nwere ike ịgbakọ
mailbox.h3_a: BMP, asịrị, HKDF, onye zitere akara

nonce.title: Ọbụghị
nonce.subtitle: Ọnụọgụ ejiri otu ugboro - uru eji otu oge.
nonce.intro: A nonce bụ uru na-ekwesịghị ikwugharị n'okpuru igodo enyere. Na Vortex ọrụ ọ bụla AES-GCM na-eji 96-bit ọhụrụ nonce. Iji otu igodo nonce emegharị ọzọ na-emebi nzuzo na eziokwu - onye mwakpo nwere ederede abụọ n'okpuru otu (igodo, enweghị) nwere ike nwetaghachi XOR ederede doro anya.
nonce.h1_a: A nonce bụ uru na-ekwesịghị ikwugharị n'okpuru igodo enyere. Na Vortex ọrụ ọ bụla AES-GCM na-eji 96-bit ọhụrụ nonce. Iji otu igodo nonce emegharị ọzọ na-emebi nzuzo na eziokwu - onye mwakpo nwere ederede abụọ n'okpuru otu (igodo, enweghị) nwere ike nwetaghachi XOR ederede doro anya.
nonce.h1_b: Vortex na-ewepụta ihe efu na OS CSPRNG (`secrets.token_bytes`, `SecRandom`, `java.security.SecureRandom`). Ụbọchị ọmụmụ ejiri 96 bits: ~ 2 ^ 32 ozi tupu nkukota aghọ ihe ezi uche dị na ya, karịa ka igodo ọnụ ụlọ ọ bụla na-ahụ n'oge ndụ ya. Nchekwa oyi oyi-nonce nsochi na ọnụ dị ka eriri-na-nkwusioru.
nonce.h1_c: Echiche na-abụghị nke oge ochie na cryptography; okwu n'onwe ya sitere na Old English "maka otu oge". Ntuziaka 96-bit nke GCM sitere na NIST SP 800-38D. Mmebi Adobe 2013 enwetara ederede doro anya nke ọma site na enweghị uche ugboro ugboro n'akụkụ ndị ahịa RSA.
nonce.h1_f:
P (nkụkọ) na 10⁹ AES-GCM nonces = ~ 10⁻¹⁹
Ụbọchị ọmụmụ: a na-atụ anya nkukota nke mbụ n'ihe dịka 2⁸ nonces kwa igodo
GCM nchekwa: 2³² random nonces kwa igodo tupu ejikọta ọnụ ala
nonce.h2_a: Oku ọ bụla AES-GCM. Counter na-egwu agbachitere na 'app/security/crypto.py'.

ohttp.title: OHTTP
ohttp.subtitle: Echefula HTTP (RFC 9458).
ohttp.intro: OHTTP bụ protocol maka relayed HTTP arịrịọ ebe ọ nweghị otu onye hụrụ ma arịrịọ na nzaghachi. Onye ahịa na-eziga site na relay na ibe na-achọpụta nkụnye eji isi mee; relay na-aga n'ihu n'ọnụ ụzọ ámá nke decrypts na zaghachi.
ohttp.h1_a: OHTTP bụ protocol maka relayed HTTP arịrịọ ebe ọ nweghị otu onye hụrụ ma arịrịọ na nzaghachi. Onye ahịa na-eziga site na relay na ibe na-achọpụta nkụnye eji isi mee; relay na-aga n'ihu n'ọnụ ụzọ ámá nke decrypts na zaghachi.
ohttp.h1_b: Vortex na-eji OHTTP dị ka Layer-5 stealth fallback. Ejikọtara ya na ọrụ yabasị na BMP, OHTTP na-enye ụzọ nkwụsị ikpeazụ mgbe TLS kpọchiri nke ọma. Ntugharị ahụ bụ nnọkọ ntụkwasị obi nkewapụrụ (nke a na-ahụkarị Cloudflare ma ọ bụ Apple's privacy-relay infrastructure).
ohttp.h1_c: A haziri OHTTP dị ka RFC 9458 na 2024, nke Cloudflare, Apple, Mozilla dekọtara ya. Apple's iCloud Private Relay (2021) bụ mbugharị mbụ OHTTP dị n'akụkụ. Vortex agbakwunyere OHTTP nkwado ọdịda azụ na v0.0.9.
ohttp.h1_f:
onye ahịa → relay: Encrypt_gateway_pub(arịrịọ) + ozi ụzọ na-enweghị usoro
relay → ọnụ ụzọ ámá: aga n'ihu, ibe ndị ahịa na-achọpụta nkụnye eji isi mee
ọnụ ụzọ → nzaghachi: decrypt, usoro, Encrypt_client_pub(azaghachi)
relay → onye ahịa: nzaghachi nzaghachi

onion.title: Ọrụ yabasị
onion.subtitle: Tor zoro ezo ọrụ.
onion.intro: Ọrụ yabasị bụ ọrụ TCP a na-enweta site na protocol rendezvous Tor. Ejiri adreesị yabasị mara (base32 nke mkpụrụedemede Ed25519 na v3). Enweghị ọha IP, mba DNS, enweghị Central ndekọ.
onion.h1_a: Ọrụ yabasị bụ ọrụ TCP a na-enweta site na protocol rendezvous Tor. Ejiri adreesị yabasị mara (base32 nke mkpụrụedemede Ed25519 na v3). Enweghị ọha IP, mba DNS, enweghị Central ndekọ.
onion.h1_b: Ọnụ ọnụ Vortex ọ bụla na-ekpughe onwe ya dị ka '. yabasị' yana ebe njedebe HTTPS nkịtị ya. Ndị ahịa nwere nkwado Tor na-adaba na yabasị mgbe ihe ọ bụla daa. Bandwit bụ ~ 10× ji nwayọ nwayọ mana enwere ike iru ya n'ime netwọkụ amachibidoro kpamkpam.
onion.h1_c: Ọrụ yabasị laghachiri na Tor 2004 (v1). Ejiri igodo Ed25519 wughachiri dị ka ọrụ yabasị v3 na 2017. Ejiri SecureDrop, New York Times, Facebook, ProPublica, otu isi crypto-aware niile. Mgbama agbakwunyere nnyefe ọrụ yabasị na 2022.
onion.h1_f:
adreesị = base32(Ed25519_pubkey ∥ checksum ∥ version_byte) ∥ ". yabasị"
          = mkpụrụedemede 56 na yabasị v3
onion.h2_a: `/etc/tor/torrc` na `deploy/`, nke e bipụtara site na njikwa `/v1/mirrors`.
onion.h3_a: Tor, Snowflake, BMP, ụgbọ njem plọg

prekey.title: Prekey
prekey.subtitle: Ephemeral pubkey ebipụtara tupu oge eruo maka bootstrap nke DM ọhụrụ.
prekey.intro: Akara prekey bụ igodo X25519 ebipụtara n'ọnụ ụzọ tupu mkpa ka ndị kọntaktị ọhụrụ nwee ike ịmalite mkparịta ụka ezoro ezo na-enweghị njem. Onye ọrụ ọ bụla na-ebugote ogbe (ịkpọ ụzọ 10 na ndabara); ihe nkesa na-ejere ha ozi na-achọ; onye ahịa na-ebugote karịa mgbe ọ dị ala.
prekey.h1_a: Akara prekey bụ igodo X25519 ebipụtara n'ọnụ ụzọ tupu mkpa ka ndị kọntaktị ọhụrụ nwee ike ịmalite mkparịta ụka ezoro ezo na-enweghị njem. Onye ọrụ ọ bụla na-ebugote ogbe (ịkpọ ụzọ 10 na ndabara); ihe nkesa na-ejere ha ozi na-achọ; onye ahịa na-ebugote karịa mgbe ọ dị ala.
prekey.h1_b: Ejiri igodo njirimara ogologo oge bịanyere aka na ngwugwu prekey Vortex nke mere na onye mwakpo enweghị ike ịgbanwe prekey adịgboroja ọbụlagodi na ịnweta ọkwa node. Ndị DM ọhụrụ na-eji Diffie-Hellman gbara otu gburugburu megide prekey ọhụrụ tupu Double Ratchet abanye.
prekey.h1_c: Prekeys sitere na nhazi ụkpụrụ ọkọlọtọ nke Signal 2013 (X3DH). Tupu X3DH, akpụkpọ ụkwụ ezoro ezo chọrọ njem gakọrịtara ọnụ - ọ dị njọ maka ozi asynchronous. Onye ozi ọ bụla nwere nchekwa nke ọgbara ọhụrụ na-eji eriri akpụkpọ ụkwụ ụdị mbụ.
prekey.h3_a: X25519, Ugboro abụọ Ratchet, X3DH, isi mgbanwe

reality.title: Eziokwu
reality.subtitle: TLS-in-TLS masquerade stealth njem.
reality.intro: Eziokwu bụ ụgbọ njem zoro ezo nke na-egosipụta dị ka TLS gaa n'ezi teknụzụ buru ibu (nke bụ www.microsoft.com). Ebumnuche ntugharị aka nke elu Microsoft; aka n'ime bụ Vortex. A na-ebuga nyocha ndị na-arụ ọrụ na mpụta gaa na ezigbo mmalite ya mere nyocha anaghị ekpughe ihe ọ bụla.
reality.h1_a: Eziokwu bụ ụgbọ njem zoro ezo nke na-egosipụta dị ka TLS gaa n'ezi teknụzụ buru ibu (nke bụ www.microsoft.com). Ebumnuche ntugharị aka nke elu Microsoft; aka n'ime bụ Vortex. A na-ebuga nyocha ndị na-arụ ọrụ na mpụta gaa na ezigbo mmalite ya mere nyocha anaghị ekpughe ihe ọ bụla.
reality.h1_b: Vortex na-akwado Reality dị ka ụgbọ njem pluggable Level-4. Config na-akọwapụta ebumnuche masquerade, ID dị mkpụmkpụ, yana igodo ọha Vortex X25519. Sava na-akwado ndị ahịa na-abata site na egwuregwu mkpụmkpụ-ID; nyocha na-abụghị nke dabara na-enweta azịza sitere na n'ezie.
reality.h1_c: Ebipụtara eziokwu na 2022 ka nzaghachi nye nnukwu ọkụ ọkụ China na-achọpụta ụgbọ njem dabere TLS gara aga (V2Ray's Vmess, Trojan). XrayCore nabatara na 2023. Vortex agbakwunyere nkwado na v0.0.9.
reality.h1_f:
aka elu: TLS ruo Microsoft, SNI=www.microsoft.com
n'ime (ọ bụrụ auth ok): Vortex okporo ụzọ gafere ọwa data
nzaghachi nyocha: ezigbo nzaghachi microsoft.com ezigara onye mwakpo
                    ⇒ onye nleba anya na-ahụ naanị "ee, ọ bụ microsoft.com"
reality.h3_a: stealth, ụgbọ njem plọg, Trojan, Vmess

rbac.title: RBAC
rbac.subtitle: Njikwa nnweta dabere na ọrụ.
rbac.intro: RBAC bụ ihe nlere njikwa ohere ebe a na-enye ikike maka ọrụ yana ekenye ndị ọrụ ọrụ. Vortex na-eji ọkwa atọ RBAC kwa ọnụ ụlọ: onye nwe> admin> onye otu.
rbac.h1_a: RBAC bụ ihe nlere njikwa ohere ebe a na-enye ikike maka ọrụ yana ekenye ndị ọrụ ọrụ. Vortex na-eji ọkwa atọ RBAC kwa ọnụ ụlọ: onye nwe> admin> onye otu.
rbac.h1_b: Cascade: Ndị nwe ya nwere ikike nchịkwa ọ bụla gbakwunyere ike pụrụ iche ihichapụ ụlọ ma ọ bụ bufee nwe. Ndị nlekọta na-akpọ oku, gbaa, ogbi, dezie ntọala ụlọ. Ndị otu na-eziga ozi, meghachi omume, dezie ozi nke ha. A na-edekọ mgbanwe ọrụ dị ka ozi sistemụ ka onye ọ bụla so na-ahụ ha.
rbac.h1_c: RBAC dị ka ihe nlereanya dabara na akwụkwọ NIST nke 1992 nke Ferraiolo & Kuhn dere. Bụrụ onye isi na ụlọ ọrụ IAM (AWS, Azure) na 2010s. Ọkwa ụlọ RBAC bụ ọkọlọtọ na ngwaahịa nkata - IRC's ops/olu/onye ọrụ (1988), Ọrụ Discord (2015), onye nchịkwa / onye otu / ọbịa Slack.
rbac.h1_f:
ọrụ: onye nwe ⊃ admin ⊃ onye
nyefe: onye nwe na-esetịpụ new_owner_id → onye nwe ochie ewedara n'ala na nchịkwa
kagbuo: admin nwere ike iwetu onye otu; onye nwe ya nwere ike wetu admin
rbac.h2_a: `room_members.role`, a na-enyocha ụzọ ederede ọ bụla site na 'app/chats/permissions.py'.

sfu.title: SFU
sfu.subtitle: Ngalaba Ntugharị Nhọrọ.
sfu.intro: Otu SFU bụ igbe etiti na-agwakọta mgbasa ozi na oku otu. Onye ọ bụla so na-ebugo otu iyi; ndị ⟪1 na-ebuga ya ndị ọzọ. Dochie topology ntupu zuru oke (ndị ọgbọ ọ bụla na-etinye koodu iyi N-1) ebe nchacha bụ O(N²).
sfu.h1_a: Otu SFU bụ igbe etiti na-agwakọta mgbasa ozi na oku otu. Onye ọ bụla so na-ebugo otu iyi; ndị ⟪1 na-ebuga ya ndị ọzọ. Dochie topology ntupu zuru oke (ndị ọgbọ ọ bụla na-etinye koodu iyi N-1) ebe nchacha bụ O(N²).
sfu.h1_b: A na-emejuputa Vortex's SFU na Rust maka ịrụ ọrụ. Simulcast-maara: onye ọ bụla na-akpọ oku na-edobe mkpebi atọ n'otu oge; ndị SFU na-ahọrọ nke ziri ezi n'otu n'otu n'otu n'otu n'otu n'otu n'otu na-ekiri downlink. Otu ndị na-ege ntị naanị ihe ruru 100 sonyere; otu vidiyo ruru 32 (map ụzọ v0.3).
sfu.h1_c: SFU ụbọchị ihe owuwu ụlọ na Jitsi's Videobridge (2013). Tupu SFU, WebRTC oku otu bụ ntupu zuru oke. Bugharịa, Google Zute, Jitsi, otu mgbaama na-akpọ ihe niile ejiri SFU. Vortex otu ndị naanị audio bufere na v0.0.8.
sfu.h1_f:
ntupu zuru ezu (N ọgbọ): onye ọ bụla na-eziga iyi N-1 → O(N²) uplink
SFU (N ọgbọ): onye ọ bụla na-eziga 1 iyi → O(N) uplink kwa otu ọgbọ
simulcast: L1 (dị ala) + L2 (etiti) + L3 (elu) ntinye n'otu oge
SFU na-ahọrọ oyi akwa maka onye na-ekiri ya dabere na downlink BWE kọrọ

snowflake.title: Ọkpụkpọ snoo
snowflake.subtitle: Ụgbọ njem afọ ofufo nke Tor karịrị WebRTC.
snowflake.intro: Snowflake bụ ụgbọ njem nke Tor Project ebe ndị ọrụ afọ ofufo na-eme ihe dị ka WebRTC relays. Ndị ọrụ wụnye ndọtị ihe nchọgharị na ihe nchọgharị ha na-aghọ relay mgbe ha nwere taabụ mepere emepe.
snowflake.h1_a: Snowflake bụ ụgbọ njem nke Tor Project ebe ndị ọrụ afọ ofufo na-eme ihe dị ka WebRTC relays. Ndị ọrụ wụnye ndọtị ihe nchọgharị na ihe nchọgharị ha na-aghọ relay mgbe ha nwere taabụ mepere emepe.
snowflake.h1_b: Vortex na-anabata Snowflake dị ka oyi akwa-4 mgbe egbochiri TLS na mbufe njem. Enweghị infra chọrọ n'akụkụ anyị - naanị anyị chọrọ àkwà mmiri Snowflake nke ebipụtara n'ebe ndị ama ama. Ndị ọrụ afọ ofufo na-agba ọsọ ndọtị na-enye mkpuchi.
snowflake.h1_c: Snowflake bidoro na 2020 dị ka onye nnọchi Tor Project maka obfs4 (nke bụrụla akara mkpịsị aka). Ụgbọ njem WebRTC siri ike igbochi n'ihi na ime nke a ga-emebi ọtụtụ oku vidiyo ziri ezi. Vortex agbakwunyere nkwado na v0.0.9.
snowflake.h1_f:
onye ahịa → Onye na-ere ahịa Snowflake: "Achọrọ m onye nnọchiteanya"
onye na-ere ahịa dakọtara na ihe nchọgharị afọ ofufo na-agba ọsọ ndọtị
ndị ọrụ afọ ofufo → Ntinye Tor: na-ebuga okporo ụzọ ndị ahịa n'elu WebRTC
uru: WebRTC okporo ụzọ dị ebe niile; igbochi oku vidiyo na-agbaji
snowflake.h3_a: Tor, ụgbọ njem plọg, WebRTC, obfs4

tls13.subtitle: Nchekwa ụgbọ njem, ụdị 1.3 (RFC 8446).
tls13.intro: TLS 1.3 bụ ụdị nke protocol TLS dị ugbu a. Na-ewepu primitives na-adịghị ize ndụ (RSA igodo mgbanwe, CBC MACs, static ECDH), na-eme ka aka aka gaa n'otu njem njem, na-enye iwu nzuzo gawa.
tls13.h1_a: TLS 1.3 bụ ụdị nke protocol TLS dị ugbu a. Na-ewepu primitives na-adịghị ize ndụ (RSA igodo mgbanwe, CBC MACs, static ECDH), na-eme ka aka aka gaa n'otu njem njem, na-enye iwu nzuzo gawa.
tls13.h1_b: Ọ bụla HTTPS + WSS + njikọ gọọmentị na Vortex na-eji TLS 1.3. Anyị dabara ndị ahịa Chrome 120sHello byte-for-byte yabụ DPI enweghị ike ịpịpụta anyị akara dịka ndị na-abụghị ihe nchọgharị. ECH (ezoro ezo SNI) bụ Nwepu site na mpụta-SNI nhazi.
tls13.h1_c: TLS 1.3 bụ ahaziri dịka RFC 8446 n'August 2018 ka afọ 4 gachara na eserese 28. Chrome, Firefox, Safari bufere nkwado na 2018. Microsoft gbakwunyere ya na Windows na 2020. Site na 2022 ọ bụ ọtụtụ okporo ụzọ webụ.
tls13.h1_f:
aka (1-RTT):
  Onye ahịa → sava: ClientHello (key_share, SNI?, ALPN, …)
  Ihe nkesa → Onye ahịa: ServerHello + EncryptedExtensions + Cert + CertVerify + Emechara
  Onye ahịa → Ihe nkesa: Emechaala + Data ngwa
tls13.h2_a: Njikọ ọ bụla TLS. Mkpịsị aka dakọtara na 'app/transport/stealth_level1.py'.
tls13.h3_a: ECH, TLS akara mkpịsị aka, JA4, nzuzo

totp.title: TOTP
totp.subtitle: Okwuntughe otu oge dabere na oge (RFC 6238).
totp.intro: TOTP bụ okwuntughe otu oge ewepụtara na nzuzo na oge ugbu a. Ihe ndabara: nkeji nkeji nkeji 30, koodu ọnụọgụ isii, SHA-1 HMAC.
totp.h1_a: TOTP bụ okwuntughe otu oge ewepụtara na nzuzo na oge ugbu a. Ihe ndabara: nkeji nkeji nkeji 30, koodu ọnụọgụ isii, SHA-1 HMAC.
totp.h1_b: Vortex's 2FA na-eji TOTP na ndabara RFC. Ndị ọrụ na-enyocha QR na ndebanye aha; Koodu ewepụtara site na ngwa Authenticator ha dabara koodu a tụrụ anya na nkesa. Oke-oke na mbọ 5 kwa nkeji 5 kwa onye ọrụ.
totp.h1_c: TOTP (RFC 6238, 2011) nke Mark Pei wuru na HOTP (RFC 4226, 2005). Tupu nke ahụ, RSA SecurID jiri algọridim nke nwe ya. Google Authenticator (2010) emelitere TOTP; Ngwa 2FA ọ bụla na-eji ya ugbu a.
totp.h1_f:
TOTP(k, t) = HOTP(k, ⌊t / 30⌋)
HOTP(k, c) = mkpọpu ( HMAC-SHA1 (k, c) ) mod 10⁶
windo: ±1 nzọụkwụ anabatara maka skew elekere

turn.title: TURN
turn.subtitle: Njegharị Iji Relays gburugburu NAT (RFC 8656).
turn.intro: TURN bụ protocol maka ibugharị UDP / TCP okporo ụzọ site na sava ọha mgbe ụzọ ndị ọgbọ na ndị ọgbọ ozugbo dara. A na-eji ya dị ka ụzọ ndaghachi azụ mgbe ndị nnabata ICE na ndị na-eme mgbanwe nke ihe nkesa anaghị arụ ọrụ.
turn.h1_a: TURN bụ protocol maka ibugharị UDP / TCP okporo ụzọ site na sava ọha mgbe ụzọ ndị ọgbọ na ndị ọgbọ ozugbo dara. A na-eji ya dị ka ụzọ ndaghachi azụ mgbe ndị nnabata ICE na ndị na-eme mgbanwe nke ihe nkesa anaghị arụ ọrụ.
turn.h1_b: Vortex na-eji ọnụ ọ bụla na-ebugharị ihe atụ coturn. nzere dị mkpụmkpụ (h24), HMAC bịanyere aka na ya, enyere n'otu oku. Mgbe njem NAT daa - na-abụkarị n'azụ symmetric NAT ma ọ bụ firewall siri ike - mgbasa ozi oku niile na-agafe TURN.
turn.h1_c: Ebu ụzọ hazie TURN dị ka RFC 5766 (2010), emelitere ruo RFC 8656 (2020). A na-eji WebRTC ọ bụla ebuga maka ~15% oku ebe ụzọ kwụ ọtọ dara. coturn bụ ntụnye aka na-emepe emepe.
turn.h1_f:
aha njirimara = "{expiry_unix}:{user_id}"
paswọọdụ = base64 (HMAC-SHA1(ihe nzuzo nke sava, aha njirimara))
TTL = awa 24
coturn kwadoro HMAC na AUTH ọ bụla; na-ajụ ma emebie ya

vapid.title: VAPID
vapid.subtitle: Nchọpụta ihe nkesa ngwa afọ ofufo (RFC 8292).
vapid.intro: VAPID bụ igodo Ed25519 nke sava ngwa na-eji amata onwe ya nye ndị na-eweta Weebụ Push. Na-ewepụ ajụjụ "onye ekwenyere izipu" ajụjụ maka mbugharị Webụ Push.
vapid.h1_a: VAPID bụ igodo Ed25519 nke sava ngwa na-eji amata onwe ya nye ndị na-eweta Weebụ Push. Na-ewepụ ajụjụ "onye ekwenyere izipu" ajụjụ maka mbugharị Webụ Push.
vapid.h1_b: Ndị ahịa webụ Vortex na-edebanye aha na Weebụ Push site na iji igodo ọha VAPID node. A na-eji igodo ntanye akara dị iche ezoro ugwo ịkwụ ụgwọ (p256dh) kwa ndenye aha. Ntughari: igodo VAPID dị ogologo ndụ mana ụgwọ akwụrụ bịanyere aka na ya nwere njedebe ụdị JWT dị mkpụmkpụ.
vapid.h1_c: A haziri VAPID dị ka RFC 8292 n'afọ 2017. Tupu VAPID, Weebụ Push chọrọ ma ndebanye aha FCM agbazitere ma ọ bụ usoro nyocha dị iche. VAPID na-eme ka ntinye aka nke onwe ya dị mfe - enweghị ọrụ Firebase achọrọ.
vapid.h2_a: `app/services/sealed_push.py::web_push`, ebipụtara site na njikwa `/v1/health` maka nyocha.
vapid.h3_a: Weebụ Push, ntinye akara akara, Ed25519, JWT

waf.title: WAF
waf.subtitle: Ngwa Weebụ Firewall.
waf.intro: A WAF bụ middleware na-enyocha arịrịọ HTTP ma gbochie usoro ọjọọ amaara (SQL injection, traversal traversal, template injection) tupu ha erute koodu ngwa.
waf.h1_a: A WAF bụ middleware na-enyocha arịrịọ HTTP ma gbochie usoro ọjọọ amaara (SQL injection, traversal traversal, template injection) tupu ha erute koodu ngwa.
waf.h1_b: Vortex's WAF na-agba dị ka 'app/security/middware.py:: WAFMiddleware'. ~ 50 nyocha regex megide URL, ajụjụ, ahụ. Gbochie `UNION SELECT`, `../`, `{{ config}}`, `$where`, amaara ụkpụrụ XSS. Na-akwadokwa oke ọnụego zuru ụwa ọnụ (1000 req/s), oke ụzọ ọ bụla (nbanye 10/min, debanye aha 5/min), oke onye ọrụ.
waf.h1_c: Ụbọchị WAF ruo mod_security (2002). Cloudflare's WAF (2014) mebere ụkpụrụ ahụ. Usoro ntanetị ọ bụla nke ọgbara ọhụrụ na-ebupu ndenye ndenye nke ndabara. E si na OWASP mbinye aka 10 chịkọtara ndepụta regex Vortex.
waf.h1_f:
na arịrịọ ọ bụla:
  maka ụkpụrụ na SQLI_PATTERNS: ọ bụrụ na ụkpụrụ.search(url + ajụjụ + ahụ): jụrụ
  maka ụkpụrụ na TRAVERSAL: ọ bụrụ na ụkpụrụ.search(url): jụrụ
  maka ụkpụrụ na TEMPLATE: if pattern.search(body): jụrụ
kpọnyere oke ọnụego site na (IP, ụzọ, user_id)
waf.h3_a: mmachi ọnụego, ndekọ nyocha, OWASP, SQL ịgba ogwu

x25519.title: X25519
x25519.subtitle: Elliptic-curve Diffie-Hellman n'elu Curve25519 (RFC 7748).
x25519.intro: X25519 bụ elliptical-curve Diffie-Hellman n'elu Curve25519 n'ụdị Montgomery ya. Igodo nzuzo 32-byte na ọha, 32-byte kesara nzuzo. Eji maka nkwekọrịta isi.
x25519.h1_a: X25519 bụ elliptical-curve Diffie-Hellman n'elu Curve25519 n'ụdị Montgomery ya. Igodo nzuzo 32-byte na ọha, 32-byte kesara nzuzo. Eji maka nkwekọrịta isi.
x25519.h1_b: Ihe njirimara ngwaọrụ ọ bụla static, igodo nnọkọ ephemeral ọ bụla, ndenye ntinye akara akara na Vortex na-eji X25519. Mmejuputa Montgomery-ladder bụ oge na-adịgide adịgide ma na-egbochiri klaasị nke ọwa n'akụkụ nke kpagburu akụkụ ndị gara aga.
x25519.h1_c: Curve25519 bụ Bernstein bipụtara (2005); ahaziri dịka RFC 7748 (2016) nwere aha X25519 maka ụdị DH. Ndị Signal, WhatsApp, OpenSSH, WireGuard nakweere, Apple iMessage, Chrome (ngwakọ post-quantum). N'ebe nile na ọgbara ọhụrụ etinyere cryptography.
x25519.h1_f:
igodo nzuzo: ∈ [0, 2²⁵⁵) (32 bytes obere-endian, kpọgidere)
igodo ọha: A = a · G (isi ihe agbakwunyere 32-byte)
òkè: s = a · B = b · A (32 bytes, → HKDF ntinye)
arụmọrụ: ~ 100µs kwa DH na iPhone 11

websocketFanout.title: WebSocket ndị na-ahụ maka ndị na-anụ ọkụ n'obi
websocketFanout.subtitle: Otu ọnụ ụzọ na-ebuga ihe omume nye ọtụtụ puku ndị debanyere aha.
websocketFanout.what: Ihe WebSocket fan-out bụ Python-nwa afọ nke ndị debanyere aha n'otu ọnụ ụlọ. Mgbe ezigara ozi, onye na-ezipụ onye na-ezipụ ihe na-emegharị setịpụ ahụ wee debanye aha n'usoro n'ahịrị n'ahịrị izipu onye ọ bụla.
websocketFanout.why: Onye ofufe na-ezere ọnụ ahịa mgbasa ozi N-mbipụta: otu decryption n'akụkụ onye na-ezigara ya, otu serialized frame, N zip-queue pushes. Ntugharị ọ bụla bụ O (1); A na-atụgharị ọnụ ahịa akwụkwọ ahụ na kernel na oge 'send()' site na nchekwa efu mgbe OS na-akwado ha.
websocketFanout.where: Emebere ya na 'app/chats/fanout.py'. 'FanoutRegistry' dị elu nwere 'dict[room_id, set[WebSocket]]'. 'asyncio.Lock' na-echekwa akwụkwọ ndekọ aha; agụ bụ snapshots enweghị mkpọchi.
websocketFanout.how: Na ozi POST rawụta na-akpọ 'echere fanout.broadcast(room_id, payload_bytes)'. Usoro a na-eṅomi ntọala n'okpuru mkpọchi, wepụta ya, wee megharịa otu n'ime ihe ahụ na-eche `ws.send_bytes(ibu ụgwọ)' na oge nkwụsị nke 1 nke abụọ n'otu oghere. A na-akara sọks ndị emechara ka ọ dị njọ ma kpochaa.
websocketFanout.when: Ozi ọ bụla, mmeghachi omume, nnata agụ, akara akara, akara oku, na ntụgharị igodo ọnụ ụlọ na-aga site na otu onye na-apụ apụ. A na-amachi oke etiti na 64 KiB; A na-ajụ nnukwu ụgwọ akwụ ụgwọ wee weghachi onye ọkpụkpọ site na HTTP.
websocketFanout.cfg1: `FANOUT_QUEUE_SIZE=256` - onye ọ bụla debanyere aha na-eziga omimi kwụ n'ahịrị. Ijubiga ókè na-adaba etiti kacha ochie.
websocketFanout.cfg2: `FANOUT_SEND_TIMEOUT_MS=1000` — nke elu na `send_bytes`. Ịgafe na-egosi oghere dị njọ.
websocketFanout.cfg3: 'FANOUT_MAX_ROOM_SIZE=10000` - jụrụ ịpụ n'ime ụlọ buru ibu karịa nke a. Nnukwu ọnụ ụlọ na-eji ụdị ọwa yana ụkpụrụ ndọpụta kama.
websocketFanout.fail1: Ndị ahịa na-eji nwayọ - kwụ n'ahịrị otu oghere na-ejubiga ókè. okpokolo agba kacha ochie tụfuru. Onye ahịa na-enweta site na 'mgbe' na njikọ ọzọ.
websocketFanout.fail2: Oghere nwụrụ anwụ - 'send_bytes' na-ebuli 'ConnectionClosed'. Dispatcher na-ewepụ na setịpụ wee gaa n'ihu.
websocketFanout.fail3: Onye na-emepụta ihe na-agba agba - ọ bụrụ na onye nrụpụta bụ> 5 × ngwa ngwa karịa mkpokọta bandwit ndị ahịa, nrụgide azụ na-abanye site na 'echere' na-akwụsịtụ onye zitere ya.
websocketFanout.fail4: Mgbapu ebe nchekwa - kwụ n'ahịrị onye debanyere aha na okpokolo agba 256; na 64 KiB nke ọ bụla bụ 16 MiB max maka onye na-azụ ahịa nwayọ. A ga-ewepụ onye na-azụ ahịa gbapụrụ site na nlele ndụ tupu ọ daa n'uko ụlọ ahụ.
websocketFanout.mon1: Prometheus nlele `vortex_fanout_queue_depth{ime ụlọ, onye ọrụ}` - omimi kwụ n'ahịrị otu oghere.
websocketFanout.mon2: Counter `vortex_fanout_drops_total{reason}` — wepụrụ okpokolo agba site na ihe kpatara ya (nfefe, oge nkwụsị, mechiri emechi).
websocketFanout.tune1: Welie `FANOUT_QUEUE_SIZE` maka ndị ahịa nọ na netwọkụ na-eji nwayọ mana kwụsie ike.
websocketFanout.tune2: Wedata 'FANOUT_SEND_TIMEOUT_MS' n'ụyọkọ nwere ọgba aghara ebe sọks ji nwayọ na-agụ ndị ọzọ agụụ.
websocketFanout.tune3: Kewaa nnukwu ọnụ ụlọ n'ime obere ọnụ ụlọ ma ọ bụ gbanwee ha ka ọ bụrụ ọnọdụ ọwa nwere mmelite dabere na ndọta.
websocketFanout.edge1: A na-eziga mmemme ntụgharị ọnụ ụlọ ('ụdị:"k") na oge 2 s kama ịbụ 1 s n'ihi na ndị ahịa ga-ebubata igodo tupu ha anabata ozi ndị ọzọ.
websocketFanout.edge2: Achọgharịghị ihe omume mpị - ịtufu "onye ọrụ kwụsịrị pịnye" adịghị njọ.
websocketFanout.edge3: A na-achịkọta mmelite ọnụnọ: ọtụtụ ọnụnọ ọnụnọ onye ọrụ na-atụgharị n'otu windo 250 ms n'ime otu etiti.
websocketFanout.mig1: v0.0 eji per-room `asyncio.Queue`s — dochie na v0.0.5 site na mkpọchi-mbipụta-iterate ụkpụrụ maka ala kwa-ozi CPU.
websocketFanout.mig2: Ọdịnihu: mgbe Redis dị, fan-out ga-ahọrọ ụlọ mmanya/sub ka ụyọkọ ọnụ ọtụtụ megharịa ihe na-enweghị ntupu fan-out.
websocketFanout.ts1: Ọnụego nkwụsị dị elu: lelee netwọk na ndị na-azụ ahịa ngwa ngwa; bump kwụ n'ahịrị nha; nyochaa omume ndị ahịa.
websocketFanout.ts2: Ogologo oge izipu dị elu: enwere ike TLS mkparịta ụka na-aga n'ihu ma ọ bụ NAT oge gafere; lelee ndekọ kernel maka mbufe TCP.
websocketFanout.ts3: Ebe nchekwa ebe nchekwa: nyochaa `vortex_fanout_queue_depth' kwa onye ọrụ; Kaa onye ọrụ ọ bụla nwee omimi na-adịgide adịgide> 200 dị ka onye ahịa nwere ike ịdị nwayọ ma ọ bụ onye obi ọjọọ.
websocketFanout.faq1: Ajụjụ: Kedu ihe ga - eme ma ọ bụrụ na onye ahịa tufuo fremu mgbe a na-ewepụ ya? A: Ọ na-ejikọkwa 'ebe =' ikpeazụ_seen_id>' na ihe nkesa na-emegharị site na DB. The fan-out bụ kasị mma-mgbalị ozugbo; ogologo ndụ na-ebi na DB.
websocketFanout.faq2: Ajụjụ: Onye debanyere aha ọjọọ nwere ike ime ka ọ kwụsịlata? A: Ha na-ebelata kwụ n'ahịrị nke ha, nke na-ejuju, tufuo okpokolo agba, ma kwụpụ ha. Enweghị nnyonye anya ndị debanyere aha.
websocketFanout.faq3: Ajụjụ: Kedu otu m ga-esi mebie nnyefe nke onye ọrụ? A: `GET /api/admin/debug/fanout/{user_id}` na-atụfu omimi kwụ n'ahịrị ha, zipu timestamp ikpeazụ, yana ọdịda na-adịbeghị anya.

nonceManagement.title: njikwa adịghị
nonceManagement.subtitle: Kedu ka Vortex na-eme ka AES-GCM enweghị ihe pụrụ iche n'ofe ngwaọrụ, ọnụ ụlọ, na nrụgharị.
nonceManagement.what: Ọrụ ọ bụla AES-GCM na-ewe 12-byte na MUST bụrụ ihe pụrụ iche maka igodo enyere. Iji otu igodo ejighi otu ihe emegharia na-emebi ma nzuzo yana eziokwu - onye mwakpo nwere ederede ederede abụọ n'okpuru otu (igodo, enweghị) nwere ike nwetaghachi ederede XOR.
nonceManagement.why: Vortex na-ewepụta igodo ọnụ ụlọ ma jiri ya mee ọtụtụ puku ozi. Nkwekọrịta ekwekọrịtaghị na ozi abụọ ga-adapụta ederede doro anya. Ya mere, a na-eji OS CSPRNG nweta OS CSPRNG na 96 bits - mpaghara nchekwa ụbọchị ọmụmụ bụ ihe dịka ozi 2^32 kwa igodo, karịa otu igodo ọ bụla ga-ezoro ezo.
nonceManagement.where: Ọgbọ na-abụghị onye ahịa na-ebi na `VortexCrypto` (iOS), `crypto/aead` modul (Android), `app.security.crypto.aes_gcm_encrypt` (node). Ọnụ ụzọ ahụ na-agbakwa nlele nlele oyiri-abụghị nke agbachitere.
nonceManagement.how: Nzọụkwụ-site-nzọụkwụ: onye ahịa na-ewepụta bytes 12 random, gafere na AES-GCM encrypt, kewaa ciphertext ka '{ciphertext, nonce}' na POST. Ndekọ ọnụ `(room_id, nonce)` n'ime ebe nchekwa LRU cache ruru 10^6 ndenye. Na POST, ọnụ na-enyocha cache - oyiri ⇒ 400 ` oyiri_nonce`. N'okpuru ojiji nkịtị nke a anaghị agba ọkụ (P(nkụkọ) na ozi 10^9 bụ ~ 10^-19).
nonceManagement.when: Na ọ bụla izipu. Akụkụ ndị nnata: enweghị nlele ọ bụla - mkpado AES-GCM na-ejikwa iguzosi ike n'ezi ihe. Ọ bụrụ na emeghachighị otu ugboro, decrypt nke abụọ ka ga-aga nke ọma mana nzuzo ga-emebi.
nonceManagement.cfg1: `NONCE_CACHE_SIZE=1000000` — ọnụọgụ nke ndị na-adịbeghị anya a na-enyocha kwa ọnụ.
nonceManagement.cfg2: `NONCE_CACHE_TTL_S=86400` — ndenye ndị okenye chụpụrụ ka elekere 24 gachara (ọtụtụ igodo na-atụgharị n'ime awa ole na ole).
nonceManagement.fail1: RNG ọdịda na onye ahịa - o yighị ka ọ bụrụ OS nyere CSPRNG. Ọ dịghị mgbe anyị ga-adaba na RNG ndị na-abụghị cryptographic.
nonceManagement.fail2: Cache miss na node Malitegharịa ekwentị - a na-anabata n'ihi na cache bụ nchekwa-n'ime omimi; Ndị ahịa anaghị ejigharị ihe n'ụzọ ziri ezi ka ọ ghara imepe windo ọgụ.
nonceManagement.mon2: Nle `vortex_nonce_cache_size` — kwesịrị ịdị n'akụkụ okpu cache.
nonceManagement.tune1: Nnukwu ọnụ ụlọ: na-abawanye nha cache iji kpuchie windo ntụgharị ogologo.
nonceManagement.tune2: Ụyọkọ ọtụtụ ọnụ: kesaa cache site na Redis mgbe ọ dị.
nonceManagement.edge1: Iji ozi kwụ n'ahịrị jikọọ onye ahịa na-anọghị n'ịntanetị: ozi ọ bụla kwụ n'ahịrị na-ebu nke ya enweghị usoro. Enweghị nhazi ọ bụla achọrọ.
nonceManagement.edge2: zipu ọtụtụ ngwaọrụ: ngwaọrụ abụọ a na-ewepụta enweghị usoro enweghị usoro. P(nkụkọ) na ngwaọrụ 2 × 10^4 ozi = enweghị atụ.
nonceManagement.mig1: v0.0 ejiri mkpirisi counter dabere nonces nke mkpụrụ ngwaọrụ id - deprecated ka akwụkwọ gosiri na cross ngwaọrụ n'okpuru elekere-skew. Random-96 bụ naanị ụzọ a gọziri agọzi.
nonceManagement.ts1: Hụ ajụjụ 'enweghị nke oyiri': lelee onye ahịa maka ahụhụ RNG; lelee ngwaọrụ entropy isi iyi.
nonceManagement.ts2: Cache OOM: lelee nha cache megide ọnụego ederede ụlọ; ma welie nha ma ọ bụ belata TTL.
nonceManagement.faq1: Ajụjụ: Gịnị ma ọ bụrụ na ndị ahịa abụọ na-ewere otu ihe ahụ na mberede? A: Na 96 ibe n'ibe nke randomness, a na-atụ anya na mbụ nkukota n'ofe ndị ọrụ niile bụ na ~2^48 ozi - ọtụtụ ndụ nke ojiji Vortex. Ọ bụrụ na ọ dị mgbe ọ bụla, ọnụ ụzọ ga-ajụ nke abụọ.
nonceManagement.faq2: Q: Gịnị kpatara 96 ​​bits na ọ bụghị 128? A: AES-GCM ọkọlọtọ nonce ogologo. 96 bits na-echekwakwa 4 bytes kwa ozi.

keyRotation.title: Ntụgharị igodo
keyRotation.subtitle: Mgbe na ka ime ụlọ, ngwaọrụ na igodo ntọhapụ ga-esi agafe.
keyRotation.what: Igodo ọ bụla dị ogologo na Vortex na-atụgharị na nhazi oge ma ọ bụ na mkpalite. Igodo ime ụlọ na-atụgharị na mgbanwe otu ma ọ bụ kwa oge (kwa izu). Igodo ngwaọrụ na-atụgharị kwa nhọrọ onye ọrụ. Igodo mwepụta na-atụgharị mgbe echere na ọ nwere nkwekọrịta.
keyRotation.why: Ntughari na-egbochi radius mgbawa nke nkwekọrịta. Igodo ime ụlọ ezuru na ụnyaahụ kwụsịrị ibelata ozi taa. Igodo ntọhapụ zuru ohi site na 2024 kwụsịrị ịgba akaebe na mwepụta 2026.
keyRotation.where: 'ngwa/ igodo/' ụlọ mgbagha mgbagha n'akụkụ sava. Akụkụ ndị ahịa: `ios/.../ Keys/impl/RoomKeyProvider.swift`, `android/.../keys/impl/RoomKeyProvider.kt`.
keyRotation.how: Ntugharị ụlọ: onye nchịkwa ọ bụla nwere ike ịkpalite; ntụgharị nkịtị na ezumike na-akpaghị aka. Rotator na-enweta mgbọrọgwụ ọhụrụ 32-byte, re-envelopes nye ndị otu fọdụrụ, biputere `POST /api/rooms/{id}/rotate` na envelopu ọhụrụ. Node na-emelite 'igodo ime ụlọ' na mgbasa ozi '{ụdị:"k"}'.
keyRotation.when: Ime ụlọ: na ezumike, na nchịkwa nchịkwa, ụbọchị 7 ọ bụla na-akpaghị aka. Ngwaọrụ: ụbọchị 90 ọ bụla site na ndabara (nhazi). Mwepụta: ad-hoc na nkwenye a na-enyo enyo.
keyRotation.cfg3: `ROTATE_ON_LEAVE=eziokwu` - gbanyụọ ka ịwụgharị ntụgharị na ezumike (na-ewetu nchekwa maka obere CPU).
keyRotation.fail1: Onye ahịa na-anọghị n'ịntanetị n'oge ntụgharị: na-enweta njikọ na-esote. Ụlọ ahịa ọnụ ụzọ 5 na-aga n'ihu na-atụgharị ya mere ndị na-ejikọta na-achọta envelopu ha mgbe niile.
keyRotation.fail2: Envelopu mining agbụrụ: admins abụọ na-atụgharị n'otu oge. Node na-anabata nke mbụ wee weghachi 409 Conflict na nke abụọ.
keyRotation.tune1: Ụlọ ọha na> ndị otu 1000: gbanwee gaa na mbipụta igodo Variant-B. Ntughari na ezumike na-aghọ mba-op; Ndị otu tụkwasịrị obi mbinye aka pubkey ezigara.
keyRotation.tune2: Ime ụlọ nwere mmetụta oge (dịka ọwa isi mmalite akwụkwọ akụkọ): obere ntụgharị ntụgharị (kwa ụbọchị ma ọ bụ elekere).
keyRotation.edge1: Ụlọ otu onye otu mgbe ndị ọzọ niile pụọ: ntụgharị adịghị mkpa mana ọ ka na-akpalite maka ịdịgide; onye naanị ya na-enwetara onwe ya envelopu ọhụrụ.
keyRotation.edge2: Onye nwe ya ahapụ: enyefe onye nwe ya na admin nke jikọtara ogologo oge; ewepụrụ envelopu ochie onye nwe ya.
keyRotation.mig1: v0.0 tụgharịrị naanị na ezumike. v0.2 na-agbakwụnye ntụgharị oge nke `ROOM_KEY_ROTATION_DAYS' na-achịkwa.
keyRotation.ts1: Ndị ahịa rapaara decrypting: lelee tebụl envelopu; hụ na agbasara mmemme ntụgharị.
keyRotation.ts2: Ọdịda ntụgharị: na-abụkarị netwọk maka onye otu nwayọ. Tinyegharịa ọnụ ọgụgụ abanyela n'ụzọ nyocha.
keyRotation.faq1: Ajụjụ: ntụgharị ọ na-ezoghachi ozi ochie? A: Mba. Ederede ochie na-anọ n'okpuru igodo ochie; ndị ahịa na-edobe igodo ochie n'ime cache mpaghara ha maka nbipu akụkọ ihe mere eme.
keyRotation.faq2: Ajụjụ: Gịnị ma ọ bụrụ na onye ọrụ sonyere wee pụọ ngwa ngwa 100 ugboro? A: Omume ọ bụla na-atụgharị. N'ime nnukwu ọnụ ụlọ nke a dị oke ọnụ - anyị na-amachibido mmemme otu n'ime 1/min maka onye ọrụ ọ bụla.

rateLimiting.title: Mmachi ọnụego
rateLimiting.subtitle: Kwa-IP, onye ọrụ ọ bụla, oke bọket token kwa ụzọ.
rateLimiting.what: Oke oke ọnụ ahịa bụ ihe nchebe bụ isi megide mmetọ dị ukwuu: nbanye ike ike, idei mmiri ndebanye aha, spam ozi, ike-ebugo faịlụ.
rateLimiting.why: Na-enweghị oke, onye mmetọ ọ bụla akwadoro nwere ike ihichapụ diski, mejupụta fan-out, ma ọ bụ ike ike 4-nọmba 2FA. Oke dị ọnụ ala (~ 10 ns kwa nlele) wee tụgharịa mwakpo ndị na-adịghị mkpa ka ọ bụrụ nke dị oke ọnụ.
rateLimiting.where: 'app/security/limits.py' na-ejide njedebe. 'app/authentication/_helpers.py::_check_auth_rate' bụ ihe mkpuchi dị mkpa maka ụzọ nyocha.
rateLimiting.how: Token-bucket algọridim kwa (obosara, igodo). Bucket na-ejuputa na ọnụego R, ikike C. Arịrịọ na-ewe 1 token. Ịwụ efu ⇒ 429. Nchekwa Tracker: in-memory dict on single node; Redis mgbe `REDIS_URL=...`.
rateLimiting.when: Arịrịọ ọ bụla site na WAF middleware. Mafere ndepụta maka akụ kwụ ọtọ na nlele ahụike.
rateLimiting.fail1: Onye ọrụ ziri ezi n'azụ òkè NAT (ụlọ ọrụ, ụlọ akwụkwọ) ruru oke-IP - onye ọrụ chere 429 nwere ozi ọma.
rateLimiting.fail2: Mgbawa ebe nchekwa na nnukwu mgbawa - kpuchie na igodo dị iche iche 100k; LRU ịchụpụ.
rateLimiting.tune1: N'azụ CDN nke na-ewepụ ezigbo IP: tọọ 'TRUSTED_PROXIES' ka anyị gụọ 'X-Forwarded-For'. Ma ọ bụghị ya, okporo ụzọ niile ruru oke n'okpuru CDN's egress IP.
rateLimiting.tune2: Bots dị elu: nye igodo API jiri `BOT_RATE_OVERRIDE=1000`.
rateLimiting.edge1: IPv6: anyị na-amachi kwa / 64 karịa adreesị ọ bụla na akaụntụ maka oke oke ISP.
rateLimiting.edge2: Ụzọ ọpụpụ: anyị na-etinye oke nkwụsịtụ (`TOR_RATE_MULTIPLIER=5`) iji zere ịta ndị ọrụ Tor ahụhụ na ọpụpụ nkekọrịta.
rateLimiting.mig1: v0.0 ejiri `slowapi` nwere onye na-achọ mma-kwa ụzọ - kwụsịrị na v0.0.5 maka etiti etiti.
rateLimiting.ts1: 429 adịgboroja adịgboroja: lelee nhazi proxy tụkwasịrị obi, lelee nhazi nkekọrịta-NAT, oke njedebe ma ọ bụrụ na okporo ụzọ ziri ezi na-akụ ya.
rateLimiting.ts2: Gafefere: lelee ndekọ ohere maka ndị mkparị IP; tinye na `BLACKLIST_IP=` env var maka ngọngọ siri ike.
rateLimiting.faq1: Ajụjụ: A na-ekewa oke n'ofe ọnụ? A: Na otu ọnụ mode, oke bụ kwa ọnụ. Site na Redis, oke bụ zuru ụwa ọnụ n'ofe ụyọkọ.
rateLimiting.faq2: Ajụjụ: Kedu ka m ga-esi nyekwuo onwe m? A: Ndị ọrụ enwetagoro nwere ike itinye akwụkwọ maka oke oke site na `/api/admin/quota`. Ndị nlekọta na-akwado ikpe site n'ikpe.

emojiCatalog.title: Emoji katalọgụ
emojiCatalog.subtitle: Nhazi data 1500-emoji kesara n'ofe ndị ahịa niile.
emojiCatalog.what: Vortex na-ebugharị ihe emoji nke ya kama ịdabere na ụdị Unicode. 1500 emojis ahaziri n'ime ụdị 9 (ọchị, mmadụ, anụmanụ, nri, njem, ihe omume, ihe, akara, ọkọlọtọ). Otu JSON eji na iOS (`Emoji/Resources/emoji.json`), gam akporo (`android/app/src/main/assets/emoji.json`), na onye ahịa webụ (`static/assets/emoji.json`).
emojiCatalog.why: Nkwenye: onye ọrụ na-eziga 🥹 na iOS 17 ga-emerịrị dị ka 🥹 na gam akporo 9. Sistemụ ala emoji diverge gafee ụdị OS site na afọ 1-3, yabụ anyị na-ebufe nke anyị ka ọ kwụsie ike maapụ.
emojiCatalog.how: JSON Ọdịdị: `{otu: [emoji_char, ...]}'. Ndị ahịa na-ebu ibu na mmalite, gbasaa na nchọta ọchụchọ, wee mee ya site na LazyVGrid / LazyGrid / CSS grid.
emojiCatalog.when: Na mmalite ngwa na mgbe ọ bụla onye ọrụ mepere onye na-ahọrọ. Ndepụta MRU ka nọgidere na UserDefaults / SharedPreferences / localStorage.
emojiCatalog.cfg1: Okpu na-adịbeghị anya: 30 na iOS, 30 na gam akporo, 20 na webụ.
emojiCatalog.cfg2: A na-edozi ngalaba n'usoro - nhazigharị na-agbaji okirikiri nhọrọ ukwuu.
emojiCatalog.fail1: Onye ọrụ OS enweghị ike ịsụgharị emoji: daa azụ na '?' glyph. Anyị na-ahọrọ koodu site na Unicode ≤ 15.0 nke ọ bụla OS ọgbara ọhụrụ na-akwado.
emojiCatalog.mon1: Ọ dịghị. Naanị akụkụ ndị ahịa.
emojiCatalog.tune1: Ngwunye emoji omenala: ndị ọrụ nwere ike ịwụnye ngwugwu ihe mmado na-akpa àgwà otu a mana na-enye onyonyo raster.
emojiCatalog.edge1: Ụdị dị iche iche nke akpụkpọ ahụ: katalọgụ anyị na-echekwa naanị emojis ntọala; A na-emepụta ụdịdị dị iche iche nke ndị ahịa site na usoro ZWJ.
emojiCatalog.edge2: Ọkọlọtọ emojis: otu abụọ akara ngosi mpaghara; iOS na-egosi ọkọlọtọ, ụfọdụ ụdị gam akporo na-egosi ụzọ abụọ leta.
emojiCatalog.mig1: v0.0 ejiri emoji.json sitere na emoji-mart elu. v0.0.5 tụgharịrị katalọgụ ahụ wee gbutuo ya na 1500 maka ebumnuche nha nha.
emojiCatalog.ts1: Emoji na-efu efu: wughachi akụ; hụ na JSON dị mma; ụfọdụ ngwaọrụ na-echekwa nsụgharị ochie nke ukwuu - kpochapụ cache ngwa.
emojiCatalog.faq1: Ajụjụ: Enwere m ike itinye emoji omenala? A: Ọ bụghị site na katalọgụ. Jiri ngwugwu ihe mmado.
emojiCatalog.faq2: Ajụjụ: Gịnị kpatara na ị gaghị eji Twemoji? A: Ikikere + nha ngwugwu. Twemoji bụ CC-BY-4.0 mana nhazi PNG na-agbakwunye 20MB kwa onye ahịa.

audio.title: Ụzọ codec ọdịyo
audio.subtitle: Opus 48 kHz VBR
audio.what: Opus 48 kHz VBR. DTX na maka ịgbachi nkịtị. Ndagharị bitrate 6-128 kbps dabere na atụmatụ netwọkụ.
audio.why: Opus bụ onye mmeri doro anya maka ọdịyo VoIP: enweghị eze, NetEQ dakọtara, obere oge, nwalere nke ọma.
audio.where: Hụ koodu koodu n'ụzọ aha subsystem pụtara.
audio.how: Rụtụ aka na modul's README ma ọ bụ faịlụ mmejuputa bụ isi maka nzọụkwụ site na nzọụkwụ.
audio.when: Ebe ọ bụla subsystem dị mkpa; hụ saịtị oku site na grep.
audio.cfg1: Ihe ndabara bụ ergonomic; gee ntị mgbe metrik gosiri.
audio.cfg2: Env-var dabeere; enweghị mgbanwe koodu achọrọ.
audio.fail1: Na-eweda ala gaa n'ọkwa ọrụ dị ala karịa ịdaba n'ike.
audio.fail2: Ndekọ na WARN; metrics abawanye; onye ọrụ nwere ike mara.
audio.mon1: Prometheus counters na gauges. Grafana dashboard na `deploy/grafana/`.
audio.mon2: Ndekọ ahaziri JSON nwere njirimara njikọ.
audio.tune1: Malite na ndabara. Gbanwee naanị ka otu izu gachara ilele metrik ntọala.
audio.tune2: Detuo mgbanwe ọ bụla na ops runbook ka ops n'ọdịnihu mara ihe kpatara ya.
audio.edge1: Na-ejikwa mbelata ibu mara mma na-ejizi ibu ezi uche dị na ya.
audio.edge2: Ụdị ọdịda edekọtara nke dị n'elu na-ekpuchi ikpe ọrịa ọrịa na-emekarị.
audio.mig1: Ụdị-akpado; Ndozigharị Alembic na-ekpuchi mmetụ atụmatụ DB ọ bụla.
audio.mig2: Rollback bụ 'git checkout <tag> && mee ka ebuga'.
audio.ts1: Lelee metrik mbụ. Mgbe ahụ, ndekọ ndekọ site na njikota id na-enyocha.
audio.ts2: Ọ bụrụ na ihe niile daa, tinye py-spy wee nweta flamegraph.
audio.faq1: Ajụjụ: Nke a ọ dị ezigbo mkpa? A: Ee maka nhazi njirimara zuru oke; nwere ike stubed na obere ntinye ọrụ.
audio.faq2: Ajụjụ: Gịnị bụ ọnụ ahịa? A: A na-adịghị ahụ anya na ibu ndị a na-ahụkarị; edebere na 'docs/costs.md'.
audio.faq3: Ajụjụ: Enwere m ike gbanyụọ ya? A: Lee `.env.example` maka ọkọlọtọ njirimara.

smartReply.title: Smartreply - ntụaka
smartReply.subtitle: Nchịkọta nke sistemụ.
smartReply.what: smartReply bụ sistemụ nchịkwa Vortex. Ọ na-esonye na protocol ngwụcha ruo ọgwụgwụ nke onye ozi ma dekọọ ya na sistemụ ndị ọzọ dị na ntụaka a.
smartReply.why: Usoro subsystem dị n'ihi na protocol nwere oghere akọwapụtara nke ọma maka ya. Iwepu ya ga-ahapụ oghere na-arụ ọrụ nke ndị ọrụ na-adabere na ya.
smartReply.where: Hụ Vortex osisi isi iyi. Mgbakọ aha aha bụ 'ngwa/<atụmatụ>/' n'ọnụ ọnụ, `static/js/<feature>/` na web ahịa, `ios/Modules/Isi mmalite/<Feature>/` na iOS, `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/<atụmatụ>/` na gam akporo.
smartReply.how: Ndị ahịa na-akpọku sistemụ ahụ site na elu API; ụzọ ọnụ ụzọ, ụlọ ahịa, na fan dị ka o kwesịrị. Nkọwa mmejuputa na-ebi na modul's README ebe ọ dị.
smartReply.when: Mgbe ọ bụla smartReply dị mkpa - lee koodu maka saịtị oku.
smartReply.cfg1: Nhazi ndabere na-arụ ọrụ maka ikpe nkịtị.
smartReply.cfg3: Edere mkpịsị ugodi na-emegharị na modul's README.
smartReply.fail1: Ọrụ ewedara ala karịa ọdịda siri ike.
smartReply.fail2: Mmụba metrics; na-egosi ọkụ ma ọ bụrụ na oke gafere.
smartReply.fail3: Mgbalị ọzọ bụ oke; enweghị loops enweghị ngwụcha.
smartReply.mon3: Banye na INFO maka ụzọ na-aga nke ọma, WARN maka mperi enwere ike nwetaghachi.
smartReply.tune2: Lelee metrics maka otu izu tupu ịgbanwe.
smartReply.tune3: Detuo ihe kpatara mgbanwe ngbanwe ọ bụla.
smartReply.edge1: Na-edozi ikpe ọnụ ọnụ a na-atụ anya n'otu ụdịdị protocol.
smartReply.edge2: A na-abanye n'ọnụ ọnụ ọnụ amaghi ama maka nyocha onye ọrụ.
smartReply.mig1: Ndozigharị Alembic na-ekpuchi mgbanwe schema ọ bụla.
smartReply.mig2: A na-akwado Rollback maka otu obere ụdị.
smartReply.ts2: Wepụta ndekọ site na njirimara njikọ.
smartReply.ts3: Gaa na ngalaba nchọpụta nsogbu README modul.
smartReply.faq1: Ajụjụ: Njirimara a ọ kwụsiri ike? A: Ee, obere ụdị kwụsiri ike. Isi ụdị nwere ike imebi ndakọrịta.
smartReply.faq2: Ajụjụ: Enwere m ike gbanyụọ ya? A: Ee site na ọkọlọtọ njirimara.
smartReply.faq3: Ajụjụ: A na-akwado ya na ndabara? A: dabere; lelee `.env.ihe atụ'.

silentPushWakeup.when: Mgbe ọ bụla silentPushWakeup dị mkpa - lee koodu maka saịtị oku.
silentPushWakeup.cfg1: Nhazi ndabere na-arụ ọrụ maka ikpe nkịtị.
silentPushWakeup.cfg3: Edere mkpịsị ugodi na-emegharị na modul's README.
silentPushWakeup.fail1: Ọrụ ewedara ala karịa ọdịda siri ike.
silentPushWakeup.fail2: Mmụba metrics; na-egosi ọkụ ma ọ bụrụ na oke gafere.
silentPushWakeup.fail3: Mgbalị ọzọ bụ oke; enweghị loops enweghị ngwụcha.
silentPushWakeup.mon3: Banye na INFO maka ụzọ na-aga nke ọma, WARN maka mperi enwere ike nwetaghachi.
silentPushWakeup.tune2: Lelee metrics maka otu izu tupu ịgbanwe.
silentPushWakeup.tune3: Detuo ihe kpatara mgbanwe ngbanwe ọ bụla.
silentPushWakeup.edge1: Na-edozi ikpe ọnụ ọnụ a na-atụ anya n'otu ụdịdị protocol.
silentPushWakeup.edge2: A na-abanye n'ọnụ ọnụ ọnụ amaghi ama maka nyocha onye ọrụ.
silentPushWakeup.mig1: Ndozigharị Alembic na-ekpuchi mgbanwe schema ọ bụla.
silentPushWakeup.mig2: A na-akwado Rollback maka otu obere ụdị.
silentPushWakeup.ts2: Wepụta ndekọ site na njirimara njikọ.
silentPushWakeup.ts3: Gaa na ngalaba nchọpụta nsogbu README modul.
silentPushWakeup.faq1: Ajụjụ: Njirimara a ọ kwụsiri ike? A: Ee, obere ụdị kwụsiri ike. Isi ụdị nwere ike imebi ndakọrịta.
silentPushWakeup.faq2: Ajụjụ: Enwere m ike gbanyụọ ya? A: Ee site na ọkọlọtọ njirimara.
silentPushWakeup.faq3: Ajụjụ: A na-akwado ya na ndabara? A: dabere; lelee `.env.ihe atụ'.

pollMessages.what: pollMessages bụ sistemụ nchịkwa Vortex. Ọ na-esonye na protocol ngwụcha ruo ọgwụgwụ nke onye ozi ma dekọọ ya na sistemụ ndị ọzọ dị na ntụaka a.
pollMessages.why: Usoro subsystem dị n'ihi na protocol nwere oghere akọwapụtara nke ọma maka ya. Iwepu ya ga-ahapụ oghere na-arụ ọrụ nke ndị ọrụ na-adabere na ya.
pollMessages.where: Hụ Vortex osisi isi iyi. Mgbakọ aha aha bụ 'ngwa/<atụmatụ>/' n'ọnụ ọnụ, `static/js/<feature>/` na web ahịa, `ios/Modules/Isi mmalite/<Feature>/` na iOS, `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/<atụmatụ>/` na gam akporo.
pollMessages.how: Ndị ahịa na-akpọku sistemụ ahụ site na elu API; ụzọ ọnụ ụzọ, ụlọ ahịa, na fan dị ka o kwesịrị. Nkọwa mmejuputa na-ebi na modul's README ebe ọ dị.
pollMessages.when: Mgbe ọ bụla ozi ntuli aka dị mkpa - lee koodu maka saịtị oku.
pollMessages.cfg1: Nhazi ndabere na-arụ ọrụ maka ikpe nkịtị.
pollMessages.cfg3: Edere mkpịsị ugodi na-emegharị na modul's README.
pollMessages.fail1: Ọrụ ewedara ala karịa ọdịda siri ike.
pollMessages.fail2: Mmụba metrics; na-egosi ọkụ ma ọ bụrụ na oke gafere.
pollMessages.fail3: Mgbalị ọzọ bụ oke; enweghị loops enweghị ngwụcha.
pollMessages.mon3: Banye na INFO maka ụzọ na-aga nke ọma, WARN maka mperi enwere ike nwetaghachi.
pollMessages.tune2: Lelee metrics maka otu izu tupu ịgbanwe.
pollMessages.tune3: Detuo ihe kpatara mgbanwe ngbanwe ọ bụla.
pollMessages.edge1: Na-edozi ikpe ọnụ ọnụ a na-atụ anya n'otu ụdịdị protocol.
pollMessages.edge2: A na-abanye n'ọnụ ọnụ ọnụ amaghi ama maka nyocha onye ọrụ.
pollMessages.mig1: Ndozigharị Alembic na-ekpuchi mgbanwe schema ọ bụla.
pollMessages.mig2: A na-akwado Rollback maka otu obere ụdị.
pollMessages.ts2: Wepụta ndekọ site na njirimara njikọ.
pollMessages.ts3: Gaa na ngalaba nchọpụta nsogbu README modul.
pollMessages.faq1: Ajụjụ: Njirimara a ọ kwụsiri ike? A: Ee, obere ụdị kwụsiri ike. Isi ụdị nwere ike imebi ndakọrịta.
pollMessages.faq2: Ajụjụ: Enwere m ike gbanyụọ ya? A: Ee site na ọkọlọtọ njirimara.
pollMessages.faq3: Ajụjụ: A na-akwado ya na ndabara? A: dabere; lelee `.env.ihe atụ'.

roomAgeRestriction.faq3: Ajụjụ: A na-akwado ya na ndabara? A: dabere; lelee `.env.ihe atụ'.

botPayments.why: Usoro subsystem dị n'ihi na protocol nwere oghere akọwapụtara nke ọma maka ya. Iwepu ya ga-ahapụ oghere na-arụ ọrụ nke ndị ọrụ na-adabere na ya.
botPayments.where: Hụ Vortex osisi isi iyi. Mgbakọ aha aha bụ 'ngwa/<atụmatụ>/' n'ọnụ ọnụ, `static/js/<feature>/` na web ahịa, `ios/Modules/Isi mmalite/<Feature>/` na iOS, `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/<atụmatụ>/` na gam akporo.
botPayments.how: Ndị ahịa na-akpọku sistemụ ahụ site na elu API; ụzọ ọnụ ụzọ, ụlọ ahịa, na fan dị ka o kwesịrị. Nkọwa mmejuputa na-ebi na modul's README ebe ọ dị.
botPayments.when: Mgbe ọ bụla botPayments dị mkpa - hụ koodu maka saịtị oku.
botPayments.cfg1: Nhazi ndabere na-arụ ọrụ maka ikpe nkịtị.
botPayments.cfg3: Edere mkpịsị ugodi na-emegharị na modul's README.
botPayments.fail1: Ọrụ ewedara ala karịa ọdịda siri ike.
botPayments.fail2: Mmụba metrics; na-egosi ọkụ ma ọ bụrụ na oke gafere.
botPayments.fail3: Mgbalị ọzọ bụ oke; enweghị loops enweghị ngwụcha.
botPayments.mon3: Banye na INFO maka ụzọ na-aga nke ọma, WARN maka mperi enwere ike nwetaghachi.
botPayments.tune2: Lelee metrics maka otu izu tupu ịgbanwe.
botPayments.tune3: Detuo ihe kpatara mgbanwe ngbanwe ọ bụla.
botPayments.edge1: Na-edozi ikpe ọnụ ọnụ a na-atụ anya n'otu ụdịdị protocol.
botPayments.edge2: A na-abanye n'ọnụ ọnụ ọnụ amaghi ama maka nyocha onye ọrụ.
botPayments.mig1: Ndozigharị Alembic na-ekpuchi mgbanwe schema ọ bụla.
botPayments.mig2: A na-akwado Rollback maka otu obere ụdị.
botPayments.ts2: Wepụta ndekọ site na njirimara njikọ.
botPayments.ts3: Gaa na ngalaba nchọpụta nsogbu README modul.
botPayments.faq1: Ajụjụ: Njirimara a ọ kwụsiri ike? A: Ee, obere ụdị kwụsiri ike. Isi ụdị nwere ike imebi ndakọrịta.
botPayments.faq2: Ajụjụ: Enwere m ike gbanyụọ ya? A: Ee site na ọkọlọtọ njirimara.
botPayments.faq3: Ajụjụ: A na-akwado ya na ndabara? A: dabere; lelee `.env.ihe atụ'.

cloudStorageLimit.what: CloudStorageLimit bụ sistemụ nchekwa Vortex. Ọ na-esonye na protocol ngwụcha ruo ọgwụgwụ nke onye ozi ma dekọọ ya na sistemụ ndị ọzọ dị na ntụaka a.
cloudStorageLimit.why: Usoro subsystem dị n'ihi na protocol nwere oghere akọwapụtara nke ọma maka ya. Iwepu ya ga-ahapụ oghere na-arụ ọrụ nke ndị ọrụ na-adabere na ya.
cloudStorageLimit.where: Hụ Vortex osisi isi iyi. Mgbakọ aha aha bụ 'ngwa/<atụmatụ>/' n'ọnụ ọnụ, `static/js/<feature>/` na web ahịa, `ios/Modules/Isi mmalite/<Feature>/` na iOS, `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/<atụmatụ>/` na gam akporo.
cloudStorageLimit.how: Ndị ahịa na-akpọku sistemụ ahụ site na elu API; ụzọ ọnụ ụzọ, ụlọ ahịa, na fan dị ka o kwesịrị. Nkọwa mmejuputa na-ebi na modul's README ebe ọ dị.
cloudStorageLimit.when: Mgbe ọ bụla cloudStorageLimit dị mkpa - lee koodu maka saịtị oku.
cloudStorageLimit.cfg1: Nhazi ndabere na-arụ ọrụ maka ikpe nkịtị.
cloudStorageLimit.cfg3: Edere mkpịsị ugodi na-emegharị na modul's README.
cloudStorageLimit.fail1: Ọrụ ewedara ala karịa ọdịda siri ike.
cloudStorageLimit.fail2: Mmụba metrics; na-egosi ọkụ ma ọ bụrụ na oke gafere.
cloudStorageLimit.fail3: Mgbalị ọzọ bụ oke; enweghị loops enweghị ngwụcha.
cloudStorageLimit.mon3: Banye na INFO maka ụzọ na-aga nke ọma, WARN maka mperi enwere ike nwetaghachi.
cloudStorageLimit.tune2: Lelee metrics maka otu izu tupu ịgbanwe.
cloudStorageLimit.tune3: Detuo ihe kpatara mgbanwe ngbanwe ọ bụla.
cloudStorageLimit.edge1: Na-edozi ikpe ọnụ ọnụ a na-atụ anya n'otu ụdịdị protocol.
cloudStorageLimit.edge2: A na-abanye n'ọnụ ọnụ ọnụ amaghi ama maka nyocha onye ọrụ.
cloudStorageLimit.mig1: Ndozigharị Alembic na-ekpuchi mgbanwe schema ọ bụla.
cloudStorageLimit.mig2: A na-akwado Rollback maka otu obere ụdị.
cloudStorageLimit.ts2: Wepụta ndekọ site na njirimara njikọ.
cloudStorageLimit.ts3: Gaa na ngalaba nchọpụta nsogbu README modul.
cloudStorageLimit.faq1: Ajụjụ: Njirimara a ọ kwụsiri ike? A: Ee, obere ụdị kwụsiri ike. Isi ụdị nwere ike imebi ndakọrịta.
cloudStorageLimit.faq2: Ajụjụ: Enwere m ike gbanyụọ ya? A: Ee site na ọkọlọtọ njirimara.
cloudStorageLimit.faq3: Ajụjụ: A na-akwado ya na ndabara? A: dabere; lelee `.env.ihe atụ'.

terraformModule.what: terraformModule bụ sistemụ nchịkwa Vortex. Ọ na-esonye na protocol ngwụcha ruo ọgwụgwụ nke onye ozi ma dekọọ ya na sistemụ ndị ọzọ dị na ntụaka a.
terraformModule.why: Usoro subsystem dị n'ihi na protocol nwere oghere akọwapụtara nke ọma maka ya. Iwepu ya ga-ahapụ oghere na-arụ ọrụ nke ndị ọrụ na-adabere na ya.

terraformModule.how: Ndị ahịa na-akpọku sistemụ ahụ site na elu API; ụzọ ọnụ ụzọ, ụlọ ahịa, na fan dị ka o kwesịrị. Nkọwa mmejuputa na-ebi na modul's README ebe ọ dị.
terraformModule.when: Mgbe ọ bụla terraformModule dị mkpa - lee koodu maka saịtị oku.
terraformModule.cfg1: Nhazi ndabere na-arụ ọrụ maka ikpe nkịtị.
terraformModule.cfg3: Edere mkpịsị ugodi na-emegharị na modul's README.
terraformModule.fail1: Ọrụ ewedara ala karịa ọdịda siri ike.
terraformModule.fail2: Mmụba metrics; na-egosi ọkụ ma ọ bụrụ na oke gafere.
terraformModule.fail3: Mgbalị ọzọ bụ oke; enweghị loops enweghị ngwụcha.
terraformModule.mon3: Banye na INFO maka ụzọ na-aga nke ọma, WARN maka mperi enwere ike nwetaghachi.
terraformModule.tune2: Lelee metrics maka otu izu tupu ịgbanwe.
terraformModule.tune3: Detuo ihe kpatara mgbanwe ngbanwe ọ bụla.
terraformModule.edge1: Na-edozi ikpe ọnụ ọnụ a na-atụ anya n'otu ụdịdị protocol.
terraformModule.edge2: A na-abanye n'ọnụ ọnụ ọnụ amaghi ama maka nyocha onye ọrụ.
terraformModule.mig1: Ndozigharị Alembic na-ekpuchi mgbanwe schema ọ bụla.
terraformModule.mig2: A na-akwado Rollback maka otu obere ụdị.
terraformModule.ts2: Wepụta ndekọ site na njirimara njikọ.
terraformModule.ts3: Gaa na ngalaba nchọpụta nsogbu README modul.
terraformModule.faq1: Ajụjụ: Njirimara a ọ kwụsiri ike? A: Ee, obere ụdị kwụsiri ike. Isi ụdị nwere ike imebi ndakọrịta.
terraformModule.faq2: Ajụjụ: Enwere m ike gbanyụọ ya? A: Ee site na ọkọlọtọ njirimara.
terraformModule.faq3: Ajụjụ: A na-akwado ya na ndabara? A: dabere; lelee `.env.ihe atụ'.

codeSigningMicrosoft.what: codesigningMicrosoft bụ sistemụ Vortex. Ọ na-esonye na protocol ngwụcha ruo ọgwụgwụ nke onye ozi ma dekọọ ya na sistemụ ndị ọzọ dị na ntụaka a.
codeSigningMicrosoft.why: Usoro subsystem dị n'ihi na protocol nwere oghere akọwapụtara nke ọma maka ya. Iwepu ya ga-ahapụ oghere na-arụ ọrụ nke ndị ọrụ na-adabere na ya.
codeSigningMicrosoft.where: Hụ Vortex osisi isi iyi. Mgbakọ aha aha bụ 'ngwa/<atụmatụ>/' n'ọnụ ọnụ, `static/js/<feature>/` na web ahịa, `ios/Modules/Isi mmalite/<Feature>/` na iOS, `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/<atụmatụ>/` na gam akporo.
codeSigningMicrosoft.how: Ndị ahịa na-akpọku sistemụ ahụ site na elu API; ụzọ ọnụ ụzọ, ụlọ ahịa, na fan dị ka o kwesịrị. Nkọwa mmejuputa na-ebi na modul's README ebe ọ dị.
codeSigningMicrosoft.when: Mgbe ọ bụla codesigningMicrosoft dị mkpa - lee koodu maka saịtị oku.
codeSigningMicrosoft.cfg1: Nhazi ndabere na-arụ ọrụ maka ikpe nkịtị.
codeSigningMicrosoft.cfg3: Edere mkpịsị ugodi na-emegharị na modul's README.
codeSigningMicrosoft.fail1: Ọrụ ewedara ala karịa ọdịda siri ike.
codeSigningMicrosoft.fail2: Mmụba metrics; na-egosi ọkụ ma ọ bụrụ na oke gafere.
codeSigningMicrosoft.fail3: Mgbalị ọzọ bụ oke; enweghị loops enweghị ngwụcha.
codeSigningMicrosoft.mon3: Banye na INFO maka ụzọ na-aga nke ọma, WARN maka mperi enwere ike nwetaghachi.
codeSigningMicrosoft.tune2: Lelee metrics maka otu izu tupu ịgbanwe.
codeSigningMicrosoft.tune3: Detuo ihe kpatara mgbanwe ngbanwe ọ bụla.
codeSigningMicrosoft.edge1: Na-edozi ikpe ọnụ ọnụ a na-atụ anya n'otu ụdịdị protocol.
codeSigningMicrosoft.edge2: A na-abanye n'ọnụ ọnụ ọnụ amaghi ama maka nyocha onye ọrụ.
codeSigningMicrosoft.mig1: Ndozigharị Alembic na-ekpuchi mgbanwe schema ọ bụla.
codeSigningMicrosoft.mig2: A na-akwado Rollback maka otu obere ụdị.
codeSigningMicrosoft.ts2: Wepụta ndekọ site na njirimara njikọ.
codeSigningMicrosoft.ts3: Gaa na ngalaba nchọpụta nsogbu README modul.
codeSigningMicrosoft.faq1: Ajụjụ: Njirimara a ọ kwụsiri ike? A: Ee, obere ụdị kwụsiri ike. Isi ụdị nwere ike imebi ndakọrịta.
codeSigningMicrosoft.faq2: Ajụjụ: Enwere m ike gbanyụọ ya? A: Ee site na ọkọlọtọ njirimara.
codeSigningMicrosoft.faq3: Ajụjụ: A na-akwado ya na ndabara? A: dabere; lelee `.env.ihe atụ'.
