bweAimd.what: bweAimd bụ sistemụ nchịkwa Vortex. Ọ na-esonye na protocol ngwụcha ruo ọgwụgwụ nke onye ozi ma dekọọ ya na sistemụ ndị ọzọ dị na ntụaka a.
bweAimd.why: Usoro subsystem dị n'ihi na protocol nwere oghere akọwapụtara nke ọma maka ya. Iwepu ya ga-ahapụ oghere na-arụ ọrụ nke ndị ọrụ na-adabere na ya.
bweAimd.where: Hụ Vortex osisi isi iyi. Mgbakọ aha aha bụ 'ngwa/<atụmatụ>/' n'ọnụ ọnụ, `static/js/<feature>/` na web ahịa, `ios/Modules/Isi mmalite/<Feature>/` na iOS, `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/<atụmatụ>/` na gam akporo.
bweAimd.how: Ndị ahịa na-akpọku sistemụ ahụ site na elu API; ụzọ ọnụ ụzọ, ụlọ ahịa, na fan dị ka o kwesịrị. Nkọwa mmejuputa na-ebi na modul's README ebe ọ dị.
bweAimd.when: Mgbe ọ bụla bweAimd dị mkpa - hụ koodu maka saịtị oku.
bweAimd.cfg1: Nhazi ndabere na-arụ ọrụ maka ikpe nkịtị.
bweAimd.cfg3: Edere mkpịsị ugodi na-emegharị na modul's README.
bweAimd.fail1: Ọrụ ewedara ala karịa ọdịda siri ike.
bweAimd.fail2: Mmụba metrics; na-egosi ọkụ ma ọ bụrụ na oke gafere.
bweAimd.fail3: Mgbalị ọzọ bụ oke; enweghị loops enweghị ngwụcha.
bweAimd.mon3: Banye na INFO maka ụzọ na-aga nke ọma, WARN maka mperi enwere ike nwetaghachi.
bweAimd.tune2: Lelee metrics maka otu izu tupu ịgbanwe.
bweAimd.tune3: Detuo ihe kpatara mgbanwe ngbanwe ọ bụla.
bweAimd.edge1: Na-edozi ikpe ọnụ ọnụ a na-atụ anya n'otu ụdịdị protocol.
bweAimd.edge2: A na-abanye n'ọnụ ọnụ ọnụ amaghi ama maka nyocha onye ọrụ.
bweAimd.mig1: Ndozigharị Alembic na-ekpuchi mgbanwe schema ọ bụla.
bweAimd.mig2: A na-akwado Rollback maka otu obere ụdị.
bweAimd.ts2: Wepụta ndekọ site na njirimara njikọ.
bweAimd.ts3: Gaa na ngalaba nchọpụta nsogbu README modul.
bweAimd.faq1: Ajụjụ: Njirimara a ọ kwụsiri ike? A: Ee, obere ụdị kwụsiri ike. Isi ụdị nwere ike imebi ndakọrịta.
bweAimd.faq2: Ajụjụ: Enwere m ike gbanyụọ ya? A: Ee site na ọkọlọtọ njirimara.
bweAimd.faq3: Ajụjụ: A na-akwado ya na ndabara? A: dabere; lelee `.env.ihe atụ'.

mlsLeafNode.what: mlsLeafNode bụ sistemụ nchịkwa Vortex. Ọ na-esonye na protocol ngwụcha ruo ọgwụgwụ nke onye ozi ma dekọọ ya na sistemụ ndị ọzọ dị na ntụaka a.
mlsLeafNode.why: Usoro subsystem dị n'ihi na protocol nwere oghere akọwapụtara nke ọma maka ya. Iwepu ya ga-ahapụ oghere na-arụ ọrụ nke ndị ọrụ na-adabere na ya.
mlsLeafNode.where: Hụ Vortex osisi isi iyi. Mgbakọ aha aha bụ 'ngwa/<atụmatụ>/' n'ọnụ ọnụ, `static/js/<feature>/` na web ahịa, `ios/Modules/Isi mmalite/<Feature>/` na iOS, `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/<atụmatụ>/` na gam akporo.
mlsLeafNode.how: Ndị ahịa na-akpọku sistemụ ahụ site na elu API; ụzọ ọnụ ụzọ, ụlọ ahịa, na fan dị ka o kwesịrị. Nkọwa mmejuputa na-ebi na modul's README ebe ọ dị.
mlsLeafNode.when: Mgbe ọ bụla mlsLeafNode dị mkpa - hụ koodu maka saịtị oku.
mlsLeafNode.cfg1: Nhazi ndabere na-arụ ọrụ maka ikpe nkịtị.
mlsLeafNode.cfg3: Edere mkpịsị ugodi na-emegharị na modul's README.
mlsLeafNode.fail1: Ọrụ ewedara ala karịa ọdịda siri ike.
mlsLeafNode.fail2: Mmụba metrics; na-egosi ọkụ ma ọ bụrụ na oke gafere.
mlsLeafNode.fail3: Mgbalị ọzọ bụ oke; enweghị loops enweghị ngwụcha.
mlsLeafNode.mon3: Banye na INFO maka ụzọ na-aga nke ọma, WARN maka mperi enwere ike nwetaghachi.
mlsLeafNode.tune2: Lelee metrics maka otu izu tupu ịgbanwe.
mlsLeafNode.tune3: Detuo ihe kpatara mgbanwe ngbanwe ọ bụla.
mlsLeafNode.edge1: Na-edozi ikpe ọnụ ọnụ a na-atụ anya n'otu ụdịdị protocol.
mlsLeafNode.edge2: A na-abanye n'ọnụ ọnụ ọnụ amaghi ama maka nyocha onye ọrụ.
mlsLeafNode.mig1: Ndozigharị Alembic na-ekpuchi mgbanwe schema ọ bụla.
mlsLeafNode.mig2: A na-akwado Rollback maka otu obere ụdị.
mlsLeafNode.ts2: Wepụta ndekọ site na njirimara njikọ.
mlsLeafNode.ts3: Gaa na ngalaba nchọpụta nsogbu README modul.
mlsLeafNode.faq1: Ajụjụ: Njirimara a ọ kwụsiri ike? A: Ee, obere ụdị kwụsiri ike. Isi ụdị nwere ike imebi ndakọrịta.
mlsLeafNode.faq2: Ajụjụ: Enwere m ike gbanyụọ ya? A: Ee site na ọkọlọtọ njirimara.
mlsLeafNode.faq3: Ajụjụ: A na-akwado ya na ndabara? A: dabere; lelee `.env.ihe atụ'.

intro.h3: Otu esi agụ akwụkwọ ntụaka a
intro.p1: Architex bụ asụsụ nkwuputa UI wuru maka Vortex Mini Apps. Kama ịde JavaScript nke na-agbanwe DOM, ị na-akọwa ihuenyo ịchọrọ na oge ọ na-agba ọsọ na-eme ka pikselụ na mmekọrịta na steeti na-akpaghị aka.
intro.p2: Asụsụ ahụ pere mpe: nkwupụta anọ (@screen, @theme, @import, @for), otu prefix maka mgbanwe mgbanwe (~), na otu ndị na-arụ ọrụ maka ịke (::).
intro.p3: Ọ bụrụ na ịdela HTML + CSS + JS, Architex ga-amata nke ọma mana ọ nwere obere efere efere 10×. Ọ bụrụ na i mebeghị, Architex bụkwa okwu mmeghe dị nro maka mmemme reactive n'ihi na asụsụ dị ntakịrị ị nwere ike ijide ya niile n'isi gị.
intro.p4: Akụkụ nke ọ bụla n'ime ntụaka a na-adabere na ndị gara aga. Maba n'ebe ọ bụla masịrị gị ma ọ bụrụ na ị maraworị usoro nkwupụta UI ọzọ; gụọ elu ruo ala ma ọ bụrụ na ị na-amalite ọhụrụ.
intro.li1: Nkwupụta - kọwapụta ọdịdị nke UI, ọ bụghị usoro iji wuo ya.
intro.li2: Reactive - otu ọrụ na-emelite akara, klaasị ma ọ bụ ọnụ ọ bụla dabere
intro.li3: Portable - otu .arx na-agba na webụ, iOS na gam akporo ndị ọbịa.
intro.li4: Tiny — parser + ebugharị ụgbọ mmiri n'okpuru 30 KB gzipped
intro.ct1: Architex bụ ngalaba-kpọmkwem. Ọ gaghị edochi asụsụ ebumnuche izugbe - mana maka ibupu ihuenyo n'ime nkata ọ na-adị ngwa karịa usoro ọ bụla anyị tụrụ.
intro.ct2: Onye ọ bụla na-arụ na maapụ asụsụ ahụ ruo otu oge ochie. Enweghị anwansi ị na-enweghị ike ịkọwa.
intro.h1_a: Architex bụ asụsụ nkwuputa UI wuru maka Vortex Mini Apps. Kama ịde JavaScript nke na-agbanwe DOM, ị na-akọwa ihuenyo ịchọrọ na oge ọ na-agba ọsọ na-eme ka pikselụ na mmekọrịta na steeti na-akpaghị aka.
intro.h1_b: Nchịkọta mmejuputa maka "Gịnị bụ Architex?". A na-emejuputa usoro a na modul kwekọrọ n'okpuru 'app/', `ios/Modules/sources/', ma ọ bụ 'android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/'. Modul README na-akpọpụta ụzọ faịlụ ziri ezi.
intro.h1_c: Kedu ihe bụ Architex? usoro malitere n'ofe Vortex mwepụta. Nhazi ahụ na-esochi nyocha na omume mmepụta nke ndị ozi mbụ bipụtara. Akụkọ ụdị dị na ndekọ `CHANGELOG.md` mgbe ibe ọ bụla rutere na ihe kpaliri ya.
intro.h2_a: Asụsụ ahụ pere mpe: nkwupụta anọ (@screen, @theme, @import, @for), otu prefix maka mgbanwe mgbanwe (~), na otu ndị na-arụ ọrụ maka ịke (::).
intro.h2_b: Nchịkọta mmejuputa maka "Ònye bụ nke a maka?". A na-emejuputa usoro a na modul kwekọrọ n'okpuru 'app/', `ios/Modules/sources/', ma ọ bụ 'android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/'. Modul README na-akpọpụta ụzọ faịlụ ziri ezi.
intro.h2_c: The "Onye bụ nke a maka?" usoro malitere n'ofe Vortex mwepụta. Nhazi ahụ na-esochi nyocha na omume mmepụta nke ndị ozi mbụ bipụtara. Akụkọ ụdị dị na ndekọ `CHANGELOG.md` mgbe ibe ọ bụla rutere na ihe kpaliri ya.
intro.h3_a: Ọ bụrụ na ịdela HTML + CSS + JS, Architex ga-amata nke ọma mana ọ nwere obere efere efere 10×. Ọ bụrụ na i mebeghị, Architex bụkwa okwu mmeghe dị nro maka mmemme reactive n'ihi na asụsụ dị ntakịrị ị nwere ike ijide ya niile n'isi gị.
intro.h3_b: Nchịkọta mmejuputa maka "Otu esi agụ akwụkwọ ntụaka a". A na-emejuputa usoro a na modul kwekọrọ n'okpuru 'app/', `ios/Modules/sources/', ma ọ bụ 'android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/'. Modul README na-akpọpụta ụzọ faịlụ ziri ezi.

syntax.p1: Ewubere mmemme Architex ọ bụla site na nkwupụta ọkwa anọ dị elu: @screen, @theme, @import, @component, yana @for loop ahụ. Nke ọ bụla na-amalite na kọlụm 0; ihe niile etinyere n'okpuru bụ nke ngọngọ ahụ.
syntax.p2: A na-ede mgbanwe ndị na-emeghachi omume ~name - prefix tilde na-egosi ha dị ka sel esoro. Jiri ~name gụọ, kenye ya na =, jiri := gbakọọ.
syntax.p3: Akụrụngwa bụ ihe nchọpụta efu n'ahịrị nke ha: text, button, image, col, row, na ndị ọzọ. Arụmụka ọnọdụ ha na-abịa ozugbo: text ~message, button "Save".
syntax.p4: Ndị na-agbanwe agbanwe na-ejikọta mgbe ::. Ị nwere ike ịgbanye ọtụtụ ndị masịrị gị: :: pad(24) gap(16) center color(#4f8ef7) bold size(20).
syntax.p5: Ihe omume na-adị mgbe =>. Otu omume kwa akụ; yinye akụ ọtụtụ: button "Buy" => ~busy = true => send(action: "buy") => ~busy = false.
syntax.cc1: // nkwupụta mgbanwe reactive - a na-enweta ụdị ahụ site na uru
syntax.cc2: // ụdị nkọwa bụ nhọrọ mana ọ na-enyere aka mezue ozi njehie +
syntax.cc3: // components akwu site na indentation - 2 oghere kwa ọkwa, ọ dịghị taabụ
syntax.cc4: // modifiers na-etinye aka na akụrụngwa na ahịrị bu ụzọ
syntax.cc5: // otu omume kwa akụ - yinye ọtụtụ akụ n'otu ahịrị ma ọ bụrụ na ịchọrọ ha n'usoro
syntax.td7: Mgbọrọgwụ nke ihuenyo renderable - ngwa ọ bụla nwere otu.
syntax.td8: Ihe mgbochi isiokwu token - agba, radii, nha.
syntax.td9: Wepụ nkwupụta @component / @screen site na faịlụ ọzọ.
syntax.td10: Kọwaa akụrụngwa enwere ike ijikwa ya na parampat akpọrọ.
syntax.td11: Nye otu ngọngọ ụmụaka n'otu akụkụ nke ndepụta mmeghachi omume.
syntax.td12: Otu dị ka nke dị n'elu mana kechie ndeksi dabere na efu.

variables.p1: Ngbanwe na-emeghachi omume na-ejide uru ma na-agwa onye ọ bụla gụrụ ya na-akpaghị aka mgbe ị na-ede uru ọhụrụ. Jiri = kwupụta, nyegharịa ya na =, jiri += / -= / *= / /= kwalite.
variables.p2: Ndị mgbanwe agbakọtara na-enweta uru ha site na okwu na-enyochagharị mgbe ọ bụla ntinye ọ bụla gbanwere. Jiri := kwupụta kama =. Enweghị ndebanye aha akwụkwọ ntuziaka, enweghị chinchi uru bara uru.
variables.p3: Jiri : Type kọwapụta ụdị ahụ mgbe aha ahụ gachara. Ụdị akwadoro: number, string, boolean, array, object. Nkọwa bụ nhọrọ; A na-enweta ụdị ahụ site na uru mbụ.
variables.p4: Jiri obereCamelCase ma ọ bụ ikpe agwọ; Architex anaghị akwado ma. Debe aha dị mkpụmkpụ: ihuenyo nwere ọtụtụ aha ogologo na-emebi indentation.
variables.p5: Oke: mgbanwe mmeghachi omume ekwuputara n'ime @screen ka a na-ahụ anya naanị n'ime ahụ ihuenyo ahụ. A na-ahụ akara ngosi @theme n'ụwa niile.
variables.p6: Lifecycle: steeti na-adị ndụ ma ọ bụrụhaala na etinyere ihuenyo ahụ. Ịgagharị na-ebibi ya; ịnyagharị azụ na-emepụtaghachi ya na uru mbụ.
variables.p7: Nkwụsi ike: ka ị gafechara ihuenyo ahụ, kpọọ send(action: "save", data: ~state) ma hapụ onye ọbịa bot ka ọ nọgide.

variables.cc5: ~ ekele : = "Ndewo, & # 123;~ aha"!"  // gbakọrọ n'elu eriri ndebiri
variables.cc7: ~ ihe = [] // doro anya site na ntinye ọzọ

variables.h4_c: Usoro "ịkpọ aha" malitere n'ofe ewepụtara Vortex. Nhazi ahụ na-esochi nyocha na omume mmepụta nke ndị ozi mbụ bipụtara. Akụkọ ụdị dị na ndekọ `CHANGELOG.md` mgbe ibe ọ bụla rutere na ihe kpaliri ya.

state.p1: Mkpụrụ ndụ ọ bụla na-emeghachi omume na-adị ndụ ma ọ bụrụhaala na etinyere @screen mkpuchi ya. Imepe ihuenyo na-eme nkwupụta ya n'elu-ruo ala; ịhapụ ya site back() ma ọ bụ goto() na-ebibi ha.
state.p2: Ọ bụrụ na ịchọrọ steeti iji lanarị igodo, nweta ya n'aka onye ọbịa: ma ọ bụ POST gaa na bot nwere send() wee weghachi ya na oghe, ma ọ bụ nọgide na mpaghara site na oku store(key, value).
state.p3: Ntọgharị: nyegharịa na uru mbụ. Enweghị reset isiokwu n'ihi na re-ekenye ọrụ ugbua arụwo ọrụ; Oge ojiri gaa na-agbanwe ma na-atụgharị naanị ihe gbanwere.
state.p4: A na-agbakọ steeti ewepụtara site na :=. Architex na-akwado ndabere na-akpaghị aka, yabụ ị naghị eji aka depụta ha. Nleba anya dabere na ihe onwunwe ọ bụla, ọ bụghị otu ihe.
state.p5: A na-atụnyere nhazi na ihe site na ntụnye aka. Iji manye regharịa, kenye ihe n'usoro / ihe ọhụrụ. A na-eleghara mmụgharị nke ochie anya - ahia ebum n'obi maka semantics mmelite enwere ike ịkọ.
state.cc1: ~ ndepụta = [...~ ndepụta, ihe ọhụrụ] // manyegharịa ya na nrụtụ aka ọhụrụ
state.cc2: ~ ihe = & # 123;...~ obj, aha: "x""  // otu ụkpụrụ maka ihe
state.li2: Oge ndụ: site na @screen banye ka ọpụpụ.
state.li3: Concurrency: otu-threaded kwa ihuenyo. A na-ahazi mmelite n'ime otu microtask.
state.li4: Ịha nhata: siri ike (===) - inye otu uru ahụ na-akpalite ihe ọ bụla.

types.p1: Architex nwere ụdị ochie ise: number, string, boolean, null, na ihe mejupụtara object / array. A na-agafe ụbọchị dịka eriri (ISO 8601) ma ọ bụ nọmba (unix ms).
types.p2: Ọnụọgụ bụ 64-bit okpukpu abụọ (IEEE 754). Mgbakọ ọnụọgụgụ ruru 2^53 bụ kpọmkwem.
types.p3: Ụdọ bụ UTF-8; ogologo agụ koodu, ọ bụghị bytes. Interpolation na-eji ihe nkwado gbagọrọ agbagọ.
types.p4: Booleans bụ true / false. Ọnweghị ntụgharị ezoro ezo site na eriri.
types.p5: A na-enye usoro nhazi, 0-indexed. Nweta site na ~arr[0]; ogologo site ~arr.length.
types.p6: Ihe bụ igodo enweghị usoro → maapụ uru. Nweta site na ~obj.name ma ọ bụ ~obj["name"].
types.p7: Mmanye: Ndị na-ahụ maka mgbakọ na mwepụ na-amanye eriri na ọnụọgụ ma ọ bụrụ na eriri ahụ yiri ọnụọgụ; ma ọ bụghị ya, njehie okwu na-agba ọkụ n'oge ọ na-agba ọsọ.
types.p8: Eziokwu: ụkpụrụ ụgha bụ false, 0, "", null, na ihe / ihe efu. Ihe niile ọzọ bụ eziokwu.

operators.h1: Ndị na-arụ ọrụ mgbakọ na mwepụ
operators.p1: Arthmetic na-eso ụzọ ọkọlọtọ. Nkewa site na efu na-alaghachi Infinity wee dekọọ ịdọ aka ná ntị; modulo site efu nloghachi NaN.
operators.p2: Ndị na-ahụ maka ntụnyere na-alaghachi boolean. == bụ nha anya siri ike (enweghị mmanye ụdịrị).
operators.p3: Ndị na-arụ ọrụ ezi uche na-eme mkpirisi okirikiri aka ekpe ruo aka nri.
operators.p4: The ternary cond ? a : b na-arụ ọrụ ebe ọ bụla a nabatara okwu; akwu maka enum-dị ka anya.
operators.p5: Ndị na-ahụ maka ọrụ ngwakọta (+=, -=, *=, /=, %=) na-arụ ọrụ na cell ọ bụla na-arụ ọrụ.
operators.td20: Ihe na-erughị / obere ma ọ bụ nhata
operators.td23: Ezi uche ma ọ bụ (obere okirikiri)

layout.p1: Architex nwere kpọmkwem akpa abụọ nwere ike ịmekọrịta: col ( vetikal) na row (n'ahịrị). Ihe ọ bụla ọzọ bụ akụkụ akwukwo.
layout.p2: Tinye ụmụaka otu ọkwa dị omimi karịa akpa ha. Enweghị mkpado mmechi - parser na-eji indentation naanị.
layout.p3: Ngwongwo na-anabata gap(px) maka ohere n'etiti ụmụaka, pad(px) maka nkpuchi ime, center ka etiti n'akụkụ obe, grow mejupụta oghere fọdụrụ n'akụkụ axis isi.
layout.p4: Nhazi nhazi bụ ọkwa-akpa: center n'ime ebe col kwụ n'ahịrị; na a ⟪2 ⟫ ọ gbadoro ụkwụ ọtọ. align(left) / align(right) / align(top) / align(bottom) bụ mgbaghara doro anya.
layout.p5: Nhazi: na ndabara akụrụngwa ọ bụla na-ada ada ka ọ dabara ọdịnaya ya. Jiri w(px), h(px), grow, ma ọ bụ nke doro anya maxW(px) / maxH(px) iji jide.
layout.cc3: col :: tolite // were oghere vetikal niile fọdụrụ
layout.cc4: ahiri :: tolite // were ohere niile fọdụrụ na kehoraizin
layout.li2: row - ụmụaka ahịrị aka ekpe gaa n'aka nri
layout.li4: Ụmụaka nwere grow na-ekewa ohere fọdụrụ n'otu nha ma ọ bụrụ na enyereghị nha doro anya.

modifiers.p1: Ndị na-agbanwe agbanwe na-abịa mgbe :: ma bụrụ ndị a na-ekekọta ya mgbe niile. Enweghị usoro nkwupụta icheta; esemokwu na-edozi onye edemede ikpeazụ-emeri n'ime ezinụlọ.
modifiers.p2: Spacing ezinụlọ: pad(n) (n'akụkụ niile), pad(x, y) (horizontal, vetikal), pad(t, r, b, l) (CSS usoro), gap(n) (n'etiti ụmụaka), margin(n) (n'èzí).
modifiers.p4: Ezinụlọ agba: color(#rrggbb) (foreground), bg(#rrggbb) (ndabere). Ha abụọ na-anabata akara ngosi isiokwu (color(~primary)) na hex ọnụọgụ asatọ maka alfa (#00000080).
modifiers.p6: Ezinụlọ visibility: hidden(~flag) na-ewepụ ọnụ mgbe ọkọlọtọ bụ eziokwu; visible(~flag) bụ ihe mgbagha. Nodes na-ekpughị wụfuo DOM - ọnọdụ UI dị ọnụ ala.
modifiers.p7: Ezinụlọ omume: debounce(ms) na mmelite input na-emelite; placeholder("…") na-egosi ndumodu; format(kind, arg) na text usoro nọmba ("currency", "percent", "compact").
modifiers.p8: Border/radius: radius(px) gburugburu nkuku; border(#rrggbb) na-adọta strok 1 px; border(px, #rrggbb) na-atọkwa ọkpụrụkpụ.
modifiers.cc2: :: mpe mpe akwa (24, 16) // kwụ ọtọ 24, vetikal 16
modifiers.li2: Ndị na-agbanwe agba na-edozi mmeri ikpeazụ-odee.
modifiers.li3: Ọdịiche na-emetụta tupu nha, nha tupu oke.

handlers.p1: Ihe ndị na-emekọrịta ihe na-ejikọta ihe omume mgbe =>. Omume bọtịnụ na-agba ọkụ na mgbata. Omume ntinye na-enwu na mgbanwe (mgbe debounce ma ọ bụrụ na ahaziri ya).
handlers.p2: Ị nwere ike kenye ọtụtụ omume n'otu ahịrị. Ha na-eme n'elu ruo na ala n'otu microtask, yabụ UI na-emelite otu ugboro na njedebe.
handlers.p3: Omume nwere ike ekenye sel na-arụ ọrụ, kpọọ ụlọ arụnyere ụlọ ọrụ, ịnyagharịa, ma ọ bụ send() ozi laghachi na bot.
handlers.p4: A na-enweta ụlọ ndị ọbịa wuru n'elu ikpo okwu: copy(~text), share(~text), haptic("light"|"medium"|"heavy"), vibrate(ms), alert("..."), confirm("...") => ~ok = it, goto("ScreenName", arg: val), back(), close().
handlers.cc2: bọtịnụ "zụta" => ~ ọrụ n'aka = eziokwu => zipu (omume: "zụta") => ~ arụ ọrụ = ụgha
handlers.cc3: ntinye ~ email :: debounce(300) => zipu (omume: " kwadoro", email: ~ email)
handlers.cc5: bọtịnụ "Mepee ntọala" => goto("Ntọala", onye ọrụ: ~ onye ọrụ)

control_flow.h3: Gbanwee-dị ka site na akwu ternary
control_flow.p1: Architex enweghị nkwupụta if na ọkwa dị elu nke syntax. A na-egosipụta ọnọdụ UI site na mgbanwe hidden(~flag)/visible(~flag) ma ọ bụ site na okwu ternary na ụkpụrụ akụrụngwa.
control_flow.p2: Ternary na-arụ ọrụ ebe ọ bụla anabatara uru: arụmụka akụrụngwa, arụmụka mgbanwe, uru agbakọrọ.
control_flow.p3: Maka ihe karịrị alaka abụọ, akwụ ụgwọ ternary. Architex na-atụgharị aka nri-gaa n'aka ekpe ka akwu na-agụkwa ya.
control_flow.p4: Maka mgbagha dị ka switch maka ihe, jiri nyocha agbakọtara: ~labels := {home: "Home", settings: "Settings"}; text ~labels[~active].
control_flow.cc5: ederede ~ akara[~ arụ ọrụ] :: nkwuwa okwu
control_flow.li1: Enweghị ngọngọ if - jiri modifier ma ọ bụ ternary.
control_flow.li2: Ọ dịghị else if yinye - jiri akwu ternary.
control_flow.li3: Enweghị ụkpụrụ dabara na ya - jiri tebụl nyocha kama.
control_flow.li4: Ọ dịghị mmalite nloghachi - keonodu alaka bụ ụkpụrụ, ọ bụghị nkwupụta.

loops.p1: Tinyegharịa ngọngọ nke UI kwa element na @for item in ~list. Tinye n'ime ahụ; Nwa ọ bụla na-eme otu ugboro n'otu akụkụ.

loops.p4: Akwu @for n'efu. Loops dị n'ime na-ahụ njikọ aka aka mpụta.

theme.p2: Token na-aghọ mgbanwe mgbanwe nkịtị. Oge ngbanwe ọnọdụ gbara ọchịchịrị bụ ahịrị atọ: egwu ~isDark, ka isiokwu kọwaa akara dị ka ternary, na otu akụkụ toggle na-atụgharị mgbanwe ahụ.

imports.p1: @import "./path/to/file.arx" na-ewepụ @component na @screen ọ bụla site na faịlụ ahụ n'ime oke ugbu a. Ụzọ ndị metụtara faịlụ mbubata.
imports.p2: Mbubata anaghị emepụta oghere aha. Aha na-agbakọ n'ofe mbubata - mmeri ndị mbubata ikpeazụ. Debe aha akụrụngwa pụrụ iche.
imports.p3: Mbupụ ọzọ: enweghị isi okwu re-export. Iji mee ka faịlụ dị ala keta akụrụngwa, bubata ihe ndị dị n'elu wee kwupụta na ihuenyo gị na-ezo aka na ha.
imports.p4: A na-achọpụta mbubata okirikiri n'oge nzacha. Otu faịlụ A na-ebubata B na-ebubata mperi A nwere ụzọ okirikiri.

define_comp.h4_c: Usoro "reusing components" malitere n'ofe Vortex ewepụtara. Nhazi ahụ na-esochi nyocha na omume mmepụta nke ndị ozi mbụ bipụtara. Akụkọ ụdị dị na ndekọ `CHANGELOG.md` mgbe ibe ọ bụla rutere na ihe kpaliri ya.

reactivity.p1: Ihe ọ bụla a na-agụ na-emeghachi omume n'ime okwu agbakọtara ma ọ bụ arụmụka mgbanwe na-edebanye aha ndabere. Mgbe ndabere ọ bụla gbanwere, okwu ahụ na-enyochagharị na microtask na-esote.
reactivity.p2: A na-ahazi ederede: ọtụtụ ọrụ n'ime otu onye na-ahụ maka ihe omume na-agba ọkụ kpọmkwem otu ngafe na njedebe. Nke a bụ ya mere => ~a = 1 => ~b = 2 ji dị ọnụ ala ọbụlagodi na ọtụtụ ndị na-agụ akwụkwọ.
reactivity.p3: Ịha nhata siri ike (===). Ide otu uru ahụ anaghị eme ihe ọ bụla. Iji ụdị nrụtụ aka ịmanye mmelite, kenye n'usoro ma ọ bụ ihe ọhụrụ.
reactivity.p4: A na-achọpụta cycles na ndabere agbakọrọ (~a := ~b + 1 na ~b := ~a - 1) n'oge nkwupụta wee kọwapụta dị ka mperi.
reactivity.p5: Mmelite Async: send() na-eweghachi uru na-emelite cell ị kenyere nsonaazụ ya, na-ahazi ngafe nyefe mgbe Nkwa ahụ kpebiri.

strings.p1: Ekwuru ụdọ abụọ: "Hello". A na-anabatakwa nhụta otu maka akara ngosi nwere JS.
strings.p2: Interpolation na-eji ihe nkwado gbagọrọ agbagọ n'ime eriri: "Hello, {~name}!". A na-anabata okwu ọ bụla - mkpụrụ ndụ, ụkpụrụ agbakọtara, oku ọrụ.
strings.p3: Ụmụ agwa mgbapụ: \n (ọhụrụline), \t (taabụ), \" (see okwu), \\ (azụ azụ), \{ (ihe nkwado nkịtị).
strings.p4: Multi-akara: gbajie n'ahịrị ọhụrụ n'ime nhota ndị ahụ. Oge ojiri gaa na-echekwa oghere ọcha kpọmkwem.
strings.p5: Nhazi: maka ngọngọ ederede nwere ọtụtụ njikọ, eriri agbakọtara bụ akpaala okwu. Chekwaa ya na cell ma depụta ya na UI.
strings.li1: Okwu interpolation na-emeghachi omume - ọgụgụ ọ bụla na-adabere na ndabere.
strings.li2: Ihe nkwado agbapụrụ agbapụ na-eme ka ihe nkwado nkịtị.
strings.li3: Nkwukọrịta efu {} ezighi ezi - mperi nyocha.
strings.li4: Concatenation na-eji + (mmanye eriri) maka ikpe dị mfe; interpolation na-agụ nke ọma maka ndebiri ogologo.

errors.p1: Wepụ njehie na-agba ọkụ n'oge ibu faịlụ. Oge ojiri gaa na-akọ ahịrị, kọlụm na ntụnye. Ihe na-akpatakarị: eriri na-adakọghị ọnụ, efu =, ihe mgbanwe amabeghị, eriri emechiri emechi.
errors.p2: Njehie oge ojiri agba ọkụ n'oge nyocha. Ọtụtụ na-emeghachi omume - okwu na-ezo aka na cell enweghị ọkwa, ma ọ bụ ụdị adabaghị na mgbakọ na mwepụ. Ndekọ oge ojiri gaa, na-egosi ọkọlọtọ ọbara ọbara na nhụchalụ, wee mafee mmelite etiti ahụ.
errors.p3: Njehie mgbanwe (mgbanwe amaghi ama, ụdị arụmụka na-ezighi ezi) na-agba ọkụ n'oge nzacha. Architex siri ike gbasara ihe mgbanwe amaghi ama iji kpuchido ndakọrịta n'ihu.
errors.p4: Ndozi: kechie okwu a na-enyo enyo na debug(...). Oge ojiri gaa na-edekọ nyocha ọ bụla na njikwa na-agbanweghị uru ya. Jikọọ na onye nyocha Architex ka ị banye na mgbanwe steeti.
errors.p5: Ntinye nchịkọta akụkọ: Architex IDE na Vortex bot studio na-egosipụta njehie ozugbo, tupu echekwaa faịlụ ahụ.
errors.cc2: ederede "x" :: onyinyo // ERROR: "onyinyo" abụghị ihe ngbanwe akwadoro
errors.cc4: ederede ~ ozi // ERROR: ~ ekwuputaghị ozi na ihuenyo a
errors.li1: Wepụ mperi na-akwụsị mmezu tupu nsụgharị ọ bụla amalite.
errors.li2: Njehie oge ịgba ọsọ na-awụpụ etiti mmejọ ahụ; na UI ma ọ bụghị na-anọgide na-anabata.
errors.li3: Idozi-n'ihu: gbanwee faịlụ ma chekwaa; na-agba ọsọ na-ekpo ọkụ-reloads.
errors.li4: Enweghị try / catch syntax - nkwurịta okwu bot na-eji send() doro anya yana ọrụ nsonaazụ.

host_builtins.p1: Ihe arụnyere ndị ọbịa bụ omume sitere n'elu ikpo okwu. Ha bụ gluu n'etiti DSL na ngwa gbara ya gburugburu.
host_builtins.p2: Klipbọọdụ: copy(~text) na-etinye arụmụka na bọọdụ; paste() => ~x = it na-agụ klipbọọdụ n'ime cell. share(~text) mepere mpempe akwụkwọ nkesa sistemụ.
host_builtins.p3: Haptics: haptic("light"|"medium"|"heavy") na-ebute nzaghachi na ngwaọrụ na-akwado. vibrate(ms) bụ uzu dị ogologo.
host_builtins.p4: Ngwa ngwa: alert("message") na-egosi modal nwere OK. confirm("message") => ~ok = it ihe ngosi OK + Kagbuo; it shorthand bụ uru nloghachi.
host_builtins.p5: Ntugharị: goto("ScreenName", arg: val, ...) na-akwagharị ihuenyo; back() pọpụ otu; close() wepụrụ Mini App niile.
host_builtins.p6: Nko ndụ okirikiri: @on mount, @on unmount, @on focus, @on blur. Onye ọ bụla na-ewere ihe mgbochi ahụ nke na-agba ọsọ mgbe ihe omume na-agba ọkụ.

bestpractices.cc3: aha isiokwu token n'usoro semant (~ isi, ~ ihe egwu)
bestpractices.cc4: jiri :: zoro ezo maka boolean UI, ọ bụghị ederede ternary
bestpractices.cc6: let the Runtime diff arrays — zere idebe akwụkwọ ntuziaka
bestpractices.cc7: tinye ogologo ndebiri na sel agbakọtara
bestpractices.cc8: zere akwu miri emi - ọkwa 3 nke kọlụm / ahịrị dị ukwuu
bestpractices.cc9: jiri @import kesaa akụrụngwa, ọ bụghị data
bestpractices.cc10: na-ahọrọ itolite + etiti karịa w/h doro anya maka nzaghachi
bestpractices.cc11: nwalee na obere + nnukwu steeti - ndepụta efu, ndepụta ogologo
bestpractices.cc12: jiri @on mount maka mbute data mbụ
bestpractices.p1: Architex na-akwụghachi ịdị mfe. Ihuenyo ọ bụla nke na-esiri ike ịgụ nwere ike nwere otu ọkwa nesting dị ukwuu, otu ọtụtụ inline ternary, ma ọ bụ otu akụkụ na-arụ ọrụ abụọ.
bestpractices.p2: Mgbe obi abụọ adịghị ya, wepụ. A 5-akara @component dị mfe grok karịa mgbochi 30-akara @screen.
bestpractices.p3: Na-ahọrọ ndị na-agbanwe agbanwe karịa mkpuchi. A text :: pad(16) dị mma karịa ikechi na col :: pad(16).
bestpractices.p4: Ka oge na-agba ọsọ rụọ ọrụ. Akwụkwọ ntuziaka hidden ọkọlọtọ maka ihe ọ bụla dị na ndepụta na-emebi emebi - oge ịgba ọsọ adịlarị.
bestpractices.p5: Kpọọ ihe maka onye na-agụ ya, ọ bụghị onye nchịkọta. ~isLoading > ⟪1.
bestpractices.li1: N'okpuru ahịrị 200 kwa ihuenyo - kewaa ma ọ bụrụ ogologo oge
bestpractices.li2: Ọ dịghị ihe karịrị 3 ọkwa nesting - refactor ma ọ bụrụ na miri emi
bestpractices.li3: Ọ dịghị ihe karịrị 2 ternaries kwa okwu - jiri a gbakọọ
bestpractices.li4: Ọ dịghị ihe karịrị 1 ihuenyo kwa faịlụ - ọ gwụla ma ejikọtara ya

forms.p1: Ntinye na-ejikọta ụzọ abụọ na cell arụ ọrụ: input ~email. Mpi na-emelite cell; imelite cell na-emelite ubi.
forms.p2: Nkwenye bụ ihe agbakọrọ agbakọọ: ~emailOk := ~email.matches("^[^@]+@[^@]+\.[^@]+$"). Jiri ihe ndozi hidden/visible na akara mperi.
forms.p3: Nyefee bụ bọtịnụ nkịtị nwere omume ejiri eriri. Gbochie nrubeisi mgbe nkwado na-ada site na disabled(!~formOk).
forms.p4: Ngosipụta mperi: jiri visible(!~fieldOk) gosi text ma ọ bụ label iji gosi naanị mgbe adịghị mma. Tinye color(~danger) maka imesi ike anya.
forms.p5: Debouncing: tinye :: debounce(300) iji gbuo oge nkwado netwọkụ kwadoro ruo mgbe onye ọrụ kwụsịrị ịpị 300 ms.
forms.p6: Ndokwa: :: placeholder("...") na-egosi ntụnye mgbe cell tọhapụrụ. Ndụmọdụ na-apụ n'anya na mkpịsị igodo mbụ.
forms.p7: Ụdị ntinye: larịị input bụ ederede; input.email, input.number, input.password, input.tel, input.date gbanwee kiiboodu na ihe mkpuchi.
forms.cc3: akara "Email na-ezighi ezi" :: agba (~ ihe ize ndụ) a na-ahụ anya (! ~ emailOk && ~ email != "")
forms.cc4: bọtịnụ " Nyefee" :: nkwarụ(!~emailOk) => zipu (omume: " nyefee", email: ~ email)
forms.cc6: ntinye ~ search :: debounce(300) => zipu (omume: "nyocha", q: ~ search)
forms.li1: Njide bụ ụzọ abụọ - dee ihe na-agbanwe cell na ọzọ.
forms.li2: Nkwado bụ naanị cell boolean agbakọtara.
forms.li3: Gosi/zobe mperi site na iji ihe mgbanwe visibiliti.
forms.li5: Wepu nkwado netwọk kwadoro iji zere spam.

animations.p1: Architex na-eme ihe n'ezoghị ọnụ mgbe uru na-emeghachi omume na-emegharị ọnụọgụ ma ọ bụ mgbanwe agba. Ntughari mbu bu 200 ms mfe-apụ. Wepu :: animate(ms, curve).

network.p1: send(action: "name", ...args) bụ àkwà mmiri maka ndị ọbịa bot. Onye ọbịa ahụ na-enweta ozi JSON RPC, usoro na weghachi nsonaazụ.
network.p2: E kenyere nsonaazụ ya na cell site na => ~result = it. it bụ mkpirisi maka uru nloghachi.
network.p3: Ọdịda n'elu dị ka ~result.error. Lelee tupu ịgụ akwụkwọ ~result.data. Jiri ternaries akwụ ụgwọ maka nbudata / ịga nke ọma / njehie steeti.
network.p4: Steeti na-ebu ibu bụ boolean nke gị: tụgharịa cell ~loading tupu oku akuku, tụgharịa azụ ma emechaa. Gosi akụrụngwa spinner etinyere na ~loading.
network.p5: Ọnọdụ agbụrụ: ọ bụrụ na onye ọrụ kpalitere send ugboro abụọ tupu nke mbụ ekpebie, nke abụọ ga-edegharị cell ahụ. Iji gbochie, ọnụ ụzọ nwere disabled(~loading).

performance.h3: Zere ịrụ ọrụ na igodo igodo ọ bụla
performance.p1: Nmeghachi omume bụ nke ọma: naanị ihe ndị na-agụ mkpụrụ ndụ gbanwere agbanwe. Ọ dịghị ihe ị na-ede "n'efu" na-akpalite a zuru ezu regharịa osisi.
performance.p2: Ndepụta puku ihe dị mma. Oge ojiri gaa dị iche site na njirimara elementrị, yabụ prepending bụ O(1). Zenarị okwu agbakọtara nke na-enyochagharị ndepụta niile na mgbanwe ọ bụla - gbajie ọrụ ahụ n'ime mkpụrụ ndụ agbakọtara n'otu ihe.

runtime.p1: Oge ojiri gaa Architex bụ ngwugwu TypeScript ebipụtara dị ka architex. Ọ nwere modul anọ: lexer, parser, renderer, reactive.
runtime.p2: Onye na-agụ akwụkwọ na-agụ ederede isi mmalite wee wepụta akara ngosi. Ọ bụ naanị akụrụngwa na-eche banyere oghere ọcha - modul ọ bụla na-agbadata na-arụ ọrụ na tokens na AST nodes.
runtime.p3: Ntụsa ahụ na-ewu AST. A na-apịpị ọnụ ọnụ AST ma nwee ike izipu ha n'ofe oke usoro (ọ bara uru maka mbugharị ọkụ na nlele anya).
runtime.p4: Onye na-enye ihe na-aga AST na ntụgharị ntụgharị nke onye ọbịa nyere (web DOM / SwiftUI bridge / Compose bridge) wee wepụta echiche obodo.
runtime.p5: Ndị ụsụụ ndị agha na-arụ ọrụ dị warara: createNode, updateNode, removeNode, gbakwunyere ngwa mgbanwe. Ịgbakwunye onye ọbịa ọhụrụ na-ewe ihe dị ka ahịrị 500 nke koodu gluu.
runtime.li3: Onye nrụpụta: na-aga AST, ndị nnọchi anya onye ọbịa.
runtime.li4: Reactive: nsuso ndabere akpaghị aka + mmelite bated.

migration.p1: Architex na-esote semver. Patches anaghị agbaji ihe ọ bụla. Ụmụaka na-agbakwụnye atụmatụ. Majors nwere ike mebie ihe na windo nkwụsị nke ọnwa 12.
migration.p2: Atụmatụ emebi emebi na-aga n'ihu na-arụ ọrụ site na obere usoro niile. Oge ojiri gaa na-edekọ ịdọ aka ná ntị mbelata na ojiji mbụ; na IDE na-egosipụta koodu emebiela.
migration.p3: Kọmpat na-aga n'ihu: faịlụ ndị edere megide obere ụdị mbụ na-eme otu ihe mgbe oge na-aga. Ọ dịghị mgbe anyị na-agbanwe mgbanwe semantics.
migration.p4: A na-ekwupụta mgbanwe na-emebi emebi n'ime loglog nwere ntuziaka mbugharị. Ngwa mbugharị akpaaka na-ekpuchi ọtụtụ mgbanwe igwe.
migration.p5: LTS: ụdị isi ọ bụla nwere windo nkwado ọnwa 24 maka ndozi nchekwa dị oke egwu, ọbụlagodi ụgbọ mmiri ndị ọzọ na-esote.

faq.p1: Ajụjụ: Enwere m ike dee ngwa zuru ezu na Architex? A: Emebere Architex maka Mini Apps - ihuenyo bi n'ime nkata. Maka ngwa ala ala zuru oke ịchọrọ SwiftUI / Mepụta / meghachi omume.
faq.p2: Ajụjụ: Kedu ka o si atụnyere Flutter? A: Flutter ka sara mbara mana ọ nwere oge ịgba ọsọ nke ya (Dart VM + Skia). Architex dị ntakịrị ma na-arụ ọrụ na primitives ndị ọbịa. Ọ bụrụ na ịchọrọ mkpọchi ikpo okwu, Flutter; Ọ bụrụ na ịchọrọ iru, Architex.
faq.p3: Ajụjụ: Gịnị kpatara enweghị if ngọngọ? A: N'ihi na hidden / visible modifiers na-ekpuchi 95%% nke ọnọdụ UI nke ọma karị. Maka 5%% nke ọzọ, okwu ternary na-arụ ọrụ.
faq.p4: Ajụjụ: Architex ọ bụ mepere emepe? A: Ee - hụ GitHub repo. Oge ojiri ikike MIT, enweghị eriri patent.
faq.p5: Ajụjụ: Enwere m ike ịkpọ koodu obodo? A: Naanị site n'ọrụ arụnyere arụnyere ma ọ bụ bot send(). A naghị akwado ụma na-akwado ya - ọ ga-emebi ibugharị.
faq.p6: Ajụjụ: Ihe mgbagwoju anya ihuenyo kacha? A: Oge ojiri gaa na-ejikwa sel 10k na-arụ ọrụ na ihe ndepụta 100k. E wezụga nke ahụ, gbaba n'ime ọtụtụ ihuenyo.
faq.p7: Ajụjụ: Enwere m ike ịnọgide na-ekwu? A: Ee, site na store(key, value) (kwa-Obere-App mpaghara) ma ọ bụ send(action: "save") gaa na bot (akụkụ nkesa).
faq.p8: Ajụjụ: Ọ na-arụ ọrụ na-anọghị n'ịntanetị? A: Ee maka ihuenyo dị ọcha-UI. Ihe ọ bụla na-akpọ send() chọrọ netwọkụ.
faq.p9: Ajụjụ: Kedu ka m ga-esi tinye mpaghara omenala? A: Ma @component n'ime Architex, ma ọ bụ (ọ bụrụ na ịchọrọ primitives nke ala) tinye aka na ngwungwu ndị ọbịa Architex.
faq.p10: Ajụjụ: Arụmọrụ n'elu vs nwa afọ ejiri aka dee? A: Ọ na-adịkarị 3-8% % iji nwayọ karịa SwiftUI / Mepụta ejiri aka dee. Mmadụ-enweghị ike ime maka ihuenyo nkịtị.

gotchas.p1: Architex na-eji oghere 2 n'otu ọkwa nbanye. Ajụrụ taabụ n'oge nzacha. Ọtụtụ IDE na-atụgharị na-akpaghị aka; ọ bụrụ na ị hụ mperi mperi na-atụghị anya ya, lelee maka oghere ọcha agwakọtara.
gotchas.p2: Mmechi n'okwu agbakọrọ na-agụ mkpụrụ ndụ na-arụ ọrụ n'oge nleba anya, ọ bụghị n'oge nkwupụta. ~a := ~b + 1 na-eji ugbu a ~b, ọ bụghị uru dị na nkwupụta.
gotchas.p3: Async send() na-ekenye na cell mgbe Nkwa ahụ kpebiri, nke nwere ike ịpụ n'usoro ma ọ bụrụ na ọtụtụ izipu na-agba ọsọ. Jiri ọkọlọtọ ~loading chekwaa ma ọ bụ nọmba usoro.
gotchas.p4: Ụdị mmanye: "5" + 1 na-enyocha ka "51", ọ bụghị 6. Jiri Number("5") ma ọ bụ kọwaa cell dị ka : number.
gotchas.p5: Ihe arụrụ arụ nke ọma: imegharị ihe (~obj.x = 5) anaghị akpalite mmelite na ndị na-agụ ~obj. Tinyegharịa ihe ahụ dum kama.
gotchas.p6: Usoro mgbanwe n'ime ezinaụlọ: ndị na-agbanwe agba na-edozi mmeri ikpeazụ-edere. Ejila agbụ abụọ color(...) na-atụ anya ngwakọta.
gotchas.p7: @for ahụ a ga-agbanyerịrị otu ọkwa miri emi. Nwatakịrị nọ n'ọkwa abụọ abụghị njehie ntugharị kama ọ bụ akwụghị nke semantic - oge ịgba ọsọ na-ewere ya dị ka nwanne nke @for.

gotchas.li5: Ndị na-agbanwe agba na-edozi mmeri ikpeazụ-odee.
